paper.title: Geometric and Behavioral Stratification in Transformer Residual Streams
paper.abstract: Trained transformer models develop privileged bases: coordinate axes whose statistics differ from the rest of the residual stream. But what kind of direction does such a basis select? We investigate the prediction direction, the unembedding direction of the token a model currently predicts, and find that it functions as a content-defined privileged anchor. Measured with respect to this anchor, residual-stream variation is geometrically and behaviorally stratified by proximity to the prediction.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 Transformer residual stream 中的“特权基”到底对应什么功能方向。核心结论是：当前预测 token 的 unembedding 方向不仅是 logit readout 的诊断轴，也是 residual stream 几何结构的锚点。围绕这个方向，模型把少量与读出直接相关的变化压缩在很窄的 prediction interface 中，同时把大部分 residual variation 放在远离 readout 的补空间里。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析和训练动态解释。论文提示，AR 训练下的线性 unembedding readout 会在 residual stream 中形成稳定的几何分层：预测相关信息需要靠近读出方向，其他计算状态则尽量保持远离，以免干扰 logits。这有助于理解为什么宽模型增加了大量维度，但直接服务于当前 token readout 的有效维度并不随宽度线性扩大。它也给 logit lens、activation patching、表示压缩、残差流正则化等分析方法提供了更具体的几何坐标系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 prediction-anchored decomposition，作者称为 PDSF。给定某个位置的 residual state，先取当前 argmax token 的 unembedding 向量作为 prediction direction，并将 residual state 分解出 rank-1 投影 P。然后在去掉 P 后的残差上做 PCA，取高方差子空间 D；再在去掉 P+D 后的残差上做第二轮 PCA，取子空间 S；剩余正交补空间记为 F。P+D+S 被定义为 prediction interface，F 是 prediction-distal complement。这个设计和普通 PCA 的差别在于，它先固定一个由模型自身预测决定的功能轴，再看方差如何围绕该轴分层，而不是只找全局高方差方向。论文进一步比较不同 prompt set 下各子空间的有效维度、方差分布、读出相关性和对生成的作用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 18 个 Transformer 模型，来自 Llama、Gemma、Mistral、Mixtral、Qwen、GPT-OSS 六类模型族，包含 dense 与 MoE、base 与 instruction-tuned，参数规模约 7B 到 120B。作者在三个结构化 prompt sets 上分析 residual stream。主要结果是：在受约束的一 token 回答任务中，prediction-proximal 的 D 子空间有效维度通常只有个位数，整个 prediction interface 的有效维度少于 20；这个窄接口在不同模型宽度上近似保持稳定。与此同时，F 补空间占据绝大部分维度，每个方向与 readout 的对齐较弱，但并非无用噪声，而是对时间推进和后续生成有因果作用。一个关键观察是 residual stream 的变化更多体现为方向组织，而不是单纯的范数变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和方法部分的 PDSF 定义，再看实验图中关于 effective dimensionality、variance proximity、prediction interface 宽度随模型规模变化的结果。重点不是具体 PCA 技巧，而是“先固定当前预测 token 的 unembedding 方向，再分析 residual geometry”的框架。预计阅读 30 到 45 分钟。若做 interpretability 或 pretrain dynamics，可以深挖两个问题：第一，prediction interface 的宽度为何随模型宽度近似不变；第二，F 补空间如何在远离 readout 的同时仍保留对未来 token 的因果信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what functional role the privileged basis in transformer residual streams plays. Its main claim is that the unembedding direction of the token currently predicted by the model is not only a diagnostic readout axis, but also a geometric anchor. Residual-stream variation stratifies by proximity to this prediction direction: a small prediction interface carries readout-relevant structure, while most variation lives in a prediction-distal complement.
summary_en.importance: The result is useful for understanding pretraining dynamics and residual-stream organization. Autoregressive training with a fixed linear unembedding appears to induce a narrow geometric channel through which computation becomes legible to logits. Increasing model width does not simply expand the number of dimensions directly used for current-token readout; instead, much of the added capacity lies in directions weakly aligned with the unembedding. This has practical implications for logit-lens analysis, activation patching, representation compression, and hypotheses about how wide models separate computation from readout.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main tool is a prediction-anchored decomposition called PDSF. For each residual state, the method first takes the unembedding vector of the current argmax token as the prediction direction and extracts the rank-1 projection P. It then performs PCA on the residual after removing P to obtain a high-variance subspace D, performs another PCA after removing P+D to obtain S, and treats the remaining orthogonal subspace as F. The union P+D+S is called the prediction interface, while F is the prediction-distal complement. This differs from ordinary PCA because the first axis is not chosen by variance; it is chosen by the model’s own readout geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 18 transformer models from six families: Llama, Gemma, Mistral, Mixtral, Qwen, and GPT-OSS. The suite includes dense and MoE models, base and instruction-tuned variants, and sizes from roughly 7B to 120B parameters. Across three structured prompt sets, the prediction-proximal region remains small. On constrained one-token-answer prompts, the D subspace has single-digit effective dimensionality, and the full prediction interface has fewer than about 20 effective dimensions. This narrowness is approximately invariant to model width. The F complement contains most dimensions and is weakly aligned with readout on a per-direction basis, but it remains causally and temporally important for generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the geometric framing, then read the PDSF method carefully. The most useful figures are those showing effective dimensionality, variance stratification by prediction proximity, and how the prediction interface scales with model width. Expected reading time is 30–45 minutes. For deeper work, focus on two questions: why the readout-proximal interface stays narrow, and how the distal complement can remain far from the current readout while still carrying information needed for future generation.

recommendation.zh: 跨 dense/MoE/规模一致的几何观察很扎实，prediction-distal 空间随规模扩张这一点值得在内部机制分析里复现。
recommendation.en: The geometric finding is consistent across dense, MoE, and scales; the claim that prediction-distal subspace expands with model size is worth reproducing in internal mechanistic ablations.

paper.title: Memorization Diagnostics for Code LLMs Should be Scale-Aware
paper.abstract: The extent to which large language models for code rely on memorization over genuine understanding remains highly debated. While current literature frequently reports widespread memorization, evaluating the underlying probing techniques across dense architectures reveals a severe breakdown in their utility at scale. Traditional encoder-style probes using perturbations such as synonym fuzzing or dead-code insertion struggle to expose memorization in scaled models, even on known-contaminated bench

summary.core_problem: 现有代码LLM的记忆化诊断探针在模型规模扩大时会饱和失效，且未区分记忆化与表征负载两个独立维度，无法准确判断大模型的代码能力来源。
summary.importance: 说明代码LLM的能力评估与数据质量诊断需考虑规模效应，小模型上有效的探针不能直接迁移到大模型；同时提示预训练应强化算法知识的跨表征泛化能力，而非仅优化训练分布内的表面匹配性能，提出的I/O同构探针可补充现有评测体系用于检测数据污染与真实推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 先系统验证主流编码器侧（同义词替换）、解码器侧（对数概率偏移）记忆探针在不同规模模型上的有效性，确认其规模饱和特性；再正式定义与记忆化独立的「表征负载」维度，即模型在核心算法不变、接口偏离训练表面形式时的正确性保持能力；最后提出基于双射数值变换（仿射变换、进制转换等）的I/O同构探针，通过在提示中加入编解码契约，在数学上保证核心任务不变的同时增加表征负载，迫使模型无法依赖记忆。
summary.experiments: 在已知污染的代码基准上测试不同规模密集架构代码LLM发现：1）主流编码器/解码器侧记忆探针的判别能力随模型规模增大显著下降直至饱和；2）表征负载提升会降低所有规模模型性能，但该下降不直接对应记忆化程度；3）操作码分析显示大模型在高表征负载下仍能生成原任务的解决方案家族（仅成功率降低），小模型则会丢失整个解决方案家族。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注探针饱和的问题定义、表征负载与记忆化的分离框架、I/O同构探针的构造逻辑与操作码分析结果；预计阅读时间25-35分钟，可重点留意探针的数学保证设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing memorization diagnostics for code LLMs saturate and lose discriminative power as model scale increases, and they fail to separate memorization from the distinct dimension of representational load, making it impossible to accurately identify the source of large code models' problem-solving capability.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that code LLM evaluation and data quality diagnostics must account for scale effects, as probes validated on small models cannot be directly applied to large ones; pretraining should prioritize cross-representation generalization of algorithmic knowledge over surface-form matching within the training distribution, and the proposed I/O isomorphism probe can supplement existing evaluation pipelines to detect data contamination and measure true reasoning capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: First systematically validates the effectiveness of two mainstream memorization probe families (encoder-side synonym substitution, decoder-side log-likelihood shift) across dense code LLMs of varying scales, confirming their scale saturation property; then formalizes representational load as a dimension independent of memorization, defined as the ability to maintain correctness when core algorithmic logic is fixed but interfaces deviate from training-distribution surface forms; finally proposes an I/O isomorphism probe based on bijective numerical transforms (affine transforms, base conversion, etc.), which adds an explicit encode/decode contract to prompts to mathematically preserve the core task while increasing representational load, forcing the model to avoid relying on memorization.
summary_en.experiments: Tests on dense code LLMs of varying scales across known-contaminated code benchmarks yield three key results: 1) The discriminative power of mainstream encoder/decoder-side memorization probes drops significantly with model scale until full saturation; 2) Increased representational load degrades performance across all scales, but this drop does not directly correlate with memorization level; 3) Opcode analysis shows large models still produce solution families matching the original task under high representational load (only with lower success rates), while small models lose entire solution families entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus on the probe saturation problem formulation, the framework separating representational load from memorization, the construction logic of the I/O isomorphism probe, and opcode analysis results; estimated reading time 25-35 minutes, with extra attention to the mathematical guarantee design of the probe.

recommendation.zh: 对做数据污染/记忆化分析的人是一记提醒：小模型上 work 的 probe 在大模型上会假阴，结论方向比方法更重要，看 §4 的解耦实验即可。
recommendation.en: A useful warning that memorization probes validated on small models give false negatives at scale; read §4 for the disentanglement, ignore the rest if you're not in contamination eval.

paper.title: SAEVerbalizer: Generating Explanations for Sparse Autoencoder Features via Representation Verbalization
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are proposed to extract numerous features from large language model (LLM) representations, yet explaining these features still relies primarily on external observation. This reliance leads to superficial explanations inferred from observed model behavior and computational inefficiency from collecting such behavioral evidence at scale. We introduce SAEVerbalizer, a framework that injects SAE decoder directions into an LLM's representations and fine-tunes the LLM's downs

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 SAE 特征解释的可扩展性问题。现有做法通常先在大语料上收集某个 SAE feature 的 top-activating examples，再让 LLM 总结这些文本的共同模式。这种方法计算成本高，而且解释的是激活样本的表面共性，不一定是 decoder direction 在模型表示空间里的语义。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析工具。SAE 已经成为分析 LLM 内部表示的重要工具，但 feature labeling 仍然是瓶颈。SAEVerbalizer 尝试让模型直接把内部方向翻译成自然语言，为大规模解释 SAE 字典提供一种更便宜的路径。它也提示一个有趣问题：LLM 的中间表示是否能被训练成可 verbalize 的对象，而不只是在外部行为上被观察。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是把 SAE decoder direction 当作唯一的 feature-specific 输入，注入到 verbalizer backbone 的某一层 hidden states 中，然后微调后续网络生成自然语言解释。注入采用 norm-matched additive injection：先归一化 decoder direction，再按注入 span 内 hidden state 的平均范数缩放，并用 α 控制强度。这样做可以减少不同 feature direction 范数差异带来的干扰。对于来自另一个 LLM 的 SAE，作者训练一个轻量 affine adapter，把源模型某层表示空间映射到 verbalizer 的注入层空间。和基于 top activations 的解释方法相比，这里不需要为每个 feature 重新跑语料、取激活、检索样本和调用解释模型。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，训练后的 verbalizer 可以解释未见过的 SAE features，并能迁移到单独训练的 SAE dictionaries。加入轻量 adapter 后，也可以处理来自不同 LLM 的 SAE features。消融实验检查了额外监督、prompt 变化和注入方式变化的影响；干预实验包括 joint injection 和 direction reversal，用来观察 verbalizer 是否对表示方向有可控响应。摘要和正文片段未给出具体数值，因此不宜把结果解读为已经替代基于激活样本的人工审查。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。重点看方法部分的 injection 设计、归一化方式和 cross-LLM adapter；再看实验中关于 unseen features、跨 SAE dictionary、跨 LLM 的评估。需要特别关注 supervision 的来源和评价协议：如果训练标签仍来自 top-activating examples 或自动解释器，verbalizer 可能学习的是已有标签分布，而不是完全独立地读出内部语义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the bottleneck of explaining sparse autoencoder features at scale. Standard SAE labeling relies on collecting top-activating examples from a large corpus and asking another model to summarize them. This is expensive and often describes patterns in the examples rather than the internal direction itself.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is mainly interpretability. SAEs are widely used to inspect LLM representations, but feature labeling remains costly. SAEVerbalizer proposes a way to verbalize decoder directions directly, which could make large SAE dictionaries easier to analyze. It also probes whether internal representation directions can be converted into language by a trained model, rather than only inferred from external activations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework injects an SAE decoder direction into the hidden states of a verbalizer backbone at a chosen layer and then trains the downstream computation to generate a natural-language explanation. The injection is norm matched: the decoder direction is normalized, scaled to the average norm of the hidden states in the injection span, and controlled by a strength parameter α. This reduces confounding from raw direction norms. For SAE features from another LLM, a lightweight affine adapter maps source-model directions into the verbalizer’s injection-layer representation space. Unlike activation-example methods, the feature-specific input is only the decoder direction; no retrieved texts are supplied at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show generalization to unseen SAE features, transfer across independently trained SAE dictionaries, and extension to features from other LLMs through a small adapter. Ablations study the effect of additional supervision and robustness to prompt and injection variations. Intervention analyses include joint injection and direction reversal to test whether generations respond coherently to changes in the injected direction. The provided text does not include exact numerical gains, so the result should be read as a promising interpretation tool rather than a complete replacement for activation-based inspection.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the injection mechanism, the normalization choice, and the affine adapter for cross-model transfer. Then check the unseen-feature and cross-dictionary experiments. The key thing to verify is the source of supervision and the evaluation protocol, because a verbalizer trained on existing explanations may reproduce the biases of those labels.

recommendation.zh: SAE特征解释的新范式，跳过行为观测直接从解码器方向生成解释，重点看§3方法和§4迁移实验
recommendation.en: A new paradigm for SAE feature explanation that skips behavioral observation and generates explanations directly from decoder directions; focus on §3 methods and §4 transfer experiments

paper.title: Falsehood and Impossibility Are Different Directions in an AI's Representation of Language
paper.abstract: Language can describe states of affairs that are false and states of affairs that could not be the case at all. Whether an AI model internally distinguishes these failures remains unclear. I report an exploratory activation study of the multimodal open-weight model Gemma 3 4B IT using 85 prompts from 17 philosophical families and a topic-matched modality set of 15 topics, each expressed as a truth, contingent falsehood, improbable claim, semantic anomaly, and necessary falsehood. In its answers,

summary.core_problem: 探测多模态开源模型 Gemma 3 4B IT 是否在内部表示中区分“事实为假”和“逻辑上不可能”。
summary.importance: 贡献是小规模机制分析：行为输出把偶然假命题和矛盾混在一起，但激活探针显示两者在表示空间中可分。样本量很小，结论应作为假设种子而非强证据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造 17 个哲学问题族的 85 个 prompt，以及 15 个主题的配对模态集合；每个主题包含真命题、偶然假命题、不太可能命题、语义异常和必然假命题。随后在 Gemma 3 4B IT 的层激活上训练线性 truth probe 和 impossibility probe，并做 held-out topic family 评估。
summary.experiments: 模型回答中将 15 个偶然假陈述里的 12 个标成 contradiction。激活上，truth probe 能区分 impossible 与 true，AUC 0.93，但不能区分 impossible 与 false，AUC 0.20；impossibility probe 在 held-out topic families 上区分 necessary falsehood 和 contingent falsehood，AUC 1.00，layer 15 达到 balanced accuracy 0.97，Bonferroni 校正 P=0.018。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper probes whether Gemma 3 4B IT internally distinguishes contingent falsehood from logical impossibility.
summary_en.importance: It is a small-scale mechanistic analysis: model outputs conflate contingent falsehood with contradiction, while activations suggest separable representational directions. The sample size is small, so the result is best treated as a hypothesis generator.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author uses 85 prompts from 17 philosophical families and a topic-matched modality set with 15 topics, each expressed as a truth, contingent falsehood, improbable claim, semantic anomaly, and necessary falsehood. Linear truth and impossibility probes are trained on Gemma 3 4B IT activations and evaluated on held-out topic families.
summary_en.experiments: In outputs, the model labels 12 of 15 false statements as contradictions. In activations, a truth probe separates impossible from true statements with AUC 0.93 but not impossible from false statements with AUC 0.20. An impossibility probe separates necessary from contingent falsehood with AUC 1.00 on held-out topic families, peaking at layer 15 with balanced accuracy 0.97 and Bonferroni-adjusted P=0.018.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

recommendation.zh: 小样本探针论文，只适合记下 falsehood/impossibility 分离这个假设；不要据此更新模型语义表征的强 prior。
recommendation.en: A small-probe study: log the falsehood-versus-impossibility separation hypothesis, but do not strongly update your priors on semantic representations.

paper.title: Conflict and Congruency Effects in Large Language Models: In-Weight and In-Context Competition in a Verbal Conflict Task
paper.abstract: Congruency effects, observed in conflict tasks such as Stroop and flanker tasks, have been investigated for nearly a century in psychology and neuroscience, but their mechanistic basis is not fully understood. We introduce a verbal-only LLM conflict task in which a prompt stem elicits a default same-color completion and an explicit rule either agrees with (congruent condition) or conflicts with (incongruent condition) the completion. Gemma-2-2B and six Pythia models ranging from 410M to 12B para

summary.core_problem: 心理学冲突任务（如Stroop任务）中的一致性效应已有近百年研究历史，但其底层机制尚未完全明确；现有双过程理论、并行分布处理（PDP）模型要么缺乏具体算法级的机制解释，要么人为硬编码了响应通路和控制结构，无法回答通用预训练的模型是否会自发涌现出类似的自动-控制双通路；同时已有研究观测到LLM中存在一致性效应，但尚未用机制可解释性工具拆解其内部加工通路。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的具体启发包括两点：一是验证了仅通过next-token自监督预训练，Transformer架构就能自发涌现出两种独立的响应通路（权重内存储的默认响应、上下文即时解析的规则驱动响应）及其竞争机制，为理解预训练如何催生高级认知控制能力提供了实证依据；二是定位了两种控制来源对应的神经通路差异，为后续通过调整预训练目标、数据配比来优化模型的指令遵循能力、抗干扰能力提供了可解释性层面的抓手。
summary.technical_approach: 设计纯语言形式的LLM冲突任务：提示词词干会触发模型产生默认的同色补全倾向，同时给出的显式规则分为与默认倾向一致（一致条件）和冲突（不一致条件）两种。选取Gemma-2-2B和6个参数量从410M到12B的Pythia模型作为测试对象，采用因果归因分析、注意力分析、注意力消融三种机制可解释性工具，定位LLM中处理默认响应和规则控制响应的不同加工通路。
summary.experiments: 7个测试模型中有6个表现出显著的一致性效应（冲突条件下性能明显下降），所有模型都存在强烈的默认同色补全倾向。通过可解释性方法识别出两条功能独立的加工通路：一条是依赖短程注意力、调用权重内预训练语义知识的默认响应通路，另一条是依赖长程注意力、负责解析和执行上下文显式规则的控制通路。注意力消融实验验证了两条通路的因果作用：关闭对应通路会选择性损害对应条件下的模型性能，不会影响另一条件的表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读引言中对现有心理学模型局限性的梳理，重点关注第3章的纯语言冲突任务设计逻辑，再阅读第4-5章的通路定位结果与消融验证实验。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Congruency effects in psychological conflict tasks (e.g., the Stroop task) have been studied for nearly a century, but their underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Existing dual-process theories and parallel distributed processing (PDP) models either lack concrete algorithmic mechanistic explanations, or artificially hard-code response pathways and control structures, so they cannot answer whether general-purpose pretrained models spontaneously emerge similar automatic-controlled dual pathways. While congruency effects have been observed in LLMs in prior work, their internal processing pathways have not been dissected with mechanistic interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: This work brings two concrete implications for pretraining research. First, it verifies that Transformer architectures trained only with next-token self-supervised learning can spontaneously emerge two independent response pathways (default responses stored in weights, rule-driven responses parsed online from context) and their competition mechanism, providing empirical evidence for how pretraining produces high-level cognitive control capabilities. Second, it locates the neural pathway differences corresponding to the two control sources, offering interpretability-level handles for optimizing LLM instruction following and interference resistance by adjusting pretraining objectives or data mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: A verbal-only LLM conflict task is designed: a prompt stem elicits a default same-color completion tendency in models, while an explicit rule provided in the prompt is either congruent (consistent with the default tendency) or incongruent (conflicting with it). Gemma-2-2B and six Pythia models with parameters ranging from 410M to 12B are selected as test subjects. Three mechanistic interpretability tools — causal attribution analysis, attention analysis, and attention ablation — are adopted to locate distinct processing pathways for default responses and rule-controlled responses in LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Six of the seven tested models show significant congruency effects (notable performance degradation under incongruent conditions), and all models exhibit strong default same-color completion tendencies. Two functionally independent processing pathways are identified via interpretability methods: a default response pathway that relies on short-range attention and invokes in-weight pretrained semantic knowledge, and a control pathway that relies on long-range attention and is responsible for parsing and executing explicit in-context rules. Attention ablation experiments validate the causal role of both pathways: disabling a target pathway selectively impairs model performance under the corresponding condition, without affecting performance under the other condition.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: First read the Introduction for the review of limitations in existing psychological models, focus on Section 3 for the design logic of the verbal-only conflict task, then read Sections 4-5 for pathway localization results and ablation validation experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 双通路机制的识别方法可迁移到预训练训练动态分析，重点看§4因果归因与注意力消融实验设计。
recommendation.en: The dual-pathway identification methodology is transferable to pretraining training dynamic analysis; focus on §4 causal attribution and attention ablation experimental design.

paper.title: Decodable But Not Detachable: Training Data Granularity Determines Parametric Modularity in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Do large language models contain domain-specific parametric shells: concentrated, causally necessary neuron populations whose removal selectively degrades a target domain while sparing others? We apply a uniform causal methodology across two domain granularities, three model families (1.5B to 7B parameters), and eight domains. At the academic subject level, zero neurons exceed 60\% domain selectivity across 939,008 combined FFN neurons and causal damage matrices are flat, despite domain identity

summary.core_problem: 大语言模型中是否存在可独立移除的领域特异性参数模块，以及这类模块化结构的形成条件与训练数据粒度的关联，此前研究结论存在矛盾。
summary.importance: 明确了参数模块化的形成边界——仅当训练数据在token层面具备领域模块化时才会形成可分离的参数壳，对预训练数据配比、多语言/多模态数据组织、模型压缩、选择性微调等方向有直接指导意义；代码神经元承载数学推理能力的发现，为代码预训练提升通用推理的机制提供了参数层面的证据。
summary.technical_approach: 采用统一的因果消融方法，跨两种领域粒度（学科级、语言/模态级）、三个模型家族（1.5B到7B参数，共93.9万个FFN神经元），通过领域激活份额识别选择性神经元，再通过屏蔽实验测量各领域的性能变化，结合随机基线和IoU等指标评估模块化程度。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括：一是学科级领域无符合60%选择性阈值的神经元，虽可线性解码领域身份但无法参数分离；二是语言/模态级有0.65%-1.14%的神经元达到60%选择性，损伤矩阵接近对角（领域内/跨领域损伤比最高595:1），领域间神经元几乎不重叠（IoU<0.003）；三是2%的神经元承载约94%的领域特异性功能负载，模型越大参数壳的功能负载越强；四是代码选择性神经元同时承载数学推理能力，非英语神经元集中在末层，选择性神经元空间交错无法做组级选择性量化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中对先前研究矛盾的梳理，以及方法部分的因果消融设计（骨干神经元排除、随机基线控制）；重点关注粒度边界和规模效应的结论，无需深挖统计细节，预计阅读25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether large language models contain independently removable domain-specific parametric modules, and how the formation of such modular structures relates to training data granularity, remains unresolved with conflicting findings in prior work.
summary_en.importance: The work defines a clear boundary for parametric modularity: separable domain shells form only when training data is modular at the token level. This directly informs pretraining data mixture design, multilingual/multimodal data organization, model compression, and selective fine-tuning. The finding that code-selective neurons carry mathematical reasoning capability also provides parametric evidence for the mechanism behind code pretraining improving general reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified causal ablation methodology is applied across two domain granularities (academic subject, language/modality) and three model families (1.5B to 7B parameters, 939,008 total FFN neurons). Selective neurons are identified via a domain activation share metric, excluding top 0.1% globally active backbone neurons. Causal damage is measured by masking selective neurons and evaluating performance changes across all domains, compared against a count-matched random neuron baseline, with IoU used to measure overlap between domain neuron sets.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: first, zero neurons meet the 60% selectivity threshold at the academic subject level — domain identity is linearly decodable (>85% accuracy) but not parametrically detachable, with flat damage matrices. Second, 0.65–1.14% of neurons exceed 60% selectivity at the language/modality level, with near-diagonal damage matrices (intra-to-cross domain damage ratio up to 595:1) and nearly disjoint neuron sets (IoU < 0.003). Third, 2% of neurons carry ~94% of domain-specific functional load, and shell load increases monotonically with model scale (1.82 to 3.37 nats from 1.5B to 7B parameters). Fourth, code-selective neurons carry mathematical reasoning capability, non-English neurons concentrate in final layers, and selective neurons are spatially interleaved, precluding group-level selective quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction's review of conflicting prior results on activation preference vs. causal necessity. Then review the causal ablation design in the method section, particularly backbone neuron exclusion and random baseline controls. Focus on the granularity boundary and scale effect results. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 干净的因果消融：线性可解码≠可移除的领域壳，模块化只在语言/模态粒度出现。做可解释性/知识本地化的人应看 Table 2 和损伤矩阵图。
recommendation.en: Clean causal ablation: linear decodability ≠ removable domain shells; modularity only emerges at language/modality granularity. Interpretability/knowledge-localization folks should read Table 2 and the damage-matrix figures.

paper.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Benchmark leaderboards summarize how well a language model performs, but not how its behavior relates to that of other models or changes across generations. We characterize the output behavior of 32 models from six families using their responses to a shared bank of 10{,}000 prompts. After embedding each response, we construct three complementary sentence-level dissimilarities: an aligned mean per-prompt distance, which is a pseudometric on observed model responses; a PCA-compressed summary of pr

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM基准排行榜仅反映模型在固定测试集上的分数，无法刻画不同模型间的行为相似性，以及模型迭代过程中的行为演化规律。
summary.importance: 提出了三种无需模型白盒访问的行为差异度量，可定量分析异构LLM的行为聚类与代际演化，为模型行为分析提供了新工具。
summary.technical_approach: 收集6个家族共32个LLM在10k共享提示词上的回复，将回复嵌入为句子向量，构建三种互补的行为距离度量：对齐的逐提示平均距离、PCA压缩的逐提示分歧表示、无需对齐的Gromov-Wasserstein响应几何距离；基于这些度量构建行为地图，分析模型聚类、代际漂移、跨家族收敛等特征。
summary.experiments: 在32个公开LLM上验证了度量有效性，发现同家族模型在行为空间中形成连贯簇，GPT-2为全局离群点，不同家族模型的行为距离随发布时间推移逐渐减小，存在跨家族收敛趋势。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港中文大学，无大模型基座预训练团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM leaderboards only reflect performance on fixed test sets, and cannot characterize behavioral similarity across models or behavioral evolution patterns across model iterations.
summary_en.importance: Proposes three behavioral distance metrics that do not require white-box model access, enabling quantitative analysis of behavioral clustering and inter-generational evolution across heterogeneous LLMs, providing a new tool for model behavior analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Collects responses from 32 LLMs across 6 model families on 10k shared prompts, embeds responses into sentence vectors, and constructs three complementary behavioral distance metrics: aligned per-prompt mean distance, PCA-compressed per-prompt disagreement representation, and alignment-free Gromov-Wasserstein distance on response geometry; builds behavioral maps from these metrics to analyze clustering, drift and cross-family convergence.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the metrics on 32 public LLMs, finding that models from the same family form coherent clusters in behavior space, GPT-2 is a global outlier, and cross-family behavioral distances decrease over release time indicating a cross-family convergence trend.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from The Chinese University of Hong Kong, with no affiliation to major foundation model teams.

recommendation.zh: 提出基于响应分布的LLM行为相似性度量，观察到跨家族行为收敛现象，适合作为模型行为分析工具参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Proposes response-distribution-based LLM behavioral similarity metrics and observes cross-family behavioral convergence; useful as a behavior analysis reference, read the method section only.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-IV: Developmental Topology Observatory
paper.abstract: Transformers have had a profound impact on the world of language processing and computer vision. As efforts to answer the million-dollar question of ``How does a Transformer learn?" have been increasing, existing interpretability studies primarily analyze representations at isolated layers or the network as a whole, while the developmental evolution of individual representations and its manifolds across transformer layers remains underexplored. With this work, we aim at providing a comprehensive

summary.core_problem: 如何用拓扑工具刻画Transformer层间表征“点云”随深度演化的几何/拓扑变化，而不是只看单层或整体统计。
summary.importance: 属于机制/可解释性方法学：把Persistent Homology引入“表征发展轨迹”分析；对理解预训练表征演化可能有启发，但通常较难给出可操作的训练改动。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TGO-IV：把每层表征视为点云，计算持久同调等拓扑摘要，追踪跨层的拓扑不变量变化，用于定位表征从“原始输入”到“任务相关特征”的转变层段。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型（LLM/Vision Transformer）、数据、任务与定量结论；更像分析框架/工具论文，价值取决于是否提供可复现的案例与稳定的度量。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterizing how Transformer representations evolve across layers using topology of representation point clouds, beyond per-layer or whole-network snapshots.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic/interpretability methodology: persistent homology for developmental trajectories; potentially insightful but often hard to translate into actionable pretraining changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: TGO-IV treats each layer’s representations as a point cloud, computes persistent-homology summaries, and tracks topological invariants across depth to identify where representations become task-relevant.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify models (LLM vs ViT), datasets, tasks, or quantitative findings; value depends on reproducible case studies and metric stability.

recommendation.zh: 当作“表征几何分析工具箱”备查即可；先看是否有稳定可复现的层间拓扑转折案例再投入时间。
recommendation.en: Keep as a toolbox reference; only invest if they show stable, reproducible topological phase changes across layers.

paper.title: Post-Hoc Sparse Coding of Latent Communication Between Vision-Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Latent-space communication allows heterogeneous vision-language model agents to exchange continuous representations without serializing visual and reasoning states into text. Vision Wormhole realizes this approach by translating visual features into a universal latent representation that can be consumed by another model, but every message is transported as a dense tensor of the same size regardless of its content. A fixed-capacity dense tensor therefore need not have a fixed effective informatio

summary.core_problem: VLM agent 间的潜在通信使用固定大小稠密张量传输，信息密度随内容变化，通道可能存在大量冗余。
summary.importance: 首次将稀疏自编码器(SAE)用于分析多模态 agent 间潜在通信通道的可压缩性，属于机制/可解释性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 对冻结的 Vision Wormhole 激活拟合 post-hoc 稀疏自编码器，用 uint16 索引 + float16 值的稀疏表示替代原始 float32 稠密传输。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个推理 benchmark 上测量重建误差、下游效用、特征复用率和 token 级干预效果，对比 float32 稠密传输与稀疏编码。

summary_en.core_problem: Latent communication between VLM agents uses fixed-size dense tensors whose effective information density varies with content, suggesting the channel is highly compressible.
summary_en.importance: First application of sparse autoencoders to analyze the compressibility of latent communication channels between multimodal agents; an interpretability/mechanism study.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fit a post-hoc sparse autoencoder to frozen Vision Wormhole activations, replacing float32 dense transport with uint16-index / float16-value sparse representations.
summary_en.experiments: Measure reconstruction, downstream utility, feature reuse, and token-level interventions across nine reasoning benchmarks, comparing sparse coding against dense float32 transport.

recommendation.zh: SAE 用在多模态 agent 通信通道上，结论是稠密表示可压缩；对做 SAE/可解释性的人有参考，对 pretrain 直接启发有限，看摘要和 Fig 即可。
recommendation.en: SAE applied to multimodal agent communication shows dense latents are compressible; relevant for SAE/interpretability folks, limited direct pretrain insight—read abstract and figures.

paper.title: Reasoning Shortcuts and Value Symmetries: What Symmetry Permits, Architecture Realizes, and Optimization Selects
paper.abstract: Reasoning shortcuts are solutions of a neurosymbolic system's rules that produce correct predictions through unintended concepts. A recent framework of Takemura, Inoue, and Nishino analyzes them through an automorphism group of value relabelings and asks, as its central open question, when rules pin concepts down. We first show that the framework's key definition, one shared permutation applied at every position, does not apply as stated to any of the four heterogeneous benchmarks it was evaluat

summary.core_problem: 现有基于值重标记自同构群的神经符号系统推理捷径分析框架存在核心定义缺陷，导致假阳性病理判断。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，修正了领域内已有分析框架的核心定义问题，提出更严谨的层级化测量方案，澄清了推理捷径与对称结构的关联。
summary.technical_approach: 指出原框架的共享置换定义不适用于异构基准，padding嵌入方案会产生随配置变化的假阳性；提出层级化的自同构群嵌入方法，通过11个规则族、15个预定义预测验证未解释解对比例与可证明结构的对应关系。
summary.experiments: 在CLE4EVR等四个异构基准上测试，原padding方法报告90.91%的未解释解对，新框架下为0%；11个规则族的未解释对比例跨度从0%到99.9999%，与可证明的结构特征高度一致，15个预定义预测中13个得到验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The existing automorphism-group-based framework for analyzing reasoning shortcuts in neuro-symbolic systems has core definition flaws leading to false positive pathology judgments.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution: corrects the core definition of a widely used framework, proposes a more rigorous hierarchical measurement scheme, and clarifies the relationship between reasoning shortcuts and symmetry structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Shows the original framework's shared permutation definition does not apply to heterogeneous benchmarks, and padding embeddings produce false positives that rotate with configuration order; introduces a hierarchical automorphism group embedding, validating the correspondence between unexplained pair rates and provable structure across 11 rule families and 15 pre-specified predictions.
summary_en.experiments: On four heterogeneous benchmarks including CLE4EVR, the original padding method reports 90.91% unexplained solution pairs, while the new framework reports 0%; unexplained pair rates across 11 rule families range from 0% to 99.9999%, tracking provable structure, with 13 of 15 pre-specified predictions confirmed.

recommendation.zh: 偏神经符号理论的推理捷径分析，修正了已有对称框架的核心缺陷，与LLM预训练关联较弱，仅做文献备查。
recommendation.en: Theoretical neuro-symbolic analysis of reasoning shortcuts correcting core flaws in the symmetry framework; weak relevance to LLM pretraining, keep as literature reference.

paper.title: TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance
paper.abstract: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relation

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖元数据的情况下判断一个语言模型的来源基座、训练数据重叠和谱系关系。
summary.importance: 提出一种训练免费的模型指纹方法，可用于训练分布重叠、模型溯源和治理审计；对预训练数据检测和模型谱系分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 用 250 个固定知识探针激发模型，取后期隐藏状态的 top-k 词表投影并解码为 token 字符串，用 Jaccard 重叠度比较模型；还进行词表校正以消除 tokenizer 差异。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个家族、32 个 0.6B–32B 开源模型上评测。相同数据独立训练模型原始相似度 0.48、词表校正后 0.35；共享基座微调模型 0.39/0.33；同厂商相关模型 0.38/0.28；无记录关系模型 0.22/0.17。信号跨机构、tokenizer 和架构稳定，并在训练前 1% 内出现。

summary_en.core_problem: How to determine a language model's base checkpoint, training-data overlap, and provenance without relying on metadata.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a training-free fingerprint for model provenance and training-distribution overlap, relevant to data-forensics, model lineage, and governance audits in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses 250 fixed knowledge probes, takes top-k vocabulary projections from late hidden states, decodes them into token strings, and compares models with Jaccard overlap; a vocabulary-correction step reduces tokenizer confounds.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 32 open-weight models from nine families, spanning 0.6B to 32B parameters. Independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw and 0.35 vocabulary-corrected; shared-base fine-tunes 0.39/0.33; same-developer relatives 0.38/0.28; unrelated models 0.22/0.17. The signal persists across organizations, tokenizers, and architectures, and emerges within the first 1% of training.

recommendation.zh: 数据溯源和模型谱系检测的轻量方法，偏治理；只看 similarity ladder 与 1% 训练即出现的结论即可。
recommendation.en: A lightweight provenance and data-overlap method, mainly useful for governance; read the similarity-ladder numbers and the 1%-training emergence claim.

paper.title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
paper.abstract: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的不是“如何解释一个已经训练好的黑盒模型”，而是更前置的问题：能不能把可解释性直接做成训练约束，让模型在预训练阶段就学出一个可干预、可分解、语义对齐的内部接口，同时不随着规模增大而付出越来越高的能力代价。作者把这个问题落到 language modeling 上，覆盖 AR 和 diffusion 两类 backbone，核心检验是两个：一是 capability–interpretability 是否真有硬冲突；二是如果把解释接口写进训练流程，随 scale 增长，模型会更难理解还是更容易理解。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的意义很直接，而且量级不小。第一，它把 interpretability 从 post-hoc 分析工具，推进成 pretraining recipe 的一部分，涉及数据、架构、目标函数和 scaling law，属于训练范式层面的工作。第二，它给出了一个明确的经验结论：在作者定义的 inherent interpretability 设定下，可解释性更像是一个小而固定的 scaling offset，而不是随规模扩大的能力税。这一点如果成立，会改变很多人对“先把模型做强，再想办法解释”的默认假设。第三，论文不只讲理念，还做了大规模数据管线、概念瓶颈架构、diffusion LM 实例化、IsoFLOP scaling 拟合和 8B 级训练，完整度很高。对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是某个解释 demo，而是它如何把‘概念监督 + 结构约束 + 训练目标’拼成一个可扩展 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案可以拆成四层：概念数据、可解释架构、训练目标、以及 scaling 分析。

第一层是概念数据 Atlas。作者认为 post-hoc 方法的问题，不只是解释器弱，而是训练时根本没有一个与预测计算耦合的语义接口。所以他们先构建大规模概念库和标注流水线：从数百万文档中抽取数亿 free-form tags，做 canonicalization 后得到 3.3 万多个概念，再训练 annotator 对任意文本做 chunk-level 概念标注。Atlas 最终覆盖 web text、code、math、academic prose，总标注规模超过 1T tokens。这里的关键不是“有标签”这么简单，而是把概念监督提升到预训练同量级，否则 concept bottleneck 很容易只停留在小数据实验。

第二层是架构。Steerling-8B 采用 diffusion language model，并使用 block-causal attention：块内保留 diffusion 式并行，块间保留类似 AR 的因果结构和 KV cache 能力。这一点很重要，因为它不是纯粹为了可解释性牺牲生成接口，而是在并行训练与可部署推理之间做折中。真正的解释接口插在 backbone 和 LM head 之间，是一个 additive concept bottleneck。作者强调它让 logit decomposition 变成 algebraically exact，也就是说输出可以精确分解为概念通道与 residual 通道的贡献，而不是事后近似投影。与此同时，masking objective 让模型学到“该位置无信息”的 in-distribution absence baseline，这使 feature removal / token attribution 不再依赖离分布的删词基线。论文把 faithful explanation 需要的几个条件——变量、干预、语义标签与预测计算耦合——都尽量写进了结构里。

第三层是训练目标与解释轴。模型对任意输出都沿三条轴给出归因：对输入 token 的影响、对人类可理解概念的贡献、以及对 residual 未解释部分的贡献。概念在模型中不是只供 probe 读取的标签，而是 forward pass 里真实参与计算的方向，因此可以直接做 intervention，比如放大或抑制某个概念方向，观察输出变化。这个设计和传统 probe / SAE 的差别在于：后者证明“信息可解码”，这里追求的是“概念变量就是计算接口的一部分”。

第四层是 scaling。作者做了四个 family 的 IsoFLOP 扫描：AR、causal diffusion、AR+concepts、causal diffusion+concepts。然后用 joint Chinchilla form 去拟合 loss 与 compute 的关系，并同时拟合多项 interpretability metrics。论文的核心判断来自这里：加入 concept module 后，compute-optimal scaling exponent 只发生小而固定的 per-backbone offset；解释约束没有随着规模放大而越来越贵。更有意思的是，多个解释性指标随 compute 一起改善，包括概念预测更准、known/unknown 表征分离更清楚、更多预测质量通过概念通道而非 residual 路由、概念 embedding 与人类标签更对齐。这不是“能力没掉太多”这么简单，而是“规模增长同时改善能力和可解释接口质量”。

和现有方法相比，区别主要有三点。第一，不是 post-hoc 解释，而是 training-time interpretability。第二，不是把 concept bottleneck 用在小模型分类任务，而是放进大规模 LM 预训练，并覆盖 diffusion LM。第三，不只给案例分析，而是给 scaling law 和大模型实例，试图说明这件事在现代训练规模下仍成立。
summary.experiments:
实验部分信息量很大，最关键的是 scaling 与 8B 实例化两块。

在 scaling 方面，作者做了跨三个数量级 compute 的 IsoFLOP sweep，比较四类模型：AR、causal diffusion、AR with concepts、causal diffusion with concepts。结论是，加入概念模块后，loss–compute 曲线出现的是小而固定的偏移，而不是随规模扩大的惩罚。Steerling-8B 的验证集 loss 可以被小模型拟合的 joint Chinchilla form 预测到 0.11 nats 以内，四个解释性指标里有三个也能被较紧地预测。这说明作者不是只在单一规模上讲故事，而是把“可解释性是否可扩展”当成 scaling 问题来处理。

在解释性指标上，论文报告了几类趋势：概念预测准确率随 compute 提升；known/unknown representation separation 变好；更多 logit 贡献通过 concept path 而不是 residual path；concept embedding 与人类可读标签的对齐增强。这里最值得注意的是“residual routing 比例下降”这一类结果，因为它直接对应一个核心担忧：概念瓶颈会不会只是挂名存在，真正计算仍绕过它。作者的结果表明，至少在他们的训练设定里，随着规模上升，模型更愿意把预测质量放到概念通道里。

在大模型实例化上，Steerling-8B 是一个带 causal attention mask 的 diffusion LM。训练数据是 1.2T token 预训练，再加 150B token 的 code/math augmented midtraining。概念模块在 8B 时只占 4% 参数；按同样参数化外推到更大规模，会降到 1% 以下。和同尺度开源 peer 相比，这个模型在 benchmark 平均表现上落在大约 10% 以内，而对手使用的训练计算量约为它的 2 到 16 倍。这个结果不能简单解读成“同算力最优”，但足以说明解释约束没有把模型能力拉到不可用的程度。

论文还强调它同时在 AR 和 diffusion backbone 上验证了趋势，这一点很重要。因为如果结论只在单一架构上成立，很难判断是 interpretability recipe 有效，还是某个 backbone 的偶然性。这里至少给出了更强的外推信号。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇建议精读。最值得花时间的是五个部分。

第一，先看 Introduction 和作者对 post-hoc interpretability 局限的界定。重点不是那些常见批评，而是他们提出的标准：一个解释接口要想可信，变量、干预、语义标签和预测计算必须耦合。理解这个标准后，后面的数据、架构、loss 设计就会顺很多。

第二，精读数据部分，尤其是 Atlas 的构建流程。要看清楚概念是怎么从 free-form tags 变成可训练标签体系的，chunk-level 标注如何做，覆盖哪些语料域。这里决定了 concept bottleneck 能否在预训练规模上站住。

第三，精读 architecture。重点看 block-causal attention 为什么适合 diffusion LM；additive concept bottleneck 如何做到 exact logit decomposition；masking objective 为什么能提供 in-distribution absence baseline。这里是全文最有新意、也最容易被摘要掩盖的部分。

第四，认真看 scaling laws。优先看四个 family 的 IsoFLOP 曲线、joint Chinchilla 拟合、以及 interpretability metrics 的 scaling 图。要关注的不是“有没有一点损失”，而是 offset 是否固定、斜率是否变化、不同 backbone 是否一致。这部分决定论文最核心的经验结论是否站得住。

第五，再看 Steerling-8B 的训练与评测。这里要把它当成 recipe 的完整实例，而不是单独一个模型发布。重点看 1.2T pretrain + 150B midtrain 的数据配比、概念模块参数占比、与开源 peer 的 compute 对比方式，以及 residual/concept 路由分析。

如果时间有限，至少要看：概念数据管线图、架构总图、scaling law 主图、interpretability metrics 主图、8B 训练配置表。若要深挖，建议顺着一个问题读：模型到底有没有把概念当成真实计算通道，而不是旁路监督。相关证据主要在 exact decomposition、routing 指标和 intervention 结果里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a training-time question rather than a post-hoc one: can interpretability be built into language-model pretraining as a structural constraint, so that the model learns a manipulable, semantically aligned internal interface without paying an ever-growing capability cost as scale increases? The authors test this on both autoregressive and diffusion language models. The central issue is whether capability and interpretability are fundamentally in tension, and whether larger models become harder or easier to understand when the explanatory interface is part of the training recipe itself.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to foundation-model pretraining, and the contribution is substantial. First, it moves interpretability from an after-the-fact analysis tool into the pretraining recipe, touching data construction, architecture, objectives, and scaling laws. Second, it offers a concrete empirical claim: under their notion of inherent interpretability, the cost behaves like a small fixed scaling offset rather than a growing tax. If that holds more broadly, it weakens the default assumption that one must first train an opaque model and only then attempt to explain it. Third, the paper is unusually complete: a trillion-token concept annotation pipeline, a concept-native architecture, diffusion-LM instantiation, IsoFLOP scaling sweeps, and an 8B model. For pretraining researchers, the main value is not a demo of explanations, but a full recipe that tries to make semantic structure part of the optimization target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has four layers: concept data, interpretable architecture, training objective, and scaling analysis.

The first layer is Atlas, a large-scale concept annotation pipeline. The paper argues that post-hoc interpretability fails not only because the explainer is weak, but because standard training never creates a semantic interface coupled to prediction. Atlas addresses that by extracting hundreds of millions of free-form tags from millions of documents, canonicalizing them into more than 33,000 concepts, and training an annotator that labels arbitrary text at the chunk level. The final annotation coverage exceeds 1 trillion tokens across web text, code, mathematics, and academic prose. The important point is scale: concept supervision is elevated to something comparable to pretraining scale, rather than remaining a small auxiliary dataset.

The second layer is architecture. Steerling-8B is a diffusion language model with block-causal attention. Within a block it preserves diffusion-style parallelism; across blocks it retains an autoregressive-style causal structure and KV-cache compatibility. This is a practical compromise between parallel training and deployable generation. The interpretability interface sits between the transformer backbone and the LM head as an additive concept bottleneck. The paper emphasizes that this makes the logit decomposition algebraically exact, so output contributions from concept channels and residual channels are not merely approximate post-hoc projections. In parallel, the masking objective teaches the model an in-distribution notion of “no information at this position,” which gives token-removal and feature-removal attributions a trained absence baseline rather than an out-of-distribution deletion heuristic.

The third layer is the objective and explanatory interface. For any output, the model attributes prediction along three axes: influential input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and residual unexplained contribution. Concepts are not passive labels decoded by a probe; they are directions used in the forward pass. That means interventions are native: amplifying or suppressing a concept direction directly changes computation. This is the main departure from probes or sparse autoencoders, which often establish decodability rather than computational use.

The fourth layer is scaling. The paper runs IsoFLOP sweeps over four model families: AR, causal diffusion, AR plus concepts, and causal diffusion plus concepts. It fits loss with a joint Chinchilla-style form and also tracks several interpretability metrics as functions of compute. The central empirical claim comes from this section: adding the concept module changes the compute-optimal scaling behavior by a small fixed per-backbone offset, not by a worsening penalty with scale. At the same time, interpretability metrics improve with compute: concept prediction gets better, known-versus-unknown representations separate more cleanly, more predictive mass is routed through concept channels rather than residual channels, and concept embeddings align better with human labels.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. This is training-time interpretability rather than post-hoc explanation; it brings concept bottlenecks into large-scale language-model pretraining rather than small supervised tasks; and it supports the claim with scaling laws and an 8B model rather than isolated case studies.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is dense, but two parts matter most: scaling and the 8B instantiation.

On scaling, the authors run IsoFLOP sweeps across three orders of magnitude of compute for four families: AR, causal diffusion, AR with concepts, and causal diffusion with concepts. Their main result is that adding the concept module produces a small fixed shift in the loss-compute tradeoff rather than a penalty that grows with scale. The validation loss of Steerling-8B is predicted within 0.11 nats by a joint Chinchilla-style fit from smaller runs, and three of four interpretability metrics are also predicted within tight bounds. This matters because the paper treats interpretability as a scaling question, not as a one-off model anecdote.

For interpretability, the paper reports several monotonic trends with compute: concept prediction accuracy improves; separation between known and unknown representations becomes cleaner; a larger fraction of the model’s predictive contribution flows through the concept path rather than the residual path; and concept embeddings align more closely with human-readable labels. The routing result is especially important because it addresses a central concern: a concept bottleneck could exist only nominally while the real computation bypasses it. Their evidence suggests that, under this recipe, larger models rely more rather than less on the concept channel.

For the large model, Steerling-8B is a diffusion LM with a causal attention mask. It is trained on 1.2T pretraining tokens followed by 150B midtraining tokens with a code-and-math-augmented mixture. The concept module accounts for 4% of parameters at 8B and would fall below 1% at larger scales under the same parameterization. Compared with open peers at similar parameter count, Steerling-8B lands within roughly 10% of their average benchmark performance, despite those peers using about 2x to 16x more training compute. This does not prove compute-optimality, but it does show that the interpretability constraints do not collapse model usefulness.

The fact that the paper validates the trend on both AR and diffusion backbones is also important. If the result held only for one architecture, it would be hard to tell whether the gain came from the interpretability recipe or from a backbone-specific artifact.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a close read. Five parts are worth real attention.

First, read the introduction and the formal discussion of why post-hoc interpretability is structurally limited. The key standard is not a generic complaint about probes; it is the requirement that variables, interventions, semantic labels, and prediction computation be coupled. Once that standard is clear, the rest of the recipe makes sense.

Second, read the data section carefully, especially Atlas. You want to understand how free-form tags are turned into a trainable concept system, how chunk-level annotation is produced, and how the pipeline reaches pretraining scale. Whether the whole approach is credible depends heavily on this layer.

Third, read the architecture in detail. Focus on why block-causal attention is a good fit for diffusion LM, how the additive concept bottleneck yields exact logit decomposition, and why the masking objective creates an in-distribution absence baseline. This is where much of the real novelty sits.

Fourth, spend time on the scaling-law section. Prioritize the IsoFLOP plots for the four families, the joint Chinchilla fits, and the scaling plots for interpretability metrics. The main question is not whether there is some loss penalty, but whether the offset is fixed, whether the slope changes, and whether the pattern is consistent across backbones.

Fifth, read the Steerling-8B training and evaluation sections as a full recipe instantiation rather than a model release. Pay attention to the 1.2T pretrain plus 150B midtrain mixture, the parameter share of the concept module, the compute comparison to peers, and the concept-versus-residual routing analysis.

If time is limited, at minimum read the concept-data pipeline figure, the architecture overview, the main scaling-law plots, the main interpretability-metric plots, and the 8B training table. If you want one deep question to track while reading, use this: does the model actually compute through concepts, or are concepts only an auxiliary supervision layer? The strongest evidence is in the exact decomposition, routing metrics, and intervention results.

recommendation.zh: 必须看 scaling 曲线和干预指标；若指标没被 reward hack，这会改变“可解释性只能后验补丁”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the scaling curves and intervention metrics; if the metrics are not reward-hacked, this changes the prior that interpretability is only a post-hoc patch.

paper.title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we

summary.core_problem: 如何从预训练Transformer注意力权重中分离结构化功能信号与类随机噪声，并因果验证这些结构成分对模型性能的实际贡献。
summary.importance: 提供了基于Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论的无监督注意力结构诊断框架，其发现的谱异常值承载主要功能信息、GQA架构改变V投影结构分布等结论，可为参数高效微调的秩与层选择、模型压缩、注意力架构设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 用Marchenko-Pastur（MP）定律对Q/K/V/O每个注意力投影矩阵的奇异值做分解，超过MP上界的归为谱异常值（结构化信号），其余为类随机体成分。配套三种分析手段：入口级异常值热图（可视化4σ以上权重的空间分布）、跨层残差流对齐分析（识别持续出现的异常残差通道）、因果消融实验（对比置零谱异常值与等量随机体成分的性能下降，验证功能重要性）。共分析11个覆盖编码器、解码器架构的预训练模型。
summary.experiments: 在Mistral-7B上置零MP识别的谱异常值，HellaSwag、MMLU、PIQA性能降至接近随机水平，置零等量随机体成分的下降幅度小得多。跨架构规律包括：Q投影的谱异常值最多（LLaMA-2-7B中Q占87.8%谱能量，V占79.0%）；GQA架构下V投影异常值大幅减少（LLaMA-3-8B中V仅占43.1%谱能量，较Q少6倍）；谱能量占比从低层到高层逐层递减。空间分布上Q异常值呈行带状、O呈列带状，K和O存在跨层持续的残差通道。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第II节的MP分解方法与消融协议、第III节的跨架构谱模式与因果消融结果，预计阅读20-30分钟。关注参数高效微调或模型压缩可优先看谱异常值的功能验证部分，关注架构设计可重点看GQA对V投影结构的影响分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to separate functionally meaningful structured signal from random-like noise in pre-trained Transformer attention weights, and causally validate whether the identified structures actually contribute to model performance.
summary_en.importance: Provides an unsupervised diagnostic framework for attention weight structure based on Marchenko-Pastur random matrix theory. Findings such as spectral outliers carrying dominant functional information and GQA altering the structural distribution of V projections offer empirical guidance for rank and layer selection in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, model compression, and attention architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes each attention projection matrix (Q, K, V, O) into spectral outliers (singular values above the Marchenko-Pastur upper edge, treated as structured signal) and a random-like bulk using MP law. Three complementary analysis methods are included: entry-level outlier heatmaps (visualizing spatial distribution of weights above 4σ), cross-layer residual-stream alignment analysis (identifying persistent outlier residual channels), and causal ablation experiments (comparing performance degradation from zeroing spectral outliers vs an equal number of random bulk components to verify functional importance). Analyzes 11 pre-trained models spanning encoder-only and decoder-only architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Zeroing MP-identified spectral outliers in Mistral-7B drops HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA performance to near random chance, while zeroing an equal number of random bulk components causes far smaller degradation. Cross-architecture patterns include: Q projections have the most spectral outliers (87.8% spectral energy for Q vs 79.0% for V in LLaMA-2-7B); V projections under GQA have dramatically fewer outliers (only 43.1% spectral energy in LLaMA-3-8B, a 6x reduction relative to Q); spectral energy ratio decreases gradually from early to late layers. Spatially, outliers form row-bands in Q and column-bands in O, with persistent cross-layer residual channels in K and O.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section II for the MP decomposition method and ablation protocol, and Section III for cross-architecture spectral patterns and causal ablation results. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. Readers interested in parameter-efficient fine-tuning or model compression should prioritize the functional validation of spectral outliers; those focused on architecture design can dive into the GQA impact analysis on V projection structure.

recommendation.zh: 谱分解+因果消融的 setup 干净，结论对结构化剪枝和 PEFT 有直接提示，重点看 §4-5 的五个 pattern。
recommendation.en: Clean spectral-plus-causal-ablation setup; the five patterns in §4-5 are directly useful for structured pruning and PEFT.

paper.title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
paper.abstract: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction ups

summary.core_problem: 多语言MoE模型存在低资源语言下有害请求更易被遵从的跨语言安全差距，其内在机制是检测失效还是生成失效，以及拒绝行为的神经回路如何组织。
summary.importance: 揭示了多语言对齐中有害检测与拒绝生成的分离机制，解释了统一检测与不均衡拒绝共存的原因，可为多语言安全对齐策略设计、MoE模型的定向对齐干预提供机制层面的依据。拒绝行为跨自回归步骤构建的结论，也对对齐干预方法的设计有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 以Sarvam-30B（30B参数、19层、128专家top-6路由的印度语族多语言推理MoE）为研究对象，使用成对有害/良性提示的TwinBreak语料（覆盖6种语言）开展实验。核心方法包括：计算每层有害方向与拒绝方向，分析两者的跨语言一致性与正交性；通过单次/逐解码步激活注入实验，验证拒绝行为是单次前向读出还是跨步骤构建；用直接logit归因与专家激活分析定位拒绝回路的具体层与专家；量化不同干预的流畅度代价。
summary.experiments: 有害检测方向在中层（第11层）跨语言高度一致（印度语言间余弦相似度0.95±0.01，英印间0.90±0.01），英语的检测表示更强。有害方向与拒绝方向几乎正交（所有层|cos|≤0.10），拒绝方向幅值从低层到高层单调增长。单次上游注入有害方向无法驱动输出端拒绝，效果在2层内衰减；逐解码步注入可实现0.65的拒绝恢复率、16倍有害/良性选择性、4%的良性误杀率。拒绝生成回路定位在后期MoE层（第14-16层贡献正拒绝logit，第17-18层出现正负抵消模式），可定位到具体专家。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节（有害检测与拒绝的分离）、第4节（拒绝的跨步骤构建）、第5节（回路归因），预计阅读25-35分钟。关注多语言对齐可优先看跨语言有害方向一致性分析，关注MoE对齐可重点看专家层面的归因结果。

summary_en.core_problem: What causes the cross-lingual safety gap in multilingual MoE models where harmful requests in low-resource languages are more likely to be complied with, whether the gap stems from failed harm detection or failed refusal generation, and how the refusal neural circuit is organized.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the dissociation between harm detection and refusal generation in multilingual aligned models, explaining why uniform harm detection can coexist with uneven cross-lingual refusal behavior. This provides mechanistic guidance for multilingual safety alignment strategy design and targeted alignment interventions for MoE models. The finding that refusal is constructed across autoregressive generation steps also directly informs the design of alignment intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Studies Sarvam-30B, a 30B-parameter 19-layer Indic-multilingual reasoning MoE with 128 experts and top-6 routing, using the TwinBreak corpus of paired harmful/benign prompts across 6 languages. Core methods include: computing per-layer harm and refusal directions to measure cross-lingual consistency and orthogonality; testing whether refusal is a single-pass readout or constructed across generation via single-shot vs per-decode-step activation injection; localizing the refusal circuit's specific layers and experts using direct logit attribution and expert activation analysis; quantifying fluency cost of different interventions.
summary_en.experiments: Harm detection directions are highly cross-lingually consistent at middle layers (layer 11: 0.95±0.01 cosine similarity between Indic languages, 0.90±0.01 between English and Indic), with stronger representation in English. Harm and refusal directions are nearly orthogonal (|cos| ≤ 0.10 at all layers), with refusal direction magnitude growing monotonically from early to late layers. Single-shot upstream injection of the harm direction fails to drive refusal at the output, with effects decaying within 2 layers; per-step injection achieves 0.65 refusal recovery rate, 16x harmful/benign selectivity, and 4% benign knockout. The refusal generation circuit is localized to late MoE layers (L14-L16 contribute positive refusal logits, L17-L18 show a canceling sign pattern), with specific refusal-associated experts identifiable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dissociation between harm detection and refusal), Section 4 (cross-step construction of refusal), and Section 5 (circuit attribution). Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes. Readers focused on multilingual alignment should prioritize the cross-lingual harm direction consistency analysis; those interested in MoE alignment can dive into expert-level attribution results.

recommendation.zh: 把跨语言拒答差距拆成检测/写入两段并定价干预，结论对 MoE 对齐 recipe 有动作含义，重点看 writer/opposer 电路部分。
recommendation.en: Decomposes the cross-lingual refusal gap into detection vs. writing and prices interventions; the writer/opposer circuit section is the actionable part for MoE alignment.

paper.title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly reported to exhibit human-like neural and cognitive signatures, including concept cells, mental number lines, and cognitive maps. These claims often rely on linear probing and activation steering applied to a single model, yet both methods are highly sensitive to measurement choices. A reported parallel may therefore reflect the model, the measurement procedure, or both. We audit four representative neuroscience-inspired paradigms across 17 models fr

summary.core_problem: LLM 中类神经科学现象（概念细胞、心理数字线、认知地图等）的证据有多少来自真实表示，又有多少来自测量流程混淆。
summary.importance: 这是一项重要的测量可靠性审计，指出线性探针和激活操控中的尺度效应可能是未校准管线造成的伪影，直接影响对 LLM 涌现能力和认知相似性的解释。
summary.technical_approach: 跨 5 个模型家族、17 个 0.6B–72B 模型审计四个神经科学启发范式；主实验比较原始激活单元、固定层和系数下的概念方向可操控性，并检查 readout 指标、工作点和校准方式对趋势的影响。
summary.experiments: 在未校准设置下，概念可操控性看似随模型规模增长，类似涌现能力；但校正原始单元、readout 指标和 operating point 后，该规模趋势消失，说明原结论依赖测量选择。

summary_en.core_problem: How much of the reported neuroscience-like behavior in LLMs—concept cells, mental number lines, cognitive maps—reflects real representations versus measurement-procedure confounds.
summary_en.importance: A valuable measurement-reliability audit showing that scale effects in linear probing and activation steering can arise from uncalibrated pipelines, directly affecting claims about emergent capabilities and neural parallels in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper audits four neuroscience-inspired paradigms across 17 models from five families, spanning 0.6B to 72B parameters. The main experiment tests causal steerability of concept directions and varies raw activation units, layers, coefficients, readout metrics, operating points, and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: With raw units, a fixed layer, and a fixed coefficient, steerability appears to increase with model scale and resembles an emergent capability. After correcting for raw units, readout metric, and operating point, the trend disappears, indicating that the original pattern depends on measurement choices.

recommendation.zh: 把激活可操控性的规模效应打回测量伪影；做 steering/probing 前必读校准讨论，主实验趋势图就够。
recommendation.en: Shows that scale effects in activation steerability can be measurement artifacts; read the calibration analysis and main trend figures before doing steering or probing work.

paper.title: UNMASK: Discovering and Causally Verifying Spurious Shortcuts in Text Classifiers
paper.abstract: Neural language models trained on large crowdsourced corpora frequently exploit spurious surface patterns tied to target labels without true linguistic or causal relevance, boosting benchmark performance while failing on adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs. Existing approaches either require manual specification of the feature vocabulary or automate discovery only partially, leaving the gap between dataset-level correlation and model-level exploitation unaddressed. We present U N M ASK, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是文本分类器中的伪相关发现问题：数据里某些表面模式和标签相关，但不一定被模型真正使用；已有方法常常只能发现数据层面的相关性，或需要人工指定偏置特征，无法自动区分“数据中存在”和“模型依赖”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，因为实验主体是 NLI、评论毒性分类和偏好数据上的分类器分析。但它对预训练数据审计有方法启发：把候选数据 artifact 表达成可执行的布尔函数，再用反事实编辑验证模型是否真的依赖该特征，比只看词频、互信息或 benchmark 分组更可靠。这个思路可迁移到预训练语料质量分析、指令数据偏置检测、reward/preference 数据 shortcut 诊断。
summary.technical_approach: UnMask 分三步。第一步是自动发现：用 LLM 在不看标签的训练样本上提出候选表面模式，并要求输出自然语言描述、类别标签、简短理由和可执行 boolean expression。作者刻意不用自由文本特征，而是用确定性的布尔表达式，目的是让后续统计过滤、反事实验证和重加权都能复用同一个特征定义。为降低长上下文幻觉，样本被分 batch 查询，再聚合候选。第二步是统计验证：先做表达式和描述层面的去重，再用两阶段 replication protocol 过滤真正和标签稳定相关的特征。第三步是因果验证：对每个候选特征生成最小反事实编辑，移除表面模式但尽量保持语义标签不变，然后比较编辑前后的模型预测变化。只有当预测发生系统性变化时，才认为模型利用了该 shortcut。最后，这些布尔表达式还能直接作为 group label，用于 annotation-free Deep Feature Reweighting，避免人工 demographic 或 bias annotation。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 MNLI 上的 BERT、RoBERTa，以及多个 NLI 相关 benchmark；还扩展到 CivilComments-WILDS 和 RewardBench2 偏好数据。文中报告的关键现象是：UnMask 能恢复 NLI 中已知的 lexical overlap 和 negation bias；相关性分析看不出的架构差异可以通过反事实验证暴露出来，例如 BERT 会利用某些 contradiction 相关特征，而 RoBERTa 对这些特征不敏感；在 sentiment 场景中方法返回零个被模型实际利用的特征，对这些非因果特征做 debiasing 也不会带来收益。CivilComments 上，用自动挖出的 group 做 DFR，可以接近手工标注 group 的 DFR 效果。提供内容未包含完整数值表，因此不应过度解读提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三个接口：LLM 如何生成 executable boolean expression，统计过滤如何避免把偶然相关当作 artifact，反事实编辑如何把 dataset-level correlation 和 model-level reliance 分开。若关心预训练数据治理，可以重点看 boolean expression 作为统一 artifact 表示的设计，而不是具体 NLI 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in shortcut analysis for text classifiers: surface patterns may correlate with labels in the dataset, but correlation alone does not show that a trained model actually uses them. Prior methods often require humans to specify the bias vocabulary or stop at dataset-level discovery.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is moderate, since the main experiments are on classifiers rather than base LM training. The useful idea is methodological: represent candidate artifacts as executable boolean functions, then reuse the same representation for statistical filtering, counterfactual causal verification, and debiasing. This is a cleaner interface than ad hoc keyword lists and could be adapted to pretraining corpus audits, instruction-data bias checks, and reward/preference-data shortcut diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: UnMask has three stages. First, an LLM proposes candidate surface patterns from unlabeled training examples and returns a natural-language description plus an executable boolean expression. Labels are withheld at this stage so that candidate generation is not label-conditioned. The boolean expression is the central design choice, because it makes feature evaluation deterministic across discovery, verification, and mitigation. Candidates are generated in mini-batches, deduplicated using exact normalization and semantic clustering, and then statistically filtered with a two-phase replication protocol. Second, the method causally verifies model reliance by generating minimal counterfactual edits that remove the surface pattern while preserving the semantic label, and then measuring paired prediction shifts. Third, the same boolean expressions are used as group labels for annotation-free Deep Feature Reweighting.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on MNLI with BERT and RoBERTa, several NLI benchmarks, CivilComments-WILDS, and RewardBench2 preference data. The main reported findings are qualitative but informative: UnMask recovers known lexical-overlap and negation biases; it exposes an architecture-level difference where BERT exploits some contradiction-associated features while RoBERTa does not; on sentiment it returns no exploited features, and debiasing these non-causal features does not help. On CivilComments, automatically mined groups can support DFR with performance close to hand-labeled groups. The supplied text does not include full numeric tables, so exact effect sizes should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the representation choice—executable boolean expressions—and on the counterfactual verification protocol. For pretraining researchers, the most transferable part is the separation between data-level artifact discovery and model-level causal reliance, rather than the specific NLI or toxicity results.

recommendation.zh: 全自动虚假捷径发现与因果验证框架，反事实干预的设计对分析预训练数据中的虚假模式、提升数据质量有参考价值，看§3方法部分。
recommendation.en: Fully automated spurious shortcut discovery and causal verification pipeline; the counterfactual intervention design is useful for analyzing spurious patterns in pretraining data, read §3 method section.

paper.title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
paper.abstract: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models

summary.core_problem: Khatri et al. (2026) 报告在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 最后一层激活上训练轻量 MLP 探针即可检测有害 prompt，F1 可比千倍大的 guard 模型；本文复现并检验其跨模型/架构的泛化性与推理非确定性。
summary.importance: 可复现性 + 跨家族泛化研究，对"安全概念是否线性编码在隐藏表示中"这一机制问题提供经验证据；属于 interpretability/safety 交叉。
summary.technical_approach: 端到端复现 MLP 探针 pipeline，在 Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B 上以相同设置训练探针，使用 WildJailbreak/BeaverTails/AEGIS 2.0 三个 benchmark，并用 5 个随机种子测量 F1 方差。
summary.experiments: 在原 LLaMA 模型上 F1 复现偏差 ≤0.37 个百分点（BeaverTails 上 ≤0.2）；跨模型/架构的泛化结果与种子方差在摘要中未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Khatri et al. (2026) reported that lightweight MLP probes on LLaMA-3.1-8B final-layer activations detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger; this paper reproduces and tests cross-family generalization and inference non-determinism.
summary_en.importance: A reproducibility and cross-family generalization study that bears on whether safety concepts are linearly encoded in hidden representations; sits at the interpretability/safety intersection.
summary_en.technical_approach: End-to-end reproduction of the MLP probe pipeline, trained identically on activations from Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen2-7B across WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, and AEGIS 2.0, with five random seeds to quantify F1 variance.
summary_en.experiments: Reproduces original LLaMA F1 within 0.37 points (within 0.2 on BeaverTails); cross-model generalization and seed-variance results not fully stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 复现扎实，跨家族泛化结论是判断"安全探针是否真在读取表征"的关键；只看跨模型表格和种子方差即可，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: Solid reproduction; the cross-family generalization table is what decides whether safety probes actually read representations—skip the method, read those tables and the seed-variance numbers.

paper.title: Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Decoupling the Shared Control Bottleneck of RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting

summary.core_problem: RL 微调提升 LLM 推理能力，但现有解释将成功归因于更强更多样的电路激活，混淆了激活与控制。
summary.importance: 原理分析，挑战以激活为中心的 RLFT 解释，引入控制论视角区分"被激活"与"实际控制奖励增益"。
summary.technical_approach: 改编代谢控制分析，定义训练后控制系数度量组件对奖励增益的控制；构建控制矩阵（组件×任务族）与激活幅度矩阵对比；识别共享控制瓶颈和激活-控制差距。
summary.experiments: 显示高度共享的激活可与任务特定的控制共存，小的激活-控制差距对应更好的跨任务泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: RL fine-tuning improves LLM reasoning, but existing accounts attribute success to stronger and more diverse circuit activation, conflating activation with control.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis: challenges the activation-centered account of RLFT by introducing a control-theoretic view that distinguishes 'being activated' from 'actually controlling reward gain'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adapts Metabolic Control Analysis to define the Post-training Control Coefficient measuring each component's control over reward gain; builds a control matrix (components × task families) and compares it with an activation-magnitude matrix; identifies the Shared Control Bottleneck and Activation-Control Gap.
summary_en.experiments: Shows that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, and a small activation-control gap correlates with better cross-task generalization.

recommendation.zh: 激活≠控制这个区分值得吸收，做 RLFT 电路分析时应同时看控制系数而非只看激活幅度；重点看控制系数定义和控制矩阵那一节。
recommendation.en: The activation-vs-control distinction is worth internalizing: when analyzing RLFT circuits, track control coefficients alongside activation magnitude; focus on the control coefficient definition and control matrix section.

paper.title: Multilingual Emotion Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Emotion is central to human communication, and its expression varies across languages. Large audio-language models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on multilingual speech tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they encode emotion through language-specific correlations or language-agnostic representations. We present the first neuron-level interpretability study of this question. We define Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs) as functional units exhibiting stable emotional selectivity and aligne

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：大音频语言模型里的情感表征，究竟主要依赖语言特定相关性，还是存在跨语言共享、可因果操控的“情感神经元”。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在机制分析而不是方法推进。它把语音/音频 LM 的可解释性从单语扩展到多语，并尝试用神经元级别证据讨论跨语言共享表示，这对统一音频-语言预训练是否学到语言无关语义有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了 Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs)，要求这些神经元在不同语言上同时满足稳定的情感选择性和一致的因果效应；并提出 Consistency-Regularized Fusion (CR-Fusion)，把跨语言证据融合起来识别这类单元。核心不是改模型，而是做神经元筛选、跨语言一致性约束和干预验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个现代 LALM、12 种类型学差异较大的语言。结果显示：若按单语言分别找情感神经元，跨语言重合度很低；继续增加单语识别数据也很快饱和，难以找到更可迁移的单元；而用跨语言 pooled 证据识别出的 MLENs，在因果干预下表现出更稳定的跨语言情感控制效果。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合把它当作现象论文而非可直接复现的 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自语音、情感计算和多语 NLP 交叉方向；Philipp Koehn 与 Björn Schuller 在机器翻译、语音与情感计算领域有较高知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether emotion in large audio-language models is encoded mainly through language-specific correlations or through cross-lingually shared, causally meaningful neurons.
summary_en.importance: Its value is primarily mechanistic rather than methodological. It extends interpretability in speech/audio LMs from monolingual settings to multilingual ones, and probes whether unified audio-language pretraining learns language-agnostic affective representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs) as units with stable emotional selectivity and aligned causal effects across languages, and introduce Consistency-Regularized Fusion (CR-Fusion) to identify them from pooled multilingual evidence. The contribution is neuron discovery plus causal probing, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four modern LALMs and 12 typologically diverse languages. Emotion-sensitive neurons identified independently per language have little overlap; adding more monolingual identification data saturates quickly and does not reveal more transferable units; pooled multilingual identification yields MLENs with stronger cross-lingual causal effects under intervention. The abstract does not expose model sizes or exact gains, so this reads more like a phenomenon paper than a directly actionable recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors sit at the intersection of speech, affective computing, and multilingual NLP; Philipp Koehn and Björn Schuller are well-known in MT, speech, and emotion-related research.

recommendation.zh: 偏机制观察，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe；但如果你在做语音/音频统一建模，只看神经元重合度低而跨语融合后可因果对齐这个结论就够了。
recommendation.en: This will not change your pretraining recipe, but if you work on speech/audio LM pretraining, the key takeaway is that per-language emotion neurons barely overlap while pooled multilingual evidence yields causally aligned units.

paper.title: Deployable Per-Instance Multi-Layer Activation Steering for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Activation steering edits the behaviour of a frozen language model by adding a learned vector to its residual stream, and current practice fixes the injection layers globally per task. We argue that the best layers are an instance-level decision, and we make per-instance, multi-layer selection both well understood and deployable. On two open-weight 8B models and six binary persona traits, a per-instance oracle over layer subsets shows that the best layers vary from one input to the next: on most

summary.core_problem: Activation steering 通常为一个任务固定选择注入层，但不同输入可能需要不同层组合，导致全局层选择不能充分利用 steering 效果。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 activation steering 层选择粒度的机制性观察和一个可部署近似方案；它对模型行为控制和推理时干预有参考价值，但离预训练目标或训练动态较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造 per-instance layer-subset oracle，验证最佳层组合随输入变化；再用按单层边际效应排序的 greedy rule 近似 oracle。由于 oracle 和 greedy 需要用 gold answer 打分，作者把 greedy 结果作为监督目标，训练一个只依赖 prompt embedding 的层排序器，并配合分类器在推理时决定是否干预。
summary.experiments: 在两个开源 8B 模型和六个二元 persona traits 上评估。摘要称多数 trait-model 组合中，固定全局层集合无法恢复 per-instance oracle 的收益；greedy rule 几乎恢复 oracle 收益，但不能直接部署，因此转化为 prompt-only predictor。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering usually fixes injection layers globally for a task, but different prompts may require different layer subsets, limiting the benefit of global layer choices.
