summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic observation about instance-level layer choice in activation steering and a deployable approximation. It is useful for behavior control and inference-time intervention, though it is not close to pretraining objectives or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first builds a per-instance layer-subset oracle to show that optimal steering layers vary by input. It then approximates the oracle with a greedy rule based on single-layer marginal effects. Since both require scoring against gold labels, the greedy rule is used as a supervision target for a prompt-only layer ranker, combined with a classifier to decide whether to intervene at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use two open-weight 8B models and six binary persona traits. The abstract reports that, for most trait-model pairs, no fixed global layer set recovers the per-instance benefit. A greedy rule recovers nearly all oracle benefit, but is not directly deployable, motivating the prompt-only predictor.

recommendation.zh: 结论比方法更有用：固定 steering 层是弱 prior；扫一下 oracle-vs-global 的表就够。
recommendation.en: The finding is more useful than the method: fixed steering layers are a weak prior; skim the oracle-versus-global results and stop there.

paper.title: SkillEval: Decomposing Agent Skill Quality into Interpretable Signals
paper.abstract: Agent skills provide reusable procedural knowledge that helps agents solve specialized tasks. As their use expands, evaluating skill quality becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations often measure skill quality by testing whether a skill improves performance on specific downstream tasks. However, a reusable skill may apply to multiple task scenarios. Downstream evaluation mainly reflects the compatibility between a skill and the evaluated task, provides only a partial view of skill qu

summary.core_problem: 评估 Agent skill 的可复用质量，而不是只看某个 skill 是否提升某个下游任务的成功率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent skill 评测框架。它指出下游任务评测会混入 skill 与具体任务的兼容性，无法解释 skill 文档本身哪里好、哪里需要改；因此提出更可解释的 document-level skill evaluation。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillEval，将 skill 文档拆成若干通用属性，并为每个属性设置固定且可检查的 scoring direction，输出可解释的分项分数。框架还尝试测量并降低无关文档特征对评分的影响，使得分更接近 skill 本身的质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出 skill 数据规模、评估属性数量、使用的 judge 模型、人工标注规模、baseline 或数值结果。可确认的是其核心实验应围绕 skill 文档属性评分与下游任务表现之间的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates the reusable quality of agent skills rather than only measuring whether a skill improves a particular downstream task.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-framework contribution for agent skills. It argues that downstream task performance conflates intrinsic skill quality with task compatibility and gives little diagnostic signal about what part of a skill should be improved.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillEval decomposes a skill document into general properties and scores each property along a fixed, inspectable direction. It also measures and reduces the influence of unrelated document features so that the score better reflects the skill itself.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, number of properties, judge model, human annotation scale, baselines, or numerical results. The likely evaluation focuses on the relation between document-level skill properties and downstream utility.

recommendation.zh: skill 评测的诊断视角比成功率更细，但离预训练较远；只看属性定义和去混杂方法即可。
recommendation.en: The diagnostic framing is better than raw success rate, but it is far from pretraining; read only the property definitions and the deconfounding setup.

paper.title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes
paper.abstract: Existing measures of how much a text is about a concept read the surface of the text: dictionary word shares, topic proportions, embedding similarities. They score the words a text uses, not the judgment a reader forms about it. Recent work has shown that a gap exists in what Large Language Models (LLMs) know internally versus what they express in their response. This paper asks whether that internal knowledge, read by monitoring the activations of frozen, out-of-the-box LLMs, can stand in for t

summary.core_problem: 用冻结 LLM 的内部激活来衡量文本中某个概念的含量，而不是只依赖词表、主题模型、embedding 相似度或模型显式回答。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析与测量方法结合。它关注 LLM 内部表征是否能替代任务微调用于概念测量，和“模型知道但不一定说出”的 prior 有关。应用场景是 ESG 金融文本，因此对基座预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 probe/activation-based measurement 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从冻结、现成 LLM 中抽取激活，并用 Recursive Feature Machine 与线性 probe 构造概念含量分数；对比 embedding baseline、surface baseline 以及同一模型对问题的直接回答。方法不是训练新 LLM，而是读出已有模型隐藏状态中的概念信息。
summary.experiments: 实验使用人工标注的 ESG 金融文本资源，比较 RFM、linear probing、embedding、surface features 和模型自回答的概念测量效果。摘要未给出模型名称、层位选择、样本规模或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures how much a text is about a concept by reading frozen LLM activations rather than relying on dictionaries, topic proportions, embedding similarity, or the model's explicit answer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits between interpretability and measurement. It tests whether internal representations can substitute for task-specific fine-tuning in concept-content estimation, building on the observation that LLMs may encode knowledge they do not express. The ESG finance setting limits direct relevance to pretraining, but the probing setup is still useful background.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extract activation-based concept measures from frozen off-the-shelf LLMs using Recursive Feature Machine and linear probing. These are compared against embedding baselines, surface-text baselines, and the same model's direct answer to the concept question.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on human-annotated ESG financial text resources. The abstract states comparisons across RFM, linear probes, embeddings, surface baselines, and direct LLM answers, but does not provide model names, activation-layer choices, data scale, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表即可；它是 probe 测量论文，不是预训练 insight，但可提醒别把输出当成全部知识。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and result table only; this is a probing-measurement paper, not a pretraining result, but it reinforces that outputs are not the whole model state.

paper.title: Beyond Routing Weights: Faithful Response-Level Interpretation of Mixture-of-Experts Reward Models via Contribution Contrast
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to learning from human preferences, yet identifying what drives their predictions remains challenging. Recent sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reward models seek to improve interpretability by routing prompts to specialized experts and characterizing experts through examples with high routing weights. However, routing weights only reveal which prompts an expert $\textit{receives}$, not how it $\textit{judges}$ responses, providing only a partial account of expert behavio

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE reward model 的专家解释不忠实问题：router weight 只能说明样本被送到哪个专家，不能说明专家如何判断 chosen/rejected response。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 reward model 解释与诊断方法。它对 RLHF/RLVR 中 reward model 的可控性有参考价值，尤其是当 reward model 采用稀疏专家结构时，专家解释不能只看路由分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Contribution-Contrast, 简称 CoCo。它以 chosen-rejected response pair 为单位，寻找对某个专家贡献差异最大的样本，用“贡献对比”同时刻画 routing 行为和 preference scoring 行为。相比只按高 routing weight 找代表样本，CoCo 更接近专家对最终 reward 差异的实际作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在自动评估和人工评估中，CoCo 相比 router-based、score-based 和 sparse autoencoder-based 解释方法更 coherent、faithful、specialized，同时保持竞争性的 reward model 表现。摘要未给出模型规模、偏好数据集、提升幅度和人工评估协议细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies faithful interpretation of MoE reward models, where routing weights reveal which prompts an expert receives but not how the expert judges chosen-versus-rejected responses.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability and diagnostics contribution for preference modeling. It is relevant to RLHF and RLVR pipelines when reward models use sparse expert structure, because expert specialization cannot be inferred from routing alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Contribution-Contrast or CoCo, identifies chosen-rejected response pairs with the largest contribution contrast for each expert. This jointly captures routing behavior and preference-scoring behavior, unlike representative-example methods based only on high routing weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports automatic and human evaluations showing more coherent, faithful, and specialized expert interpretations than router-based, score-based, and sparse-autoencoder-based alternatives, while preserving competitive reward model performance. Model size, datasets, and effect sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 MoE reward model 才需要看，重点读贡献分解定义；对基座训练只是弱诊断信号。
recommendation.en: Only read it if you run MoE reward models; focus on the contribution decomposition, as the signal for base pretraining is indirect.

paper.title: The Ignition Index: Measuring Global Workspace Dynamics in Language Models
paper.abstract: We introduce the Ignition Index (I), a validated scalar metric that operationalizes Global Workspace Theory's (GWT) all-or-none ignition prediction in transformer language models. The metric fits a four-parameter sigmoid to per-layer linear probe accuracy as a function of input signal strength, extracting steepness parameter beta-hat: high values indicate abrupt, ignition-like transitions; low values indicate graded build-up. Across 11 models spanning five architecture families, shuffled-label c

summary.core_problem: 如何把 Global Workspace Theory 里“点火（ignition）是阈值式、全或无的表征跃迁”这一可检验预测，落到语言模型的层级表征动力学上，并给出一个能区分不同架构（注意力 Transformer vs SSM 等）的可重复测量指标。
summary.importance: 这篇属于机制分析/表征评测方法，对预训练 recipe 的直接改动不多，但有两点对基座研究员有用：1）提供了一个相对严格的、带对照的 probe+扰动测量协议，用来比较不同架构的“全局广播/信息整合”特性；2）把训练过程中的相变（phase transition）与表征动力学联系起来，报告了在 Pythia-410M 上一个早于 induction head 形成的“点火结构”转变信号。若该信号在更多模型/训练设置下稳定，可能成为训练监控与早期诊断的一个候选指标。
summary.technical_approach:
Ignition Index（I）定义为：对每一层的线性 probe 解码准确率随输入信号强度 s∈[0,1] 的变化曲线 Acc(l,s) 拟合一个四参数 sigmoid，并取其陡峭度参数 
β̂ 作为“点火程度”。β̂ 高表示在某个阈值附近出现陡峭跃迁（更像 all-or-none ignition），β̂ 低表示更线性/渐进的 build-up。
关键在于如何构造“信号强度”轴与如何做选择性验证：
- 信号强度通过受控 token corruption 与 embedding noise 来连续调节；
- 用 TransformerLens 抽取各层 residual stream 表征；
- 在多种语言 probing 任务上逐层训练线性 probe；
- 通过 shuffled-label 控制实验验证该指标确实捕捉到语言结构而不是 probe 容量或拟合伪象；并额外检查 sigmoid ceiling 命中对拟合的影响。
论文还把该指标用于不同架构族的比较，并对 Huginn-3.5B 这类 recurrent-depth 结构做“沿迭代轴”的 probing，显示点火特性与计算轴相关。
summary.experiments:
文中覆盖 12 个模型、5 个架构族（GPT-2、Pythia、Gemma 2、Huginn-3.5B、Mamba）与 7 个 probing 任务。
- 架构可分性：注意力家族的平均 β̂≈130.0，而 SSM（Mamba）平均 β̂≈68.7，差异显著（p<1e-13）；Mamba 呈近线性 profile，被解释为缺少类似全局广播的阈值跃迁。
- shuffled-label 选择性：真实标签与打乱标签之间有 9.6 倍 selectivity gap（p<0.001），用于证明指标不是 probe 过拟合。
- ceiling 鲁棒性：排除 sigmoid ceiling 命中后，FF–SSM 差距扩大到 2.12×，说明差异不是拟合上限导致。
- 训练动态：在 Pythia-410M 上报告 step=256 出现新的点火结构相变，早于已知的 induction head 形成阶段。
- recurrent-depth：对 Huginn-3.5B 沿 recurrence 维度测得 2.12× 更高的点火，提示“点火”可能依赖于信息反复整合的计算路径，而不只是层数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看方法定义与拟合细节：Ignition Index 的 sigmoid 参数化、信号强度 s 的构造方式、以及为什么用 β̂ 而不是阈值 s0 或上限。
- 必看 shuffled-label 与 ceiling robustness 两组控制实验；没有这两块，probe 指标很容易被质疑。
- 如果关心架构选择，重点看 attention vs Mamba 的对比图（逐层曲线）以及统计检验设置。
- 如果关心训练监控，重点看 Pythia-410M 的训练步数轴分析（step=256 的相变）以及它与 induction head 形成的时间关系。
- 预计不需要逐字读背景的 GWT 综述，直接抓住“阈值式跃迁”如何被 operationalize 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: How to operationalize Global Workspace Theory’s falsifiable prediction—an all-or-none “ignition” transition—as a quantitative, architecture-comparable metric in language models’ layerwise representational dynamics.
summary_en.importance: This is mechanistic evaluation rather than a new pretraining recipe, but it is useful in two ways for foundation-model work: (1) it provides a fairly controlled probe+perturbation protocol to compare “global broadcast / integration” tendencies across architectures (attention Transformers vs SSMs); (2) it reports a training-time transition signal (in Pythia-410M) that appears earlier than the well-known induction-head formation, suggesting a potential early diagnostic for training dynamics—if it replicates broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The Ignition Index (I) is defined by fitting a 4-parameter sigmoid to probe accuracy as a function of input signal strength. Concretely:
- Construct a continuous signal-strength axis s∈[0,1] by controlled token corruption and embedding noise.
- Extract per-layer residual stream activations (via TransformerLens).
- Train linear probes at every layer for multiple linguistic probing tasks.
- Fit Acc(l,s) with a sigmoid and take the steepness parameter β̂ as the ignition score: high β̂ indicates an abrupt threshold-like transition; low β̂ indicates graded accumulation.
Selectivity and robustness are addressed with shuffled-label controls (to rule out probe capacity artifacts) and analyses excluding sigmoid “ceiling hits” (to ensure the attention–SSM gap is not a fitting artifact). The metric is also applied along different computation axes (e.g., recurrent-depth iterations in Huginn) to test axis-dependent ignition patterns.
summary_en.experiments:
Coverage: 12 models across 5 families (GPT-2, Pythia, Gemma 2, Huginn-3.5B, Mamba) and 7 probing tasks.
Key results:
- Architecture discrimination: attention-based families show much higher ignition (mean β̂≈130.0) than SSMs (mean β̂≈68.7), highly significant (p<1e-13). Mamba exhibits near-linear profiles, consistent with absent threshold-like global broadcast.
- Shuffled-label validation: a 9.6× selectivity gap between real vs shuffled labels (p<0.001), supporting that the metric captures genuine linguistic structure.
- Ceiling robustness: excluding ceiling-hit cases increases the feedforward–SSM gap to 2.12×, arguing against sigmoid-fitting artifacts.
- Training dynamics: in Pythia-410M, a new ignition-structure phase transition is reported at step 256, preceding induction-head formation.
- Recurrent-depth: Huginn-3.5B shows ~2.12× higher ignition along the recurrence dimension, suggesting ignition depends on the computation axis (iterative integration) rather than depth alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Start with the metric definition: the sigmoid parameterization, how s is generated, and why β̂ is the chosen summary statistic.
- Do not skip the controls: shuffled-label selectivity and the ceiling-hit robustness check are the credibility anchors.
- For architecture implications, focus on the layerwise curves comparing attention models vs Mamba and the associated statistical tests.
- For training-dynamics interest, read the Pythia-410M step-axis analysis around the step-256 transition and its temporal relation to induction-head emergence.
- The GWT background can be skimmed; the key is how “ignition” is operationalized and validated.

recommendation.zh: 用GWT理论量化架构的全局信息广播能力是很有意思的角度，Transformer vs SSM的差异结论可作为架构选型的弱参考，重点看Fig 3的架构对比。
recommendation.en: Quantifying global information broadcasting capability of architectures using GWT is an interesting angle; the Transformer vs SSM difference conclusion can serve as weak reference for architecture selection, focus on Fig 3.

paper.title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
paper.abstract: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintr

summary.core_problem: 现有基于残差流层间位移的推理正确性探测方法，存在位移丢初始状态、全状态探测易引入捷径特征的权衡，无法可靠区分正确与错误推理。
summary.importance: 方法类增量改进，通过拆分状态表示的粒度平衡探测精度与捷径风险，为推理过程的内部表示探测提供了新的设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三流检测器：一路捕捉层间运动信息，一路基于向量量化做粗粒度区域位置读取，一路在归一化多层状态上做细粒度方向读取，仅保留受限的位置上下文避免捷径。
summary.experiments: 在训练阶段未见过的推理基准上，相比纯位移探测方法，正确推理结果的选择准确率最高提升12%。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing residual-stream displacement based reasoning correctness probes face a trade-off: displacement omits initial state context, while full-state probing reintroduces shortcut-prone features.
summary_en.importance: An incremental method design that balances probing accuracy and shortcut risk by disentangling state representation granularity, offering a new design reference for internal reasoning representation probing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a three-stream detector: one stream captures inter-layer motion, one uses vector quantization for coarse region reading, one performs fine-grained direction reading over normalized multi-layer states, retaining only restricted location context to avoid shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, the method improves correct reasoning selection accuracy by up to 12% compared to displacement-only baselines.

recommendation.zh: 残差流探测推理错误的增量改进，三流拆分位置与运动的设计有参考性，无训练侧可直接落地的结论
recommendation.en: Incremental work on residual-stream reasoning error detection, the three-stream design is decent but offers no actionable insights for pretraining.

institutions: Australian Institute for Machine Learning, University of Adelaide

paper.title: Strengthening Target-Language Features: SAE-Based Steering for Multilingual Inference
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models exhibit substantial performance differences across languages, while existing adaptation methods often require parameter updates and considerable multilingual training data. We propose an inference-time multilingual steering method that uses pretrained sparse autoencoders to identify and strengthen target-language-related features. Using multilingual parallel sentences, we compare SAE activations across languages and select a small number of layer-specific featu

summary.core_problem: 解决多语言 LLM 在目标语言推理上性能不均衡、而现有适配方法又依赖参数更新和多语训练数据的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇的价值不在多语任务本身，而在它把 SAE feature steering 用到语言特征层面，提供了一个“语言能力是否可由少量可识别特征在推理时调节”的机制性证据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用预训练 sparse autoencoder 从模型内部表征中抽取特征；再借助多语平行句比较不同语言的 SAE 激活，选出与目标语言相关的少量层特征。随后把这些特征解码成 steering signal，直接注入 hidden states，在不更新模型参数的情况下增强目标语言相关表征。
summary.experiments: 在 Gemma-3-12B-it 上评测，目标是多语言推理与理解。摘要报告平均提升：XCOPA +10.9 个点、XNLI +5.3 个点、MGSM +1.9 个点。未见训练新模型，属于纯 inference-time intervention。baseline 应是未 steering 的原模型及现有适配方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Johns Hopkins University；Philipp Koehn 是机器翻译与多语言 NLP 领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses uneven target-language performance in multilingual LLMs without relying on parameter updates or substantial multilingual adaptation data.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about the multilingual benchmarks themselves and more about using SAE-based feature steering as evidence that language-specific capability may be modulated through a small set of identifiable internal features at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses pretrained sparse autoencoders to extract internal features, compares SAE activations across parallel multilingual sentences to identify layer-specific target-language features, and decodes those features into steering signals injected into hidden states. No model parameters are updated.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Gemma-3-12B-it for multilingual reasoning and understanding. The abstract reports average gains of +10.9 on XCOPA, +5.3 on XNLI, and +1.9 on MGSM. This is a pure inference-time intervention, with baselines likely including the unsteered model and existing adaptation methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Johns Hopkins University; Philipp Koehn is a well-known researcher in machine translation and multilingual NLP.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 SAE 到可控能力编辑的接口，这篇值得看；先别把分数提升当真理，重点看语言特征是否真有层级局部性，以及 steering 是否牺牲非目标语言。
recommendation.en: If you care about the interface between SAE features and controllable capability editing, this is worth reading; don’t over-index on the gains—check whether language features are truly localized and whether steering hurts other languages.

paper.title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
paper.abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become the de facto standard for image encoding across many perception tasks. Despite their empirical success, it remains mechanistically unclear how they encode low-level features, given their lack of inductive biases: ViTs process information globally rather than relying on local structure. Biological visual systems, in contrast, build low-level features, such as orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex, by combining information from small, localized

summary.core_problem: 分析 ViT 是否以及如何形成类似生物视觉皮层的低级方向选择性表示。
summary.importance: 这是视觉表示机制分析论文，贡献是提出一组受神经科学启发的指标来测量 ViT 中 orientation selectivity 的出现方式；对 VLM 视觉编码器选择和解释有弱相关性，但不直接改变 LLM 预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: IRIS 框架引入 representational similarity score、orientation recruitment score 等指标，用于检测 ViT 表示是否按方向刺激形成结构化响应，并分析这种低级特征在不同层或模块中的出现位置。方法是把神经科学测量思路迁移到 ViT 表征分析中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体模型清单、训练数据或数值结果；可以确认的是论文针对 ViT 图像编码器做系统测量，而不是提出新的训练目标或架构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes whether and how Vision Transformers develop low-level orientation-selective representations analogous to those observed in the biological visual cortex.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-mechanism study for visual encoders. Its main contribution is a neuroscience-inspired measurement suite for orientation selectivity in ViTs. It has weak relevance to VLM visual encoder analysis, but it does not change LLM pretraining practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: IRIS introduces metrics such as representational similarity score and orientation recruitment score to test whether ViT representations show structured responses to oriented stimuli and where such low-level features arise across the model. The approach transfers neuroscience-style probes to ViT representation analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list the exact model set, training data, or quantitative findings. It indicates a systematic analysis of ViT image encoders rather than a new objective, architecture, or pretraining recipe.

recommendation.zh: 若关心 VLM 视觉编码器机制，可看指标定义；对语言预训练没有动作项，别在实验细节上花时间。
recommendation.en: Useful only if you care about visual-encoder mechanisms for VLMs; read the metric definitions, not the full experimental detail.

paper.title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答一个较窄但有用的问题：LLM 在把数值序列当文本做 in-context learning 时，内部表示是否真的按序列动力学复杂度组织，而不只是最终预测误差看起来有差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。它把注意力矩阵看成 token 图，把 hidden states 看成图上信号，用图谱诊断来分析数值 ICL。这个视角适合补足纯 output-level evaluation 的不足：两个序列族的外推误差可能接近，但内部表示的连通性、频谱能量和谱熵已经不同。对基座模型研究来说，价值在于提供了一套可复用的表征诊断工具，尤其适合研究长上下文中模型如何组织非自然语言结构，例如时间序列、程序 trace、表格和离散化后的多模态 token。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把每一层、每个 attention head 的 post-softmax attention 矩阵视为一个加权图，token hidden states 是定义在图节点上的信号。论文使用三个图谱指标：normalized Fiedler value 衡量 attention 图的全局连通性；high-frequency energy ratio 衡量 hidden-state 信号在图上的粗糙程度；spectral entropy 衡量信号频谱支撑的分散程度。实验输入包括 10 类一维序列族：常数序列、不同 r 参数下的 logistic map 周期轨道和混沌轨道，以及 Lorenz 系统 x 分量。logistic map 被用作主控对象，因为它在相同递推形式下可以沿 period-doubling 路径从低周期过渡到混沌。数值序列被线性缩放到 50 到 950，量化为三位整数，并用逗号分隔；这样三位数字和逗号在常见 tokenizer 中通常是单 token，可以保持数值状态与 token 的一一对应，避免数字被拆分后污染图分析。
summary.experiments: 主要实验每个序列族采样 20 条轨迹，并比较不同 context length 下的层内表示。结论是：context length 增加后，内部表示更清楚地按输入动力学复杂度排序；周期更长、混沌程度更高的序列，在图谱指标上与低复杂度序列分离更明显。论文还指出，某些输入族在最终外推误差上很接近，但 graph-spectral diagnostics 可以区分它们，说明输出误差不是观察数值 ICL 的唯一有效信号。附录还扩展到带 distribution shift、平滑周期变化和随机演化的结构化数值序列，用来检查现象是否只依赖 logistic map 设置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methods 中的数值序列序列化设计和三个谱指标定义；这部分决定了分析是否可信。图 1 可以帮助理解 attention graph + hidden-state signal 的建模方式。主结果图和附录中关于 extrapolation error 聚集但表征指标分离的图值得看，因为它们说明这种诊断相对常规误差指标提供了什么额外信息。若关注 tokenizer 和数值表示，建议细看三位整数、逗号分隔、全轨迹先量化再截断这些实现选择；这些细节比图谱术语更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs organize numerical sequence information internally according to dynamical complexity during in-context learning, rather than only showing differences in final prediction error.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic. It proposes a representation-level lens for numerical ICL: attention matrices define token graphs, and hidden states define graph signals. This helps expose structure that output error alone can miss. The same type of analysis could be useful for long-context pretraining studies where the input is structured but serialized as tokens, such as time series, tables, program traces, or discretized multimodal streams.
summary_en.technical_approach: At each transformer layer and attention head, the post-softmax attention matrix is treated as a weighted graph over tokens. Hidden states are treated as node signals on that graph. The paper applies three graph-spectral diagnostics: normalized Fiedler value for global connectivity, high-frequency energy ratio for signal roughness, and spectral entropy for the breadth of spectral support. The controlled input suite contains constant sequences, logistic-map trajectories with increasing periods and chaotic regimes, and the x-component of the Lorenz system. The logistic map is the main controlled family because changing the parameter r moves the dynamics from low-period behavior through period doubling to chaos while preserving the recurrence form. Numerical values are rescaled to 50-950, rounded to zero-padded three-digit integers, and separated by commas, so that numeric values and separators align cleanly with tokens under common tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: The main suite uses 10 sequence families with 20 trajectory realizations per family. The reported pattern is that longer contexts make internal representations more clearly ordered by input dynamical complexity. Periodic sequences with longer periods and chaotic sequences become more separable from low-complexity inputs in the graph-spectral diagnostics. The paper also notes cases where output extrapolation errors remain tightly clustered while representation-level diagnostics separate the input families. Additional appendix experiments consider structured numerical sequences with distribution shifts, smooth periodic variation, and stochastic evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20-30 minutes. Focus on the serialization design and the definitions of the three spectral diagnostics, since these choices determine the validity of the analysis. Figure 1 is useful for the attention-graph and graph-signal framing. The main result figures and the appendix comparison against extrapolation error are the most relevant parts. Readers interested in tokenizer effects should pay attention to the three-digit integer format, comma tokens, and the decision to quantize the full trajectory before truncation.

recommendation.zh: ICL 机制分析的新视角，图谱诊断方法可借鉴；重点看图谱指标和可视化部分，结论偏描述性。
recommendation.en: A new perspective on ICL mechanism analysis; the graph-spectral diagnostic methodology is worth borrowing. Focus on spectral metrics and visualizations; conclusions are mostly descriptive.

paper.title: A Theory of Conditional Collapse under Low-Rank Weight-Space Ablations: I. The Single-Block Theory and Synthetic Validation
paper.abstract: Activation patching and weight-space ablation both claim a component is causally responsible for a behavior, yet they act on different objects: one forward pass versus the parameters behind every forward pass. We ask when they agree.   We study an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream, $F(x)=F_0(x)+\sum_iα_i(x)v_i$, read out by a linear functional, and prove three exact results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses a matched inp

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 activation patching 和 weight-space ablation 什么时候会给出一致的因果结论。两者都常被用来判断某个网络组件是否承载某种行为，但一个改的是单次 forward 的激活，另一个改的是产生所有 forward 的参数；论文用一个单 block 的理想化模型说明二者可以系统性不一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在机制分析方法论。大模型预训练后的能力归因经常依赖 patching、ablation、低秩方向移除等工具；这篇论文给出一个明确警告：patching recovery 很强不等于 weight ablation 一定显著，ablation 看起来影响小也不等于组件无关。原因不是实验噪声，而是 patching 测量的是 matched pair 上的 contrast，ablation 测量的是 receiver 上的 absolute level。这会影响如何解释 circuit、feature direction、低秩编辑和安全相关的能力移除实验。
summary.technical_approach: 论文建立一个 abstract conditional model：残差流表示为 F(x)=F0(x)+∑i αi(x)vi，其中 vi 是固定 carrier direction，αi(x) 是输入相关系数；线性读出 s(x)=ψ(F(x))+b 的符号决定输出。对 matched pair (xA,xB)，论文证明三个结果。第一，删除某个 carrier 子集 S 会把 pair collapse 到同一个 unconditional output，当且仅当被删除的 mass 在 pair 上对称，并且 S 外部不再保留 contrast；此时错误是确定性的，且所有满足条件的子集产生相同 collapse。第二，patching carrier i 的读出变化是 βiδi，其中 βi=ψ(vi)，δi=αi(xA)-αi(xB)；ablation carrier i 的变化是 -βiαi(xB)。这两个量互不支配，因此可以构造出每个单 carrier patch 都能翻转决策、但没有任何单 carrier ablation 能翻转决策的例子。第三，对 attention head 与同层 MLP 这种非独立组合，论文分析 RMSNorm 之后的 MLP 交互项，给出二阶 remainder bound；MLP 单独 ablation 时该项消失，但 head ablation 会扰动同 block 的 MLP 输出。
summary.experiments: 实验是小规模合成验证，而不是大模型实证。作者训练小 transformer 完成 synthetic conditional task，用来展示理论预测可以在训练后的网络中出现。实验验证了条件 collapse、patching 与 ablation effect 不一致、以及 head-MLP 组合中由归一化和 MLP 引入的偏差项。论文明确把实验定位为 sanity check，不是完整 validation campaign。给出的数值规模和任务细节有限，结论强度主要来自定理而不是 benchmark 结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction，确认论文要区分的是 activation-level intervention 和 parameter-level intervention。重点读 abstract conditional model 的定义，以及三个定理对应的小节。最值得细看的是第二个结果：patch effect βiδi 与 ablation effect -βiαi(xB) 的差异，它直接解释了为什么 patching 和 ablation 会给出相反印象。RMSNorm-MLP 交互部分适合有 mechanistic interpretability 背景的读者细读；如果只关心预训练能力归因，可以快速看结论和误差项含义。合成实验部分看图和现象即可，不宜过度外推到大模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when activation patching and weight-space ablation should agree as causal evidence. Both are used to attribute a behavior to a model component, but they intervene on different objects: one modifies activations in a single forward pass, while the other edits parameters that affect all forward passes. The paper uses a single-block idealized model to show that disagreement is expected in well-defined regimes.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly methodological for mechanistic analysis of pretrained models. Patching, ablation, low-rank direction removal, and circuit localization are often used to explain capabilities learned during pretraining. This paper gives a precise reason why strong patching recovery does not imply strong ablation effect, and weak ablation effect does not imply irrelevance. Patching measures contrast between a matched pair; ablation measures the absolute contribution at the receiver input. That distinction matters for interpreting feature directions, circuit claims, low-rank model edits, and attempts to remove capabilities from pretrained networks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is built on an abstract conditional model: the residual representation is written as F(x)=F0(x)+∑i αi(x)vi, where vi is a fixed carrier direction and αi(x) is an input-dependent coefficient. A linear readout s(x)=ψ(F(x))+b determines the decision sign. For a matched pair (xA,xB), the paper proves three main results. First, deleting a subset of carriers collapses both inputs to the same unconditional output if and only if the removed mass is symmetric on the pair and no contrast remains outside the deleted subset. The induced error is deterministic, and all subsets satisfying the condition produce the same collapse. Second, patching carrier i shifts the readout by βiδi, with βi=ψ(vi) and δi=αi(xA)-αi(xB), whereas ablating carrier i shifts it by -βiαi(xB). These quantities do not bound each other. The paper constructs cases where every single-carrier patch flips the decision but no single-carrier ablation does. Third, for the non-independent case of an attention head and its own layer’s MLP separated by RMSNorm, the paper derives an explicit interaction error with a second-order remainder bound. The correction vanishes for MLP-only ablation, but not for head ablation, because removing the head also perturbs the input seen by the same block’s MLP.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section is intentionally small. The authors train small transformers on a synthetic conditional task and check that the theoretical regimes appear in trained networks. The experiments illustrate conditional collapse, disagreement between patching and ablation effects, and the head-MLP interaction introduced by normalization and the MLP. The paper does not present a broad validation on large language models. The evidence is best read as a sanity check for the theory rather than as a benchmark-driven empirical claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the Introduction to understand the distinction between activation-level and parameter-level interventions. Then read the abstract conditional model and the three theorem statements. The most useful part is the comparison between the patching effect βiδi and the ablation effect -βiαi(xB), since it directly explains why the two tools can support different causal stories. The RMSNorm-MLP interaction section is worth reading carefully for readers working on transformer circuits; otherwise, focus on the implication of the error term. The synthetic experiments are useful for intuition, but the conclusions should not be directly extrapolated to large pretrained models without additional evidence.

recommendation.zh: 做可解释性或因果归因实验的人应读 §3 主定理，能避免把补丁结论直接外推到权重消融的常见错误。
recommendation.en: Researchers doing causal attribution work should read §3 theorems to avoid the common mistake of extrapolating patching conclusions to weight ablations.

paper.title: LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs
paper.abstract: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by hum

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 attribution graph 标注中的人工瓶颈：circuit tracing 能生成由 MLP neuron 或 SAE feature 构成的计算图，但把大量底层节点合并成有语义的 supernode 通常需要人工完成，单个图可能耗费一到两个研究小时。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在机制分析工具链。它降低了大规模检查模型内部计算图的成本，使 circuit tracing 更适合作为假设生成工具。对研究 ICL、planning、multi-hop reasoning 或训练后行为变化的团队，这类自动标注可以帮助更快定位候选 circuit，再用干预实验或 steering 做验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。实验对象是 Gemma-2-2B，特征来自 Gemma Scope single-layer transcoders，attribution graph 由 circuit-tracer 生成。对每个剪枝后的 feature，先用 LLM 根据 5 个 Neuronpedia top-activating examples 生成 feature description，并额外提供该 feature 最促进和最抑制的 token logit 信息。随后用 GPT-5 mini 做三阶段 supernode grouping：先处理影响最高的 50 个 feature，识别并命名有意义的 supernode；再把剩余 feature 按 50 个一批分配到已有 supernode、新 supernode 或未分组；最后做 refinement，删除无关组、合并等价组并修正错误分配。提示词里加入了粒度控制，例如 output feature 只能和 output feature 合并，分组粒度要相对原 prompt 判断，并避免为标点、停用词等低信息模式建组。
summary.experiments: 实验包含三类证据。第一，与 circuit-tracer 中 15 个 human-annotated reference graphs 比较，使用两个自动可解释性指标评估 supernode 描述质量：Feature Detection Score 让 LLM 根据 supernode 描述从 10 个 feature 描述中找出成员 feature；Text Detection Score 用文本层面的检测来评估描述是否可操作。结果显示自动 supernode 与人工标注在这些指标上相当，并优于随机基线。第二，在 two-hop Capitals 任务上，自动流程在 100 个 prompt 中有 97 个恢复出对应 intermediate hop 的 supernode。第三，作为开放探索示例，自动标注了 1000 个 Wikipedia prompts 的 attribution graphs，并筛选可能有趣或异常的行为。成本方面，40–80 个节点的重剪枝图约 3–6 美分；约 585 个节点的较密图约 60 美分，输入约 728K tokens、输出约 214K tokens。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–25 分钟。优先看 Methods 中 feature description 和三阶段 grouping prompt 设计，再看 human annotation comparison 的两个自动指标。two-hop Capitals 结果适合快速判断方法是否能恢复已知中间变量。开放 Wikipedia 探索部分可以略读，它更多展示工具使用方式，而不是给出强机制结论。若要复现，Appendix A 的提示词和剪枝阈值设置比主结果更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a practical bottleneck in circuit tracing: attribution graphs expose model components such as MLP neurons or SAE features, but grouping many low-level nodes into semantically meaningful supernodes still requires substantial manual annotation.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is through mechanistic analysis rather than training. Automating supernode annotation makes circuit tracing more scalable as a hypothesis-generation tool. This can help researchers inspect reasoning, planning, multi-hop retrieval, or behavioral changes after fine-tuning and RL before committing to more expensive causal interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline is intentionally simple. Experiments use Gemma-2-2B with Gemma Scope single-layer transcoders, and attribution graphs are produced with circuit-tracer. For each pruned feature, an LLM first writes a feature description using five Neuronpedia top-activating examples, augmented with promoted and suppressed token-logit information. GPT-5 mini then groups feature descriptions into supernodes in three stages. It first names and groups meaningful supernodes among the top 50 highest-influence features. It then assigns remaining features in batches of 50 to existing groups, new groups, or an ungrouped bucket. A final refinement pass removes irrelevant groups, merges equivalent groups, and fixes misplaced features. The prompts include constraints on grouping granularity, output-feature handling, and low-information patterns such as punctuation or stop words.
summary_en.experiments: The study compares automated supernodes with 15 human-annotated reference graphs from circuit-tracer using two automated interpretability metrics. Feature Detection Score asks whether an LLM can recover a member feature from a supernode description among distractors. Text Detection Score evaluates whether the description is useful at the text level. The automated groupings are reported to be comparable to human groupings on these metrics and better than random baselines. On a two-hop Capitals task, the pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 out of 100 prompts. The authors also annotate 1000 Wikipedia-prompt attribution graphs as a proof of concept for open-ended exploration. Cost scales roughly with graph size: about 3–6 cents for heavily pruned 40–80 node graphs and about 60 cents for denser graphs with roughly 585 nodes.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 15–25 minutes. Read the methods for the feature-description step and the three-stage grouping procedure, then check the human-comparison metrics and the two-hop Capitals result. The Wikipedia exploration is useful for understanding workflow, but it should not be treated as strong mechanistic evidence by itself. For implementation, the appendix prompts and pruning thresholds are likely the most reusable parts.

recommendation.zh: 研究circuit tracing或神经元可解释性的人员读方法部分即可，可直接复用流水线减少人工标注成本，无机制层面的新发现
recommendation.en: Read the method section if you work on circuit tracing or neuron interpretability; directly reusable pipeline to reduce manual annotation, no new mechanistic insights

paper.title: The Tell-Tale Trace: Detecting Reasoning Failures in LLMs Using Chain-of-Thought Dynamics
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large language model (LLM) performance while also providing an observable interface to the model's reasoning process. Existing approaches that leverage verbalized CoTs to monitor reasoning correctness, however, largely evaluate the semantic correctness or consistency of individual intermediate steps, rather than how the reasoning process evolves across the trace. As a result, failures distributed across the reasoning trajectory, rather than those localiz

summary.core_problem: 能否不依赖 CoT 单步语义正确性，而利用可见 CoT 轨迹的动态特征来识别 LLM 的推理失败？
summary.importance: 原理/分析贡献：把 CoT 视为不忠实反映内部计算的可观测轨迹，从轨迹动态而非单步语义角度检测推理失败，对 verifier 和 test-time 控制有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在可验证的 Boolean 类推理任务上研究多种 LLM，提取 CoT 轨迹随步骤演化的动态特征，区分成功与失败推理，而不把中间陈述当作内部计算的字面解释。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型清单、特征定义或准确率数字；仅说明覆盖多个 LLM 和可验证 Boolean 推理任务。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校和圣裘德儿童研究医院；摘要未披露知名作者或相关代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Can visible chain-of-thought dynamics, rather than the semantic correctness of individual steps, be used to detect LLM reasoning failures without assuming CoT faithfulness?
summary_en.importance: Analytical/mechanistic contribution: it treats CoT as an observable trace that need not faithfully reflect internal computation, and detects failures from trajectory dynamics rather than step-level semantics, which is relevant to verifiers and test-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach: It studies a range of LLMs on verifiable Boolean-style reasoning tasks, extracts dynamic features of how the CoT trace evolves across steps, and distinguishes successful from failed reasoning without interpreting intermediate statements as literal accounts of internal computation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list specific models, feature definitions, or accuracy numbers; it only states that multiple LLMs and verifiable Boolean reasoning tasks are covered.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Washington University in St. Louis and St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital; the abstract does not identify well-known authors or representative prior work.

recommendation.zh: 把 CoT 当动态信号而非语义解释来做失败检测，角度新；摘要无定量结果，先看特征构造和跨模型一致性。
recommendation.en: Treating CoT as a dynamic signal rather than a semantic account is a fresh angle; with no quantitative results in the abstract, inspect the feature design and cross-model consistency first.

paper.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理 test-time latent reasoning 的信用分配问题。已有 LatentSeek、LTPO、MILR 一类方法在测试时优化样本级连续 latent，但 latent 通常先被解码成 token，再通过离散 token 序列影响后续推理。这样 reward 信号只能间接穿过解码过程回到 latent，既弱化优化信号，也让每个 latent 对后续 reasoning token 和最终答案的作用难以解释。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在 latent reasoning 与模型内部计算接口。它把可优化 latent 放到 Transformer 中间层 hidden space，而不是放在输出侧 token 接口，这提供了一种更接近模型内部计算图的测试时推理增强方式。对研究 pretrain-posttrain 接口也有启发：如果模型未来要支持 latent thinking 或 internal scratchpad，latent 插入位置、attention 可达性、梯度路径是否直接，会影响推理时优化的稳定性和可解释性。
summary.technical_approach: GradCuit 选择某个 Transformer 中间层作为 latent 优化空间。对一个 M 层 decoder，在第 l 层后得到 prompt 和已生成 token 的 hidden states，然后把一组可优化 latent states 插入这些表示之间，再经过剩余层和 LM head 预测下一个 token。这样 latent 不是先映射成离散 token，而是直接作为 self-attention 中的节点参与后续层计算。生成 token 对 latent 的影响路径由剩余 Transformer 层中的 attention 和 MLP 形成，反向传播时 reward-weighted policy gradient 可以从每个生成位置直接回到每个 latent。论文还用 token probability 对 latent 的 Jacobian 来观察 token-latent sensitivity，从而分析哪些 reasoning connector token 对 latent 更新贡献更大。和 LatentSeek 的主要区别是：LatentSeek 的 latent 作用在输出侧，需要通过 decoded prefix 建立影响；GradCuit 的 latent 作用在中间 hidden space，梯度路径更短，也更贴近 Transformer 自身的计算结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 backbone 和 3 个 reasoning benchmark，并比较标准 CoT 与 4 个增强推理 baseline。按论文报告，GradCuit 在所有 backbone、benchmark 和 answer format 的平均上比 CoT 高 6.6 个百分点；整体平均准确率为 64.5%，强于最强竞争方法的 62.1%。鲁棒性实验中，在 7 个 learning-rate 设置下，GradCuit 持续优于 LatentSeek，并把准确率标准差从 1.53 降到 0.82。一个有信息量的消融是把 policy-gradient 更新替换成 random walk 后，GradCuit 仍能接近 LatentSeek，说明中间层 latent space 本身比输出侧 latent 更容易被模型利用，性能并不完全依赖精细的优化方向。可解释性实验通过 Jacobian 分析发现 reasoning-connector tokens 在 latent dynamics 中作用明显，这支持了作者关于 attention circuit 作为信用分配路径的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分中 latent 插入位置、autoregressive factorization 和 policy-gradient 更新公式，确认它和输出侧 latent 方法的差异。实验部分重点看三类结果：平均准确率对比、learning-rate 鲁棒性、random-walk 消融。可解释性部分建议看 Jacobian/token-latent sensitivity 的图表，因为这决定了 GradCuit 是否只是一个 test-time optimizer，还是确实提供了可观察的 latent dynamics。若只关心预训练启发，可重点思考一个问题：预训练时是否可以显式暴露或正则化这种中间层 latent slot，让模型在训练阶段就学会使用可优化 internal states。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the credit-assignment problem in test-time latent reasoning. Prior methods optimize instance-specific continuous latents, but the latents usually affect reasoning through decoded tokens. The reward signal therefore reaches the latents only through a discrete generation interface, making optimization indirect and making it hard to tell how a latent variable contributed to later reasoning tokens or the final answer.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is the interface between latent reasoning and the model’s internal computation, rather than a new pretraining recipe. GradCuit places optimizable latent states inside the Transformer hidden space instead of at the output-token interface. This is a useful design point for future latent-thinking models: where the latent state is inserted, whether tokens can attend to it, and how directly gradients can reach it all affect robustness and interpretability at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: GradCuit selects an intermediate layer of an M-layer decoder as the latent optimization space. After the first l layers process the prompt and previously generated tokens, a small set of latent states is inserted into the hidden-state sequence. The concatenated sequence is then passed through the remaining Transformer layers and the LM head to predict the next token. Since these latent states participate directly in self-attention, each generated token can attend to the latent positions, and reward-weighted gradients can flow back to the latents through the same Transformer computation path. The method also inspects the Jacobian of token probabilities with respect to latent states to analyze token-latent sensitivity. The key difference from LatentSeek is the interface: LatentSeek lets latents influence generation through decoded prefix tokens, while GradCuit lets them operate as hidden-state nodes inside the attention circuit.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five backbones and three reasoning benchmarks, with comparisons against standard CoT and four enhanced reasoning baselines. Averaged over all backbones, benchmarks, and answer formats, GradCuit improves over CoT by 6.6 percentage points. Its overall average accuracy is 64.5%, compared with 62.1% for the strongest competing method. In a robustness study over seven learning-rate settings, GradCuit consistently outperforms LatentSeek and reduces the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82. A useful ablation replaces policy-gradient updates with a random walk; GradCuit remains competitive with LatentSeek, suggesting that the intermediate hidden-state latent space is easier for the model to use than an output-side latent interface. The interpretability analysis uses Jacobians and highlights the role of reasoning-connector tokens in latent dynamics.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough. Focus first on the algorithm section: the latent insertion point, the modified autoregressive factorization, and the reward-weighted latent update. Then read the experimental tables for average accuracy, learning-rate sensitivity, and the random-walk ablation. The Jacobian-based interpretability figures are worth checking because they clarify whether the method only improves test-time search or also provides a usable view into latent dynamics. For pretraining researchers, the most useful question is whether such latent slots should be exposed during pretraining so that the model learns to use optimizable internal states before inference-time search.

recommendation.zh: 把 test-time latent 优化的 credit assignment 从“经由解码 token”改成“穿过 Transformer 电路直连”，接口更干净；重点看 latent 插入位置与梯度路径设计，数值提升先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: It cleans up test-time latent optimization by routing credit assignment through the Transformer circuit instead of decoded tokens; focus on where latents are inserted and how gradients flow—treat reported gains as a weak signal until you inspect the setup.

paper.title: Divergent large language model predictions from convergent representations in ambiguous word pairs
paper.abstract: In this work we investigate how decoder-only transformers resolve lexical ambiguity through layer-by-layer analysis of three models spanning three parameter sizes (GPT-2-Small-117M, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-32B). For both homonyms and polysemes, we find that representations become maximally distinct in middle layers, then partially reconverge in late layers, while the KL divergence between their next-token predictions reaches its maximum in the final layers. The activation patching experiment provi

summary.core_problem: 词汇歧义消解场景下，晚期层嵌入的几何相似性与模型实际预测的语义区分度存在脱节，这一脱节的形成机制、晚期层表示对消歧结果的因果作用，以及不同规模模型的层间依赖规律均不明确。
summary.importance: 澄清了decoder-only Transformer中表示几何与预测行为的解耦关系，纠正了用晚期层余弦相似度直接衡量语义编码程度的常见做法；为理解预训练模型的分层语义计算逻辑提供了跨规模的一致证据，对嵌入模型设计、探测方法选择有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 选取跨三个数量级参数量的三个decoder-only模型（GPT-2-Small 117M、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-32B），覆盖同音异义词、多义词两类歧义场景，采用三层分析框架：1）通过logit lens逐层测量隐藏状态余弦距离、投影logit距离、下一词预测KL散度，分离表示编码与预测编码过程；2）通过激活补丁验证层特异性表示与最终消歧输出的因果关联；3）通过单层消融对比不同模型的层依赖模式。
summary.experiments: 三类模型、两类歧义场景下均呈现一致规律：不同语境中同一歧义词的表示在中间层区分度达到峰值，晚期层出现部分重新收敛，而下一词预测分布的KL散度在最后一层达到最大。激活补丁实验证实，晚期层表示尽管几何分离度下降，仍因果决定消歧输出。单层消融结果显示，不同模型的层脆弱性模式存在质性差异，但最终消歧性能相当。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法章节的激活补丁与单层消融实验设计，以及结果章节的跨模型一致性结论，尤其是层间表示距离与预测散度的变化曲线、激活补丁的因果效应图。预计阅读时间20-25分钟，核心是理解表示几何与行为输出的解耦逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: In lexical disambiguation scenarios, a gap exists between the geometric similarity of late-layer embeddings and the semantic distinction reflected in model predictions. The mechanism behind this gap, the causal role of late-layer representations in disambiguation outcomes, and the layer-wise dependency patterns across model scales remain uncharacterized.
summary_en.importance: The decoupling between representational geometry and predictive behavior in decoder-only Transformers is clarified, correcting the common practice of using late-layer cosine similarity as a direct measure of semantic encoding depth. Cross-scale consistent evidence for the layered semantic computation logic of pretrained models is provided, with direct reference value for embedding model design and probing method selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three decoder-only Transformer models spanning three orders of magnitude in parameter count (GPT-2-Small 117M, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-32B) are analyzed across two ambiguity types (homonyms and polysemes), with a three-layer analysis framework: 1) layer-wise measurement of hidden state cosine distance, projected logit distance, and next-token prediction KL divergence via the logit lens, to separate representational and predictive encoding processes; 2) activation patching to establish causal links between layer-specific representations and final disambiguation output; 3) single-layer ablation to compare layer-wise dependency patterns across models.
summary_en.experiments: Consistent patterns hold across all three models and both ambiguity types: representations of the same ambiguous word in different contexts reach maximum distinctness in middle layers, then partially reconverge in late layers, while KL divergence between next-token prediction distributions peaks in the final layer. Activation patching confirms that late-layer representations causally determine disambiguation output despite reduced geometric separation. Single-layer ablation results show that models achieve comparable disambiguation performance despite qualitatively different layer-wise vulnerability profiles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section for activation patching and single-layer ablation design, and the Results section for cross-model consistency findings, particularly the layer-wise representational distance and prediction divergence curves, and causal effect plots from activation patching. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. The core takeaway is the decoupling between representational geometry and behavioral output.

recommendation.zh: 做Transformer语义机制或架构改进的研究员重点看Fig2和激活补丁实验，能解释表征与行为脱钩的常见现象
recommendation.en: For researchers studying Transformer semantic mechanisms or architecture improvements, focus on Fig 2 and activation patching experiments to explain the common representation-behavior decoupling phenomenon

paper.title: Isotropy Cliffs: The Geometric Signature of Decision-Making in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We investigate the geometry of decision-making in Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) through the lens of isotropy. Analyzing five open-weight models across diverse datasets, we identify decision-critical transition layers characterized by a shift in isotropy, coinciding with a major representational change and the emergence of task-relevant clusters. We demonstrate that this synchronized geometric behavior is strongly correlated with downstream accuracy ($r\approx0.84$), displaying its re

summary.core_problem: 探究 LLM 在多项选择问答（MCQA）任务中，内部表征的几何结构（特别是各向同性 isotropy）如何随网络层数演变，以及这种几何变化与模型最终决策准确率之间的关系。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 内部表征演变的一个关键几何特征——“各向同性悬崖”（isotropy cliffs），并证明其陡峭程度是下游任务准确率的强预测指标。这为理解 LLM 的内部工作机制（特别是决策过程）提供了一个新的、全局的几何视角，可能对模型诊断、层级剪枝或早期退出（early exiting）等推理优化技术有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过追踪模型各层表征的各向同性（isotropy）、局部类结构（k-NN Score）和层间相似度（CKA），分析了五种不同架构和规模的开源模型（如 Qwen、Llama、Mistral）在四个 QA 数据集上的表现。核心发现是：各向同性在早期层逐渐上升，在某个临界层达到峰值，随后急剧下降（即 isotropy cliff）。这一急剧下降与表征的重大重组（CKA 相似度下降）和任务相关聚类结构的出现（k-NN Score 上升）同步发生。
summary.experiments: 在五种模型和四个 QA 基准测试中，发现 isotropy cliff 的陡峭程度与下游任务准确率高度相关（Spearman 相关系数最高达 0.92，在 Mistral-7B 上）。这一几何转变对提示词变化和上下文学习（ICL）样本数量具有鲁棒性，表明它是 decoder-only 模型处理信息的内在机制，而非特定提示格式的产物。此外，该指标在预测性能上优于内在维度（Intrinsic Dimensionality）。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methodology 部分关于各向同性（IsoScore）和局部纯度（k-NN Score）的计算方法，以及实验部分中 isotropy cliff 陡峭程度与准确率相关性的散点图（如果有的话）。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating how the geometric structure of internal representations (specifically isotropy) evolves across layers in LLMs during Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA), and how this geometric evolution relates to the model's final decision accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a key geometric signature of LLM internal representation evolution—'isotropy cliffs'—and demonstrates that their steepness is a strong predictor of downstream task accuracy. This provides a novel, global geometric perspective for understanding LLM internal mechanisms (especially decision-making), which could inspire model diagnostics, layer pruning, or early exiting techniques for inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: By tracking isotropy, local class structure (k-NN Score), and inter-layer similarity (CKA) of representations across layers, the study analyzes five open-weight models (e.g., Qwen, Llama, Mistral) of varying architectures and sizes across four QA datasets. The core finding is that isotropy steadily rises in early layers, peaks at a critical layer, and then drops sharply (the isotropy cliff). This sharp drop coincides with a major representational reorganization (drop in CKA similarity) and the emergence of task-relevant cluster structure (rise in k-NN Score).
summary_en.experiments: Across five models and four QA benchmarks, the steepness of the isotropy cliff is highly correlated with downstream task accuracy (Spearman correlation up to 0.92 on Mistral-7B). This geometric transition is robust to prompt variations and the number of in-context learning (ICL) samples, suggesting it is an intrinsic mechanism of decoder-only models rather than an artifact of specific prompt formats. Furthermore, this metric outperforms Intrinsic Dimensionality in predicting performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section for the computation of isotropy (IsoScore) and local purity (k-NN Score), and the experimental section for scatter plots (if any) showing the correlation between isotropy cliff steepness and accuracy. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 Fig/层级曲线即可；若 r=0.84 在模型族外仍成立，它会成为 cheap probe 的候选信号。
recommendation.en: Read the figures and layer curves; if the r=0.84 signal survives across model families, it is a plausible cheap probe.

paper.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train m

summary.core_problem: 当用户只能看到模型的最终回答、模型自生成的简短推理摘要、或完整推理链时，各自能在多大程度上判断该次回答是否正确？论文通过控制变量的可观测性阶梯，量化了不同信息暴露层级对正确性判别的预测力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于两点：其一，推理摘要在有 prompt 时几乎不提供额外判别信号（增益仅 +0.019 AUROC），这意味着用摘要做 RL 奖励信号或过程监督时需谨慎——摘要可能丢失了 trace 中的关键判别信息；其二，同一道题正确与错误运行之间的区分（run-level discrimination）远比跨题排序困难，线性分类器在 summary 上接近随机，这对 reward model 训练中 pair 构造和 hard negative 挖掘有直接参考。论文也触及了 reasoning trace 的忠实性问题，与 R1-Zero 类范式中训练信号质量的讨论相关。
summary.technical_approach: 核心实验设计是 observability ladder：固定同一次 completed run（含 prompt q、trace C、response R、正确性标签 y），只改变 reader 能看到的信息层级。摘要 S 由同一模型在 run 结束后仅根据 C 生成，限制 90 词以内。在每个层级上训练 matched linear correctness predictor（用文本特征预测 y），对比 response-only、response+summary、response+summary+trace，以及加入 answer probabilities 和 hidden states 的 provider-only 信号。关键控制包括：prompt 可见/不可见的对比、同词数下 trace 末尾片段与自摘要的对比、同一题重复运行的 pair 判别。
summary.experiments: 五个开源模型（Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、gpt-oss-20b/120b），三个 benchmark（GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro、Omni-MATH-2-Filtered）。无 prompt 时 summary-only AUROC 0.774，full trace 0.813，summary 相对 response alone 增益 +0.156；有 prompt 时 summary 增益骤降至 +0.019，trace 仍有 +0.041。Prompt-only reader 已达 0.734 AUROC，说明 prompt 本身携带了大量正确性先验。同词数下 trace 末尾片段匹配或略优于自摘要，包含更密集的不确定性和自我纠错线索。在同题正确/错误运行的 pair 判别上，summary reader 接近随机，trace reader 仅有微弱信号。GPT-5-mini 作为 reader 在无 prompt 时恢复更多信号，但 trace 仍略优于 summary。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 Figure 1 的实验设计框架和主结果表。Introduction 中关于 monitorability 是 display 与 reader 联合属性的论述值得注意。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。对 RL/过程监督方向的研究者，建议关注同题 pair 判别实验（repeated-run comparisons），这部分结果直接关系到 reward signal 的分辨率上限。
summary.authors_note: Vrije Universiteit Brussel（VUB）等机构，通讯作者 Andres Algaba。

summary_en.core_problem: When a user can only see the model's final response, a self-generated short reasoning summary, or the full reasoning trace, how well can each level predict whether the answer is correct? The paper introduces a controlled observability ladder that quantifies the discriminative power of different information exposure levels.
summary_en.importance: Two implications for pretraining research. First, when the prompt is visible, the summary adds almost no signal (+0.019 AUROC), cautioning against using summaries as RL reward signals or process supervision—summaries may discard discriminative information present in the trace. Second, distinguishing correct from incorrect runs of the same question is far harder than ranking across questions; linear readers on summaries are near chance, which has direct bearing on pair construction and hard-negative mining in reward model training. The faithfulness question also connects to training-signal quality discussions in R1-Zero-style paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The observability ladder fixes one completed run (prompt q, trace C, response R, correctness label y) and varies only what the reader inspects. The self-summary S is produced after the run by the same model from C alone, capped at 90 words. Matched linear correctness predictors are trained at each level: response-only, response+summary, response+summary+trace, plus provider-only signals (answer probabilities and hidden states). Key controls include prompt-visible vs. prompt-withheld, same-word-count trace-end extracts vs. self-summaries, and repeated-run discrimination on questions with both correct and incorrect outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Five open-weight models (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, gpt-oss-20b/120b) across GPQA-Diamond, MMLU-Pro, and Omni-MATH-2-Filtered. Without the prompt, summary-only AUROC is 0.774 vs. 0.813 for full trace; summary adds +0.156 over response alone. With the prompt visible, the summary gain collapses to +0.019 while the trace still adds +0.041. A prompt-only reader already reaches 0.734 AUROC, indicating the prompt carries substantial correctness prior. At matched word count, trace-end extracts match or slightly outperform self-summaries, carrying denser uncertainty and self-correction cues. On same-question correct/incorrect pairs, summary readers are near chance and trace readers retain only modest signal. A GPT-5-mini reader recovers more signal when the prompt is withheld, but the trace still slightly outperforms the summary.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Figure 1 for the experimental framework and the main results table. The introduction's framing of monitorability as a joint property of display and reader is worth noting. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. For researchers in RL/process supervision, the repeated-run same-question discrimination results are the most relevant—they bear on the resolution ceiling of reward signals.
summary_en.authors_note: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) and collaborators; corresponding author Andres Algaba.

recommendation.zh: 有prompt时推理摘要几乎无额外信号的结论反常识，重点看§3实验设计和Fig 2的分层对比，对推理输出协议设计有参考。
recommendation.en: The counterintuitive finding that reasoning summaries add almost no signal with the prompt visible is notable; focus on §3 and Fig 2, useful for reasoning output protocol design.

paper.title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by l

summary.core_problem: 现有研究默认VLM中的视觉表征是不随语言提示改变的静态信息库，缺乏对目标导向语言如何调制视觉表征的因果性刻画
summary.importance: 通过因果干预实验证实语言会动态重编码VLM的视觉表征，修正了VLM多模态交互的静态表征假设，为多模态对齐与架构设计提供表征层面的实证依据
summary.technical_approach: 提取自然语言提示下对应目标相关物体的对比steering vector（引导向量），通过因果干预验证该抽象参考表征对模型预测的因果作用，刻画语言诱导的视觉重编码现象
summary.experiments: 基于公开VLM开展表征提取与干预实验，验证了目标相关抽象参考表征的存在及其对预测的因果效应；摘要内容截断，未披露具体模型参数量、对照基线与量化性能数据
summary.authors_note: 布朗大学Ellie Pavlick团队，该团队长期从事自然语言处理、多模态表征与模型可解释性研究

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static information repositories manipulated by language, leaving the causal mechanism of how goal-directed language modulates visual processing poorly characterized.
summary_en.importance: Provides causal evidence for language-induced recoding of visual representations in VLMs, revising the long-held static view of visual-language interaction and offering empirical grounding for multimodal alignment and architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extracts contrastive steering vectors corresponding to abstract goal-relevant object representations under natural language prompts, and conducts causal intervention experiments to validate their causal role in driving model predictions.
summary_en.experiments: Runs representation extraction and intervention experiments on public VLMs to verify the existence and causal efficacy of goal-relevant reference representations; the abstract is truncated, with no disclosed model sizes, baselines, or quantitative performance metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Team led by Ellie Pavlick at Brown University, whose research focuses on NLP, multimodal representations, and model interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 多模态可解释性工作，修正VLM视觉表征静态的既有认知，无直接可落地的训练recipe，了解结论即可，无需通读全文
recommendation.en: Multimodal interpretability work revising the static VLM visual representation prior; no actionable training recipes, knowing the conclusion suffices without full read.

paper.title: Role-Break in Attention Heads: Understanding and Detecting Hallucinations in VLMs
paper.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in vision-language generation, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing content that is inconsistent with or unsupported by the input image. Existing works largely design detection or mitigation methods around one specific hallucination pattern, such as visual-textual imbalance, but real VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of multiple patterns, so signals bound to a single pattern struggle to remain stable across models and tasks. Un

summary.core_problem: VLM幻觉由多种模式混合引起，绑定单一模式（如视觉-文本失衡）的检测信号跨模型跨任务不稳定。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，从注意力头层面统一刻画幻觉信号，发现幻觉表现为各头偏离其忠实上下文行为的局部偏差（Role-Break），且该信号在保留头身份时线性可读。
summary.technical_approach: 在统一的头级别视角下分析幻觉诱导的注意力变化，发现偏差跨注意力头、上下文来源和偏差方向系统组织；在此基础上训练轻量线性检测器。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM和任务上验证Role-Break检测器的跨模型跨任务稳定性（摘要截断，无具体模型名和数字）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Nan Duan（段楠），MSRA Principal Researcher，在VLM/NLP/代码生成方向有大量代表性工作；论文标注机构为北京大学，可能为合作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of patterns, so detection signals bound to a single pattern (e.g., visual-textual imbalance) are unstable across models and tasks.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis work that characterizes hallucination signals at the attention-head level, finding that hallucinations manifest as localized deviations from each head's faithful contextual behavior (Role-Break), and that the resulting signal is linearly readable when head identity is preserved.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes hallucination-induced attention changes under a unified head-level view; finds deviations systematically organized across attention heads, contextual sources, and deviation directions; builds a lightweight linear detector on top of Role-Break features.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the Role-Break detector's cross-model and cross-task stability on multiple VLMs and tasks (abstract truncated, no specific model names or numbers).
summary_en.authors_note: Author list includes Nan Duan, Principal Researcher at MSRA with extensive work on VLMs, NLP, and code generation. The listed institution is Peking University, possibly indicating a collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 头级别Role-Break现象对LLM幻觉可解释性有弱迁移价值，但实验仅在VLM上且摘要无数字，作为literature备查即可。
recommendation.en: The head-level Role-Break phenomenon has weak transfer value to LLM hallucination interpretability, but experiments are VLM-only with no numbers in the abstract. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Do Unified Multimodal Models Think in One Space? A Lens Through Cross-Branch Steering
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to integrate understanding and generation within a single architecture, yet it remains unclear whether these capabilities share a unified and transferable semantic space. This question is fundamentally challenging, as the two branches operate over heterogeneous representations (text tokens vs.\ visual latents) and distinct training objectives, making direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce \emph{cross-branch semantic steering}, an intervent

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究统一多模态模型的理解分支和生成分支是否共享同一个语义空间，而不只是共享一个外观上的模型框架。
summary.importance: 对统一多模态预训练有明确启发。很多 UMM 同时做图像理解和图像生成，但这不保证两个分支内部的语义表示是可迁移的。论文用 intervention 而不是相关性分析来检测这一点：如果从理解分支学到的语义方向能改变生成结果，才说明两个分支至少共享了一部分可操作的语义子空间。结论也比较具体：理解到生成可以迁移，生成到理解基本失败。这提示预训练设计不能只把任务塞进同一个 backbone，还需要让生成侧的 latent 表示对齐到对象、属性、关系等抽象语义，而不是主要承载颜色、光照、背景这类低层外观统计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 cross-branch semantic steering。核心思想是不直接比较 text tokens 和 visual latents 的表示，因为两者 token 类型和训练目标都不同，而是做因果干预。具体做法是从一个分支提取语义 steering vector，例如“red → pink”，再在另一个分支推理时注入这个向量。如果理解分支得到的方向能让生成分支把 red ribbon 画成 pink ribbon，就说明该方向跨分支可用。作者构造 UMMSteer 数据集，包含 51 组视觉语义概念对，覆盖颜色、文字、数量、位置、风格、外观和 persona。理解侧的向量主要来自文本 QA 样本的表示差分；生成侧向量则来自生成过程中的 latent 表示。论文还分析了迁移不对称性的来源：理解侧方向更偏组合式、对象中心的语义，因此能被生成分支利用；生成侧方向更多捕捉背景色调、光照、全局颜色分布等低层外观特征，与理解分支的语义结构不匹配。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕跨分支 steering 的可迁移性展开。作者首先在目标 UMM 上展示 understanding-to-generation 的成功案例：从理解分支抽取的概念方向可以改变图像生成中的属性，同时提升语义忠实度。反向的 generation-to-understanding 基本不能稳定改变理解分支预测，形成明显不对称。作者进一步在 Janus-Pro、UniPic-1 等其他统一多模态模型上验证，发现强任务性能并不自动意味着理解和生成分支有良好的共享语义空间；对齐程度与架构设计和模态融合方式有关。提供内容没有给出完整指标表和具体成功率，因此更适合作为机制诊断工作阅读，而不是按单一分数比较模型。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。重点看 cross-branch steering 的定义、steering vector 的提取位置和注入位置、UMMSteer 的 51 个概念对设计，以及 understanding-to-generation 和 generation-to-understanding 的对照实验。真正值得深挖的是失败方向：生成侧表示为什么偏低层外观，是否由 diffusion/latent decoder 训练目标造成，以及预训练中能否加入跨分支一致性 loss，让生成 latent 更显式地承载对象和关系语义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether unified multimodal models actually learn a shared semantic space between their understanding branch and generation branch, rather than merely placing both functions inside one architecture.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for multimodal pretraining because it separates architectural unification from representational unification. A model can perform both VQA and image generation while still using poorly aligned internal spaces. The diagnostic is intervention-based: a semantic direction extracted from one branch must causally affect the other branch to count as transferable. The main finding is asymmetric. Understanding-to-generation transfer works, while generation-to-understanding transfer largely fails. This suggests that unified pretraining needs stronger pressure to align generation latents with object-level and relation-level semantics, not only with low-level visual appearance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce cross-branch semantic steering. Instead of directly comparing text-token representations with visual latents, they extract a steering vector for a concept pair, such as red to pink, from one branch and inject it into the other during inference. If a vector learned from the understanding branch changes the generated image in the intended semantic direction, that is causal evidence for a shared usable subspace. The paper builds UMMSteer, a visually grounded contrastive dataset with 51 concept pairs covering color, text, counting, position, style, appearance, and persona. Understanding-side vectors are derived from text-based QA representations, while generation-side vectors are derived from latent generation representations. The asymmetry is attributed to a mismatch in abstraction level: understanding vectors tend to encode compositional, object-centric semantics, whereas generation vectors often capture background tone, illumination, and global color statistics.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments test steering transfer across branches. In the main direction, understanding-derived vectors can steer generation and improve semantic faithfulness, such as shifting a prompted red object toward the target color. In the reverse direction, generation-derived vectors do not reliably alter understanding predictions. The authors also test other UMMs, including Janus-Pro and UniPic-1, and find that strong task performance does not necessarily imply aligned cross-branch representations. The supplied text does not include full numeric tables or success rates, so the result should be read primarily as a representational diagnostic rather than a leaderboard-style comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is appropriate. Read the cross-branch steering setup, where vectors are extracted and injected, the UMMSteer concept-pair design, and the asymmetric transfer results. The most interesting technical question is why generation-side latents remain appearance-heavy, and whether multimodal pretraining objectives can add cross-branch consistency so that generation representations carry more explicit object and relation semantics.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态统一预训练的可重点看§4的不对称性分析，setup干净，对理解生成分支的对齐目标设计有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Multimodal pretraining researchers should focus on §4’s asymmetry analysis; the clean setup offers direct reference for aligning understanding and generation branch objectives

paper.title: Relation Geometry in Semantic Space of Language Models
paper.abstract: When it comes to generating vector representations of words, current language models are achieving high-quality results. However, what is not known is the extent to which knowledge about semantic relations is represented in the geometry of the semantic spaces created in this way. In order to answer this question, we study the relation geometry of such semantic spaces from three perspectives. We first examine whether words standing in a particular relation to a target word~(called relata) occupy

summary.core_problem: 语言模型的语义空间是否真的编码了“关系”本身，而不只是词义相近性；以及这些关系在几何上呈现什么结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它不直接推动预训练 recipe，但对理解 embedding/hidden space 中关系知识如何组织有一定基础价值，尤其涉及 causal、masked 和 instruction-tuned 模型的表征差异。
summary.technical_approach: 从三方面研究 relation geometry：其一，检查与某目标词处于同一语义关系的 relata 是否聚集在相同区域、不同关系区域是否可分；其二，测试语义空间是否反映对称、非对称、传递等关系性质；其三，分析表面形式与上下文信息对关系几何的相对作用。实验覆盖多类 LM。
summary.experiments: 在六种语义关系上，对 causal、masked 和 instruction-tuned 模型进行表征分析。摘要未给出模型规模和具体数值提升，因为核心不是追求任务分数，而是比较不同模型语义空间中的关系结构。对预训练研究员而言，这更像表征诊断工具，而不是可直接落地的训练改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自东京大学、MBZUAI、RIKEN、NAIST、东北大学等学术机构，偏语言学与表征分析取向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether language-model semantic spaces encode relations themselves, rather than merely lexical similarity, and what geometric structure those relations take.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/representation-analysis paper. It does not directly advance pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding how relational knowledge is organized in embedding or hidden spaces across causal, masked, and instruction-tuned models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It analyzes relation geometry from three angles: whether relata of a given target occupy shared regions, whether regions for different relations are separable, whether geometric structure reflects symmetry/asymmetry/transitivity, and whether surface forms or contexts matter more for relation geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers six semantic relations and compares causal, masked, and instruction-tuned models. The abstract does not emphasize model sizes or benchmark gains because the goal is representational diagnosis rather than task optimization. For pretraining researchers, this is more of a probing framework than an actionable training recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Tokyo, MBZUAI, RIKEN, NAIST, and Tohoku University, with a clear representation-analysis and linguistics-oriented flavor.

recommendation.zh: 偏表征分析，不会直接改你的 recipe；如果你在想 hidden space 到底有没有“关系子空间”，可只看实验设计和 relation property 那部分。
recommendation.en: This won’t change your recipe, but if you care whether hidden spaces contain relation-specific geometry, the probing setup is the part worth reading.

institutions: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
Nara Institute of Science and Technology
Graduate School of Information Science and Technology, The University of Tokyo
Center for Advanced Intelligence Project, RIKEN
Division of Information Science, Nara Institute of Science and Technology
Center for Language AI Research, Tohoku University

paper.title: From Found to Designed: Concepts as a Design Axis for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich concept-like information, but represent it implicitly through distributed statistical associations rather than as explicit, structured, compositional concepts. Consequently, concept-level structure is typically \emph{found} rather than \emph{designed}: it is recovered after training through probing or dictionary learning, with no architectural guarantee of stability, compositionality, controllability, or alignment with human conceptual organization. We ar

summary.core_problem: 讨论 LLM 中“概念”是否应从训练后被动发现，转为在目标、架构、推理或解释阶段主动设计。
summary.importance: 这是概念表示方向的 taxonomy / position paper。它对预训练研究的价值在于把概念结构与训练目标、架构归纳偏置、推理时控制和外部知识 grounding 联系起来，但不是实证突破。
summary.technical_approach: 论文按两个轴组织设计空间：概念结构被引入的 pipeline 阶段，包括训练目标、核心架构、推理、事后解释；以及概念来自模型内部表示，还是来自外部资源。它进一步指出 inference-time concept 方法相对少见。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有显示新模型训练、参数规模、数据规模或系统实验结果。主要产出是设计空间梳理和研究议程，而非可直接复现的 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tel Aviv University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that concepts in LLMs should be treated as an explicit design axis rather than only recovered after training.
summary_en.importance: This is a taxonomy and position piece. Its relevance to pretraining is the framing of concepts as possible inductive bias through objectives, architectures, inference procedures, or externally grounded structures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design space is organized along two dimensions: where concept structure is introduced in the pipeline, and whether it is derived internally from model representations or grounded in external resources.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report new model training, model scale, data scale, or quantitative experiments. The main output is a conceptual map and research agenda.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Tel Aviv University.

recommendation.zh: 可作概念表示路线图备查；读 taxonomy 即可，缺少实验闭环，暂时不能指导 pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: Useful as a concept-representation map; read the taxonomy, but do not treat it as evidence for a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Interpretable GOHR Agents via Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: A central challenge in interpreting learned decision-making systems is to determine whether their internal representations contain concepts that help explain their behavior. We report interpretability experiments for a tokenized autoregressive Transformer agent in the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR). We focus on a compact two-rule task in which both hidden rules map object shapes to target buckets, but with different permutations. The policy is trained on episodes sampled from these two hidden rules

summary.core_problem: 研究一个 tokenized autoregressive Transformer agent 是否在内部表示中形成了可解释的隐藏规则概念。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析和 interpretability 小规模实验。它不是 LLM 基座训练方法，但把 SAE 用到交互式决策 agent 的 decision-token embedding 上，可作为研究隐式任务状态、规则推断和行为概念分解的简化实验模板。
