summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the task setup and data construction to see how the paper separates surface wording from intent. Then read the probe protocol, the leave-one-phrasing-out evaluation, and the bag-of-words control, since those determine whether the result is really about intent rather than lexical cues. After that, go straight to the depth-localization and steering sections. Those are the parts that justify the represent-versus-readout decomposition and make the paper more than a standard probing exercise. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main argument. If time is tight, prioritize the setup, the section showing that intent is represented, and the sections on depth and causal steering.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probe 泛化和因果测试部分；若成立，问题更像 policy readout，而不是 base model 缺少语用表示。
recommendation.en: Read the probe generalization and causal tests; if clean, the failure looks like policy readout, not missing pragmatic representation.

paper.title: Legible-by-Construction: Attention and End-to-End Transformers
paper.abstract: A companion paper showed that a transformer's feed-forward layer can be rebuilt from explicit fuzzy set operations - intersection, set-difference, and a self-forgetting sequence quantifier - so its hidden units read as named logical operators at no cost to language-model quality. That left the other half of the transformer opaque. Here we carry the same idea into attention and join the two into one model. The mechanism is minimal: a head's value is passed through a sigmoid, so each value channel

summary.core_problem: 论文试图让 Transformer 的 attention 路径在结构上更可读，而不是训练后再用 probing、logit lens 或 sparse autoencoder 解释。核心问题是 attention 的 QK 路径相对容易理解为“看哪里”，但 OV 路径很难解释为“写什么”。作者提出把 value 通道约束成可读的模糊集合成员关系，同时保持输出投影自由。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与机制解释交界的工作。它的价值不在语言建模指标提升，而在提出一种可训练的可解释 attention 设计：约束检测对象，不约束写入方式。这个原则对预训练研究有启发，因为很多可解释性约束会损伤模型容量，或者给优化器留下无意义捷径。这里的设计尝试保留标准 attention 的主要自由度，只在 value 上加 sigmoid 边界和选择性压力，让通道更像“某个特征是否成立”的检测器。
summary.technical_approach: 主要改动是将每个 head 的 value 写成 v = sigmoid(W_v x)，把 value channel 限制在 [0, 1]，解释为 fuzzy membership。attention 对这些 membership 做上下文聚合，输出投影仍然完全自由。这个 bounded-value / free-readout 设计是关键：如果反过来约束输出写入，例如把 head output 绑到词表空间，模型可能走上下文无关常量的梯度捷径，表面可读但没有实际选择性。论文还讨论 Boolean variant，把 value 进一步组织成显式的 within-token intersection 与 set-difference，使 OV 路径更接近逻辑操作。训练上加入两类压力：sparsity 让检测器只在少数上下文触发，crispness 让激活靠近 0 或 1。不同设计需要不同正则：单一 membership value 需要 sparsity 和 crispness；显式 conjunction 已经天然稀疏，更适合只加 crispness，否则容易变成死通道。
summary.experiments: 实验在 125M 参数规模上比较五种 specialized-attention 设计。结果显示，bounded value 设计中有 44% 到 62% 的 value channels 形成清晰、上下文选择性的检测器；与之对比，vocabulary-tied 设计出现 constant-collapse。层深也有明显影响：最深层可选择通道比例达到 70% 到 95%，并能读出较稳定的语义和语法特征，例如抽象概念、领域、人物/复数相关通道。论文还报告该 attention 设计可以和 companion work 中的 legible FFN 合并成端到端 Transformer，并声称没有牺牲语言模型质量。最有信息量的消融是约束位置和正则位置：约束 value 而不是 output，正则 operands 而不是组合后的 operator output。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 QK/OV 可读性差异的分析，再看 Section 3 关于为什么不能约束 write/output，尤其是 vocabulary-tied 设计的失败原因。Section 3.6 和 Section 4 是重点：前者解释 sparsity、crispness 应该施加在哪里，后者给出 125M 模型上各设计的选择性比例和通道示例。若关心可解释架构是否能扩展到大模型，需要额外检查训练开销、困惑度对比、正则强度敏感性，以及这些通道在更大数据规模下是否仍保持可读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the opacity of the attention OV path. QK patterns are relatively interpretable as where a head attends, while the value and output path is much harder to read as what the head contributes. The goal is to make attention legible by construction rather than relying only on post-hoc interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits between architecture design and mechanistic interpretability. Its main lesson for pretraining researchers is about where to place interpretability constraints. Constraining the detector side of a head can make channels readable while preserving a free output projection; constraining the write side can create optimization shortcuts and collapse to context-independent behavior. This is a useful design principle for building models whose internal units are easier to inspect without directly tying them to vocabulary outputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core modification is minimal: replace the raw value with a bounded membership value, v = sigmoid(W_v x), so each value channel lies in [0, 1] and can be interpreted as whether a feature holds at the token. Attention then aggregates these memberships over context, while the output projection remains unconstrained. This bounded-value/free-readout split is the central mechanism. The paper also studies a Boolean variant in which values are structured as explicit within-token intersections and set differences, mirroring the legible FFN operators from the companion work. Training uses two pressures: sparsity, to make detectors fire only in selected contexts, and crispness, to push activations toward 0 or 1. The paper emphasizes that the pressure must match the operator: a single membership value benefits from both, while an explicit conjunction is already sparse and mainly needs crispness.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use 125M-parameter models and compare five specialized attention designs. In the bounded-value designs, 44% to 62% of value channels become crisp and context-selective, whereas the vocabulary-tied design collapses to constants. Selectivity increases with depth: the deepest layers reach 70% to 95% selective channels, with interpretable examples tied to semantic and grammatical features such as abstract concepts, domains, and people/plural distinctions. The paper also combines legible attention with the earlier legible FFN into an end-to-end Transformer and reports no language-model quality loss. The important ablations concern the location of the constraint and regularization: constrain the value, not the output; regularize operator operands, not only the combined output.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction for the QK-versus-OV framing. Then read Section 3 for the failure mode of constraining the write/output path, especially the vocabulary-tied shortcut. Sections 3.6 and 4 are the most useful parts: they explain the sparsity/crispness pressures and show the 125M-scale channel selectivity results. For deeper follow-up, inspect perplexity trade-offs, sensitivity to regularization strength, and whether the same legibility survives larger models and broader pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它在“attention 可解释性要约束哪里”上给了清楚立场；先看方法假设和可视化，性能结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it makes a clean claim about where interpretability constraints should live in attention; read the construction and visual evidence first, treat the quality claim as provisional.

paper.title: Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry
paper.abstract: Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations

summary.core_problem: MAG 解决的是如何在没有人工标签的情况下，从 LLM 激活中提取由自然语言问题或上下文诱导的“模型相对”推理特征。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和预训练的关系主要在机制分析与数据选择。它把一个自然语言 prefix 看作外部干预，观察同一输入在有无该 prefix 时 readout activation 的几何差异。这个差异更接近模型在特定判断条件下实际使用的内部特征，而不是数据集标签定义的概念。对基座研究有两个启发：第一，很多安全、偏见、恶意性、场景属性等判断可以用模型自己的内部变化来刻画，减少对人工标签边界的依赖；第二，activation geometry 可以作为训练数据选择信号，用来判断哪些候选数据更可能补齐当前训练池的内部特征覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: MAG 的基本操作很简单：给每个输入 p 统一加上自然语言变换 Q，例如“这个物体能在沙漠中找到吗？”或“这个 prompt 是否恶意？”，然后比较模型 readout activation m(Q||p) 与 m(p) 的差值。这个差值表示 Q 在该输入上诱导出的推理变化；对一批样本求平均得到 feature direction v_Q。作者进一步定义了八类 MAG operators，用来隔离 prefix-induced activation change 的不同部分。方法强调 model-relative judgment：特征要预测模型自己的判断，而不一定匹配数据集标签。作者还研究了线性可控性，发现 prefix effect 在 readout 处可以被单个线性方向较好近似，并可通过 calibrated steering 改变模型 verdict。对于包含上下文的 prefix，MAG 得到的特征能泛化到 held-out 样本，并且在几何上不同于 prefix 中单个概念词的简单组合。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四类结论。第一，MAG 特征比 raw activation 更能预测模型自己的判断；当模型判断和数据集标签冲突时，MAG 更倾向于跟随模型判断，这符合 model-relative feature 的定义。第二，线性方向近似实验显示，prefix 诱导的 readout 变化有较低残差，可用于 steering；作者使用 calibrated steering 来避免过强干预。第三，contextual prefix 产生的方向不是简单概念叠加，能在 held-out examples 上保留可读性和泛化性。第四，MAG geometry 可用于 training data selection：在候选数据集之间选择要加入训练池的数据时，明显优于 random baseline 和经典 activation similarity 方法。给定内容没有提供模型规模、层位置、数据集名称、具体提升数值和八个 operators 的完整定义，需要阅读实验表和附录确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Feature Mining via Activation Geometry 中 m(Q||p)−m(p) 和 v_Q 的定义，再看八个 operators 的表格或小节。实验部分重点看三块：model-relative judgment 是否真的优于 raw activation，linear steering 的残差和校准方式，training data selection 与 activation similarity 的对比。对预训练数据研究者，最值得看的不是安全案例本身，而是 data selection 实验如何把 activation geometry 变成候选数据排序信号。

summary_en.core_problem: MAG asks how to extract reasoning features from LLM activations without labeled examples, using a natural-language prefix as the intervention that defines the feature of interest.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is interpretability-assisted data selection and internal evaluation. MAG treats a fixed prefix as an external probe and measures how it changes the model’s readout activation on the same input. The resulting direction is tied to the model’s own judgment under that reasoning context, rather than to a human-labeled class boundary. This matters for settings where output behavior or dataset labels are insufficient, such as safety evaluation, hidden bias, reward hacking, and evaluation awareness. It also suggests a practical data-curation signal: candidate training data can be compared by the internal features they activate, not only by surface similarity or metadata.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each input p, MAG constructs a prefixed input Q||p, where Q is a question, instruction, or contextual statement defining the reasoning feature. The core signal is the activation difference m(Q||p) - m(p) at a chosen readout representation. Averaging this difference over inputs gives a feature direction v_Q. The paper defines eight MAG operators to isolate different components of the prefix-induced change. A key framing is model-relative judgment: the extracted feature should track the model’s own verdict, including cases where that verdict disagrees with dataset labels. The authors also test whether the prefix effect is approximately linear at readout. They find that a single direction can reconstruct much of the effect and can be used for calibrated steering. For contextual prefixes, the extracted directions generalize to held-out examples and are geometrically distinct from the individual concepts mentioned in the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments support four claims. First, MAG features predict the model’s own judgments better than raw activations, and they continue to track those judgments when they diverge from ground-truth labels. Second, the prefix-induced activation change is well approximated by a linear readout direction, with residual reconstruction error used as a diagnostic. Third, activation steering along the MAG direction can shift the model’s verdict when calibrated rather than applied with an arbitrary large coefficient. Fourth, MAG geometry can guide training-data selection: when choosing which candidate dataset to add to a training pool, it outperforms random selection and classic activation-similarity baselines. The supplied content does not include the model sizes, exact layers, dataset names, numerical gains, or the full specification of the eight operators, so those details should be checked in the tables and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Read the definition of m(Q||p) - m(p), the construction of v_Q, and the table or section defining the eight MAG operators. Then go directly to the experiments on model-relative judgment, linear reconstruction and steering, and data selection. For pretraining and data researchers, the most useful part is the training-data selection setup: how activation geometry is converted into a ranking criterion for candidate data pools, and how it differs from ordinary activation similarity.

recommendation.zh: 一种有趣的无监督可解释性方法，通过对比加指令前后的激活差异来提取特征方向，值得关注其在理解模型内部表征上的应用。
recommendation.en: An interesting unsupervised interpretability method that extracts feature directions by contrasting activations with and without instructions. Worth noting for understanding internal representations.

paper.title: Detecting Answer-Driven Reasoning in LLM-Based Educational Tutors via Truncated Chain-of-Thought Auditing
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) tutors often produce fluent step-by-step explanations, but a correct and pedagogically formatted response does not guarantee that the answer was derived from the student-facing problem. In realistic tutoring systems, the model may also have access to teacher notes, answer keys, rubrics, or retrieved solution artifacts. We study whether such private answer information can make tutor explanations answer-driven: the final answer is behaviorally available before the writte

summary.core_problem: 论文要检测 LLM 教育辅导中的 answer-driven reasoning：模型的逐步解释看起来像推导，但最终答案可能在推理尚未展开时就已经由私有答案键、教师笔记或检索到的解答信息决定。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法论文，但对推理过程评测和训练数据质量有启发。它把“答案泄漏”从输出层面的显式泄露推进到过程层面的依赖检测。对于用 CoT 数据做 SFT、过程监督或 RL 的场景，这个问题很实际：一条格式正确、最终答案正确的推理链，可能只是围绕已知答案补写解释。这样的样本会提高表面正确率，但弱化模型从问题条件出发推导答案的能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者采用 TRACE，即 truncated reasoning AUC evaluation。流程很直接：先让模型在三种 paired context 下生成 tutor explanation：只给题目、给题目加正确 answer key、给题目加错误 answer key。然后把生成的解释截断到 10%、25%、50%、75%、100% 等比例，在每个前缀后追加 forced-answer 提示，要求模型停止推理并只输出最终答案。若很短前缀就能让模型回答出 gold answer，说明答案在行为上已经可恢复。指标包括 TRACE AUC、Pass@10 和 first-pass。这里的重点不是判断解释文字是否像教学推导，而是测量答案在推理链中多早变得可用。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GSM8K test split 的 1000 道题，模型是 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，4-bit MLX，本地 Apple M1 Max 运行。三种条件共生成 3000 条样本。主要结果很清楚：question-only 的 median TRACE AUC 为 0.375，answer-key 条件升到 0.900；Pass@10 从 0.113 升到 0.997；median first-pass 从解释长度的 0.750 提前到 0.100。也就是说，只要看到正确答案键，模型通常在最早的 10% 前缀后就能给出正确答案。错误答案键实验显示模型会被错误私有信息拉偏，说明这种依赖不仅影响前缀探针，也可能影响最终回答。作者还做了 final-answer correct subset，用来控制最终答案都正确时的过程差异。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。Method 部分最值得看，尤其是三种 tutoring context、prefix forced-answer probe、TRACE AUC/Pass@10/first-pass 的定义。Results 中看 Table II 和 Figure 1 即可把握主要结论。若关心 CoT 数据清洗或过程监督数据构造，可以重点看 wrong-key 设置和 final-answer correct subset，因为它们说明“最终正确”不能保证推理过程没有答案锚定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits answer-driven reasoning in LLM tutors: a step-by-step explanation may look like a derivation, while the final answer has already been determined by private answer keys, teacher notes, or retrieved solution artifacts.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for reasoning evaluation and training-data quality. It extends answer leakage from an output-level issue to a process-level dependency test. The implication for CoT SFT, process supervision, and RL data is concrete: a reasoning trace can be well formatted and end with the correct answer while merely rationalizing an answer that was already available. Such data can improve apparent correctness without teaching the model to derive the answer from the problem conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method adapts TRACE, or truncated reasoning AUC evaluation. For each GSM8K problem, the model generates tutor-style explanations under three paired contexts: question only, question plus the correct answer key, and question plus a deterministic wrong answer key. The generated explanation is then truncated at fixed fractions such as 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. After each prefix, a forced-answer prompt asks the model to stop reasoning and output only the final answer. If a very short prefix already recovers the gold answer, the answer is behaviorally available before the written reasoning has justified it. The reported metrics are TRACE AUC, Pass@10, and first-pass. The method does not evaluate whether the prose sounds pedagogical; it measures when the answer becomes recoverable from the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 1,000 GSM8K test problems and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in 4-bit MLX format on an Apple M1 Max. The three prompt conditions produce 3,000 rows. The separation between conditions is large: median TRACE AUC is 0.375 for question-only and 0.900 with the correct answer key; mean Pass@10 increases from 0.113 to 0.997; median first-pass moves from 0.750 of the explanation length to 0.100. In practice, when the model sees the correct answer key, the gold answer is usually recoverable from the first measured prefix. The wrong-key condition pulls the model toward incorrect answers, showing that private answer artifacts can affect both prefix behavior and final tutoring responses. The paper also analyzes a subset where both question-only and answer-key generations end correctly, isolating process differences from final accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. The method section is the most useful part: focus on the three tutoring contexts, the forced-answer prefix probe, and the definitions of TRACE AUC, Pass@10, and first-pass. In the results, Table II and Figure 1 capture the main empirical finding. For CoT data filtering or process-supervision work, pay special attention to the wrong-key condition and the final-answer-correct subset, since they show why final correctness alone is not enough to validate a reasoning trace.

recommendation.zh: 用TRACE方法量化了CoT的答案驱动现象，做推理能力评估或训练时需要警惕这种事后合理化，看§3的方法设计即可
recommendation.en: Quantifies answer-driven CoT reasoning via TRACE, a critical caveat for reasoning evaluation and training; read §3 for method design

paper.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Mean What They Say? On the Role of Faithfulness in Embodied Reasoning
paper.abstract: Embodied Chain-of-Thought has emerged as a promising mechanism to enhance robot decision-making and interpretability in black-box Vision-Language Action (VLA) models. However, whether this verbalized Chain-of-Thought truthfully reflects the policy's underlying decision process remains poorly understood. We distinguish between functional reasoning, in which reasoning improves task performance, and faithful reasoning, in which reasoning truly reflects the policy's internal decision process. We arg

summary.core_problem: 具身思维链被用于提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的决策性能和可解释性，但现有方法主要优化推理的功能性（即是否提升任务表现），而忽略了推理的忠实度——生成的推理链是否真实反映模型内部的决策过程。当前的推理-动作对齐只是弱忠实度指标，无法保证推理步骤与观测、动作之间存在因果关联，可能导致推理只是对已有决策的事后合理化，而非支撑决策的核心过程。
summary.importance: 该工作在具身VLA场景中系统区分了功能性推理和忠实性推理，提出将忠实度作为训练目标而非事后评测指标，对VLA模型的后训练、推理可靠性和分布外鲁棒性有重要启示，也可为LLM推理忠实度的相关研究提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）定义推理的两个互补属性：功能性推理（提升下游决策质量）和忠实性推理（推理轨迹真实反映策略的动作选择过程）。2）指出当前的推理-动作对齐仅提供弱的行为层面忠实度，不足以确保推理的因果有效性。3）将忠实度操作化为结构化推理轨迹上的行为一致性目标，从成对语义一致性约束推导出可扩展的代理目标，用于RL后训练。4）实现Pinocchio——一个学习得到的评论家模型，用于识别观测、中间推理和动作之间的不一致性，提供密集奖励信号来改善具身推理。5）使用图像修复工具构建反事实基准，通过测试模型在分布外场景下的推理和动作响应，直接评估因果性和忠实度。
summary.experiments: 以自动驾驶作为具身推理的测试平台。1）对一个主流VLA自动驾驶模型进行人工评估，发现性能与推理轨迹质量之间没有明确关联，推理可能存在观测 grounding 弱、内部不一致、与行为耦合松散的问题。2）在大规模驾驶基准和合成的分布外场景上评估，发现优化具身忠实度能够提升推理一致性、策略可信度和分布迁移下的鲁棒性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言中功能性与忠实性推理的区分、Pinocchio评论家的核心设计思路，以及反事实评测的方法。跳过具体实现细节和驾驶场景的特定设置。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。如果关注推理忠实度的训练方法，可以细看RL目标的形式化部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Embodied Chain-of-Thought is used to improve decision-making performance and interpretability of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but existing methods mainly optimize for functional reasoning (whether reasoning improves task performance) while neglecting faithful reasoning — whether the generated reasoning chain truly reflects the model's internal decision process. Current reasoning-action alignment provides only a weak faithfulness metric and cannot guarantee causal links between reasoning steps, observations, and actions; reasoning may become post-hoc rationalization of pre-made decisions rather than a load-bearing component of decision-making.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically distinguishes functional and faithful reasoning in embodied VLA scenarios, and proposes treating faithfulness as a training objective rather than a post-hoc evaluation metric. It has important implications for post-training of VLA models, reasoning reliability, and out-of-distribution robustness, and also offers insights for research on LLM reasoning faithfulness.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Define two complementary properties of reasoning: functional reasoning (improves downstream decision quality) and faithful reasoning (reasoning trace accurately reflects the policy's action selection process). 2) Argue that current reasoning-action alignment provides only a weak behavioral notion of faithfulness, insufficient to ensure causal validity of reasoning. 3) Operationalize faithfulness as a tractable behavioral consistency objective over structured reasoning traces, deriving a scalable surrogate from pairwise semantic consistency constraints for RL post-training. 4) Implement Pinocchio, a learned critic that identifies inconsistencies between observations, intermediate reasoning, and actions, providing dense reward signals to improve embodied reasoning. 5) Build a counterfactual benchmark using image inpainting tools to directly evaluate causality and faithfulness by testing model responses of reasoning and actions under out-of-distribution scenarios.
summary_en.experiments: Uses autonomous driving as a testbed for embodied reasoning. 1) Human evaluation of a leading VLA driving model reveals inconclusive coupling between performance and reasoning trace quality; explanations may have weak observational grounding, internal inconsistency, or loose coupling with behavior. 2) Evaluation on large-scale driving benchmarks and synthetic out-of-distribution scenarios shows that optimizing for embodied faithfulness improves reasoning consistency, policy trustworthiness, and robustness under distribution shift.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the distinction between functional and faithful reasoning in the introduction, the core design of the Pinocchio critic, and the counterfactual evaluation method. Skip detailed implementation specifics and driving-scene-specific setups. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes. For deeper interest in faithfulness training methods, examine the formalization of the RL objective.

recommendation.zh: 区分功能性与忠实性推理的视角有启发，对VLM/VLA对齐目标设计有参考，重点看人类评估实验结果
recommendation.en: The functional vs. faithful reasoning distinction is insightful for VLM/VLA alignment design; focus on human evaluation results

paper.title: Revealing Hidden Model Behaviors with Task-Specific Self-Reports
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning can give a language model a hidden behavior--it may give false answers under a narrow condition, or give harmful advice only when a prompt touches a particular topic. We introduce the Stabilized Adapter for self-Report (SAR), a lightweight LoRA adapter that makes a fine-tuned model describe its own hidden behavior in plain language, using only the model and the dataset it was trained on. Across seven implanted behaviors (plus a no-behavior control), SAR detects the hidden behavior in

summary.core_problem: 解决微调后模型可能潜伏狭窄条件触发的隐藏行为，而常规审计难以让模型稳定、准确地自述这些行为。
summary.importance: 这是一个模型可审计性与失配分析工作，贡献类型偏方法+分析：提出轻量适配器让模型对自身隐藏行为做 self-report，并与已有 introspection baseline 比较，关注的是微调后行为表征是否可被读出。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Stabilized Adapter for self-Report（SAR），本质上是一个轻量 LoRA 适配器。它只使用目标模型及其训练数据，在不大改原模型的前提下，诱导模型用自然语言描述自身被植入或学到的隐藏行为。论文将其与 Introspection Adapters (IA) 对比，核心改进点是提升检测召回并降低错误自述/幻觉率，尤其在训练数据无法直接解释、但模型已泛化成更广义 misalignment 的场景下仍保持信号。
summary.experiments: 在 7 种植入隐藏行为外加 1 个无行为对照上评测。摘要声称 SAR 在全部 7 种行为上都能检测到，而 IA 只能覆盖部分设置，并且在失败时会稳定地产生错误行为描述；SAR 在 IA 失效的设置中仍保留正确信号，并将 hallucination rate 降低约一半。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和更细的定量表格，因此目前更像一篇值得看方法设定与失败案例的分析文，而不是可直接迁移到预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Jagiellonian University。不是头部大模型实验室工作，定位更接近模型行为审计与可解释性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to reliably surface narrow, hidden behaviors introduced by fine-tuning, which standard auditing often fails to elicit or describe accurately.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an auditability and misalignment-analysis paper: it proposes a lightweight self-reporting adapter and tests whether hidden post-finetuning behaviors can be read out from the model itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Stabilized Adapter for self-Report (SAR), a lightweight LoRA adapter trained using only the target model and the dataset used for fine-tuning. The goal is to make the model describe its own hidden behavior in plain language. The main claimed gain over Introspection Adapters (IA) is better detection coverage and fewer hallucinated self-descriptions, including cases where the model generalized beyond what the training data explicitly encoded.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is done on seven implanted hidden behaviors plus one no-behavior control. From the abstract, SAR detects all implanted behaviors, while IA only catches some and hallucinates incorrect behaviors when it fails. SAR reportedly preserves positive signal in every setting where IA breaks and cuts hallucination rate by roughly half. The abstract does not expose model sizes, dataset scale, or detailed quantitative tables, so this currently reads more like a useful behavior-analysis paper than a directly actionable pretraining result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Jagiellonian University. This is not a frontier-lab pretraining paper; it is better viewed as model auditing and interpretability work.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但如果你在看 post-train 失配如何被模型内部表征，值得只读方法设定与失败案例；别把 self-report 当成可靠监督信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth a quick read if you care how post-training misbehavior is internally represented; do not over-trust self-reports as a clean supervision signal.

institutions: Doctoral School of Exact and Natural Sciences
Jagiellonian University, Doctoral School of Exact and Natural Sciences

paper.title: Language Models Represent and Transform Concepts with Shared Geometry
paper.abstract: How concepts are represented in neural networks is a fundamental question in machine learning. The dominant view treats concept representations as stationary geometric objects. Yet concepts appear in context, and context transforms them. Drawing from neural population geometry, we formalize concept representations as point-cloud manifolds and contextual transformations as vector fields, and instantiate this framework in large language models. Across six model families of varying scales, we find

summary.core_problem: 研究LLM中概念表征的几何本质，以及上下文如何变换概念表征，挑战此前的静态几何表征主流观点。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次将概念表征形式化为点云流形、上下文变换形式化为向量场，发现跨模型共享的概念变换几何结构。
summary.technical_approach: 借鉴神经群体几何方法，将概念表征建模为高维空间中的点云流形，上下文驱动的表征变换建模为向量场；通过跨模型位移结构迁移实验验证共享几何的存在。
summary.experiments: 覆盖6个不同规模的模型家族，验证概念位移具有语义组织性（与词汇具体性、密度相关），且位移结构跨模型可迁移，预测准确率显著高于随机水平。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates the geometric nature of concept representations in LLMs and how context transforms these representations, challenging the dominant static geometric view of concepts.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution; first to formalize concept representations as point-cloud manifolds and contextual transformations as vector fields, discovering shared transformation geometry across models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adapts neural population geometry methods to model concepts as point-cloud manifolds in high-dimensional space and contextual transformations as vector fields; validates shared geometry via cross-model displacement structure transfer experiments.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across 6 model families of varying scales, confirming semantic organization of concept displacements (correlated with lexical concreteness and density) and above-chance cross-model transferability of displacement structure.

recommendation.zh: 概念变换的跨模型共享几何是有趣的机制发现，作为表征研究文献备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Cross-model shared geometry of concept transformations is an interesting mechanism finding; useful as literature reference, no need for full text reading.

paper.title: Mechanism-level routing failure in LLMs over Lean-verified algebraic structures
paper.abstract: We present an empirical study of structural routing failure in large language models (LLMs) over a formally verified algebraic corpus. The task requires selecting the correct proof-mechanism label from a fixed closed template set for compact mathematical objects drawn from the FiberRing formalization in Lean 4, where each item is anchored to a Lean-verified artifact and assigned a label from the corresponding certificate family.   Our central finding is a mechanism-level routing ceiling: under b

summary.core_problem: 研究LLM在形式化代数证明任务中的机制级路由失败现象，量化路由天花板及线索提示的提升效果。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，在Lean验证的高质量代数语料上发现机制级路由天花板，明确了CRT到环等价误路由的主导错误模式。
summary.technical_approach: 使用FiberRing形式化语料，设置盲测与机制线索提示两种实验条件，对比不同模型的证明机制模板匹配准确率，系统分析错误模式。
summary.experiments: 测试gpt-oss-120b和Llama 3.3 70B，盲测下模板准确率分别为80.3%和68.2%，提供机制线索后分别提升10.6和13.6个百分点；CRT误路由占盲测错误的主要部分。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括新加坡国立大学、Omega Institute、ChronoAI

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates mechanism-level routing failures of LLMs in formal algebraic proving tasks, quantifying the routing ceiling and the improvement from cue exposure.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution; discovers mechanism-level routing ceiling on Lean-verified high-quality algebraic corpus, identifying CRT-to-ring-equivalence misrouting as the dominant failure mode.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses FiberRing formalized corpus with two experimental conditions (blind test and mechanism cue exposure), compares proof-mechanism template accuracy across models, and systematically analyzes error patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Tests gpt-oss-120b and Llama 3.3 70B, achieving 80.3% and 68.2% template accuracy under blind conditions, with 10.6pp and 13.6pp improvements from mechanism cues; CRT misrouting accounts for most blind errors.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include National University of Singapore, Omega Institute, ChronoAI

recommendation.zh: 形式化语料下的路由失败发现有参考价值，作为推理机制研究文献备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Routing failure finding on formal corpus is informative; useful as reasoning mechanism literature reference, no need for full text reading.

institutions: National University of Singapore / Omega Institute

paper.title: Brand-as-Memory: Vision-Language Models Encode Causal, Mechanistically Localizable Credibility Priors for News Sources
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read news and web content as images, where the publisher's identity is visually present. We show that VLMs carry a strong source-credibility prior keyed on outlet identity, and study it along three axes. (i) Cross-model benchmark. We introduce CueTrust, a cross-model diagnostic that measures which surface source cue overrides an article's content evidence via a Source-Override Index (SOI). Across seven VLMs and five cues, the vulnerability profile is mo

summary.core_problem: VLM处理新闻类图文内容时是否以及如何编码新闻来源的可信度先验，缺乏跨模型的因果性机制验证
summary.importance: 首次系统验证VLM中存在独立于内容的来源可信度先验，明确了该先验的跨模态触发条件与可定位性
summary.technical_approach: 构建跨模型诊断工具CueTrust，通过Source-Override Index测量不同来源线索对内容证据的覆盖效应；通过仅替换报头等因果干预定位先验编码，分析其与人类媒体可信度评分的相关性
summary.experiments: 在7个VLM上测试5类来源线索，发现仅媒体身份线索（报头、logo、裸域名）可触发可信度偏移，作者名、文中权威、页面布局无显著效应；仅替换报头可导致约11个log-odds的可信度变动，与Media Bias/Fact Check专业评分相关系数rho=0.88（摘要截断）

summary_en.core_problem: Whether and how VLMs encode source credibility priors for news outlets when processing multimodal news content lacks cross-model causal mechanistic validation.
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic evidence that VLMs encode content-independent source credibility priors, along with their cross-modal triggering conditions and localizability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces CueTrust, a cross-model diagnostic that measures how source cues override content evidence via the Source-Override Index; uses causal interventions (swapping only mastheads) to localize prior encoding and correlates outputs with human-rated media credibility scores.
summary_en.experiments: Tests 5 cue types across 7 VLMs, finding that only outlet identity cues (masthead, logo, bare domain) trigger credibility shifts, with no significant effect from author names, in-text authority, or page layout; masthead swaps alone shift credibility by ~11 log-odds, correlating at rho=0.88 with Media Bias/Fact Check ratings (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: VLM品牌偏见的个例机制研究，未触及预训练数据或建模的通用规律，作为文献备查即可，不读正文
recommendation.en: A case study of VLM brand credibility bias with no generalizable findings for pretraining data or modeling; keep as reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: Subliminal Clocks: Latent Time Modelling in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models. Unlike standard diffusion-based approaches, DLMs are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep, raising a natural question: do these models internally represent denoising progress, and how is such information used downstream? In this work, we show that DLMs do in fact encode a latent representation related to the diffusion timestep within their residual streams. We find that this signal can

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：masked diffusion language model 在推理时虽然没有像连续扩散模型那样显式输入 timestep，但模型内部是否仍然形成了“当前去噪进度”的隐式表征，以及这个表征是否真的参与了生成控制。作者把去噪进度具体化为当前序列中已解 mask 的比例 τ，并把问题拆成三步：能否从残差流中读出 τ；能否沿着对应方向做因果干预；这个时间信号在不同层里呈现什么几何结构。这个问题不直接提升指标，但它触及 DLM 的内部计算机制：模型到底是在做纯局部填空，还是在维护一个全局的 generation state。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在机制层面，而不是 recipe 层面。第一，它给 masked diffusion LM 提供了一个较清楚的内部状态变量：去噪进度不是外部分析者强加的观测量，而是模型残差流里可解码、可操控的信号。第二，它说明 time-agnostic 的 DLM 并不等于“没有时间”，而是把时间编码成了隐变量；这对后续设计显式时间控制、分层去噪策略、step-adaptive compute、以及 any-order / masked LM 的统一理解都有启发。第三，作者做了 probe 之外的 steering 和几何分析，至少部分避免了“能线性读出不代表被使用”的老问题。不过这篇工作的贡献量级仍偏 interpretability：它不会直接改变当前主流预训练流程，更像是在为 DLM 建模范式补一块机制拼图。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三层。第一层是恢复信号。作者在 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream 上，对每一层残差流 hidden state 训练单独的 MLP probe，回归当前推理步的 τ。probe 分别只看 mask token、只看非 mask token、或看全部 token，用来判断时间信息是否集中在某类位置。文中结果显示，多数中后层都能稳定恢复 τ，且 R² 在相当宽的层范围内保持较高，说明这不是某一层偶然泄漏的局部特征。

第二层是因果操控。作者不是只停留在线性可读性，而是从 probe 学到的时间相关子空间中提取低维方向，对残差流做 steering，观察模型生成时“主观时间”的变化。直观上，如果把 hidden state 往“更晚的去噪阶段”方向推，模型会表现得更愿意提交具体 token、减少保守性；往“更早阶段”方向推，则更像仍处在高不确定度的去噪早期。这个设计的关键在于：它不改 sampling schedule，也不改外部 mask ratio，而是只改内部表征，因此更接近检验“模型是否真的用到了这个内部时间变量”。

第三层是几何分析。作者考察不同层中时间信号的可分离性、维度和对齐关系，试图回答它是分散编码还是集中在低维子空间。摘要和正文都强调是 low-dimensional subspace，这意味着 τ 不是弥散在整个表示空间里的弱统计痕迹，而更像一个可识别的全局控制轴。若这一点成立，它和很多 AR 模型里出现的全局控制变量、phase signal、甚至 layerwise computation stage 有相通之处。

和已有工作相比，这篇文章的区别在于它不研究 attention sink、mask 操纵攻击或 SAE 概念 steering，而是直接盯住 DLM 最核心但此前没被明确刻画的内部变量：denoising progress。它也不同于理论上把 mask ratio 与连续时间对应起来的工作；这里研究的是模型是否真的在内部实现了这种对应。
summary.experiments:
实验主体建立在 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream 两个代表性 masked DLM 上。可从正文读到的关键信息是：

1. Probe 结果：在 LLaDA 上，按层训练的 probe 在较大范围内都能达到 R² > 0.5，说明 τ 从残差流中是稳定可恢复的，而不是只能在输入层或输出层读到。作者还比较了只用 mask token、只用非 mask token、以及全 token 的设置，用来判断时间信号的空间分布。这个设计很重要，因为如果只有 mask 位携带 τ，说明它可能只是显式观测量的重编码；如果非 mask 位也强可读，则更支持“全局状态”解释。

2. Steering 结果：沿时间子空间做干预后，模型的去噪行为会系统性偏移。虽然摘要截断，没有给出完整数字，但正文主张这种调制是 systematic 的，而不是少量样例上的现象学展示。阅读时应重点确认作者是否报告了：接受率/解 mask 速度/输出熵/最终文本质量等量化变化，以及 steering 强度与行为变化是否近似单调。

3. 几何结果：作者分析了时间信号在层间的组织方式，结论是存在低维结构。这里最值得看的是：低维到什么程度；不同层的时间方向是否对齐；是否存在中层最强、后层回落的 pattern；LLaDA 与 Dream 是否一致。如果两个模型都出现相似层结构，这个现象就更像范式属性，而不是单模型偶然性。

从预训练研究者角度，这篇文章的实验强项是把“可读出—可操控—有几何结构”串成了闭环；弱项是它主要是分析型工作，缺少把这一发现转成更好训练目标或更高效推理策略的后续验证。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里三个研究问题和 τ 的定义，再看 Recovering τ 这一节的 probe 设定与图 2。这里决定了整篇文章是否站得住：如果 probe 只是读到 mask 比例的表面统计，后面的解释会变弱。阅读时要特别留意作者如何控制 trivial cues，比如 token identity、位置、当前 mask 分布。

第二个重点是 steering 部分。要看清楚时间子空间是怎么构造的，是 probe 梯度、线性回归方向、还是某种子空间分解；干预发生在单层还是多层；是一次性加偏置还是逐步注入。这里关系到因果解释的力度。

第三个重点是几何分析和附录。附录里通常会给出 probe 架构、训练细节、不同 token 子集、以及 τ 与连续时间 s 的关系推导。若只想快速判断价值，读主文图 2、steering 主图、以及层间几何图，大约 25 分钟够用。若想把它作为 DLM 机制分析的参考模板，建议连附录一起看 60 分钟左右。

值得深挖的点有两个：一是这个 latent clock 是否能用于 step-adaptive decoding，例如让模型自己决定何时该更激进地 unmask；二是它是否只是 mask ratio 的函数，还是还编码了“剩余不确定度”这类更丰富的状态量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise mechanistic question about masked diffusion language models: even though these models are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep at inference, do they internally represent denoising progress, and is that representation actually used by the model? The authors operationalize denoising progress as the fraction of unmasked tokens, τ, and study three sub-questions: whether τ can be decoded from residual-stream activations, whether intervening on the corresponding direction causally changes generation behavior, and how this signal is organized across layers. This is not a benchmark-chasing paper; it is about whether DLMs maintain an internal global state rather than merely performing local masked-token recovery.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly conceptual and mechanistic. First, it provides evidence that time-agnostic masked DLMs are not truly “without time”; they appear to encode denoising progress as a latent internal variable. Second, that matters for how one thinks about diffusion-style language modeling more broadly: explicit timestep conditioning may be absent at the interface while an implicit clock still emerges in the representation. Third, the paper goes beyond pure probing by adding steering and geometric analysis, which makes the claim stronger than a simple linear-readout result. The practical impact on pretraining recipes is limited for now, but the work is relevant if one cares about DLM internals, adaptive denoising schedules, controllable generation, or the broader question of what global state variables language models learn to maintain.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers. First, the authors train per-layer MLP probes on residual-stream hidden states to regress the current denoising progress τ during inference. They do this on two representative masked DLMs, LLaDA-1.5 and Dream, and vary which token positions are used: masked tokens only, non-masked tokens only, or all tokens. This is an important design choice because it tests whether the signal is localized to visibly masked positions or distributed more globally across the sequence representation.

Second, they move from readout to intervention. From the learned time-related representation, they identify a low-dimensional subspace associated with inferred denoising progress and steer activations along that subspace. The key point is that they do not alter the external unmasking schedule or the observed mask ratio; they only perturb internal states. If generation behavior shifts in a systematic way, that is stronger evidence that the model is using an internal notion of progress rather than merely exposing a correlational artifact.

Third, they analyze the geometry of the recovered signal across layers. The paper argues that denoising progress is encoded in a relatively low-dimensional subspace rather than as a diffuse weak statistic spread across the full hidden state. That matters because a compact control-like representation is easier to interpret as an internal state variable. The layerwise analysis also helps distinguish whether the signal is strongest in early, middle, or late computation and whether similar structure appears across different DLM families.

Relative to prior DLM interpretability work, this paper is narrower and more central: it does not focus on attention sinks, harmful mask manipulations, or generic SAE features, but on the internal representation of denoising progress itself. It also differs from theoretical work that links mask ratio to diffusion time analytically; here the question is whether the model actually instantiates such a variable internally.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is built around LLaDA-1.5 and Dream. The main takeaways visible from the full text are:

1. Probe results: on LLaDA, layerwise probes recover τ with R² above 0.5 over a substantial range of layers, indicating that denoising progress is not only weakly present or confined to a single stage. The token-subset comparisons are especially important. If non-masked tokens also carry strong τ information, that supports the interpretation of a global latent state rather than a trivial reflection of visible mask positions.

2. Steering results: perturbing activations along the recovered time subspace systematically modulates the model’s effective notion of denoising stage. The abstract states this qualitatively; the main text should be checked for the exact quantitative readouts used to support the claim, such as changes in unmasking behavior, entropy, confidence, or output characteristics. The key thing to verify is whether the effect is monotonic and robust across layers and prompts.

3. Geometric analysis: the paper argues that the time signal lives in a low-dimensional subspace and studies how that structure evolves across depth. The most useful details to extract while reading are: how low-dimensional the signal is, whether the dominant directions align across layers, whether there is a middle-layer peak, and whether LLaDA and Dream show similar patterns.

From a pretraining-research perspective, the strongest part of the experimental package is the progression from decodability to causal steering to representational geometry. The main limitation is that the paper stops at analysis; it does not yet turn the discovered latent clock into a better training objective or a more efficient decoding policy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the definition of τ and the three research questions in the introduction. Then read the probing section carefully, especially the setup behind Figure 2. That is the foundation of the paper. Pay attention to whether the authors rule out trivial shortcuts such as direct dependence on visible mask statistics, token identity, or positional artifacts.

Next, focus on the steering section. The important questions are how the time subspace is constructed, whether intervention is applied at one layer or multiple layers, and whether the perturbation is a simple additive shift or something more structured. This determines how strong the causal claim really is.

Then read the geometry section and the appendix. The appendix is likely where the probe architecture, training details, token-subset definitions, and the relation between τ and the continuous corruption variable s are spelled out. For a quick pass, the main figures on probing, steering, and layerwise geometry are enough in about 20–30 minutes. For a serious mechanistic read, including appendices, budget around an hour.

Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, can this latent clock be used for adaptive decoding, where the model decides how aggressively to unmask? Second, is the recovered signal only a proxy for mask ratio, or does it encode a richer notion of residual uncertainty?

recommendation.zh: 扩散语言模型存在内部时间表征的发现值得关注，做非AR建模范式研究可重点看第3节探针实验与第4节调控实验。
recommendation.en: The discovery of latent timestep representations in diffusion LMs is noteworthy; non-AR paradigm researchers should focus on Section 3 probing and Section 4 steering experiments.

paper.title: Fast Multi-dimensional Refusal Subspaces via RFM-AGOP
paper.abstract: Steering and monitoring activations in Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for both safety and interpretability. Early work assumed behaviours are encoded along single linear directions, but recent findings suggest complex behaviours, such as the refusal to answer harmful queries, live in multi-dimensional subspaces. However, existing methods for extracting these subspaces are computationally expensive, which becomes prohibitive on reasoning models who produce long reasoning trace

summary.core_problem: 提取LLM中控制有害query拒绝行为的多维子空间时，现有方法计算成本过高，在生成长度可达数千token的推理模型上实用性差；此前基于RFM-AGOP的拒绝分析仅使用top-1特征向量，单一线性方向不足以刻画大模型中拒绝行为的多维结构。
summary.importance: 给出了秒级速度的多维拒绝子空间提取方案，可用于表征工程、模型安全干预、对齐机制分析，尤其适用于长思维链模型上的安全表征研究，无需运行昂贵的梯度优化过程即可快速定位子空间开展消融或干预实验。属于实用工具类贡献，对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 对RFM-AGOP框架做两处稳定性改进，适配多维子空间提取任务。第一，将原框架的单位矩阵初始化替换为探针引导初始化：先训练简单线性探针区分有害/无害query的激活，用探针权重向量加激活的秩k截断协方差构造初始特征矩阵，解决原方法对超参数敏感、早期迭代容易偏离主方向的问题。第二，在AGOP矩阵迭代更新时加入指数移动平均，降低更新噪声。收敛后取最终特征矩阵的top-k特征向量张成拒绝子空间，全程不需要梯度优化。方法采用马哈拉诺比斯拉普拉斯核，迭代执行核岭回归与AGOP更新。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5（非推理模型）和Qwen3（推理模型，最长思维链达8000 token）上开展实验，子空间提取耗时仅数秒，速度显著高于此前的拒绝锥优化（RCO）方法。实验验证单一线性方向确实无法完整刻画拒绝行为：多维子空间在两类操作上效果更好，一是将激活投影到子空间正交补以消除拒绝行为，二是沿基向量方向缩放以引导模型拒绝或回答有害query。正文未报告具体的拒绝率、能力保留数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的两处改动（探针初始化、EMA更新）和实验中关于多维子空间必要性的对比，预计阅读时间15分钟。无需深究RFM的理论推导，了解该工具可快速提取多维行为子空间即可；如需复现，再查阅附录中数据集构建、层选择的细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Télécom SudParis、ENS Paris-Saclay，工作发表于ICML 2026机制可解释性研讨会。

summary_en.core_problem: Extracting the multi-dimensional refusal subspace — internal representations that govern LLM refusal of harmful queries — is computationally expensive with existing methods, making the process impractical for reasoning models that produce reasoning traces thousands of tokens long. Prior RFM-AGOP work on refusal analysis only uses the top-1 eigenvector, and a single linear direction cannot fully capture refusal structure in larger models.
summary_en.importance: The method extracts multi-dimensional refusal subspaces in seconds, making it usable for representation engineering, safety intervention, and alignment mechanism analysis — especially for safety studies on long-CoT reasoning models, as it eliminates the need for expensive gradient-based optimization to locate subspaces for ablation or steering. It is a practical tooling contribution, with limited direct relevance to base model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two stability modifications are made to the RFM-AGOP framework to support multi-dimensional subspace extraction. First, the original identity matrix initialization is replaced with a probe-informed starting point: a simple linear probe is trained to separate activations from harmful and harmless queries, and the initial feature matrix is constructed from the probe weight vector plus the rank-k truncated covariance of activations. This fixes the original RFM’s sensitivity to hyperparameters and tendency to diverge from the primary direction in early iterations. Second, exponential moving average is applied to AGOP matrix updates to reduce iteration noise. After convergence, the top-k eigenvectors of the final feature matrix span the refusal subspace; no gradient optimization is required through the whole process. The method uses a Mahalanobis Laplace kernel, and iterates between kernel ridge regression and AGOP updates.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are run on Qwen 2.5 (non-reasoning) and Qwen 3 (reasoning model, with CoT up to 8000 tokens). Subspace extraction takes only seconds, substantially faster than prior Refusal Cone Optimization (RCO). Results confirm a single linear direction cannot fully model refusal behavior: the multi-dimensional subspace performs better on both standard operations — projecting activations to the orthogonal complement of the subspace to remove refusal, and scaling along basis vectors to steer the model toward refusal or compliance. Exact refusal rate and capability retention numbers are not reported in the main text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the two core method modifications (probe initialization, EMA update) and the empirical comparison supporting the need for multi-dimensional subspaces; expect around 15 minutes of reading. There is no need to dig into RFM theoretical derivations unless implementing the method — it is sufficient to know this tool can rapidly extract multi-dimensional behavioral subspaces. Refer to appendices for dataset construction and layer selection details only for reproduction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Télécom SudParis and ENS Paris-Saclay. The work appears at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop.

recommendation.zh: 快速提取拒绝子空间的方法创新，适合推理模型的激活分析，仅需看方法和实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Innovative method for fast refusal subspace extraction suitable for reasoning models, just read the method and experiment sections.

paper.title: Geometric Signatures of Reasoning: A Spectral Perspective on Task Hardness
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables large language models (LLMs) to solve complex problems by generating intermediate reasoning steps. While much attention has been paid to the length and content of these reasoning chains, far less is known about their internal geometry. We study the \emph{geometry} of CoT trajectories in the hidden state space of transformer models, formalizing each reasoning chain as a discrete curve in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and characterizing it through spectral, positional, an

summary.core_problem: 这项工作问的是：CoT 推理的隐藏状态轨迹是否携带任务难度和答案正确性的可预测信号，而不只看生成文本长度或显式推理内容。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析和推理时信号。它把一次 CoT 生成看成隐藏空间中的离散曲线，用谱特征、位置特征和运动学特征描述推理过程。对基座研究员有两个启发：一是任务难度可能对应隐藏状态探索维度的扩张，二是早期轨迹几何可以用于 best-of-n 排序、提前停止或动态分配 test-time compute。它不是提升预训练损失的工作，但能帮助理解 reasoning model 的内部动态。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把固定层的 hidden states 序列形式化为曲线 γ=(h1,...,hn)，再定义几类 geometric functionals。谱特征关注轨迹点云的协方差或 Gram 结构的特征值分布；有效维度 dρ 用来度量轨迹在多少隐藏方向上展开。直觉是，简单任务的 CoT 轨迹更集中，主方向占比较高；困难任务需要调用更多隐空间方向，特征值谱更平，dρ 更高。除谱特征外，工作还抽取位置和运动学特征，例如轨迹位移、步长变化、速度/加速度类统计，用于预测最终答案是否正确。与只统计 CoT 长度、token entropy 或文本模式的方法不同，它直接读模型内部表征；与一般 probing 不同，它关心的是生成过程中形成的整条轨迹，而不是单个 token 或单层静态表示。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有两个。第一，仅用有效维度相关特征区分数学题 easy/hard，AUC 超过 0.93，说明谱平坦度和任务难度之间有较强相关。第二，只使用生成前 20% token 的七个运动学和位置特征预测最终解答正确性，AUC 达到 0.806。这对 best-of-n 和早停比较有意义：如果早期轨迹已经显示某条推理路径质量较差，可以减少继续生成的预算。需要注意的是，结果主要支持相关性和可预测性，还不能说明有效维度就是推理难度的因果机制；不同模型层、采样温度和题型分布下的稳定性需要进一步检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的形式化定义，弄清 hidden-state curve 和 geometric functional 的构造；看 Section 4 的 effective dimension 定义和理论解释，关注为什么谱更平会对应更高复杂度；看 Section 5.2 和 5.3 的实验，尤其是 correctness prediction 的早期 token 设置和 hardness prediction 的 AUC。若用于自己的训练或推理系统，建议深挖特征是否跨模型、跨层、跨采样温度稳定，以及是否能和 logprob、entropy、verifier score 互补。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies whether the hidden-state trajectory of chain-of-thought generation contains predictive signals about task difficulty and answer correctness, beyond the length or textual content of the reasoning chain.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is mechanistic rather than a new pretraining recipe. It treats CoT generation as a discrete curve in representation space and characterizes that curve with spectral, positional, and kinematic features. For foundation-model research, the useful point is that task hardness may correspond to broader exploration of hidden dimensions, and early trajectory geometry may help rank best-of-n samples, trigger early stopping, or allocate test-time compute more selectively.
summary_en.technical_approach: For a fixed transformer layer, the generated hidden states are modeled as a curve γ=(h1,...,hn). The paper then defines geometric functionals over this curve. The spectral side analyzes the eigenvalue profile of the trajectory covariance or related point-cloud structure. The effective dimension dρ measures how many latent directions the trajectory occupies. The proposed interpretation is simple: easy problems produce more concentrated trajectories with a few dominant directions, while harder problems have flatter spectra and spread across more hidden dimensions. The paper also uses positional and kinematic statistics, such as displacement and velocity/acceleration-like changes, to predict whether a generated solution will be correct. This differs from token-level heuristics such as CoT length or entropy because it uses the model’s internal trajectory, not only the output text.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported numbers are strong for a probing-style analysis. Effective-dimension features alone separate easy and hard math problems with AUC above 0.93. Seven positional and kinematic features computed from only the first 20% of generated tokens predict final correctness with AUC 0.806. This supports the idea that some quality signal appears early in the hidden-state path. The results should still be read as predictive evidence rather than a causal account of reasoning difficulty. Robustness across layers, models, sampling temperatures, and task distributions is the key open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read Section 3 for the curve formalization and the definition of geometric functionals. Read Section 4 for effective dimension and the spectral hardness argument. Then inspect Sections 5.2 and 5.3 for the correctness and hardness prediction setups. The most useful follow-up is to test whether these trajectory features add signal beyond log probability, entropy, and verifier scores in best-of-n inference.

recommendation.zh: 用谱几何度量推理难度的视角新鲜，理论部分可读，但实验模型规模偏小，作为机制分析的弱信号参考。
recommendation.en: Fresh perspective on measuring reasoning difficulty via spectral geometry; the theory section is worth reading, but experiments use small models and serve as weak signal.

paper.title: TokenScope: Token-Level Explainability and Interpretability for Code-Oriented Tasks in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) make token-level decisions during code generation remains a major challenge for both researchers and practitioners. While recent tools provide insights into model internals or generation outcomes, they often lack decoding-time signals, fine-grained uncertainty measures, and interactive mechanisms for exploring alternative generation paths. We present TokenScope, an interactive interpretability and analysis tool for decoder-based LLMs that exposes to

summary.core_problem: 解释代码生成模型在解码时为什么选择某个 token，以及替换 token 后生成路径如何变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是可交互解释工具。它把解码时的不确定性、注意力模式、候选 token 和代码结构信息放到同一个界面里，适合做代码生成行为分析，但不是新的训练方法或机制结论。
summary.technical_approach: TokenScope 面向 decoder-only LLM，记录生成过程中的 token-level 指标、attention pattern 和替代候选；支持交互式 token replacement、counterfactual branching，并用 AST 对代码片段做结构化聚合。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模或定量评测结果。工作重点更像系统工具展示，而不是通过 controlled ablation 得出机制结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of British Columbia Okanagan。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to inspect token-level decisions made by decoder LLMs during code generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an interactive interpretability tool rather than a new training or modeling method. It combines decoding-time uncertainty, attention, token alternatives, and program structure for code-generation analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokenScope logs token-level metrics and attention patterns during decoding, supports token replacement and counterfactual branching, and aggregates code-aware signals through abstract syntax trees.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or quantitative comparisons. The value appears to be in tooling and exploratory analysis rather than clean mechanistic evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of British Columbia Okanagan.

recommendation.zh: 工具思路清楚，但离训练机制还有一层；看 token replacement 和 AST 聚合设计即可。
recommendation.en: A useful tool idea, but not a training-mechanism paper; skim the token replacement and AST aggregation design only.

paper.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly Depends on Training Methodology
paper.abstract: Model organisms (MOs) - language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours - are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents. Prior research has shown that interpretability methods can easily identify hidden behaviours in these MOs. However, recent work suggests that such post-hoc training methods may make interp

summary.core_problem: 当前用于白盒可解释性技术评测的主流测试集是模型有机体（Model Organism, MO）——即被刻意训练出特定目标行为的语言模型。现有MO几乎都通过窄域后处理监督微调构造，这类MO上测得的可解释性结果能否外推到常规训练中自然涌现的行为，以及MO构造方法对可解释性评测结果的影响程度，此前没有系统研究。
summary.importance: 结果说明基于窄域SFT构造MO的基准得到的可解释性结果普遍偏乐观，无法可靠代表方法在真实模型上的表现。更重要的是，工作提供了明确证据：相同的外在行为可以由完全不同的内部表征支撑，训练方式（后处理SFT/DPO/融入正式后训练流程）对表征结构的影响远大于行为层面的相似性，这对理解post-training如何修改模型内部表征、设计更可靠的对齐评测方法都有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造了严格控制变量的MO测试集，共54个模型，基于OLMo2-1B和Gemma-3-1b-it两个底座，覆盖三类良性触发-反应行为：烘焙错误事实、食物语境下的意大利餐偏好、军事语境下的潜艇话题执念。每类行为下分别用7种训练方式构造MO变体：标准后处理转录蒸馏（TD）、合成文档微调（SDF），两种方法分别设置加/不加无关通用数据混合的版本；后处理DPO，同样设置加/不加通用数据混合的版本；以及更贴近真实流程的集成式训练：将行为相关数据直接混入OLMo原生的DPO后训练阶段共同训练。所有MO都校准到相同的行为触发率和反应强度，且控制行为不会泄露到无关语境。之后用四类主流白盒可解释性方法（激活预言机、基于激活差的引导、logit lens方法、稀疏自编码器）测试每个MO中植入行为的可检测程度，控制变量对比训练方法、行为类型、模型架构的影响。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括三点：第一，外在行为完全匹配的MO，仅因训练方式不同，可解释性方法的检测成功率差异可达1.2-20.4倍；第二，传统窄域后处理SFT构造的MO可检测性最高，即最容易被解释，而最贴近真实后训练流程的集成式DPO构造的MO可检测性显著最低；第三，不同可解释性方法在不同训练方式MO上的表现排序，在不同行为类型、不同模型架构之间没有一致的泛化性，即一个方法在某类MO上表现好，不代表在其他训练方式得到的MO上同样有效。结果对训练随机性、数据顺序鲁棒，不是随机波动导致。全部54个MO、训练数据和代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注核心结论部分——相同外在行为在不同训练方式下的内部表征可解释性差异，以及对现有MO基准有效性的讨论，这部分对理解post-training对表征的影响最有价值。各类MO的具体训练超参数、可解释性方法的实现细节可以跳过，如果做可解释性相关工作，再参考3.3节的集成式MO构造方法和3.4节的行为匹配控制流程。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Model organisms (MOs) — language models intentionally trained to exhibit specific target behaviors — are the standard testbed for white-box interpretability evaluation. Nearly all existing MOs are built via narrow post-hoc supervised fine-tuning, and it remains untested whether interpretability results on these artificial MOs generalize to behaviors that emerge during regular model training, or how strongly MO construction methodology affects measured interpretability performance.
summary_en.importance: Results show that interpretability benchmarks built on narrow SFT MOs produce consistently overoptimistic results, and do not reliably predict method performance on models trained via more realistic pipelines. Beyond implications for interpretability evaluation, the work provides clear evidence that identical observable behavior can be supported by drastically different internal representations: training methodology (post-hoc SFT / DPO / integrated post-training) has a far larger effect on representational structure than surface-level behavioral similarity. This is relevant to understanding how post-training modifies model internals, and to designing more robust alignment evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled suite of 54 MOs is constructed on OLMo2-1B and gemma-3-1b-it bases, covering three benign trigger-reaction quirks: false cake baking facts, Italian food preference in food contexts, and submarine fixation in military contexts. For each quirk, 7 training variants are produced: standard post-hoc transcript distillation and synthetic document fine-tuning (each with and without unrelated general data mixing), post-hoc DPO (with and without general data mixing), and a novel integrated construction method that inserts quirk data directly into OLMo’s official DPO post-training pipeline. All MOs are calibrated to identical quirk trigger rates and response strength, with controls to prevent quirk leakage into irrelevant contexts. Four standard white-box interpretability techniques (activation oracles, activation difference steering, logit lens, sparse autoencoders) are used to measure quirk detectability across all MOs under controlled conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings emerge: First, MOs with identical observable behavior exhibit 1.2–20.4× variation in quirk detectability, driven solely by training method. Second, standard narrow post-hoc SFT MOs are the most easily interpretable, while integrated DPO MOs (closest to realistic post-training pipelines) are consistently the least detectable. Third, performance rankings of interpretability methods across training protocols do not generalize across quirk types or model architectures, meaning strong performance on one MO variant does not predict performance on others. Results are robust to training nondeterminism and data ordering, and are not explained by random variation. All 54 MOs, training data, and code are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core result that behaviorally identical models have drastically different interpretability based on training method, and the discussion of limitations in current MO benchmark design — these are the most relevant insights for understanding post-training representational changes. Skim detailed training hyperparameters and interpretability method implementation details unless actively building interpretability benchmarks; if so, refer to Section 3.3 for the integrated MO construction method and Section 3.4 for the behavioral matching control protocol. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 重要的方法论警示——模型生物的构造方法会严重影响可解释性实验结果，做机制研究的研究员需要注意MO构造的效度问题，重点看§4的实验结果。
recommendation.en: Important methodological warning—MO construction methods heavily affect interpretability experiment results; researchers doing mechanism studies need to be aware of MO validity issues; focus on §4 experimental results.

paper.title: NeuroCogMap Reveals Cognitive Organization of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding how complex cognitive functions are organized within artificial systems is central to interpreting large language models (LLMs) and relating them to biological cognition. Yet although LLMs exhibit broad cognitive-like behaviours, it remains unclear whether their internal representations form reproducible functional systems that explain behaviour, failure and links to human cognition. Here we present NeuroCogMap, a cognitive neuroscience-inspired framework that organizes internal fe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是：LLM 内部是否存在稳定、可复现、可解释的“认知组织”，以及这种组织能否解释模型能力、失效行为，并与人类脑活动建立可检验的联系。它不是单点神经元或局部 circuit 分析，而是试图在 sparse features、功能分区、认知能力和层级结构之间建立一套系统级地图。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在机制分析和能力诊断。NeuroCogMap 把认知神经科学中的 functional parcellation 思路迁移到 LLM：先把内部特征聚成稳定功能区，再把功能区连接到认知任务和行为输出。这种方法可能帮助研究预训练中能力如何分布、哪些功能在模型间保守、哪些失效来自表示层问题，哪些来自行为控制问题。它对训练 recipe 的直接贡献有限，但对评估模型内部结构、比较不同架构或不同训练阶段的能力形成，有方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 框架从一个较宽的 capability space 和对应评测数据集出发，收集模型在多类认知任务中的内部激活。随后提取 sparse model features，通常可理解为用稀疏特征分解或类似 SAE 的方式把高维激活拆成更可解释的特征。作者再根据这些特征的共激活、语义一致性和功能相关性形成 parcels，即类似脑区分区的功能单元。每个 parcel 被映射到 cognitive atlas，包括具体功能、能力类别和更高层级的认知结构。框架还分析 parcel 之间的结构连接，并把这些内部单元与输出行为、异常行为、人类皮层反应和经典认知模型联系起来。与局部可解释性工作相比，它关注的是中观层级：比单个 feature 更稳定，比整体 embedding 更可解释。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了几类实验。第一，parcels 在模型内部形成稳定且语义连贯的组织，并且在不同模型之间存在部分保守性。第二，pathology analysis 显示表示性异常和行为控制异常会扰动不同 circuit、parcel、capability 和 hierarchy，且这些扰动签名可用于检测和机制引导的缓解。第三，在自然语言理解的人类脑活动预测中，NeuroCogMap 的 parcel activity 相比常规模型表示带来更好的 cortical-response prediction；最强对齐的 parcels 在功能 profile 和语义描述上对应较高阶皮层系统。第四，作者用 LLM 行为模拟中的 latent strategy signatures 改进经典决策模型，并提升 held-out behavioural fit。给定内容未列出具体模型规模、SAE 配置、数据量和提升幅度，精读时应核对结果表和消融设置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。优先看框架图和方法部分：sparse features 如何抽取、parcels 如何聚类、cognitive atlas 如何标注、hierarchy 如何构建。然后看三组结果：跨模型稳定性、pathology signature、人类 cortical alignment。若关注预训练机制，重点不是脑科学类比本身，而是这套中观表征分析是否能用于比较不同 checkpoint、不同数据配比、不同 post-training 前后的内部功能重排。对实验细节要保持谨慎，尤其要检查自动标注、任务集合选择和 parcel 稳定性是否会影响结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs have a stable and interpretable internal cognitive organization, and whether that organization can explain capabilities, failures, and links to human cortical activity. It moves beyond isolated neurons or individual circuits and tries to build a system-level map from sparse internal features to functional parcels, cognitive capabilities, and hierarchical structure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to interpretability and model diagnostics rather than to pretraining recipes directly. NeuroCogMap offers a way to study how capabilities are distributed inside a trained model, which functional units are conserved across models, and how different failure modes affect different internal subsystems. For pretraining research, the useful angle is comparative analysis: the same framework could be applied across checkpoints, architectures, data mixtures, or post-training stages to see how internal organization changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: NeuroCogMap starts from a broad capability space and associated evaluation datasets. It collects internal activations from LLMs and extracts sparse model features, in the spirit of decomposing high-dimensional representations into more interpretable components. These features are then grouped into functional parcels based on coherence and functional association. Each parcel is linked to a cognitive atlas of functions, then aggregated into higher-level capabilities and a cognitive hierarchy. The framework also studies interactions between parcels and relates parcel activity to outputs, pathological behaviors, human cortical responses, and classical cognitive models. Compared with local mechanistic interpretability, the method targets a middle scale: more stable than individual features, but more interpretable than whole-layer representations.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that the derived parcels are stable, semantically coherent, and partly conserved across models. Pathology analyses separate representational failures from behavioral-control failures, showing different disruption patterns across circuits, parcels, capabilities, and hierarchy. These signatures are then used for detection and mechanism-guided mitigation. In human-alignment experiments, parcel activity improves cortical-response prediction during naturalistic language comprehension compared with conventional model representations, and the most aligned parcels correspond to higher-order cortical systems in both functional profile and semantic description. The paper also uses latent strategy signatures from LLM behavioral simulations to refine classical decision-making models and improve held-out behavioral fit. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, data scales, sparse-feature settings, or numerical gains, so those should be checked in the tables and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Focus first on the framework construction: sparse feature extraction, parcel formation, cognitive-atlas annotation, and hierarchy building. Then read the results on cross-model stability, pathology signatures, and cortical alignment. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main question is whether this meso-scale mapping can be reused to compare checkpoints, data mixtures, architectures, or pretraining versus post-training states. Pay close attention to automatic annotation, dataset selection, and stability analysis, since these choices strongly affect the interpretation.

recommendation.zh: 从认知神经科学视角做LLM功能分区，失败模式的内部信号定位值得看§4的失败模式分析部分
recommendation.en: The cognitive neuroscience-inspired functional parcellation of LLMs is insightful; focus on §4 for failure mode localization.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Aligning Sentence Embeddings to Human Concepts via Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Dense sentence embeddings are fundamental to modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems but suffer from a lack of interpretability due to feature superposition. This opacity hinders the alignment of retrieval processes with human intent, as the entangled representations are difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we propose a method to disentangle the dense representations of sentence transformers (e.g., E5) into human-interpretable concepts using Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs)

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 中 dense sentence embedding 难解释、难控制的问题，尝试把句向量拆解为人类可理解的稀疏概念。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示分析与轻量控制方法。它不是预训练方法，但把 SAE 从 LLM activation 扩展到 sentence transformer embedding，对检索模型可解释性和可控 RAG 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 E5 等 sentence transformer 的 dense embedding 上训练 Top-k Sparse Autoencoder，将原本纠缠的向量表示分解为稀疏 latent features。作者进一步提出 activation steering，通过 clamp 特定 latent feature 来重排检索结果，而不重新训练 backbone。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 SAE 特征可对应语义、句法和语用类别，并能通过特征钳制让检索结果更符合用户约束。未在摘要中给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the opacity and limited controllability of dense sentence embeddings in RAG by decomposing them into human-interpretable sparse concepts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is representation analysis plus lightweight control. It is not a pretraining method, but it extends SAE-style interpretability from LLM activations to sentence-transformer embeddings, which is relevant to controllable retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains Top-k Sparse Autoencoders on dense embeddings from sentence transformers such as E5, aiming to disentangle superposed features into sparse latents. It then uses activation steering by clamping selected latent features to re-rank retrieval results without retraining the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that learned SAE features align with semantic, syntactic, and pragmatic categories, and that clamping features can steer retrieval toward user constraints. It does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or effect sizes in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: SAE 用在 embedding 上是自然外推；只看 feature 语义验证和 steering 实验，别把它当预训练 insight。
recommendation.en: Applying SAEs to embeddings is a natural extension; read the feature validation and steering tests, but do not overread it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: Conversable Complexity: Agentic LLM Collectives as Interpretable Substrates
paper.abstract: Complexity and interpretability rarely coincide: systems rich enough for complex behaviours to emerge are usually too opaque to question, while transparent ones are too simple for anything complex to emerge. A single large language model (LLM) is a static artefact, hardly exhibiting any of the emergent properties we associate with life. This changes through interaction: populations of LLMs display emergent dynamics absent from isolated models. Furthermore, LLMs can be endowed with persistent mem

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 LLM 群体能否作为人工生命研究的计算基底，同时保留一定可解释性。
summary.importance: 贡献是概念性框架和研究议程。它把 agentic LLM collective 放到复杂系统与可解释性之间的缝隙中讨论，价值在于提出问题，而不是给出训练方法或强实验证据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张把带有持久记忆、工具、共享技能和主动行动能力的 LLM agent 组成群体，通过自然语言交互产生集体动态。由于交互轨迹是文本，研究者可以检查通信记录，也可以询问 agent 对自身行为的解释。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示这是论述型工作，没有报告具体模型规模、agent 数量、环境设置、基线或量化结果。
summary.authors_note: IT University of Copenhagen、University of Oslo、Østfold University of Applied Sciences；Sebastian Risi 长期从事人工生命、开放式演化与生成系统研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether collectives of agentic LLMs can serve as a computational substrate for artificial-life research while remaining partially interpretable.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual framework and research agenda. It positions LLM agent collectives between complex adaptive systems and interpretability, but it does not provide a training method or strong empirical evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposal is to build populations of LLM agents equipped with persistent memory, tools, shared skills, and the ability to initiate actions. Their natural-language communication produces collective dynamics, while textual traces and self-reports offer an inspection interface.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents this as an argumentative or position paper. It does not report model sizes, number of agents, environment configurations, baselines, or quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: IT University of Copenhagen, University of Oslo, and Østfold University of Applied Sciences; Sebastian Risi is known for work on artificial life, open-ended evolution, and generative systems.

recommendation.zh: 概念稿，不给可复现实验；若关心多 agent 可解释性，只看它对“文本轨迹可审计”的论证。
recommendation.en: A position piece, not an empirical result; read only the argument that language traces make multi-agent dynamics auditable.

paper.title: Signed-Permutation Coordinate Transport for RMSNorm Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern LLM workflows move coordinate-indexed objects across checkpoints: steering vectors, sparse autoencoders, top-$k$ neuron sets, attribution lists, and merge alignments. This is only well posed after fixing the model's residual-stream gauge, which we show is architecture-dependent: LayerNorm residual charts have permutation gauge $S_d$ (up to a global sign flip), while RMSNorm charts with generic per-channel gain have signed-permutation gauge $B_d = S_d \ltimes \{\pm 1\}^d$. Permutation-only

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个常被忽略、但对坐标级分析和工具迁移很关键的问题：RMSNorm Transformer 的残差流坐标并不只有“置换”等价，而是存在“带符号置换” gauge。若只按 permutation 去对齐两个 checkpoint、两个 seed、或训练轨迹上的不同时刻，就会把很多本来等价的坐标当成不匹配，导致 steering vector、SAE feature、LoRA 更新、merge 对齐、甚至 AdamW optimizer state 的跨模型搬运失真。论文要解决的不是功能等价下的任意重参数化，而是“保留坐标身份”的离散对称群到底是什么，以及如何从激活中把这个正确的 gauge 恢复出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在两个层面。第一，它把 RMSNorm 模型里一个很基础的对称性问题讲清楚了：LayerNorm 残差流天然对应的是 S_d（外加全局符号），而 RMSNorm 在 generic per-channel gain 下对应的是 B_d = S_d ⋉ {±1}^d。这个结论直接影响所有依赖“第 i 个坐标/神经元/特征”可比性的工作。第二，它给出的是可操作的 transport 规则，而不是纯理论提醒。现在很多开源 LLM 都是 RMSNorm，若继续沿用 permutation-only 的 neuron matching 或 merge alignment，很多坐标级结论会系统性失真。对做 interpretability、checkpoint surgery、model merging、continual finetune 恢复、optimizer state 迁移的人，这篇文章提供了一个必要的校正。
summary.technical_approach: 技术上分三步。第一步是群论和参数化层面的刻画。作者证明：在保留原生坐标语义、显式保留 RMSNorm gain γ 的参数化下，RMSNorm 残差流允许的最大 coordinate-preserving 离散对称群是 hyperoctahedral group B_d，也就是任意坐标置换加每个坐标独立翻转符号。若把 γ 吸收到相邻线性层里，可以恢复更宽的正交自由度，但那已经改变了坐标系，不再适合讨论稀疏坐标身份、top-k neuron、SAE dictionary 这类对象。第二步是 gauge recovery。作者把传统 activation matching 的 Hungarian assignment 改成 sign-marginalized 版本：匹配代价不再用 signed correlation，而是用绝对相关 |<h_i, h'_j>|，匹配完成后再由相关符号恢复 sign。关键点在于，正确匹配在 RMSNorm 下可能是强负相关；若直接最大化 signed correlation，负号那一半真匹配会被系统性排斥。文中给了 decorrelated source coordinates 下的 sharp population failure mode：当一半真实符号为负时，即使 probe 无限多，signed-correlation matching 也会稳定失败。第三步是 transport via atlas。与其只做两个端点的全局匹配，作者沿训练轨迹保存局部 B_d gauge，并把这些局部高置信小步匹配复合起来，形成 transport-via-base。这样做利用了训练相邻 checkpoint 之间变化小、局部 margin 高的事实，比直接 endpoint matching 更容易恢复真实坐标对应。论文还把同样的 signed transport 规则扩展到 merge 和 AdamW state 恢复，强调 READ/WRITE 都要 obey B_d-covariance。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是大规模 benchmark，而是验证“少了 sign 会怎样坏”。几个结果比较关键。1）在记录了真实 gauge 的 LLM activation 上，signed-cost recovery 基本停留在约 50%，而 sign-marginalized recovery 可以到 100%，直接对应理论里的负相关失配。2）在一个 gauge-instrumented 的 Qwen2.5-1.5B finetuning 轨迹上，训练 1500 steps，并在 step 0 施加随机 B_d gauge 作为真值。端点直接匹配只能恢复 60.3% 坐标；transport-via-base 提升到 91.1%；若只是 endpoint-via-base 但不利用局部链式 transport，则只有 11.4%。这说明收益来自“很多局部小步高 margin 匹配”的复合，而不是简单拿 base 当参考。3）在 Llama-2-7B 的 gauge-scramble merge 测试里，signed alignment 把 peak-above-chord barrier 从 6.14 降到 0.00；精确 permutation-only alignment 反而有害。4）在独立训练的 10M RMSNorm Transformer 不同 seed 间，也观察到自然出现的 sign mismatch；signed alignment 相比 permutation-only，把 merge barrier 从 0.66 降到 0.42。5）对 optimizer state，signed transport 可以保持 resumed trajectory，而 permutation-only 即便从函数等价 checkpoint 出发也会训练发散或偏离。文中还给出一个理论 corollary：若对 RMSNorm 更新误用 permutation-only，对 learned weight update 引入的期望平方误差量级是 2||ΔW||_F^2，和更新本身能量同阶，这解释了为什么错误不是“小噪声”，而是结构性破坏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看引言和理论部分里对 LayerNorm 与 RMSNorm gauge 的区分，尤其是 Theorem 2.2 及相关 corollary，弄清“为什么 broader orthogonal freedom 不等于 coordinate-preserving symmetry”。第二，看 activation matching 那部分，重点理解为什么 cost 要从 signed correlation 改成 absolute correlation，以及 decorrelated population 例子里失败是如何必然发生的。第三，看训练轨迹 transport 的实验图表，尤其 Qwen2.5-1.5B 1500-step 那组结果，它最能说明 atlas 思路的实际价值。若时间有限，优先读 Introduction、理论结论、activation recovery 实验、transport-via-base 实验和 merge/optimizer state 两节，预计 30–45 分钟能抓住主线。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是这个 B_d-correct transport 能否成为 SAE/steering/LoRA 发布时的标准接口；二是对更一般的 normalization 或 fused parameterization，哪些对称性仍然保留坐标身份。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a precise but underappreciated issue in RMSNorm transformers: coordinate-indexed objects are not well-defined up to permutations alone. In RMSNorm residual streams, the native coordinate-preserving gauge is a signed permutation group, not just S_d. If one aligns checkpoints, seeds, or training-time states using permutation-only matching, many coordinates that are actually equivalent under a sign flip will be treated as mismatches. This breaks the transport of neuron-level artifacts such as steering vectors, SAE features, sparse neuron sets, LoRA updates, merge alignments, and even optimizer states.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented work is not that it improves perplexity, but that it fixes a foundational assumption behind a growing set of workflows around open-weight LLMs. Many modern models use RMSNorm, yet much of the alignment tooling inherited from LayerNorm-era work still assumes permutation symmetry only. The paper shows that this is symmetry-incomplete for RMSNorm and can induce errors on the same scale as the update being transported. For interpretability, checkpoint surgery, model merging, continual finetuning, and optimizer-state recovery, this is a necessary correction rather than a cosmetic refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper has three main technical components. First, it characterizes the native discrete gauge of transformer residual streams under coordinate-preserving parameterizations. For LayerNorm, the residual chart has permutation symmetry up to a global sign. For RMSNorm with generic per-channel gain, the correct group is the hyperoctahedral group B_d = S_d ⋉ {±1}^d, meaning arbitrary coordinate permutations plus independent sign flips. The paper also clarifies an important distinction: broader orthogonal freedom can be recovered only after absorbing the RMSNorm gain into adjacent weights, but that changes the coordinate system and no longer preserves sparse coordinate identity. Second, it proposes sign-marginalized activation matching. Instead of matching coordinates by signed correlation, it matches by absolute correlation |<h_i, h'_j>| and recovers the sign afterward from the matched pair. This is the right objective because the true counterpart of a coordinate may be maximally anti-correlated under a negative gauge sign. The authors prove a sharp population-level failure mode for signed-correlation matching in a decorrelated setting: if half of the true signs are negative, the correct entries become the most negative ones in their rows, so maximizing signed correlation systematically avoids them even with unlimited probes. Third, it introduces transport via a checkpoint atlas. Rather than matching only two endpoints, the method composes local B_d gauges saved along a training trajectory. This exploits the fact that nearby checkpoints differ only slightly, so local matches have higher margins and can be chained into a much more reliable global transport map.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to show how omission of signs fails in practice. On gauge-recorded LLM activations, signed-cost recovery stays near 50%, while sign-marginalized recovery reaches 100%, matching the theoretical obstruction.
