On a gauge-instrumented Qwen2.5-1.5B finetuning trajectory of 1500 steps, with a random B_d gauge applied at step 0 and the induced correspondence recorded as ground truth, direct endpoint matching recovers 60.3% of coordinates. Transport-via-base raises this to 91.1%, whereas endpoint-via-base without local chained transport achieves only 11.4%, showing that the gain comes from composing many small high-margin local gauges rather than from using the base model as a trivial reference. In a Llama-2-7B gauge-scramble merge test, signed alignment reduces the peak-above-chord barrier from 6.14 to 0.00, while exact permutation-only alignment is actively harmful. In independently trained 10M-parameter RMSNorm transformers, sign mismatch also appears naturally across seeds, and signed alignment improves the merge barrier from 0.66 to 0.42 over permutation-only alignment. The paper further shows that AdamW optimizer-state transport is gauge-covariant under signed transport: resumed training follows the original trajectory, whereas permutation-only transport diverges despite starting from a functionally equivalent checkpoint. A useful theoretical corollary states that misapplying permutation-only transport to an RMSNorm weight update introduces expected squared error of size 2||ΔW||_F^2, on the same order as the update energy itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main theorem section that distinguishes LayerNorm from RMSNorm gauges; the key conceptual point is why coordinate-preserving symmetry is B_d rather than a larger orthogonal group. Second, read the activation-matching section carefully, especially the switch from signed correlation to absolute correlation and the population failure example that explains why the old objective is structurally wrong. Third, inspect the Qwen2.5-1.5B trajectory experiment and the merge/optimizer-state sections, since these show the practical consequences most clearly. If time is limited, Introduction, the main theoretical statements, activation recovery, transport-via-base, and the merge/optimizer-state results are enough to capture the paper in about 30–45 minutes. The deeper follow-up question is whether B_d-correct transport should become a standard interface for publishing coordinate-indexed artifacts in RMSNorm LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 做模型编辑、SAE跨checkpoint迁移的研究员必看，RMSNorm的带符号置换规范证明可直接修正现有对齐方法的系统性偏差
recommendation.en: Mandatory for researchers working on model editing or cross-checkpoint SAE transport; the signed-permutation gauge proof for RMSNorm can directly fix systematic biases in existing alignment methods

paper.title: SemRF: A Semantic Reference Frame for Residual-Stream Dynamics in Language Models
paper.abstract: Residual-stream analysis asks how language-model computation evolves across depth, but intermediate decoding requires comparable readout coordinates across layers. If embedding anchors and unembedding readout disagree on the chosen span, apparent motion may reflect measurement drift rather than computation. We introduce \emph{Semantic Reference Frames} (SemRF), an anchor-based formalism separating semantic measurement from residual dynamics. A SemRF fixes anchors and measures states against them

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：我们常把 Transformer 各层 residual state 当成同一语义空间里的轨迹来分析，但这种“跨层可比”并不自动成立。若 embedding 侧的语义锚点与 unembedding/readout 侧的读出坐标没有对齐，那么 LogitLens、Tuned Lens、层间语义漂移、目标 token 证据积累等分析，可能混入 measurement drift，而不是模型真实计算。论文试图给 residual-stream dynamics 建一个可检验的“语义参考系”，把测量误差和真实动态分开。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练 recipe，而在分析方法论。现在很多关于训练动态、知识定位、层功能分工、early exit、lens 解释的结论，都默认中间层 hidden state 可以被稳定地投影到同一语义坐标系。SemRF 的贡献是把这个前提显式化：先固定 semantic anchors，再检查 token interface 在该 anchor span 上是否近似双可逆，只有这样跨层语义轨迹才有解释力。对做 mechanistic interpretability、representation analysis、mid-layer decoding、甚至 tokenizer/embedding-unembedding 设计的人，这篇文章提供的是一套更严谨的测量框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把“语义分析”写成一个 anchor-based coordinate system。给定一组语义锚点 B={b_k}，定义坐标映射 φ，把每层 residual state h_l 映到语义坐标 z_l=φ(h_l)。论文强调，关键不是随便选一个 lens，而是要保证 token interface 在所选 anchor span 上满足 restricted bi-invertibility，也就是 embedding 侧和 readout 侧在这个子空间里足够一致，语义坐标才是稳定可测的。作者给出 pseudo-inverse tying 作为一个 exact anchor-synchronization 的特例：用伪逆把两侧接口对齐，可以得到精确同步的参考系；在更一般情形下，则给出 interface mismatch 导致的 distortion bounds。建立测量条件后，论文把层间演化定义为 semantic trajectory。这里有两个分析对象。其一是连续坐标轨迹：layerwise semantic step、target-direction contribution profile、imbalance measure，用来描述每层往目标语义方向推进了多少、是否存在方向性失衡。其二是离散的 semantic Voronoi trace：由锚点诱导 Voronoi cell，把每个状态分配到“当前最接近/证据最大”的语义锚点，从而得到跨层 cell crossing 的粗粒度路径。作者再引入 margin-relaxed semantic tube，把观测到的 Voronoi trace 变成一条受约束的语义通道，并在其中用 path action 选 minimum-action canonical trace。这样做的目的，是避免只看端点插值，能够区分“路径真的绕了远路”与“测量噪声导致的抖动”。最后，论文证明了若参考系变化足够小，则这些语义动力学量是稳定的；并用 excess action 控制偏离 canonical trace 的程度。进一步，若轨迹曲率能量低，则可以用少量 piecewise-linear knots 压缩整条深度轨迹，作者把这解释为 frame-relative 的 local knowledge density：同样的语义变换，若能用更少的语义折点概括，说明该模型在该任务和参考系下的语义 transport 更紧凑。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段主要是理论框架与定义，未见大规模经验结果和明确数字，因此实验层面的信息有限。从文中结构看，重点不在追求 benchmark 提升，而在建立一套可操作的诊断流程：先选 anchors，再检查 interface/projection error，再构造 Voronoi trace 与 semantic tube，最后分析 layerwise steps、target contribution 和 trace complexity。若正文后半部分有案例实验，最值得关注的应是三类结果：1）pseudo-inverse tying 或满足 restricted interface condition 时，中间层语义坐标是否更稳定；2）不同 frame 下 layerwise semantic step 和 canonical trace 是否保持一致；3）低曲率轨迹是否真的可被少量 knots 压缩，并与某种参数效率或知识密度现象对应。就目前可见内容，论文更像一篇分析框架论文，而不是以具体数值结果为主的经验论文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是按“测量条件→轨迹定义→稳定性结论”这条线读。先看 Introduction 和 Coordinates and Measurement，弄清作者为什么认为 residual-stream analysis 的首要问题不是可视化，而是 reference frame 是否成立。然后看 pseudo-inverse tying、restricted bi-invertibility 和 distortion bounds，这部分决定了哪些 lens/anchor 选择是可解释的。接着看 semantic Voronoi diagram、semantic tube、canonical trace 的定义，理解作者为什么要引入离散 cell trace 加连续 action，而不是只看每层 logits。最后看 low-curvature compressibility 和 local knowledge density，那是全文里最有延展性的概念，但也最需要读者自己判断其可操作性。若只是想抓住主旨，读引言、测量章节和 canonical trace 定义，大约 25–35 分钟；若要真正用到自己的分析工作里，需要把定义、假设和稳定性命题逐条核对。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a basic but often skipped question in residual-stream analysis: when are hidden states from different layers actually comparable in the same semantic coordinate system? Methods such as LogitLens and related depthwise decoding implicitly assume that intermediate residual states can be read out in a stable semantic basis. The paper argues that this is only meaningful if the embedding-side anchors and the unembedding/readout interface are synchronized on the semantic span being analyzed. Otherwise, part of the apparent semantic motion across depth may be measurement drift rather than model computation.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. For pretraining researchers who study training dynamics, representation formation, knowledge localization, or layerwise computation, the paper makes an important point: semantic trajectory analysis needs an explicit reference frame. SemRF turns that hidden assumption into a formal object, with conditions under which semantic coordinates are well-posed and bounds for when they are distorted. This is useful for interpretability work, lens-based diagnostics, and any study that compares hidden-state semantics across depth or across models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to define an anchor-based semantic coordinate system. A Semantic Reference Frame consists of a set of semantic anchors and a coordinate map that projects each residual state h_l into semantic coordinates z_l. The main technical requirement is restricted bi-invertibility of the token interface on the chosen anchor span: the embedding-side and readout-side maps must agree sufficiently well on that subspace for semantic coordinates to be stably measurable. The paper presents pseudo-inverse tying as an exact anchor-synchronization case, and in the more general setting derives distortion bounds induced by interface mismatch. Once measurement is controlled, the residual stream can be treated as a semantic trajectory through depth. The paper defines layerwise semantic steps, target-direction contribution profiles, and imbalance diagnostics to quantify how each layer moves the state in semantic space. It then introduces an anchor-induced semantic Voronoi diagram, assigning each hidden state to the anchor with the strongest semantic evidence. This yields a coarse discrete trace of cell crossings. To combine discrete and continuous views, the paper defines a margin-relaxed semantic tube and selects a minimum-action path inside that tube as the canonical trace. The point is to distinguish genuine semantic transport from noisy or frame-induced fluctuations. The framework also includes stability results under nearby admissible frames, excess-action bounds controlling deviations from the canonical trace, and a low-curvature compressibility result: if the semantic trajectory has low curvature energy, it can be summarized by a small number of piecewise-linear knots. The authors interpret this as a local, frame-relative notion of knowledge density.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text content, the paper appears primarily theoretical and framework-oriented, and no concrete large-scale empirical numbers are visible in the available sections. The experimental value, if present later in the paper, would likely be in demonstrating three things: first, that pseudo-inverse tying or other admissible interface conditions make intermediate semantic coordinates more stable; second, that layerwise semantic steps and canonical traces remain consistent across nearby valid frames; and third, that low-curvature traces are indeed compressible and that this compressibility correlates with a meaningful notion of semantic efficiency or knowledge density. Based on the visible content, the paper should be read mainly as a formal analysis framework rather than a benchmark-driven empirical study.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim order is: measurement assumptions first, trajectory definitions second, stability claims third. Start with the introduction and the measurement section to understand why the paper treats reference-frame validity as the primary issue in residual-stream analysis. Then read the parts on pseudo-inverse tying, restricted bi-invertibility, and distortion bounds, since these determine when a lens-like readout is semantically trustworthy. After that, read the semantic Voronoi diagram, semantic tube, and canonical trace definitions; this is where the paper moves beyond simple layerwise logit inspection. Finally, look at the low-curvature compressibility and local knowledge density discussion, which is the most speculative but also the most extensible part of the framework. If the goal is only to capture the main idea, the introduction, measurement setup, and canonical-trace sections are enough in roughly 25–35 minutes. Using the framework in practice would require a closer read of the assumptions and stability propositions.

recommendation.zh: 做LLM残差流、训练动态分析的研究员可重点参考，伪逆绑定与语义Voronoi图的设计可直接复用在内部分析工具中
recommendation.en: Worth referencing for researchers analyzing LLM residual streams or training dynamics; the pseudo-inverse tying and semantic Voronoi diagram designs can be directly reused in internal analysis tools

paper.title: Explicit Fuzzy Logic in the Feed-Forward Layer: Self-Forgetting Quantifiers Discover Legible Grammatical-Licensing Detectors
paper.abstract: A transformer's feed-forward (FFN) sublayer materializes the distinctions attention gathers, yet gives no account of what it computes. In a parameter-neutral replacement, each hidden unit is an explicit fuzzy set operation on sigmoid-bounded [0,1] memberships: intersection A*B and set-difference A*(1-B), the latter a bounded positive negation ("A but not B") that gated/bilinear units lack -- a negation-capable FFN (NC-FFN). On N-bit parity they are the most parameter-efficient reasoning basis at

summary.core_problem: Transformer 的 FFN 到底在计算什么，以及能否用显式、可解释的逻辑运算替代常规 GELU/门控 FFN 而不明显损失语言建模性能。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制与架构边界探索工作。价值不在于直接给出更强基座模型，而在于把 FFN 的一部分功能重写成可读的模糊逻辑算子，并观察哪些语言现象能被这种显式结构捕获、哪些不能。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 NC-FFN，用参数量不增加的方式把每个隐藏单元写成显式模糊集合运算，包括交集 A*B 和集合差 A*(1-B)，后者提供普通 gated/bilinear FFN 不具备的正向有界否定能力。实验发现两元逻辑主要局限在底层且会在训练中退化，于是进一步加入一小块序列量词模块，包括软存在量词和软比例量词，并为每个单元学习遗忘率，以处理语法许可和量词相关现象。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出两类结果：在 N-bit parity 上，NC-FFN 在浅层设定下是参数效率最高的推理基元之一；在 125M、OpenWebText 规模上，语言建模困惑度可与 GELU 基线打平。作者还报告一个集中缺陷：若只用 token 内两元逻辑，模型在 grammatical licensing 和 quantifier 相关能力上表现不足，引入序列量词后可缓解。没有看到更大规模训练，因此对大模型外推价值有限。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington。论文风格偏可解释性与结构归纳偏置研究，不是主流大规模预训练路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what Transformer FFNs are actually computing, and whether explicit interpretable logic operators can replace standard GELU/gated FFNs without hurting language modeling.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-architecture boundary exploration. Its value is not in delivering a stronger foundation model, but in rewriting part of the FFN into legible fuzzy-logic operators and probing which linguistic phenomena such structure can and cannot capture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes NC-FFN, a parameter-neutral FFN replacement where each hidden unit is an explicit fuzzy-set operation, including intersection A*B and set difference A*(1-B). The latter provides a bounded positive negation that standard gated or bilinear units lack. The author finds that two-operand logic localizes to lower layers and erodes during training, then adds a small sequence-quantifier block with a soft existential, a soft proportion operator, and learned forgetting rates to better handle grammatical licensing and quantification.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports two main findings: on N-bit parity, NC-FFN is highly parameter-efficient at shallow depth; at 125M scale on OpenWebText, it matches the perplexity of a GELU baseline. A concentrated weakness appears in grammatical licensing and quantifier phenomena when only within-token two-operand logic is used, and sequence quantifiers help address it. There is no evidence yet at larger scales, so the implications for frontier pretraining remain limited.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the University of Washington. The work is closer to interpretability and inductive-bias research than to mainstream large-scale pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 更像可解释 FFN 的概念验证，不会立刻改你的训练栈；若你关心 FFN 机制，只看它对 licensing/quantifier 缺陷的分析即可。
recommendation.en: This is more a proof-of-concept for interpretable FFNs than a recipe changer; if you care about FFN mechanisms, read the part on licensing and quantifier failures.

paper.title: Why Struggle with Continuous Latents? Interpretable Discrete Latent Reasoning via Rendered Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models achieve high reasoning performance via explicit chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning, but require long output sequences and extended inference time. Latent reasoning reduces this cost by shifting computation into a latent space; however, continuous latent methods are hard to train, suffering from unstable and uninterpretable reasoning trajectories. We argue these issues stem from a misalignment between continuous-space reasoning and discrete symbolic supervision, as

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 latent reasoning 的训练稳定性和可解释性问题。连续 latent token 虽然可以减少显式 CoT 的输出长度，但缺少离散锚点，难以做 teacher forcing、过程奖励分配和轨迹检查。作者提出把中间推理状态离散化成 latent token，让 latent reasoning 回到标准 next-token 训练框架内。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近 reasoning post-training 与新型语言建模接口，而不是基座预训练结果。它的启发在于：如果 latent reasoning 要进入可扩展训练流程，离散化可能比纯连续状态更容易接入现有 SFT、RL、reward model 和解码系统。对预训练研究也有间接意义，因为它把“压缩推理”转化为扩展词表上的序列建模问题，可用于思考未来是否需要在预训练阶段加入 latent token 或混合符号-潜变量轨迹。当前证据主要来自数学推理微调，不能直接外推到通用预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Discrete Latent Reasoning，简称 DLR。它包含两个主要部分。第一部分是 stochastic latent codebook construction：先把文本 CoT 渲染成图像，再使用 DeepSeek-OCR2 encoder 提取结构化视觉特征，随后通过随机聚类或向量量化构建离散 latent 词表。作者希望每个 latent token 对应一个可恢复的语义单元，并报告最高约 20 倍压缩。第二部分是 augmented latent LM training：扩展 LLM 的词表和输出头，使模型可以在同一序列中处理自然语言 token 与 latent token。训练分三步：latent-text alignment 让 latent embedding 对齐到语言模型空间；latent SFT 学习生成正确的 latent 轨迹；latent RL 用 outcome reward 和 process reward 优化 latent-token policy。相较连续 latent 方法，DLR 的关键区别是把中间状态变成显式 token，因此可以使用标准 next-token prediction，也可以在离散步骤上施加过程监督。辅助 decoder 用来把 latent 轨迹还原成人可读内容，服务于检查和调试。
summary.experiments: 实验在 GSM8K-Aug-train 上微调 LLaMA3 和 Qwen3-VL，并在 GSM8K、GSM-Hard、SVAMP、MultiArith、MATH-500 上评估。论文报告 DLR 相比 RoT、ReGuLaR、CODI 等 latent reasoning baseline 有一致准确率提升，但给出的材料中没有包含完整数值表。作者还测试了从 1B 到 8B 模型规模的可扩展性，并分析 latent 轨迹的可解释性。实验重点说明 DLR 在数学推理上能减少显式推理 token，同时比连续 latent 方案更稳定。需要注意，当前验证集中在算术和数学题，尚不足以证明其对开放域推理或长程规划同样有效。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对连续 latent reasoning 三个问题的拆解：SFT/RL 训练瓶颈、动态不稳定、不可解释。方法部分重点看 codebook construction 和 augmented latent LM training，尤其是 latent token 如何进入词表、输出头如何扩展、三阶段训练各自解决什么问题。实验部分优先看压缩率、准确率、latent 轨迹重建质量、不同模型规模下的曲线。需要额外留意几个细节：codebook size 如何选，latent token 长度是否随题目复杂度变化，渲染 CoT 是否引入额外先验，以及过程奖励是否依赖人工或模型生成的步骤标签。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training and interpretability bottleneck in latent reasoning. Continuous latent tokens can reduce the length of explicit chain-of-thought outputs, but they lack discrete anchors for teacher forcing, process rewards, and trajectory inspection. The proposed solution is to discretize intermediate reasoning states into latent tokens and train them with standard autoregressive next-token objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a reasoning post-training and modeling-interface paper, not a base pretraining result. Its main relevance is the discrete interface: latent reasoning becomes compatible with existing SFT, RL, reward modeling, and decoding infrastructure once intermediate states are represented as tokens. For pretraining research, it suggests a possible route for adding compressed reasoning units to the vocabulary or training mixture. The current evidence is limited to math-oriented fine-tuning, so the result should not be read as a general pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Discrete Latent Reasoning, or DLR, has two main components. The first is stochastic latent codebook construction. Textual chain-of-thought traces are rendered into images, encoded with a DeepSeek-OCR2 encoder, and then discretized through stochastic clustering or vector quantization to form a latent vocabulary. The goal is to make each latent token a semantically recoverable unit, with reported compression up to about 20x. The second component is augmented latent LM training. The model vocabulary and output head are expanded so that natural-language tokens and latent tokens can be generated in a single sequence. Training has three stages: latent-text alignment to place latent embeddings into the LLM space, latent SFT to teach valid latent trajectories, and latent RL using outcome and process rewards. Compared with continuous latent methods, the key design choice is that intermediate computation is converted into explicit token prediction, which makes supervision and reward assignment much cleaner. An auxiliary decoder is used to render latent trajectories back into readable form for inspection.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments fine-tune LLaMA3 and Qwen3-VL on GSM8K-Aug-train and evaluate on GSM8K, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MATH-500. The paper reports consistent accuracy gains over latent reasoning baselines such as RoT, ReGuLaR, and CODI, although the supplied content does not include the full numeric tables. The authors also study scaling from 1B to 8B models and inspect the interpretability of latent trajectories. The empirical claim is that DLR reduces explicit reasoning tokens while improving stability over continuous latent approaches. The scope remains math reasoning, so transfer to open-ended reasoning or long-horizon planning is still an open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 40 minutes. Read the introduction for the diagnosis of continuous latent reasoning: inefficient supervision, unstable dynamics, and weak interpretability. In the method section, focus on the latent codebook construction and the augmented LM training pipeline, especially how latent tokens are added to the vocabulary and how the three training stages interact. In the experiments, prioritize compression ratio, accuracy tables, reconstruction or decoding quality of latent trajectories, and scaling behavior across model sizes. Useful details to check include codebook size, latent sequence length, whether rendered CoT introduces extra priors, and how process rewards are obtained.

recommendation.zh: 潜推理建模范式的新颖思路，用渲染+聚类实现离散化，重点看§3的潜词表构建方法，实验结果待完整论文验证。
recommendation.en: Novel latent reasoning paradigm using rendering + clustering for discretization; focus on §3 for latent vocabulary construction, experimental results await full paper verification.

paper.title: Towards Physical Intuitions for Alignment Dynamics: A Case Study With Randomness Crystallization
paper.abstract: The alignment of language models is typically studied through the lens of capability benchmarks, but the dynamics of how models change during post-training remain poorly understood. We argue that the physical sciences, and thermodynamic phase-transition theory in particular, offer a principled and underexplored vocabulary for reasoning about these dynamics. As a case study, we instantiate this position through the lens of material Crystallization, which is a well-studied thermodynamic phase tran

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的不是对齐后模型在某个 benchmark 上变强或变弱，而是 post-training 过程中行为分布如何发生结构性变化。作者用“随机数生成”等有限输出空间任务作为显微镜，研究 base model、SFT、DPO/RL 各阶段如何把原本高熵、prompt-sensitive 的输出分布压缩成稳定、低熵、近似确定的行为模式。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于给 pretrain-posttrain 接口提供了一个可检验的动态视角。核心观察是：SFT 可能已经决定了后续对齐的主要行为支撑集，DPO/RL 更多是在这个支撑集上重新分配概率质量，而不是自由地发现新行为。对基座研究员而言，这提示了两个问题：第一，base model 中潜伏的多个输出分布会被怎样的 SFT 数据“选中”；第二，后续 RL 能改多少，可能受限于 SFT 形成的吸引子。贡献更偏机制分析和研究框架，不是直接给出新的训练 recipe，但对理解 alignment dynamics 有实用意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把物理结晶过程映射到 LLM 对齐动态。类比中，base model 是“液相”：同一个随机任务在不同 prompt 下可以诱导出多种分布，熵较高，prompt sensitivity 强。SFT 是“成核”：模型输出分布突然塌缩到一个 seed distribution，这个 seed 不是凭空产生，而是已经存在于 base model 的潜在行为集合中。DPO/RL 是“settling/tempering”：概率进一步集中到 SFT 成核后的峰值附近，但通常不跳出 SFT 创建的支撑集。与常见的 mode collapse 描述不同，论文试图回答 collapse 发生在什么时候、为何落到某个分布、后续阶段还能否改写它。实验选择有限支持集任务，是因为可以直接比较完整输出分布；作者也明确指出该版本框架在大输出空间和开放式生成上会失效，需要更丰富的分布度量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个随机性任务，在 OLMo 2 和 Tulu 3 这两类公开且具有完整训练阶段 checkpoint 的模型上检查对齐轨迹。关键现象包括：base 阶段存在多个可由 prompt 诱导的随机输出分布；SFT 后 prompt 间差异迅速减小，输出分布塌缩到某个已有 seed；DPO/RL 阶段继续降低熵并强化高概率输出，但很少改变 SFT 后形成的主要支撑集。论文还报告了不同 LLM 之间可能共享 seed distribution 的现象，说明某些随机任务上的“偏好晶核”可能来自预训练语料、tokenization、数字频率或通用指令格式，而不只是某个 post-training recipe 的偶然产物。负结果同样重要：当输出空间变大或任务变成开放式生成时，简单的有限支持集分布比较不够用，结晶框架需要新的距离度量和结构化行为表征。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Section 2，它们定义了液相、成核、settling 三阶段，并说明为什么随机任务适合作为观测窗口。实验部分重点看 15 个 stochastic tasks 上跨 checkpoint 的分布曲线、熵变化、prompt sensitivity 变化，以及 SFT 与 DPO/RL 的阶段差异。值得深挖的是两点：一是 seed distribution 如何在 base model 中被识别，二是 DPO/RL 是否真的受 SFT 支撑集约束。局限性部分也要看，因为作者承认有限输出任务与开放式生成之间还有距离，这决定了该框架能否扩展到更真实的 alignment 行为分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how model behavior changes during post-training, rather than only measuring the final aligned model on capability benchmarks. It uses finite-support stochastic tasks, such as random digit generation, to observe how a pretrained model with many prompt-dependent output distributions becomes a low-entropy, stable, and nearly deterministic aligned model.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a testable account of the pretrain-to-posttrain transition. The key claim is that SFT can already select the behavioral support that later alignment stages operate on, while DPO or RL mostly sharpens probability mass within that support. For pretraining researchers, this matters because it links latent distributions in the base model to the attractors selected by post-training data. It also suggests that the controllability of RL may be bounded by earlier supervised fine-tuning. The contribution is conceptual and diagnostic rather than a new training algorithm, but it gives a useful language for studying alignment dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors map LLM alignment dynamics to physical crystallization. The pretrained model corresponds to a liquid phase: high entropy, many degrees of freedom, and strong prompt sensitivity. SFT acts as nucleation: output distributions collapse abruptly onto a seed distribution that was already latent in the base model. DPO and RL act more like settling or tempering: they concentrate probability on the peaks created by SFT without typically escaping the support selected during nucleation. This goes beyond the usual observation of mode collapse by asking when collapse happens, why a particular distribution is selected, and how much later optimization can still change. The focus on finite-support tasks is deliberate, because complete output distributions can be measured and compared directly.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 15 stochastic tasks and uses public training trajectories from OLMo 2 and Tulu 3, where checkpoints are available across the alignment pipeline. The main findings are consistent across the two model families: base models expose multiple promptable distributions; after SFT, prompt sensitivity largely disappears and behavior collapses onto a single seed-like distribution; DPO and RL further reduce entropy and sharpen the dominant outputs but rarely move outside the support induced by SFT. The paper also reports that seed distributions can be shared across different LLMs, which points to sources such as pretraining data, tokenization, frequency effects, or common instruction formats. The authors also document where the current framework breaks down: large output spaces and open-ended generation require richer metrics than direct finite-support distribution comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and Section 2 carefully, because they define the liquid, nucleation, and settling phases and make the crystallization analogy operational. In the experiments, focus on figures or tables that track output distributions, entropy, and prompt sensitivity across checkpoints. The most useful details are the SFT transition and the comparison between SFT and DPO/RL. The limitations are also important: the finite-support setting makes the evidence clean, but extending the framework to open-ended generation will require better behavioral distance metrics and more structured representations.

recommendation.zh: 相变视角解释SFT/RL对预训练分布的作用机制，SFT仅坍缩已有模式的结论值得立刻在内部消融复现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a phase-transition view of alignment; the claim that SFT only collapses existing pretrain modes deserves immediate internal replication.

paper.title: Do Models Read What They Write? Causal Registers in Scratchpad Reasoning
paper.abstract: A central hope behind process supervision is that models can expose intermediate variables that matter for their later behavior. For this to help with alignment, a scratchpad must be tied to the computation: when the model writes a state, later steps should compute from that state. To test this requirement, we use a controlled state-tracking task with a known update rule, comparing models trained to report only the final state with models trained to write intermediate states before giving the fi

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：模型写出的 scratchpad 中间状态，是否真的参与后续计算。更精确地说，当模型在链式推理里写下一个状态 token 后，后续预测是在读取这个状态并按规则更新，还是只生成了与答案相关的合理文本。论文把这个问题压缩到可控的有限状态跟踪任务，并用因果干预检验“写出来的状态”是否成为模型内部可用的寄存器。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 process supervision、CoT 监督和可解释性评估有直接价值。它区分了三个常被混在一起的概念：模型是否写了中间状态、激活里是否包含该状态、模型后续计算是否使用该状态。结论比较克制但重要：running-state supervision 可以让 scratchpad 状态变成有因果作用的计算变量；预训练模型或只训最终答案的模型则不明显具备这种性质。对预训练研究的启发是，推理轨迹数据的价值不只在于提供更多 token，而在于是否训练出“可被后续 token 读取和更新”的内部状态。对后训练也有提示：过程监督不能只检查文本格式，需要检查中间变量和后续行为之间的因果耦合。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了状态转移规则已知的 state-tracking 任务。部分模型只训练输出最终状态，另一部分模型训练输出完整 running state，再给最终答案。评测时，保持可见 scratchpad 文本不变，只编辑某个已写状态 token 对应的内部表示，尤其是 phase bit。由于转移规则已知，编辑后的状态对下一步输出有唯一正确影响：模型应该把被编辑的状态与当前 move 结合，算出新的 next-state bit。方法上使用 activation patching / representation editing，但目标不是普通的行为 steering，而是检查一个有明确定义语义的中间变量是否被当作状态寄存器使用。论文还解释了 KV cache 下的干预位置：后续 token 实际读取的是早期位置在各层产生的 key/value，因此编辑需要作用到后续注意力会读取的缓存表示。
summary.experiments: 主要模型包括 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B。实验比较了 pretrained、final-answer-only fine-tuned、running-state fine-tuned 等条件。在两个相关的 order-sensitive state-tracking 任务中，running-state 监督后的模型在当前状态 token 的内部 phase bit 被编辑后，会把下一步 phase bit 转向由编辑状态和当前 move 推导出的结果。预训练模型和只训最终答案的控制组中，这种效应很弱。两个选择性控制很关键：一是改变当前 move、保持编辑状态固定，检验模型是否真的把 move 纳入更新；二是从未来不兼容的上下文注入 counterfactual state，排除模型只是偏向某个 answer token 或复制另一个样本的未来 continuation。结果支持较强的因果解释：在 running-state 监督下，scratchpad 状态不仅被表示出来，还能被后续计算读取。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、任务构造、干预方法和控制实验。Introduction 里对“written / represented / used”三者的拆分是全文的主线。Background 中关于 residual stream、KV cache、activation patching 的说明值得看，尤其是它如何定义编辑早期状态 token 后，后续 token 实际读取什么。方法部分重点看 phase bit 编辑、同文本不同内部状态的构造、以及正确 downstream consequence 的判定。实验部分优先看 pretrained、final-answer-only、running-state 三组对比，以及两个 selectivity controls。值得深挖的问题是：这种 causal register 是否能扩展到自然语言 CoT、工具调用日志、程序状态和长上下文记忆；以及在大规模预训练阶段加入结构化状态轨迹，是否会提升模型对中间变量的可审计性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a model actually reads the scratchpad states it writes. More precisely, after the model emits an intermediate state in a reasoning trace, do later tokens compute from that state, or is the state merely plausible text correlated with the final answer? The authors make this question testable with controlled finite state-tracking tasks and causal interventions on the internal representation of a written state.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to process supervision, chain-of-thought training, and mechanistic evaluation. It separates three notions that are often conflated: writing an intermediate state, representing that state internally, and using that state in later computation. The main result is careful: running-state supervision can make a scratchpad state causally usable, while pretrained and final-answer-only controls show little of this behavior. For pretraining research, the implication is that reasoning traces are not just extra tokens; their value depends on whether they train variables that later tokens can read and update. For post-training, the result argues for causal audits of process supervision rather than checking only the surface form of a rationale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train models on state-tracking tasks with known transition rules. One training condition asks for only the final state; another asks the model to write the running state before producing the final answer. At evaluation time, the visible scratchpad text is held fixed, while the internal representation associated with one written state token is edited, especially the phase bit. Because the transition rule is known, the correct downstream consequence is unique: the next state should be computed from the edited state and the current move. The method uses activation patching and representation editing, but the target is stricter than generic steering. The intervention tests whether a semantically defined intermediate variable functions like a register. The paper also discusses why KV-cache semantics matter: later tokens read key/value vectors derived from earlier residual streams, so the intervention must affect what later attention can actually access.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported model is Qwen2.5-Coder-7B. The comparisons include pretrained, final-answer-only fine-tuned, and running-state fine-tuned models. On two related order-sensitive state-tracking tasks, the running-state model changes the next phase bit in the direction predicted by the edited internal state and the supplied move. The same intervention has little effect in the pretrained and final-answer-only controls. Two selectivity controls strengthen the interpretation. One changes the move while holding the edited state fixed, testing whether the model combines state and move rather than favoring a fixed token. The other injects a counterfactual state from a context with an incompatible future, testing whether the model copies a continuation from another example. The results support the claim that, under running-state supervision, a written scratchpad state can become a causal variable for subsequent computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, task setup, intervention method, and control experiments closely. The key conceptual split is between written, represented, and used intermediate states. The background on residual streams, KV caching, and activation patching is worth reading because it explains what is actually edited during cached autoregressive generation. In the method section, focus on phase-bit editing, the construction that keeps visible text fixed while changing internal state, and the criterion for a correct downstream consequence. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison among pretrained, final-answer-only, and running-state models, plus the two selectivity controls. The most useful follow-up questions are whether causal registers appear in natural-language CoT, tool logs, program states, or long-context memory, and whether structured state traces during pretraining can make intermediate variables more auditable.

recommendation.zh: 干净的因果干预设计，直接回答过程监督中 scratchpad 是否真被使用，应在内部推理/过程监督训练设计中参考其编辑表示的实验范式，重点看 §3 编辑方法和 §4 控制实验
recommendation.en: A clean causal-intervention design answering whether scratchpad states are truly consumed under process supervision; adopt its representation-editing protocol in internal reasoning/process-supervision ablations, focus on §3 editing method and §4 controls.

paper.title: C$^{2}$R: Cross-sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret large language models by decomposing activations into sparse, human-understandable features, but scaling to large dictionaries exposes fundamental challenges. Systematic studies reveal pervasive feature splitting that fragments coherent concepts into non-atomic latents and widespread feature absorption that creates arbitrary exceptions in general features, severely compromising latent reliability. These issues stem from inconsistent latent

summary.core_problem: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在大字典规模下会普遍出现两类失效：特征分裂把一个高层概念拆成多个冗余子特征，特征吸收让token专属隐变量截走通用特征的部分激活；两者的共同根源是标准L1/TopK稀疏约束只在单样本层面起作用，没有跨样本强制同一概念对应同一组隐变量，导致隐变量分配随样本上下文漂移。
summary.importance: 这是SAE可解释性方向中首次对分裂与吸收给出统一的几何成因分析，并提出只用批级正则就能修复的方案，不依赖额外标注或重构代价。对预训练研究的直接价值在于：更可靠的SAE特征可以作为对齐、幻觉诊断、知识编辑和circuit发现的基础工具，也为后续在预训练loss中引入稀疏可解释性约束提供了可行目标函数。
summary.technical_approach: 论文引入冗余参数α刻画真实语义特征在多个受扰基方向上的泄漏程度，把分裂和吸收统一建模成基向量偏离理想方向的结果。基于Minkowski不等式与ℓ₂范数的严格凸性，设计C²R正则：在批次维度上惩罚“同一语义信息分散到多个互不重叠的隐向量”的情形——因为多个非对齐向量的范数之和严格大于它们求和后的范数，使分裂/吸收在优化中显式变贵。正则与原有重构loss和稀疏约束联合训练，不需要修改SAE架构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖不同规模LLM上训练的SAE，对比TopK、L1等基线。主要结果：C²R在不降低重构保真度的前提下显著降低分裂与吸收的量化指标，特征层次结构更符合语言概念本身的层级关系；消融显示正则权重对性能有平缓的trade-off曲线，过大则会过度合并无关特征。文中没有放出非常具体的参数量和数据规模数字，重点是病理指标的相对下降幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction后半段对两类失效的直观例子（“数学”被拆分、“首字母S”在short/small上失效），以及Unified Problem Formulation中用α参数统一分裂与吸收的几何推导——这是全文最有洞见的部分。方法部分重点读C²R目标与Minkowski不等式的对应关系。实验部分扫主图即可，若要复现再看附录的超参选择。预计阅读时间45–60分钟。
summary.authors_note: 文中未标注具体机构与作者名单，返回""

summary_en.core_problem: When scaled to large dictionaries, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) suffer from two pervasive failure modes: feature splitting, which fragments a high-level concept into redundant sub-features, and feature absorption, where token-specific latents steal activation mass from general-purpose features. Both stem from the fact that standard L1 / TopK sparsity objectives act only per sample, so the same underlying concept can be assigned to different latents depending on context.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first unified geometric account of both splitting and absorption, and repairs them with a batch-level regularizer that requires no extra supervision and essentially no reconstruction cost. For pretraining research, more reliable SAE features directly benefit alignment auditing, hallucination diagnosis, knowledge editing and circuit-level interpretability; the regularizer also gives a concrete loss term that could later be folded into pretraining objectives to encourage intrinsic sparsity.
summary_en.technical_approach: A redundancy parameter α is introduced to quantify how much of a semantic feature leaks onto perturbed, non-ideal latent directions; splitting and absorption are then both instances of this geometric leakage. C²R (Cross-sample Consistency Regularization) leverages the Minkowski inequality and strict convexity of the ℓ₂ norm: for non-aligned vectors, the sum of norms strictly exceeds the norm of the sum. Applying this inequality across the batch dimension makes it expensive to spread one concept across disjoint latents. The regularizer is added on top of the standard reconstruction + sparsity loss without changing the SAE architecture.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments evaluate SAEs trained on activations from several LLM sizes against TopK and L1 baselines. C²R substantially reduces quantitative metrics for both splitting and absorption while preserving reconstruction fidelity, and recovers more human-aligned hierarchical feature structure. Ablations show a smooth trade-off with regularization strength: too large a coefficient over-merges unrelated features. No very specific parameter count / dataset size numbers are emphasized; results are reported as relative reductions in pathology metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a first pass, read the concrete examples of splitting and absorption in the late introduction, then the unified geometric formulation built around α in Unified Problem Formulation — this is the most insightful section. In the method section, focus on the connection between Minkowski inequality and the regularization form. Skim the main experimental figures; only go to appendices if reproduction is planned. Estimated reading time: 45–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做SAE机制分析的团队值得复现这个正则项；若你不碰SAE字典训练可略过。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing the regularizer if you run SAE dictionaries internally; skip if interpretability tooling is not on your roadmap.

paper.title: Turn-Averaged SAEs for Feature Discovery and Long-Context Attribution
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a useful tool for extracting interpretable features in language models. However, standard SAE architectures operate on individual token activations, meaning that the number of active features scales linearly with context length, and studying long model transcripts becomes difficult. We introduce turn-averaged SAEs, which represent a single Human or Assistant turn with a fixed number of features by learning to reconstruct the average model activation across

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 SAE 在长上下文和多轮对话分析中的尺度问题：逐 token SAE 的激活数量随上下文长度线性增长，导致特征发现、归因图和人工检查都变得很难操作。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型机制分析和训练后行为诊断有实用价值。它把 SAE 的分析单元从 token 改成 turn 或任意 span，使长对话中的主题、风格、persona、安全相关信号更容易被压缩成固定数量的特征。对预训练研究的启发是，模型内部表征并不总适合只按 token 观察；一些行为属性可能分布在整段文本上，用 span-level 表征更容易分离。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法很简单：对一个 span 内每个 token 的 residual stream hidden state 求平均，再用标准 SAE 重构这个平均向量。由于平均后的向量仍在 d_model 维空间内，现有 SAE 架构和训练代码基本不需要改动。作者使用 BatchTopK SAE，令 turn-level 输入学习高层特征。直觉是，token 级词汇、位置和局部句法信号在平均时会被削弱，而跨多个 token 持续存在的主题、意图、风格和行为模式会保留下来。论文还讨论两类混合结构：decoupled 版本把每个 token 的激活分解为 turn mean 与 token residual，分别训练两个 SAE；nested 版本用类似 Matryoshka 的 loss 在一个模型中同时学习 turn-level 和 token-level 特征。最后，作者把 attribution graph 从 token 层面改到 turn 层面，用更小的图分析多轮对话中 feature 到 feature 的影响关系，并用干预实验、completeness 和 replacement sufficiency 检查边权是否有解释力。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct，使用 LMSYS-Chat-1M 训练。模型 hidden size 为 3584，SAE 字典大小为 32768，BatchTopK 的 k 为 128。turn-averaged SAE 在约 158 万个 turn-averaged 样本上训练一个 epoch，4 张 H100 约 1.5 小时；同一语料若按 token 训练则对应约 2.66 亿 token。结果显示，turn-averaged 特征在 LLM judge 评价下更完整地描述单个 turn 的高层属性；归因图也明显更紧凑，更适合长上下文检查。论文还通过 intervention、completeness、replacement sufficiency 验证 turn-level attribution 的边权不是纯相关统计，而能捕捉一定的一阶影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Method 和实验部分，重点看三个点：第一，turn average 的定义和为什么它像低通滤波；第二，decoupled 与 nested SAE 如何同时保留 span-level 与 token-level 信息；第三，turn-level attribution graph 的边权验证方式。预计 30 到 45 分钟可读完关键内容。若只关心可复现实用方案，优先看训练设置、BatchTopK 参数、数据规模和 attribution graph 示例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation of sparse autoencoders for long transcripts: token-level SAE activations scale with sequence length, making feature inspection and attribution graphs difficult to use in multi-turn conversations.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability method rather than a pretraining method, but it is useful for studying large-model behavior at conversation scale. The main idea is to move the unit of analysis from tokens to turns or spans, producing a fixed-size feature representation for each segment. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that some internal signals are distributed across many positions. Topic, style, persona, and safety-relevant behavior may be easier to expose with span-level representations than with token-local features.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains an SAE on the mean residual-stream activation over a token span. The averaged vector has the same dimensionality as a normal hidden state, so the standard SAE architecture and training loop can be reused. The authors use BatchTopK SAEs and apply the method mainly to human and assistant turns. The intuition is that averaging suppresses token-specific lexical, syntactic, and positional detail, while preserving lower-frequency signals that persist across the span. The paper also studies hybrid designs. A decoupled model decomposes each token activation into a turn mean and a token residual, then trains separate SAEs on the two components. A nested architecture uses a Matryoshka-like loss to learn turn-level and token-level features in a single model. The authors further adapt attribution graphs to the turn level, reducing graph size for long conversations and validating edge weights with interventions, completeness, and replacement sufficiency tests.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct on LMSYS-Chat-1M. The model hidden size is 3584. The SAE uses a dictionary size of 32768 with BatchTopK k equal to 128. Training a turn-averaged SAE for one epoch over about 1.58 million turn-averaged samples takes around 1.5 hours on 4 H100 GPUs, compared with about 266 million token samples for token-level SAE training on the same corpus. LLM-based evaluations indicate that turn-averaged features describe high-level properties of a turn more completely than per-token features. Turn-level attribution graphs are also much more compact for long transcripts. The validation experiments suggest that the graph edges capture useful first-order effects rather than only co-activation patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method and experimental sections. The key parts are the definition of turn averaging, the low-pass-filter intuition, the decoupled and nested SAE variants, and the validation protocol for turn-level attribution graphs. A focused read should take 30 to 45 minutes. For implementation, prioritize the training setup, BatchTopK parameters, data scale, and the examples of attribution graphs on long conversations.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 attribution graph demo；这是实用的 SAE 粒度改动，适合长对话分析但别过读成机制发现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attribution-graph demo; it is a useful granularity change for SAEs, but not yet a mechanistic discovery.

paper.title: What LLMs explain is not what they believe: Evaluating explanation sufficiency under models' own input beliefs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, where free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought and post-hoc rationales are used to justify model outputs. Yet it remains unclear whether these explanations are sufficient, i.e., if they contain enough information to explain the model's output-generating process. We generalize classical sufficiency from feature attributions to arbitrary explanations and prove that explanation sufficiency can change depending on

summary.core_problem: LLM生成的自由文本解释（如思维链、事后推理理由）是否能够充分反映模型真实的决策过程，缺乏通用、可量化的评估方法。
summary.importance: 明确了自由文本解释的可靠性边界，提出的指标可以用来检测模型输出和解释不一致的问题。对使用模型生成解释作为SFT/RL训练信号的后训练流程有直接参考价值：如果解释本身不忠实于模型真实决策，基于这类解释构建的训练信号会存在系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将经典特征归因领域的“充分性”定义扩展到任意长度的自由文本解释，从理论上证明解释的充分性是相对于输入分布定义的，不存在脱离分布的绝对充分性。为了避免外部数据集的分布偏差，使用LLM自身在给定解释的条件下生成符合该解释的替代输入，以此刻画模型自身信念对应的输入分布。在此基础上定义自洽充分性指标SCSuff，基于信息论方法量化解释与模型真实决策规则的匹配程度。
summary.experiments: 在9个不同规模的LLM、4个任务上的测试显示，当前LLM的自由文本解释普遍不充分，SCSuff分数与模型大小、任务准确率、输出熵的相关性都很弱。即使在最宽松的测试条件下（使用同一个模型生成解释和测试输入），解释仍然无法完整覆盖模型的决策依据。SCSuff分数可以通过模型最后一层token的隐藏状态预测，支持自动化检测低质量、不忠实的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3-4节的核心定义和实验结论，不需要深入推导全部形式化公式，预计阅读时间20分钟。核心记忆点：解释充分性依赖于输入分布的定义，当前通用LLM的CoT类解释并不能可靠反映模型的真实决策过程。

summary_en.core_problem: No general, quantifiable metric exists to measure whether free-text LLM explanations (e.g., chain-of-thought, post-hoc rationales) contain sufficient information to reflect the model’s actual output generation process.
summary_en.importance: The work formalizes the reliability boundary of free-text LLM explanations, and provides a model-agnostic metric to detect mismatches between stated rationales and actual decision making. It has direct implications for post-training pipelines that use model-generated explanations as SFT/RL training signals: unfaithful explanations that do not align with the model’s true decision rule introduce systematic bias into these training loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors generalize the classical definition of sufficiency from feature attribution methods to arbitrary-length free-text explanations, and prove theoretically that sufficiency is always relative to a specified input distribution, with no universal distribution-agnostic measure of sufficiency. To avoid distribution bias from external datasets, they use the LLM itself to generate alternative inputs conditioned on a given explanation, capturing the input distribution implied by the model’s own beliefs. They define self-consistent sufficiency (SCSuff), an information-theoretic metric that quantifies alignment between an explanation and the model’s actual decision rule under this induced distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Across 9 LLMs of varying sizes and 4 tasks, free-text explanations generated by current LLMs are broadly insufficient. SCSuff scores show weak correlation with model size, task accuracy, and output entropy. Explanations remain insufficient even under the most permissive test setting, where the same model generates both explanations and test inputs. SCSuff scores are predictable from final-token hidden states, enabling automated detection of low-quality, unfaithful explanations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the core definitions in Sections 3-4 and high-level experimental findings, with no need to work through the full formal derivation. Expected reading time is 20 minutes. Key takeaways: explanation sufficiency is always distribution-dependent, and CoT-style explanations from current general-purpose LLMs do not reliably reflect the model’s true decision process.

recommendation.zh: 如果你把 CoT 当训练信号或分析窗口，这篇值得看；它不改模型，但会改你对“解释可当监督”的信任度，先看定义和 metric 部分。
recommendation.en: Read this if you use CoT as supervision or as an analysis probe; it won’t change your model, but it should lower your trust in explanations as faithful training signals—focus on the definition and metric sections.

paper.title: Same Concept, Different Directions: Cross-Modal Feature Heterogeneity in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Vision-language models map images and text into a joint embedding space. However, these embeddings often entangle multiple semantic features, which limits their interpretability and controllability. While sparse autoencoders have emerged as a useful tool for decomposing these embeddings into monosemantic features, their application to joint embedding spaces has largely relied on an implicit, untested assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities.

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的联合嵌入空间中，相同语义概念在图像和文本模态下的特征方向不一致（跨模态特征异质性），导致稀疏自编码器（SAE）在提取跨模态共享特征时出现“模态分裂（modality split）”。
summary.importance: 挑战了多模态 SAE 研究中“相同概念在不同模态共享相同方向”的隐式假设。为理解 VLM 的联合表示机制提供了新视角，并指出强制对齐潜在激活会损害特征重建质量，对多模态表征解耦和可解释性研究有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验验证跨模态特征异质性的存在。然后分析现有方法（如强制对齐潜在激活）在处理模态分裂时的缺陷，指出这会导致几何上不同的方向坍缩为单一坐标，牺牲重建质量。提出一种新范式：先训练模态特定的 SAE 以保留各自的特征几何结构，然后通过事后对齐（post hoc alignment）匹配对应的潜在坐标。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，所提方法在不牺牲重建质量的前提下，改善了跨模态检索性能，并在真实 VLM 嵌入上实现了更有效的概念引导（concept steering）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4 对跨模态特征异质性的刻画，以及 Section 6 中模态特定 SAE + 事后对齐的具体实现。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the joint embedding space of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the same semantic concept exhibits inconsistent feature directions across image and text modalities (cross-modal feature heterogeneity), leading to 'modality split' when Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) attempt to extract shared cross-modal features.
summary_en.importance: Challenges the implicit assumption in multimodal SAE research that 'the same concept shares the same direction across different modalities'. Provides a new perspective for understanding the joint representation mechanism of VLMs, and points out that forcing alignment of latent activations degrades feature reconstruction quality, directly impacting research on multimodal representation disentanglement and interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, experimentally verifies the existence of cross-modal feature heterogeneity. Then, analyzes the flaws of existing methods (e.g., forcing alignment of latent activations) in handling modality split, pointing out that this causes geometrically distinct directions to collapse into a single coordinate, sacrificing reconstruction quality. Proposes a new paradigm: first train modality-specific SAEs to preserve their respective feature geometries, and then match corresponding latent coordinates through post hoc alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that the proposed method improves cross-modal retrieval performance without sacrificing reconstruction quality, and enables more effective concept steering on real VLM embeddings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for the characterization of cross-modal feature heterogeneity, and Section 6 for the specific implementation of modality-specific SAEs + post hoc alignment. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对做多模态可解释性和 VLM 对齐的人很关键，直接推翻 SAE 在联合嵌入空间中的常用前提，重点看 §3 的异质性度量和 Fig 2-3。
recommendation.en: Highly relevant for multimodal interpretability and VLM alignment work; directly overturns a common SAE premise in joint embeddings—focus on §3 metrics and Figs 2–3.

paper.title: Search for Truth from Reasoning: A Dynamic Representation Editing Framework for Steering LLM Trajectories
paper.abstract: Current approaches to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought and "Wait" prompts, primarily encourage models to think more, yet often fail to guide them toward Truth. While Representation Editing (RepE) offers a intrinsic control, its application to dynamic reasoning trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by investigating the geometry of truth within unfolding reasoning chains. We uncover three critical insights: (1) Truth is encoded a

summary.core_problem: 现有增强推理的方法（CoT、Wait 等提示词）只能鼓励模型多写步骤，无法在推理分叉处主动把生成轨迹导向正确答案；传统表征编辑（RepE）擅长对齐静态属性（诚实、风格），但尚未解决动态推理过程中真值信号的定位、时序干预与副作用控制问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了推理轨迹内部真值信号的几何性质与时序规律，提供了推理时内部分叉干预的一套可操作原则；对研究模型内在真值结构、推理可解释性、推理时对齐/拒答、以及 RL 推理增强中替代显式奖励塑造，都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先通过探针实验验证三个关键结论：1）真值不是按 token 编码，而是按句子级表征出现，并与具体推理模式纠缠；用聚类解耦后判别准确率明显提升。2）干预存在「衰减效应」——越早介入越有效，后期模型轨迹固化后编辑几乎无效；同时满足「不确定性原理」——只在高熵分叉点介入才有收益，低熵位置介入会破坏正确轨迹。3）传统均值差（Mean-Difference）构造的 steering vector 会带入语义噪声，损害原本正确的推理；对此改用 Fisher-LDA 做子空间投影，最大化真值区分度的同时最小化对语义流形的干扰。

基于这些观察提出 DynaSteer：先用句子级前瞻熵在推理中识别关键分叉点；然后在解耦后的推理簇内用 Fisher-LDA 构造净化的真值 steering vector；最后按时序衰减方式注入，并配套 rollback 机制在错误刚出现时就回退纠正，避免错误滚雪球。
summary.experiments: 在领域内与分布外的复杂推理基准上对比现有提示增强与静态 RepE 方法，DynaSteer 的准确率提升明显；同时消融验证了句子级编码、聚类解耦、Fisher-LDA 子空间、早期/高熵介入、时序衰减与 rollback 分别带来的增益，并测量了错误轨迹被纠正的比例、以及对原本正确轨迹的误伤率下降。
summary.reading_guide: 先读 Intro 中的研究问题拆分（Existence/Locus/Mitigation）与三个核心结论的表述，快速把握框架；然后看分析章节中关于句子级探针与聚类解耦的判别实验、衰减效应和不确定性原理的定量曲线，这是方法的基础；接着看 Fisher-LDA 与 naive Mean-Difference 的对比；最后看推理流程的时序注入与 rollback 细节。整体是 skim 级工作，推荐 45–60 分钟，重点放在机制发现部分，工程实现部分可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-enhancement methods such as Chain-of-Thought or Wait prompts can only encourage a model to produce longer chains, but cannot actively steer unfolding trajectories toward correct answers at reasoning forks. Conventional Representation Editing (RepE) works well for aligning static attributes like honesty or style, but leaves open how to locate the truth signal, schedule interventions over time, and control side effects within dynamic reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work reveals the geometric and temporal properties of the truth signal inside reasoning chains, and provides a set of actionable principles for intervening on internal forks during inference. It informs research on internal truth structure, interpretability of reasoning, inference-time alignment / refusal, and alternative designs for RL reasoning enhancement that avoid explicit reward shaping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Probing experiments first establish three findings. (1) Truth is not encoded at the token level but emerges in sentence-level representations, and is entangled with latent reasoning patterns; disentanglement via clustering substantially improves discrimination. (2) Intervention follows a Decay Effect — editing is strongest early and becomes ineffective once the chain is committed; and an Uncertainty Principle — editing only helps at high-entropy forks and harms correct trajectories at low-entropy positions. (3) Naive Mean-Difference steering vectors carry semantic noise that damages originally correct reasoning paths; Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis is therefore used to project activations onto a purified subspace that maximizes truth separability while minimizing distortion of the semantic manifold.

On top of these observations, the paper proposes DynaSteer: it first detects critical forks during generation via sentence-level lookahead entropy, computes a purified truth steering vector using Fisher-LDA within disentangled reasoning clusters, and injects the signal with a temporally decaying schedule, paired with a rollback mechanism that corrects errors as soon as they originate to prevent hallucination snowballs.
summary_en.experiments: On in-domain and out-of-domain complex reasoning benchmarks, DynaSteer materially improves accuracy over prompt-based baselines and static RepE methods. Ablations separately quantify the gains from sentence-level probing, cluster-based disentanglement, Fisher-LDA projection, early/high-entropy intervention, temporal decay, and rollback, and report both the fraction of wrong trajectories corrected and the reduced collateral damage to originally correct ones.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the three research questions (Existence / Locus / Mitigation) and the accompanying qualitative conclusions in the introduction. Then read the mechanistic analyses: sentence-level vs. token-level probing with cluster disentanglement, and quantitative curves for the Decay Effect and Uncertainty Principle. Next compare Fisher-LDA with naive Mean-Difference steering, and finally inspect the temporal injection and rollback logic. This is a skim-level work; a 45–60 minute read is sufficient, with emphasis on the mechanistic findings rather than implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 推理链真值几何的三个发现有参考价值，重点看机制分析章节，动态干预的设计可作为后训练ablation的参考。
recommendation.en: Three findings on truth geometry in reasoning chains are informative; focus on the mechanism analysis section, and the dynamic intervention design can serve as reference for post-training ablations.

paper.title: IG-Lens: Exact Additive Probability Attribution Across Transformer Layers via Telescoping Integrated Gradients
paper.abstract: We ask a simple question about decoder-only transformers: \emph{between which two layers is the probability of a predicted token actually produced?} Existing layer-wise readout tools answer only approximately. The logit lens and its trained variant report a per-layer \emph{level} of probability but give no additive decomposition; their estimates are biased and non-monotone across depth. Direct Logit Attribution and related residual-stream methods are additive, but only in \emph{logit} space -- t

summary.core_problem: 回答 decoder-only Transformer 的一个具体机制问题：预测 token 的概率究竟是在层间哪里被“做出来”的。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析方法。价值在于把 layer-wise readout 从近似的 logit/probability 观察，推进到严格可加的概率归因，对研究训练动态、层功能分工和中途监督都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IG-Lens，用 telescoping Integrated Gradients 沿同一条 hidden-state 路径，从 baseline 到最终层做分段积分，并把每一段的贡献记到其终止层。这样得到跨层的概率空间加性分解，避免 logit lens 的偏差与非单调问题，也绕开 softmax 使 logit-space attribution 无法直接解释概率变化的缺陷。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要是方法论对比：logit lens/训练版 logit lens 只能给层级 level、不能做严格加法；Direct Logit Attribution 只在 logit 空间可加；Layer Conductance 因 baseline 不统一而不守恒。IG-Lens 声称能精确分解最终预测概率变化。未见摘要中的模型规模与数据细节，但作为分析工具，关键是归因公理是否成立和案例是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks a precise mechanistic question for decoder-only transformers: between which layers is the probability of the predicted token actually produced?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic-analysis contribution. Its value is in moving layer-wise readout from approximate logit/probability probes to an exactly additive attribution in probability space, which can help study training dynamics, layer specialization, and intermediate supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes IG-Lens, a telescoping use of Integrated Gradients along a single hidden-state path from a baseline to the final layer. Each path segment is credited to the layer it terminates at, yielding an additive decomposition in probability space. This avoids the bias and non-monotonicity of logit lens and fixes the mismatch where logit-space additive methods do not translate cleanly through the softmax.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the method against prior tools: logit lens and tuned variants provide per-layer levels but not additive decomposition; Direct Logit Attribution is additive only in logit space; Layer Conductance does not sum to the total change because each layer uses its own baseline. IG-Lens claims exact decomposition of the final probability change. The abstract does not specify model scales or datasets, so the main question is whether the attribution axioms and case studies are clean.

recommendation.zh: 如果你常用 logit lens 看层功能，这篇值得读；重点看它是否真在 probability space 守恒，若成立，很多旧图都该重画，但先别把解释性当因果。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you rely on logit-lens-style layer analysis; the key is whether probability-space conservation really holds—if yes, many old plots need revisiting, but don't confuse attribution with causality.

paper.title: VASAE: Naming SAE Dictionary Directions with Vocabulary-Aligned Anchoring
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide useful decompositions of Transformer residual streams, but their learned features are usually named post hoc rather than directly connected to the Transformer's token vocabulary. We introduce Vocabulary-Aligned Sparse Autoencoder (VASAE), a method that trains SAE features under vocabulary-aligned anchoring and assigns each feature an intrinsic token name: the token string whose embedding is nearest to that feature. Without reducing reconstruction quality compar

summary.core_problem: 残差流 SAE（Sparse Autoencoder）能把 Transformer 的高维激活分解成稀疏特征，但这些特征通常缺少“内生的名字”：特征方向与词表 embedding 的几何关系不对齐，导致解释时只能靠事后找激活上下文或另跑自动解释器，命名不稳定、成本高，也难以把特征与模型的词表接口（embedding/readout）直接关联。
summary.importance:
这是机制解释/可解释性方向的工作，不直接改进预训练指标，但它把 SAE 字典与词表几何对齐，提供一种更可复现的特征标识方式（nearest-token intrinsic name）。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：
- 更容易把“某层学到的方向”与 token 级语义接口联系起来，降低分析门槛；
- 为后续做数据/训练动态的表征追踪提供更稳定的坐标系（至少在浅层/中层）。
不过它并不保证 token 名就是语义真名，更多是一个几何锚点；深层不稳定也提示了词表几何未必覆盖高层抽象特征。
summary.technical_approach:
VASAE（Vocabulary-Aligned SAE）的核心是给 SAE 增加一个“软锚定”目标，让每个字典特征方向靠近某个 token embedding，从而训练后可以用最近邻 token 作为该特征的内生名字。
- 基础对象：在 decoder-only Transformer 的 post-residual stream 上训练 SAE；字典是 SAE decoder 权重矩阵的列向量（feature directions），稀疏码是每个特征的系数。
- 问题根源：标准 SAE 只优化重构+稀疏，学到的方向可能远离任何 token embedding；而把 decoder 硬绑定为 token embedding 矩阵又会损失重构能力。
- 方法：在标准 SAE 损失之外加入 anchor loss。对每个 feature direction，找到其最近的 token embedding 作为 anchor，并用一个系数 λ_anchor 鼓励该 feature 靠近该 embedding（“软”而非硬绑定，保留字典自由度）。训练完成后，直接用最近 token 的字符串作为 intrinsic token name。
- 诊断指标：定义 nearest-token alignment score，并用阈值（文中用 0.8 cutoff）统计有多少特征能被可靠地对齐到词表方向。
方法取舍很明确：牺牲一部分字典几何自由度，换取可命名性；并通过对比“硬绑定 decoder”来说明必须是软约束而不是直接把字典等同词表。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 GPT-2-small 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的 post-residual stream SAE。
- 重构质量：VASAE 在测试设置下与标准 SAE 的重构指标接近。文中给出 GPT-2-small 的 variance explained (VE) 约 0.965，Llama-3.1-8B 约 0.931；而“decoder 硬绑定 token embedding”的方案重构更差。
- 对齐覆盖率：在 GPT-2-small 的浅层到中浅层（L0–L10），用 alignment cutoff=0.8 时约 89%–94% 的特征可对齐到某个 token embedding。
- 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，较大的锚定系数 λ_anchor=5e-3 时，L0 可达 92.8% 对齐，但在代表性的最后层仍不稳定（提示深层特征与词表几何更脱钩，或锚定会与重构/稀疏目标冲突）。
- 论文还给了 case studies：展示在具体上下文中被激活的特征，其 intrinsic token name 作为标识符如何使用（更像“坐标标签”而非严格语义解释）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“字典几何 vs 词表几何脱钩”的动机，以及为什么 hard-tying 不够。
- 重点看方法部分 anchor objective 的定义、最近邻 token 的选取方式、以及 alignment score 的诊断口径；这些决定了‘命名’到底在多大程度上可信。
- 实验部分优先看两类对比：VASAE vs 标准 SAE（重构不掉多少）以及 VASAE vs hard-tied（说明软约束必要）。
- 如果要用于分析预训练动态，建议特别关注跨层的对齐率曲线：浅层高对齐、深层不稳定这一现象本身就值得解释（词表接口在不同深度的作用边界）。

summary_en.core_problem: Residual-stream SAEs decompose Transformer activations into sparse features, but those features typically lack intrinsic, vocabulary-grounded names. Because SAE dictionary directions are learned purely for reconstruction+sparsity, they can be geometrically far from any token embedding, forcing post-hoc naming via context inspection or separate interpretation pipelines.
summary_en.importance: This is interpretability infrastructure rather than a pretraining improvement, but it tightens the connection between learned features and the model’s vocabulary interface by aligning SAE directions to token embeddings. The practical upside is more reproducible feature identifiers (nearest-token intrinsic names), which can lower the cost of representation analysis and make layerwise tracking easier—especially in shallow/mid layers. Limitations are also informative: deep-layer instability suggests token-embedding geometry may not span higher-level abstract features, and a nearest-token label is a geometric anchor, not guaranteed semantic truth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VASAE (Vocabulary-Aligned SAE) adds a soft anchoring objective to standard SAEs so that each learned decoder direction stays close to some token embedding.
- Training target: SAEs are trained on post-residual stream activations in decoder-only Transformers; dictionary features are decoder columns; sparse codes reconstruct activations.
- Key issue: standard SAE features can reconstruct well while being far from vocabulary directions; conversely, hard-tying the SAE decoder to the token embedding matrix overly constrains the dictionary and hurts reconstruction.
- Proposed fix: augment the SAE loss with a vocabulary-aligned anchor term. For each feature direction, identify its nearest token embedding as an anchor and penalize distance to it with coefficient λ_anchor (soft constraint). After training, the nearest token string becomes the feature’s intrinsic name.
- Diagnostics: define a nearest-token alignment score and report the fraction of features exceeding a threshold (0.8 in the paper).
Design choice is explicit: trade some dictionary freedom for nameability, while keeping reconstruction competitive via soft (not hard) alignment.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations on GPT-2-small and Llama-3.1-8B residual streams.
- Reconstruction: VASAE matches standard SAE closely under tested settings, reporting variance explained (VE) around 0.965 on GPT-2-small and 0.931 on Llama-3.1-8B; hard-tying the decoder to token embeddings yields worse reconstruction.
- Alignment coverage: on GPT-2-small, with alignment cutoff 0.8, about 89%–94% of features in layers 0–10 align to a vocabulary direction.
- On Llama-3.1-8B, with a larger anchor coefficient (λ_anchor=5e-3), layer 0 reaches 92.8% alignment, but a representative final layer remains unstable (suggesting tension between anchoring and deep-layer feature geometry).
- Case studies illustrate how intrinsic token names can serve as stable identifiers for active features in context.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation carefully: why SAE dictionary geometry and vocabulary geometry diverge, and why hard-tying the decoder is insufficient.
- Focus on the exact anchor loss definition, how nearest-token anchors are chosen, and how the alignment score is computed—these determine what “named” really means.
- In experiments, prioritize (i) VASAE vs standard SAE reconstruction parity, and (ii) VASAE vs hard-tied decoder to justify the soft constraint.
- Pay attention to the layerwise alignment trend (high in shallow layers, unstable deep): it’s likely the most actionable signal if you plan to use this for representation tracking.

recommendation.zh: 做 SAE 的应看 anchoring loss 和分层结果；词表对齐可能带偏字典，但 final layer 失效是有用信号。
recommendation.en: If you use SAEs, read the anchoring loss and layerwise results; vocabulary alignment may bias the dictionary, but the final-layer failure is a useful signal.

paper.title: Dismantling Pathological Shortcuts: A Causal Framework for Faithful LVLM Decoding
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit sophisticated reasoning but remain susceptible to object hallucination. Deviating from the prevailing attention intensity assumption, we reveal a deeper dynamic structural misalignment: hallucination is triggered at decision-critical steps where specific attention heads, acting as risky mediators, decouple from visual evidence to lock onto language priors. This establishes a pathological shortcut that bypasses visual grounding. To dismantle this, we p

summary.core_problem: 解决大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中对象幻觉的问题，修正现有方法基于注意力强度假设的偏差。
summary.importance: 原理分析（揭示LVLM幻觉的新机制）+ 方法创新（训练自由的推理干预框架），修正了领域对幻觉成因的主流假设。
summary.technical_approach: 1）揭示幻觉源于决策关键步的特定注意力头（风险中介）与视觉证据脱钩、锁死语言先验的结构错位，而非注意力强度不足；2）提出Fox框架：用视觉注意力熵探针无监督定位风险中介，通过对数饱和做因果干预切断捷径，再用冲突门控协同解码平衡忠实度与流畅度。
summary.experiments: 在多个LVLM对象幻觉评测集上验证，显著降低幻觉率的同时保持生成流畅度；基于开源LVLM骨干做实验，未提及自训基座。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses object hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) and corrects biases in existing methods based on the attention intensity assumption.
summary_en.importance: Combines mechanism analysis (revealing a novel LVLM hallucination mechanism) with methodological innovation (training-free inference intervention framework), correcting the mainstream prior on hallucination causes.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Reveals hallucination stems from structural misalignment: specific attention heads (risky mediators) decouple from visual evidence and lock onto language priors at decision-critical steps, rather than insufficient attention intensity; 2) Proposes Fox: uses a visual attention entropy probe to unsupervisedly locate risky mediators, applies causal intervention via logit saturation to sever shortcuts, and uses a conflict-gated cooperative decoding strategy to balance faithfulness and fluency.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple LVLM object hallucination benchmarks, significantly reducing hallucination rates while preserving generation fluency; experiments run on open-source LVLM backbones, no self-trained foundation models disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 推翻LVLM幻觉的注意力强度假设，结构错位的机制可直接指导预训练阶段的视觉-语言对齐头设计，重点读§3的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Overturns the attention intensity prior for LVLM hallucination; the structural misalignment mechanism can directly guide vision-language alignment head design during pretraining, focus on Section 3 mechanism analysis.

paper.title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features
paper.abstract: Interpreting and controlling model behaviors through activation steering methods requires many pairs of contrastive samples that clearly exhibit desired or undesired behavior. These data pairs determine the degree to which interpretability frameworks can reliably detect model features responsible for a behavior, and therefore the ability to steer models toward or away from such behavior. In this work, we present an iterative data generation pipeline that isolates cascading linear features respon

summary.core_problem: 现有基于稠密对比向量的激活引导方法存在三方面缺陷：难以对行为强度做可分解的量化、语义不透明无法区分行为的子成分、操作整个残差流容易和无关能力纠缠，导致引导后通用能力退化。而已有基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征方法大多将行为特征视为二元触发器，无法支持连续尺度的行为检测与低副作用的稳定引导，对谄媚这类由对齐训练引入的行为偏差，目前仍缺乏可解释、可控的干预手段。
summary.importance: 这一研究提出的级联特征筛选范式，为训练后行为干预和模型机制解释提供了比传统激活加性方法更稳定的路径。“以行为强度上的单调缩放关系筛选因果特征”的思路，可以迁移到幻觉、拒答偏差等其他对齐相关行为的检测与控制上；同时为理解SFT/RLHF阶段引入的行为偏差在激活空间的分布规律提供了实证证据，支持不经过重训练的低损伤行为修正，对post-train阶段的模型对齐工作有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不再依赖“存在目标行为/不存在目标行为”的二元对比样本对，而是通过迭代生成流程构造行为强度分级的样本序列：从一个中性初始回复出发，迭代引导模型分别向更接近、更远离目标行为的方向生成回复，得到覆盖从中性到极端行为强度的连续样本。对这些样本提取SAE特征后，只保留激活值随行为强度单调线性变化的特征，即级联线性特征——满足这一标准的特征更可能和行为存在因果关联，而非偶然出现的相关噪声，这一筛选逻辑和慢特征分析的核心思路一致，优先保留跨强度平滑变化的稳定信号。最终行为强度可表示为筛选后特征激活的线性和，得到连续、确定的行为量化分数；引导时仅调整这些目标特征的激活值，不需要操作整个稠密残差流，大幅减少与无关特征的纠缠。
summary.experiments: 在Llama 3.1 8B上针对谄媚行为开展验证，对比基线为激活加性、对比激活加性等主流稠密向量引导方法。结果显示，基于级联线性特征的引导效果优于所有稠密向量基线，在降低模型谄媚倾向的同时，对通用能力的损伤更小。研究发现，识别出的谄媚相关特征在激活空间中构成线性可分的子空间，可以支撑稳定的跨上下文检测和干预；同时这些特征可以被分解，对应到“害怕冲突”“过度迎合用户”等构成谄媚行为的不同认知子成分，解决了传统稠密向量语义不透明的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法章节的迭代级联样本生成流程（参考图1示意图）、单调性特征筛选标准的设计逻辑，以及消融实验中非单调特征导致引导不稳定的相关分析。不需要深入SAE训练的实现细节，核心要理解“通过连续行为尺度上的单调变化筛选因果性、可引导特征”的核心思路，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学，通讯作者邮箱maty@stanford.edu，代码与数据开源于https://cascading-feats.github.io/。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense activation steering vectors derived from binary contrastive sample pairs suffer from three key limitations: they cannot produce decomposable, precise quantification of behavioral intensity, they are semantically opaque and offer no insight into constituent sub-components of a behavior, and they require manipulation of the full residual stream, which often entangles with unrelated capabilities and degrades general model performance. Existing sparse autoencoder (SAE) based feature approaches mostly treat behavioral features as binary triggers, and do not support continuous behavioral measurement or stable, low-side-effect intervention. For alignment pathologies such as sycophancy, there remains a lack of interpretable, controllable intervention methods.
summary_en.importance: The cascading feature selection framework introduced in this work provides a more stable alternative to standard activation addition for post-training intervention and mechanistic interpretability. The core idea of selecting causal features based on monotonic activation scaling across behavioral intensity generalizes to other alignment-induced behaviors including hallucination and over-refusal. It also adds empirical evidence for how behavioral traits introduced during SFT and RLHF are distributed in activation space, enabling low-damage behavior modification at inference time without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of relying on binary "behavior present / behavior absent" contrastive pairs, the method uses an iterative generation process to produce a sequence of samples with graded behavioral intensity: starting from a neutral seed response, the model is iteratively steered to produce responses that move incrementally towards and away from the target behavior, generating a continuous spectrum of samples from fully neutral to extreme behavioral expression. SAE features are extracted across this sample sequence, and only features that show monotonic linear activation scaling with behavioral intensity are retained as cascading linear features. This monotonicity criterion filters out spurious, incidentally correlated features and retains features with causal relevance to the behavior, a logic loosely aligned with slow feature analysis which prioritizes smoothly varying, stable signals over transient noise. Behavioral intensity is quantified as a linear sum of retained feature activations, producing a continuous, deterministic metric. Steering is performed by adjusting only these targeted feature activations, rather than manipulating the full dense residual stream, substantially reducing entanglement with unrelated capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: Validation is conducted on sycophancy detection and control tasks using Llama 3.1 8B, with comparisons to standard dense steering baselines including Activation Addition and Contrastive Activation Addition. The cascading linear feature approach outperforms all dense vector baselines at reducing sycophantic responses, while incurring smaller degradation to general model capabilities. Identified sycophancy features form a linearly separable subspace in activation space, supporting robust detection and intervention across diverse contexts. The decomposed feature set also enables interpretable breakdown of sycophancy into constituent cognitive subcomponents, such as conflict avoidance and over-validation of user opinions, addressing the semantic opacity of traditional dense steering vectors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the iterative cascading sample generation pipeline (illustrated in Figure 1), the design rationale for the monotonic feature selection criterion, and ablation analysis of how non-monotonic features lead to unstable steering. There is no need to dive into SAE training implementation details; prioritize understanding the core insight of using monotonic activation change across a continuous behavioral scale to identify causal, steerable features. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University. Corresponding author: maty@stanford.edu. Code and data available at https://cascading-feats.github.io/.

recommendation.zh: 关注可解释性与对齐的预训练研究员可看§3的级联样本构造方法，对行为特征解耦的实验设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Pretrain researchers focused on interpretability and alignment should check §3 for cascading sample construction; its experimental design for behavioral feature disentanglement is informative.

paper.title: Inherited Circuits, Learned Semantics: How Fine-Tuning Creates Evasion Vulnerabilities Invisible to Standard Evaluation
paper.abstract: LLMs fine-tuned for security classification are usually evaluated on held-out examples from the same distribution as their training data. We show that this can miss vulnerabilities introduced by fine-tuning itself: models can learn token-level indicator semantics that preserve canonical accuracy while failing under behavior-preserving transformations such as PowerShell alias substitution, command reconstruction, string construction, execution indirection, and case mutation. We study Foundation-S

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但对安全场景很麻烦的问题：同一个基座模型在安全分类任务上经过微调后，表面上的标准测试集准确率会提升，但模型可能同时学到一套对“规范写法”过度依赖的判别语义，导致它在语义不变、行为不变、只是写法被改写的脚本上出现系统性漏检。作者关心的不是一般意义上的分布外鲁棒性，而是微调本身是否把原模型内部已有的判别回路重新加权，变成一种对指示 token 敏感、对变形脆弱的分类器。更具体地说，在 PowerShell 恶意脚本检测里，像 Invoke-WebRequest、Invoke-Expression 这类命令家族既是语义线索，也是攻击者最容易做别名替换、字符串重构、大小写扰动的部位。论文要解决的是：能不能在部署前、不先枚举大量逃逸样本的情况下，仅凭规范输入上的内部表征变化，提前发现哪些命令家族已经成为高风险逃逸面。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在“安全分类”这个应用，而在“微调如何改写基座模型已有电路”这件事。文章给出的结论很清楚：Foundation-Sec 这类安全微调模型并没有重新长出一套全新的 PowerShell 检测器，而是继承了 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 里已有的分类路径，并在此基础上做了集中化和语义专门化。这样做能提高规范分布上的分类表现，但也可能把原本较稳健的判别信号压缩成更窄的 token 级语义依赖。这个观察对更广义的 post-train / continual pretrain 都有参考意义：当下游目标很强、数据分布又有明显表面相关性时，训练往往不是“增加能力”，而是“重配已有能力的使用方式”，而这种重配可能牺牲变形鲁棒性。论文的贡献量级不在提出通用训练新范式，而在给出一个可操作的、机制层面的检测框架：用基座-微调模型对照、token 消融符号反转、线性 probe 排名，去定位微调引入的家族级脆弱点。这对研究 SFT/RL 是否扭曲预训练表征、以及如何做部署前红队优先级排序，都有现实价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三层。第一层是机制分析。作者把 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 作为基座对照，把 Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct 作为安全微调后的模型，比较两者在 PowerShell 分类上的内部表示与因果路径。核心判断是：微调后的模型继承了基座中已有的中层分类回路，尤其是文中强调的 Layer 12 附近的判别路径，而不是新建一条完全不同的检测路线。作者用因果干预和表示分析去验证这一点，重点不是简单看 attention map，而是看替换/消融某些内部激活后输出置信度如何变化。

第二层是预部署检测信号。作者提出 indicator-token sign test：对一组规范恶意脚本，找到命令家族中的指示 token，例如 Invoke-WebRequest；然后在输入中把这些 token 做消融，比较消融前后恶意分类置信度的变化方向。若在基座模型中，去掉该 token 会降低恶意置信度，说明它仍是“driver”；但在微调模型中，去掉它反而提高恶意置信度，说明它已变成“suppressor”。这种符号反转意味着模型对该家族的判别主要转移到了周围 payload 上，而显式命令词本身在规范样本里反而起到抑制作用。作者把这解释为一种危险信号：一旦攻击者把显式命令词换成别名、格式串重构或大小写扰动，模型可能失去稳定锚点。

第三层是家族级排序与验证。作者没有试图做逐脚本的逃逸预测，而是用线性 probe 在分类边界附近测量表征漂移，再结合 sign test，把命令家族按风险排序，输出给红队做定向测试。随后他们构建三层逃逸 benchmark：直接改写、命令重构、大小写变异，并要求种子脚本与变体脚本在语法和行为上保持一致。这个设计的好处是把“模型怕不怕 obfuscation”拆成可归因的变换类型，而不是混成一个模糊的鲁棒性分数。

和常见安全评测不同，这篇文章的关键不是再造一个更大的攻击集，而是提出一种从内部表征出发的前置监测方法。和一般 OOD 检测也不同，它利用的是基座-微调配对以及 token 因果角色变化，而不是只看置信度或 embedding 距离。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕一个 293 对的匹配脚本 cohort 和三层逃逸基准展开，比较对象是 Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct 与其同源基座 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。文章最关键的结果有三点。

第一，indicator-token sign test 在规范输入上就能提前指出高风险家族。作者发现 Invoke-WebRequest 家族的符号反转最明显，随后在真实逃逸测试中，这一家族确实在 iwr 别名替换上出现稳定漏检。也就是说，风险排序不是事后解释，而是对后续红队结果有预测力。

第二，微调模型的失败是“变换敏感”的，而不是普遍分类能力差。Foundation-Sec 在规范 PowerShell 分类上优于基座，文中也引用其先前工作在 threat-hunting workflow 中相对 baseline 有约 +16% precision 提升；但在逃逸基准上，它会在多类行为保持不变的改写中漏掉恶意脚本，包括 Invoke-Expression 的 format-string reconstruction、alternating-case Invoke-Expression，以及 alternating-case IEX alias 等。相对地，Llama 在同一批评测变体上是 zero misses。这个对照很重要，因为它说明问题不是“基座模型本来就不会”，而是“微调后丢掉了原有的某种鲁棒性”。

第三，作者还观察到 prompt-level remediation 很不稳定：针对某一命令家族加提示或补丁，可能修复一个家族，却打开或放大另一个家族的漏检。这说明问题不只是 prompt 层面的表面偏置，而是内部判别语义已经被重排。虽然全文片段里没有给出所有消融表格的具体数值，但从叙述看，作者做了至少三类验证：家族级 sign test 排名、三层变换基准、以及内部因果干预。若精读正文，应重点找 Layer 12 路径替换实验、线性 probe 的 family ranking 结果，以及不同变换类型下的 miss breakdown。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题定义—机制证据—检测方法—基准验证”四步读。

先看 Introduction，抓住文章真正的 claim：不是在说所有安全微调都会降低鲁棒性，而是在说标准 held-out evaluation 会漏掉一种由微调诱发的 transformation-sensitive evasion。这里要特别记住 driver/suppressor 这组概念，因为后面的方法都围绕它展开。

然后看机制分析部分，重点找作者如何证明 Foundation-Sec 继承的是 Llama 的已有分类回路，而不是新学出一条检测器。凡是涉及 activation patching、causal intervention、layer-wise effect 的图表都值得细看，尤其是 Layer 12 附近的证据。如果这里只是相关性而非因果性，结论会弱很多；作者显然在努力把它做成因果论证。

接着看 sign test 和线性 probe 的方法定义。这里要关注两个问题：一是 indicator token 如何选；二是“符号反转”为什么足以作为家族级风险信号，而不是偶然的 token artifact。若正文里有 family-level ranking 表或 ROC/precision 类指标，建议仔细看，因为这决定了方法是否真能用于部署前筛查。

最后看 benchmark 构造与失败案例。建议重点看 Invoke-WebRequest / iwr、Invoke-Expression 格式串重构、大小写扰动这几组。它们代表了三类不同难度的变换：直接别名、结构性重写、表面形态扰动。若时间有限，读 Introduction、方法里 sign test 定义、以及实验中 family-level case study，大约 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线；若要深入理解微调如何重排内部语义，最好把机制分析章节和附录中的干预细节一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode of fine-tuned security classifiers: a model can improve on standard held-out evaluation while becoming easier to evade under behavior-preserving transformations. The setting is PowerShell malware classification.
