This paper tests a stronger claim: when the architecture is changed to provide a dedicated readout channel, does the model still choose to recreate the outlier? The answer is yes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计：它把“outlier 是 residual 角色冲突伪影”这个 prior 做成了可反驳测试，结论应进量化和架构 ablation 清单。
recommendation.en: Read for the experimental design: it turns the “outliers are residual-role artifacts” prior into a falsifiable test, worth adding to quantization and architecture ablation lists.

paper.title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
paper.abstract: The Categorical Jacobian (CJ) of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about 19L forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-K contact-relevant heads, selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, recovers contacts in one forward pass and beats CJ on leakage-clean data for every bidirectional model where CJ is defined, and m

summary.core_problem: 从蛋白质语言模型中无监督读出残基接触的 Categorical Jacobian 方法需要 ~19L 次前向传播，计算成本高且仅适用于带 MLM 分类头的双向掩码模型。
summary.importance: 证明蛋白质接触信号已经集中在少量注意力头中，仅用 10 个标注蛋白做头选择、再对 top-K 头做无加权平均，即可在单次前向传播内得到优于或匹配 Categorical Jacobian 的结果，且能扩展到编码器-解码器架构。同时在 leakage-clean 评测下，两种无监督方法的性能都比之前的报告值下降 30–36 个百分点，量化了预训练数据与评测集序列重叠对结果的高估程度，对预训练表征的可解释性和评测严谨性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法非常简洁：先用一个仅含 10 条蛋白的小标注集，按接触预测精度对所有注意力头排序，选出 top-K 头；推理时直接对这些头的注意力图做无加权算术平均，得到接触预测图。不需要回归拟合、不需要逐对标注、不需要多次前向扰动。作为补充，论文还提出 Representation-CJ，把原本依赖 logit 的 Categorical Jacobian 推广到隐藏状态空间，使其可用于没有 MLM 头的架构；并在因果语言模型上验证了两种方法都失效，与双向预训练对成对结构编码的重要性一致。
summary.experiments: 核心结果在 leakage-clean 的 CAMEO-PTA25 分割（仅使用模型预训练截止日期之后提交、并做序列去重的蛋白链）上得到：ESM-2-650M 上，单次前向的注意力头融合优于 Categorical Jacobian，且此时 CJ 也不再优于单个最优注意力头。该模式在 ESM-2-650M、ESM-2-3B、ProtT5-XL 三种架构上复现；在 Zhang eval-200 和 CASP14-FM 上扩展到共 5 种掩码 LM 和编码器-解码器架构，除最小的 8M 模型和 ESM Cambrian（统计持平）外，融合方法均匹配或优于 CJ。从 Zhang eval-200 换到 leakage-clean CAMEO 后，两种方法的绝对精度都下降 30–36 个百分点。因果 LM（ProGen2 系列）上两种方法均无有效信号。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 4.1 节 leakage-clean 评测下的主对比结果，以及第 4.4 节关于因果 LM 失效的讨论——后者对理解不同预训练目标（双向 vs 因果）如何编码成对依赖有直接启发。方法部分非常短，可快速浏览；附录中的 head precision 排序和 K 的选择消融值得看。全文泛读约 35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The Categorical Jacobian, an unsupervised method for reading residue contacts from protein language models, requires ~19L forward passes and is structurally limited to bidirectional masked-LM architectures with a per-position MLM head.
summary_en.importance: Shows that protein contact signal is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads. Head selection on as few as 10 labeled proteins, followed by an unweighted average of the top-K heads, matches or outperforms the Categorical Jacobian in a single forward pass and generalizes to encoder–decoder architectures. Critically, under leakage-clean evaluation both unsupervised methods drop 30–36 absolute percentage points relative to previously reported numbers, quantifying how much sequence overlap between pretraining and evaluation inflates prior results. The findings are relevant for interpretability of pretrained representations and for rigorous evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is deliberately minimal. First, rank all attention heads by contact precision on a small held-out set of only 10 labeled proteins and select the top-K. At inference, take the unweighted arithmetic mean of their attention maps as the contact prediction. No per-pair regression, no per-pair labels, and no multiple perturbed forward passes are needed. As a secondary contribution, the paper introduces Representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the original logit-based Categorical Jacobian that extends to architectures without an MLM head. It also verifies that both methods fail on causal LMs, consistent with the hypothesis that bidirectional pretraining is important for encoding pairwise structural constraints in attention.
summary_en.experiments: The central result is on the leakage-clean CAMEO-PTA25 split (chains deposited after each model's pretraining cutoff and filtered for sequence similarity). On ESM-2-650M, single-forward-pass head fusion beats the Categorical Jacobian, and CJ itself no longer outperforms the single best attention head. This pattern reproduces across ESM-2-650M, ESM-2-3B, and ProtT5-XL. Across five masked-LM and encoder–decoder PLMs evaluated on Zhang eval-200 and CASP14-FM, fusion matches or exceeds CJ everywhere except the smallest 8M model and ESM Cambrian (statistical tie). Moving from Zhang eval-200 to leakage-clean CAMEO reduces absolute precision of both methods by 30–36 pp. Neither method produces a usable signal on causal ProGen2 models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.1 for the main leakage-clean comparison, and Section 4.4 for the causal-LM failure case — the latter directly informs how different pretraining objectives (bidirectional vs causal) encode pairwise dependencies. The method section is short and can be skimmed quickly. Ablations on head-precision ranking and choice of K in the appendix are worth reading. Estimated reading time: ~35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 注意力头可线性读出结构化信号的结论对通用LLM的可解释性有类比价值，重点看 §4 头选择消融与泄露控制设置。
recommendation.en: The finding that structured signals can be linearly read out from attention heads carries analogies to general LLM interpretability; focus on §4 head-selection ablations and the leakage-controlled setup.

paper.title: LIG: Layer-wise Integrated Gradients for Within-Layer Flow Analysis in Transformers
paper.abstract: Transformers achieve strong performance, but their internal computations remain opaque. We view each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph whose nodes are token representations and per-head attention outputs, with Multi-Head Attention (ATT) and MLP as module boundaries. On this graph we use LIG (Layer-wise Integrated Gradients), which applies set-to-set Integrated Gradients (IG) at nonlinear module boundaries. Set-to-set IG applies IG to a map from a set of input token representations to a set of

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 Transformer 层内归因问题：不只解释输入 token 对最终输出的贡献，也不只看 attention map，而是把同一层里的 ATT 和 MLP 分开，分析 token 表示在层内如何流动、混合和再组织。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型机制分析有一定参考价值。它把归因粒度推进到层内模块边界，适合用来观察不同层的角色分化，例如浅层偏局部关系、深层偏全句整合。对预训练研究的启发主要在诊断层面：可用于比较架构、训练阶段、数据分布变化下的信息流差异。但贡献仍偏解释工具，实验集中在 BERT Base，离直接改进训练 recipe 还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把一个 Transformer layer 看成动态计算图。图上的节点包括每个 token 的层输入表示 z，以及每个 head 的 attention 输出 u。层内计算被拆成 z -> ATT -> u -> MLP -> z_next 两段。核心是 LIG，即在 ATT 和 MLP 这些非线性模块边界上使用 set-to-set Integrated Gradients。普通 IG 通常针对一个标量输出做归因；这里把一组输入 token 表示映射到一组输出表示，并用 L2 scalarization 把向量输出转成可求 IG 的标量目标，从而得到 token-to-token 的贡献矩阵。之后再把 ATT 段和 MLP 段的贡献组合起来，形式上接近 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation 的守恒思路。论文还比较了不同 baseline。结论是 MLP baseline 的选择影响相对小，ATT baseline 是主要影响因素；继承 ATT 输出端点 a=0 作为 MLP baseline，或使用 Zero，在归一化 L2 诊断下表现较好。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 BERT Base Uncased，配置为 12 层、12 个 attention heads、隐藏维度 768。实验主要验证两类问题：一是分段归因 ATT + MLP 的组合路径是否能和整层 z-to-z 归因保持一致；二是 baseline 选择对归因结果的影响。论文用 normalized L2 指标比较不同配置，发现 ATT baseline 主导整体误差，而 MLP baseline 的影响较弱。可视化结果展示了 token-to-token 贡献随层深变化的模式：早期层更容易看到局部或邻近 token 关系，较深层出现更广的句子级整合。整体实验偏诊断和定性分析，不是大规模模型机制发现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。优先看 Transformer graph 定义和 LIG 公式部分，确认 set-to-set IG 如何从标量 IG 扩展到 token 集合映射。然后看 baseline 消融和 normalized L2 结果，理解为什么 ATT baseline 比 MLP baseline 更关键。最后看层级可视化图，判断这种工具是否适合自己的模型诊断场景。若关注 LLM pretrain 训练动态，可重点思考它能否用于比较 checkpoint、数据阶段或架构改动，而不是只停留在单个 BERT 样例解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses within-layer attribution in Transformers: instead of explaining only input-to-output relevance or visualizing attention maps, it separates ATT and MLP and tracks how token representations flow through a single layer.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability paper rather than a pretraining method. Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic. It offers a way to inspect how information routing changes across depth and how attention and MLP contribute differently to token-to-token interactions. The impact is moderate: useful for mechanism analysis and training-dynamics studies, but not directly tied to scaling, data mixture, or optimization recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method models each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph with token representations z and per-head attention outputs u as nodes. A layer is decomposed into z -> ATT -> u -> MLP -> z_next. LIG applies Integrated Gradients at these module boundaries. Since standard IG usually attributes a scalar objective, the paper extends it to set-to-set maps by using an L2 scalarization over vector outputs, producing token-to-token contribution scores. The ATT and MLP attributions are then composed in a way similar to the conservation intuition behind Layer-wise Relevance Propagation. The paper also studies baseline choices. Under the normalized L2 diagnostic, the ATT baseline dominates the attribution quality, while the MLP baseline has a much smaller effect; inheriting the ATT endpoint at a=0 as the MLP baseline or using Zero ranks among the better configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use BERT Base Uncased with 12 layers, 12 heads, and hidden size 768. The main checks are whether the decomposed ATT-plus-MLP path aligns with direct whole-layer z-to-z attribution, and how baseline choices affect the normalized L2 consistency metric. The qualitative visualizations show a depth-dependent shift: lower layers emphasize more local token relations, while higher layers show broader sentence-level integration. The evidence is mostly diagnostic and qualitative, with limited coverage beyond BERT Base.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20-30 minutes. Focus on the graph formulation and the set-to-set IG definition first, because that is the main technical move. Then read the baseline ablations and normalized L2 comparison to understand the sensitivity of the method. The layer-wise visualization figures are useful for judging whether LIG would help analyze checkpoints, architecture variants, or training-stage differences in larger language models.

recommendation.zh: Transformer层内细粒度归因的新工具，做模型机制分析的研究员可精读§3的set-to-set IG推导，预训练工程侧无直接可落地动作
recommendation.en: Novel fine-grained intra-layer Transformer attribution tool; mechanism researchers can read §3's set-to-set IG derivation closely, no directly actionable insights for pretraining engineering

paper.title: HydraHead: From Head-Level Functional Heterogeneity to Specialized Attention Hybridization
paper.abstract: The quadratic complexity of attention poses a critical bottleneck for long-context processing, spurring interest in hybrid attention designs. Most open-source hybrid models adopt a layer-wise strategy. Yet, prior work has noted the inherent difficulty of integrating Linear Attention (LA) with Full Attention (FA), suggesting that the design space of attention hybridization remains underexplored. To probe this space, we conduct interpretability analysis and observe that layers exhibit block-wise f

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是长上下文模型中 full attention 和 linear attention 如何混合的问题。常见 layer-wise hybrid 按层替换注意力机制，但层级粒度太粗；作者观察到同一层内部不同 attention heads 的功能差异很大，尤其是长上下文精确检索只依赖少数关键 heads。因此，更合理的混合单位可能是 head，而不是 layer。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座架构和持续训练都有较直接的参考价值。它把可解释性分析用于架构迁移：先从预训练模型中找出检索关键 heads，再只保留这些 heads 的 full attention，其余 heads 改成 linear attention。这样可以在较少继续训练 token 下获得长上下文能力，同时尽量保留通用推理能力。贡献量级主要在工程可用的架构设计和迁移 recipe，而不是提出全新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: HydraHead 是 head-level attention hybridization。第一步，作者用 per-head logit contribution 分析长上下文检索任务中每个 head 对正确答案 token 的贡献。结果显示，关键检索 heads 是稀疏的，并且更集中在深层；相比之下，layer output similarity 呈平滑块状结构，不足以给出明确的层级替换决策。第二步，保留这些 retrieval-critical heads 的 full attention，把其余 heads 替换为 linear attention，从而减少长上下文计算开销。第三步，在同一层内混合 FA 和 LA 时，作者加入 head-wise scale-normalized fusion，缓解两类注意力输出尺度和特征形态不同造成的干扰。训练流程分三阶段：从预训练 checkpoint 继承参数并做 layer-wise alignment；做 global distillation；最后进行 long-context fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-1.7B，在统一训练配置下比较 layer-wise、token-wise 和 head-wise hybrid 策略。结果显示，不同粒度存在明确取舍：layer-wise hybrid 长度外推较稳，但通用推理损失更明显；token-wise 和普通 head-wise 方法推理保持较好，但长上下文外推不足。HydraHead 在这个取舍上更均衡。作者报告，在 hard reasoning tasks 上相对 layer-wise baselines 保持超过 10% 的收益；在更激进的 7:1 LA-to-FA 配比下，整体表现可以匹配 3:1 layer-wise hybrid，说明可解释性选 head 比均匀替换更有效。进一步训练只使用 15B tokens，在 512k context 的 NIAH benchmark 上相对预训练 baseline 提升超过 69%，并且没有明显牺牲一般推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。优先看 Figure 2：它支撑了从 layer-wise 转向 head-wise 的核心论据。然后看 head selection 的校准流程，特别是 per-head logit contribution 如何定义、需要多少 calibration data、是否依赖特定检索模板。方法部分重点看 head-wise scale-normalized fusion，因为 FA 和 LA 在表示形态上的差异是混合架构训练不稳的主要来源。实验部分建议看三个比较：不同混合粒度的取舍、FA heads 压缩比例的消融、15B tokens 长上下文迁移结果。若关注预训练成本，最值得细读的是三阶段 transfer pipeline。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to combine full attention and linear attention for long-context language models. Existing hybrids often operate at the layer level, but layers are a coarse unit. The authors show that attention heads within the same layer are functionally heterogeneous, and that precise long-context retrieval depends on a sparse subset of heads. This motivates using the head, rather than the layer, as the unit of attention hybridization.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to base-model architecture and continual pretraining. It turns an interpretability signal into an architecture conversion rule: identify retrieval-critical heads in a pretrained full-attention model, keep full attention only for those heads, and convert the rest to linear attention. This gives a practical path to long-context adaptation with limited additional training tokens while preserving general reasoning better than coarse layer replacement. The contribution is mainly an architecture and transfer recipe, not a new language modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: HydraHead performs head-level attention hybridization. The selection step computes per-head logit contributions on long-context retrieval examples to find heads that materially support the correct answer token. These heads are sparse and tend to appear in deeper layers. By contrast, layer output similarity forms a smooth block-like pattern, which gives little signal for deciding which entire layers should use full attention. HydraHead keeps full attention for the selected retrieval-critical heads and assigns linear attention to the remaining heads. Since full attention and linear attention produce features with different scales and structures, the method adds head-wise scale-normalized fusion to reduce interference. Training follows a three-stage transfer pipeline: parameter inheritance from the pretrained checkpoint with layer-wise alignment, global distillation, and long-context fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are built on Qwen3-1.7B under a unified training setup, comparing layer-wise, token-wise, and head-wise hybrid strategies. The reported pattern is clear: layer-wise hybrids extrapolate better in length but lose more general reasoning ability, while token-wise and ordinary head-wise variants preserve reasoning better but are weaker on long-context extrapolation. HydraHead improves this trade-off. It keeps more than a 10% advantage over layer-wise baselines on hard reasoning tasks, and with an aggressive 7:1 linear-attention to full-attention ratio it matches the overall performance of a 3:1 layer-wise hybrid. With only 15B training tokens, it improves NIAH performance at 512k context by more than 69% over the pretrained baseline, while maintaining general reasoning performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 30 to 40 minutes. Start with Figure 2, because it provides the main evidence for moving from layer-level to head-level hybridization. Then read the head-selection procedure and check how per-head logit contribution is defined, how much calibration data is required, and whether the signal depends on the retrieval template. In the method section, focus on head-wise scale-normalized fusion, since mixing full and linear attention is mainly difficult because their output features are not naturally aligned. In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the comparison across hybridization granularities, the ablation over the full-attention head budget, and the 15B-token long-context transfer result. For pretraining researchers, the three-stage transfer pipeline is the most reusable component.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把 hybrid attention 的设计粒度从 layer 改到 head，确实可能改变你做长上下文架构搜索的 prior；先看分析图和 ablation，别先信总分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it shifts hybrid attention design from the layer level to the head level, which could genuinely change your long-context architecture prior; start with the analysis and ablations, not the headline metrics.

paper.title: How Do Instructions Shape Speech? Cross-Attention Attribution for Style-Captioned Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Style-captioned text-to-speech systems use natural language to control voice characteristics, but how individual words influence acoustic output remains unclear. Understanding this is critical for diagnosing failure modes and improving controllability in expressive TTS. We propose cross-attention attribution for speech diffusion models, adapting the DAAM framework to the speech domain for the first time, and apply it to CapSpeech-TTS. Our method extracts per-token heatmaps across 25 layers and 2

summary.core_problem: 解释 style-captioned TTS 中自然语言风格指令的哪些词在何时、通过哪些层影响语音波形。
summary.importance: 贡献是语音扩散生成模型的可解释性分析。它把图像扩散里的 DAAM 式 cross-attention attribution 迁移到 TTS，用于诊断风格控制失败和提升可控性。对语音生成和统一音频建模有旁路参考，但不是语音 LM tokenizer 或统一预训练范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 CapSpeech-TTS 的 cross-attention 中抽取逐 token 的热力图，覆盖 25 层和 24 个 ODE step。分析 style caption token、文本内容 token 和 function token 在时间维、层维和采样步维上的归因分布，并把 style attention 与 F0、能量等声学属性相关联。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 120 条 style captions 与 30 条 text transcripts 的组合，共 3,600 个条件生成样本。主要发现包括：style token 的时间方差低于内容/function token，符合全局条件作用；style attention 与 F0 和能量相关；风格条件在早期采样步和深层更强；attention entropy 在第 17 层达到最低。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which words in natural-language style captions affect speech waveforms, and at which layers and denoising steps this influence appears.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is interpretability for speech diffusion generation. It adapts DAAM-style cross-attention attribution from image diffusion to TTS, mainly for diagnosing controllability in expressive speech synthesis. It is relevant to audio generation, but not a core speech-LM tokenizer or unified pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method extracts per-token cross-attention heatmaps from CapSpeech-TTS across 25 layers and 24 ODE steps. It compares style-caption tokens, transcript content tokens, and function tokens across temporal variance, layer depth, sampling step, and correlations with acoustic features such as F0 and energy.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers 3,600 style-text combinations from 120 style captions and 30 transcripts. Reported findings include lower temporal variance for style tokens than content/function tokens, correlation between style attention and F0/energy, stronger style conditioning in early steps and deeper layers, and minimum attention entropy around layer 17.

recommendation.zh: 只看层/步归因结果即可；它有助于理解 TTS 可控性，但离语音 LM 预训练还有明显距离。
recommendation.en: Skim only the layer/step attribution results; useful for TTS controllability, but far from speech-LM pretraining.

paper.title: GEMS: Geometric Constraints Enable Multi-Semantic Superposition in LLMs
paper.abstract: Activation steering controls model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states at inference time without retraining. Existing methods handle only single-direction injection; when multiple semantic directions are superposed without constraints, the model collapses. We show that this collapse decomposes into two independently acting sources: distributional deviation, where additive perturbations accumulate in norm across layers and drive activations outside the training distribution, and dire

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多语义 activation steering 的稳定性问题。单个 steering direction 往往能工作，但多个语义方向同时注入时，模型输出容易退化。作者把退化拆成两个相对独立的来源：一是激活范数逐层累积，导致 hidden state 偏离训练分布；二是不同语义向量不正交，叠加后互相削弱或串扰。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在表征几何和可控生成机制。它给 activation steering 的失败模式提供了较清楚的诊断框架：多方向控制不是简单把多个向量相加，而要同时控制范数稳定性和方向可分性。这个结论对理解 LLM hidden space 的 superposition、特征干涉、层间分布漂移有启发。作为方法，GEMS 仍是 inference-time intervention，不改变权重，因此更适合作为机制分析和数据合成工具，而不是基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: GEMS 是一个 training-free 的多方向 steering 方法。核心做法不是学习新的投影或分类器，而是在前向传播中加入几何约束。第一，做 norm preservation，避免多个 steering vector 叠加后把激活推到训练分布之外。第二，选择 o_proj 注入点，作者认为这是稳定注入的关键位置；在该位置之外注入更容易导致退化。第三，对多个语义方向做正交化，降低 directional interference。第四，用 Gaussian envelope 在连续多层上分配干预强度，而不是只在单层或少数层注入；这个设计对应了语义信息分布在多层的观察。和 ActAdd、CAA、RepE、ITI 相比，GEMS 的重点从单方向控制转到多方向并行控制；和 MSRS、MAT-STEER、K-Steering 相比，它不引入额外训练过程。
summary.experiments: 实验主线是诊断和消融。作者在 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上分析多方向 steering collapse，并把失败归因到 distributional deviation 和 directional interference。GEMS 能在 dense model 的 10 层以上连续层中并行注入多个语义方向。关键消融结论是：去掉 norm preservation 或不在 o_proj 注入会导致明显退化；不做正交化时，输出更容易出现语义漂移；Gaussian envelope 用来缓和不同层的干预强度差异。文中还给出 3B 到 31B 模型上的定性迁移结果，说明该几何约束可能不强依赖单一模型架构。提供内容中没有足够完整的量化表格和具体分数，因此不宜把结论解读为稳定的跨模型性能保证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 中对两个 failure modes 的定义，再看 Motivation 中关于层间分布式语义存储的论证。方法部分重点看四个设计：norm preservation、o_proj injection、orthogonalization、Gaussian envelope。实验部分重点看消融：哪些约束是必要条件，哪些只是提升稳定性的调节项。值得深挖的是作者如何度量“偏离训练分布”和“方向干涉”，因为这决定了该方法能否从经验技巧变成更通用的 hidden-state 控制原则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why multi-direction activation steering breaks down. Single-vector steering can often shift model behavior, but adding several semantic directions at once tends to degrade generation. The authors decompose the failure into two sources: norm-level distributional deviation, where repeated additive perturbations push hidden states away from the training distribution, and directional interference, where non-orthogonal semantic vectors suppress or distort one another.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than pretraining procedural. It provides a useful diagnosis of hidden-space control: multi-attribute steering is not just vector addition, because both activation-scale stability and geometric separability matter. This connects to superposition, feature interference, and layer-wise representation drift. GEMS is an inference-time method, so its immediate use is more likely in model analysis, controlled generation, and structured data synthesis than in base-model training itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEMS is a training-free geometric intervention method. It keeps the intervention within a stable norm range, injects at the o_proj location, orthogonalizes semantic directions to reduce interference, and distributes intervention strength over consecutive layers with a Gaussian envelope. The design follows the observation that semantic information is spread across layers, making single-layer steering brittle. Compared with ActAdd, CAA, RepE, and ITI, the shift is from single-attribute control to parallel multi-attribute control. Compared with learned multi-steering methods such as MSRS, MAT-STEER, and K-Steering, GEMS avoids additional optimization or architecture changes.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic analysis is conducted on Qwen3.5-4B-Base. The paper reports that multi-direction collapse can be separated into distributional deviation and directional interference, and that GEMS can inject multiple semantic directions across more than 10 consecutive layers in dense models. The key ablations are qualitative but informative: removing norm preservation or moving away from the o_proj injection point leads to immediate collapse; removing orthogonalization causes semantic drift; the Gaussian envelope helps allocate intervention strength across layers. The paper also reports preliminary qualitative transfer across models from 3B to 31B. The provided text does not contain enough complete quantitative tables, so the results should be read as evidence for a design principle rather than a fully established scaling claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes, then the motivation section for the argument that steering should be distributed across layers. In the method section, focus on norm preservation, o_proj injection, orthogonalization, and the Gaussian envelope. In the experiments, the most useful parts are the ablations showing which constraints are necessary. The main point worth checking carefully is how the paper measures distributional deviation and directional interference, since those measurements determine whether the method generalizes beyond the shown settings.

recommendation.zh: 读机制分解即可：norm drift 与方向干扰这个拆法干净，效果表若 setup 小就别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Read the failure decomposition: norm drift plus directional interference is a clean framing, but do not over-extrapolate if the setups are small.

paper.title: Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Models
paper.abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance the interpretability of deep learning networks by aligning the features extracted from images with natural concepts. However, existing CBMs are constrained in their ability to generalize beyond a fixed set of predefined classes and the risk of non-concept information leakage, where predictive signals outside the intended concepts are inadvertently exploited. In this paper, we propose Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Model (MM-CBM) to address these issues and

summary.core_problem: 解决Concept Bottleneck Models依赖固定类别概念、难以泛化到开放视觉任务，以及可能泄漏非概念信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是CLIP上的可解释性方法改进。它对VLM表示可解释性有参考意义，但不是基座预训练、统一建模或大规模对齐训练的核心工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Model，将CBM扩展到CLIP。方法使用双Concept Bottleneck Layers，分别把图像embedding和文本embedding对齐到可解释概念特征，从而在zero-shot分类和图像检索等开放任务中保留概念级解释。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在四个标准benchmark上，相比现有方法平均准确率最高提升51.26%，同时与黑盒CLIP性能差距约在5%以内。摘要未说明具体benchmark名称、CLIP规模、概念集构造方式和泄漏检测协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limited generalization and non-concept leakage risks of Concept Bottleneck Models when applied beyond fixed closed-set vision tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability method for CLIP-style multimodal models. It is relevant as VLM analysis tooling, but it is not a core contribution to foundation-model pretraining or large-scale multimodal alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: MM-CBM extends CBMs into CLIP by adding dual Concept Bottleneck Layers that align both image and text embeddings into interpretable concept features. This supports interpretable zero-shot classification and image retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to 51.26% average accuracy improvement over prior methods across four standard benchmarks, while staying within roughly 5% of black-box performance. It does not specify benchmark names, CLIP scale, concept construction, or leakage diagnostics in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 作为CLIP可解释性备查即可；关键是概念泄漏评估是否严，若没有干净protocol，性能数字参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a CLIP interpretability reference; the useful part depends on whether concept leakage is measured with a clean protocol.

paper.title: Comparing Linear Probes with Mahalanobis Cosine Similarity
paper.abstract: Linear probes are widely used in interpretability research and often compared by cosine similarity. The Mahalanobis cosine similarity (MCS) between two directions, which reweights the inner product by test data covariance, is a natural task-aware refinement. Ying et al. (2026) report that a probe's MCS to a reference probe trained on the out-of-distribution (OOD) data near-perfectly linearly predicts the probe's OOD AUROC (R^2 = 0.98). Here, we extend this empirical finding across models, layers

summary.core_problem: 解决 linear probe 之间如何比较的问题：普通 cosine similarity 忽略测试分布协方差，可能不能反映 probe 在 OOD 数据上的有效性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是解释性工具和理论分析。它为 Mahalanobis cosine similarity 作为 probe 比较指标提供闭式理论解释，并说明何时会失效，对 mechanistic interpretability 的测量方法有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用测试数据协方差重加权两个 probe 方向的内积，形成 task-aware 的 MCS；在 balanced classes 且投影近似 Gaussian 的条件下，证明 OOD AUROC 与 probe 到 reference probe 的 MCS 近似线性，因为二者都是 probe 测试信噪比的 sigmoid-shaped 函数。
summary.experiments: 论文扩展 Ying et al. 2026 的经验发现，跨模型、层和概念域验证 MCS 与 OOD AUROC 的线性关系；同时根据理论预测构造或观察线性失效情形，并做实证验证。摘要给出的既有结果是 R^2=0.98。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to compare linear probes when ordinary cosine similarity ignores the covariance structure of the test distribution.
summary_en.importance: This is a measurement and theory contribution for interpretability. It gives a closed-form explanation for why Mahalanobis cosine similarity can track OOD probe performance and identifies when the relationship should break.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCS reweights the inner product between probe directions by the test-data covariance. Under balanced classes with Gaussian projected features, both OOD AUROC and MCS to a reference probe become sigmoid-like functions of the probe's test-data signal-to-noise ratio, yielding a linear relation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper extends a prior empirical observation across models, layers, and concept domains, and verifies predicted failure modes. The referenced finding reports an R^2 of 0.98 between MCS to an OOD-trained reference probe and OOD AUROC.

recommendation.zh: 只看理论假设和失效条件；MCS 是 probe 比较的干净基线，但别把高斯和平衡类假设外推成模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Read the assumptions and failure cases only; MCS is a clean baseline for probe comparison, not a license to extrapolate Gaussian balanced-class theory to model capability.

paper.title: Critical Percolation as a Synthetic Data Model for Interpretability
paper.abstract: Neural networks learn features that reflect the hierarchical, multi-scale structure of natural data. Synthetic datasets used to evaluate interpretability methods typically lack this structure, limiting their value as realistic toy models. To close this gap, we introduce a family of synthetic datasets consisting of hierarchical functions defined on critical mean-field percolation clusters embedded in a high-dimensional data space. The percolation data consists of sparse, low-dimensional fractal c

summary.core_problem: 现有可解释性 toy dataset 往往缺少自然数据常见的层级、多尺度结构，导致方法在玩具环境中的结论很难外推到真实神经网络表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析侧的数据建模工作，贡献不在提出新的解释方法，而在构造一个更接近真实数据统计结构、同时又可解析的合成数据分布，供 interpretability 研究做更干净的受控实验。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出基于临界平均场渗流簇的合成数据族：数据点分布在稀疏、低维、分形结构的高维簇上，簇大小服从幂律分布；标签由带分类层级的潜变量生成。方法上利用渗流簇、随机树与 additive coalescence 的对应关系，设计近线性时间的联合采样算法，同时采样随机树结构及其层级 latent decomposition。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或标准 baseline 数字，重点更像是数据生成机制与理论可解析性，而非大规模神经网络 benchmark。可预期实验会围绕生成数据的统计性质、层级结构恢复、以及作为 interpretability testbed 的适用性展开，但从摘要看还不足以支持强经验结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Typical toy datasets for interpretability lack the hierarchical and multi-scale structure of natural data, so conclusions drawn from them often fail to transfer to realistic representation learning settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented data-modeling paper. Its value is not a new interpretability method, but a more realistic yet analytically tractable synthetic distribution for controlled interpretability experiments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a family of synthetic datasets built from critical mean-field percolation clusters. Samples lie on sparse, low-dimensional fractal clusters in a high-dimensional space, with cluster sizes following a power law. Labels are generated by latent variables with a taxonomic hierarchy. Using a mapping among percolation clusters, random trees, and additive coalescence, the authors derive an almost linear-time joint sampler for both the random tree and its hierarchical latent decomposition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scales, benchmark baselines, or headline quantitative gains. The emphasis appears to be on the statistical properties and analytical tractability of the data model rather than large-scale neural benchmarking. Any empirical value likely comes from showing that the generated data better supports interpretability studies than standard toy datasets.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但如果你做表征机制或想找更像自然数据的 toy setup，可先看数据构造；没有大规模训练结论，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material, but worth knowing if you care about representation probes or better toy worlds; read for the data model, not for training conclusions.

paper.title: SAE Interventions are Unreliable: Post-Intervention Recovery of Suppressed Behavior
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual-stream activations into interpretable features. Recent latent-space defenses increasingly rely on these decompositions, assuming that identified "unsafe" SAE features serve as actionable handles for monitoring and intervention. In this paradigm, clamping a specific harmful feature is expected to reliably prevent model misbehavior. However, we show that this success may hide a recoverable failure mode: the clamp may block one visible route to a behavi

summary.core_problem: 当前基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的表征层安全干预默认抑制指定SAE特征就能彻底消除对应有害行为，但该核心机制假设缺乏验证，实际存在抑制后行为通过其他计算路径恢复的未被识别漏洞。
summary.importance: 明确了基于SAE的可解释性与干预管线的实际边界，尤其针对潜空间对齐防御方向提供了关键约束：SAE特征仅为局部因果把手，而非完备的行为瓶颈，对后续SAE引导的模型编辑、安全引导、遗忘方法的设计有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出「干预后恢复」白盒诊断方法，将其形式化为带约束的残差空间优化问题。该方法从已完成SAE特征钳制/消融的防御后残差状态出发，而非在防御生效前绕过特征检测，核心包含两个技术设计：一是通过投影梯度下降施加几何约束，单层干预时将更新方向投影到目标SAE编码器的零空间，跨层干预时用特征图雅可比约束扰动避免跨层重激活目标特征；二是恢复路径归因，分解恢复后的残差，区分行为恢复来自未钳制的SAE潜变量还是SAE未解释的重构残差。
summary.experiments: 所有指标均在有效翻转样例（基模型存在目标行为、SAE干预已成功抑制该行为）上测量：1）SAEBench的TPP任务：编码器正交约束下行为恢复率达74.9%，目标特征重激活率仅0.002；2）WMDP-Bio遗忘任务：恢复98.9%的严格有效答案翻转，目标特征激活漂移为0；3）IOI电路任务：实现100%行为恢复，被重激活的目标特征占比仅0.016；4）AdvBench安全拒绝引导任务：严格有效恶意提示上恢复率达95.8%，防御特征相对漂移为0.131，归因分析显示恢复的恶意行为主要由SAE重构残差承载，而非其他可见SAE特征。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第1节核心问题定义与诊断方法的设计动机（重点区分其与防御生效前规避攻击的差异），再查看实验部分的4组跨任务结果与归因分析，重点关注恢复率与目标特征重激活率的对应关系、以及重构残差在恢复路径中的作用；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current representation-level safety interventions built on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) rely on an unvalidated mechanistic assumption: suppressing identified behavior-associated SAE features will fully eliminate the target harmful behavior. This work identifies and quantifies a latent failure mode where suppressed behaviors re-emerge via alternative computational paths without reactivating the targeted features.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the practical boundary of SAE-based interpretability and intervention pipelines, especially for latent-space alignment defenses. It provides empirical evidence that SAE features act as local causal handles rather than complete behavioral bottlenecks, setting concrete constraints for the design of future SAE-guided model editing, safety steering, and unlearning methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes post-intervention recovery, a white-box diagnostic formulated as a constrained residual-space optimization problem. Unlike prior attacks that evade feature detection before defenses are deployed, this method operates directly on the already-defended residual state after SAE feature clamping or ablation. Two core technical components are included: first, geometric constraints via projected gradient descent, where updates are projected to the null space of targeted SAE encoder directions for single-layer interventions, and feature-map Jacobians are used to restrict perturbations from reactivating target features across layers for cross-layer settings; second, recovery-path attribution, which decomposes recovered residuals to distinguish whether behavior is restored via unclamped SAE latents or SAE-unexplained reconstruction residuals.
summary_en.experiments: All metrics are measured on valid flip examples, where the base model exhibits the target behavior and SAE intervention successfully suppresses it: 1) TPP task on SAEBench: 74.9% behavioral recovery rate under encoder-orthogonal constraints, with only 0.002 targeted feature reactivation rate; 2) WMDP-Bio unlearning: recovers 98.9% of strict valid answer flips with 0 measured target activation drift; 3) IOI circuit task: achieves 100% behavioral recovery with only 0.016 fraction of targeted features reactivated; 4) Safety refusal steering on AdvBench: 95.8% recovery rate on strict valid malicious prompts, with 0.131 relative drift of defended features; attribution analysis shows recovered malicious behavior is primarily carried by SAE reconstruction residuals rather than alternative visible SAE features.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 1 for the core problem definition and diagnostic design motivation, especially the distinction from pre-deployment evasion attacks; then review the four cross-task experiment results and attribution analysis, focusing on the correlation between recovery rate and target feature reactivation, as well as the role of reconstruction residuals in recovery paths. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接证伪SAE特征干预的因果性假设，做对齐/可解释性干预的重点看§3的恢复攻击实验设置与成功率。
recommendation.en: Directly falsifies the causal assumption of SAE feature interventions; focus on recovery attack setup and success rates in §3 for alignment/interpretability work.

paper.title: Task-Restricted Symmetries in Recurrent Weight Space
paper.abstract: Recurrent networks can contain substantial functional redundancy in   weight space: changing a recurrent matrix may leave the input-output   rollout nearly unchanged on a task distribution, while similar-scale   changes can destroy the same behavior. We study this redundancy in   one-layer tanh RNNs using ordered real Schur coordinates. The Schur   form separates spectral blocks from directed nonnormal couplings,   giving a diagnostic basis for structured ablations that keep the input   and read

summary.core_problem: 循环网络权重空间存在大量功能冗余：相近幅度的权重扰动，有的几乎不改变任务输入输出行为，有的则彻底破坏性能，其结构来源尚不清晰。
summary.importance: 原理分析贡献：在单层 tanh RNN 中利用有序实 Schur 坐标分解，首次系统刻画了任务相关的近似功能不变量，而非普适对称性。
summary.technical_approach: 将循环矩阵分解为有序实 Schur 形式，分离谱块与有向非正规耦合；在固定输入与读出映射的前提下，对不同 Schur 分量做结构化消融以识别保性能的冗余结构。
summary.experiments: 在 copy、flip-flop、正弦生成、上下文依赖积分等合成任务上验证：不同任务与不同训练解之间，可安全移除的非正规 Schur 耦合模式存在显著差异，不存在通用冗余模式。

summary_en.core_problem: Recurrent networks exhibit large functional redundancy in weight space: perturbations of similar magnitude can either leave task behavior nearly unchanged or destroy it, and the structural origin of this asymmetry is poorly understood.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution: uses ordered real Schur coordinates in one-layer tanh RNNs to systematically characterize task-dependent approximate functional invariances, rather than universal symmetries.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes the recurrent matrix into ordered real Schur form to separate spectral blocks from directed nonnormal couplings; performs structured ablations while keeping input and readout maps fixed to identify performance-preserving redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on copy, flip-flop, sine generation and context-dependent integration tasks; the profile of removable nonnormal Schur couplings varies substantially across tasks and trained solutions, with no universal pattern.

recommendation.zh: 小模型 RNN 的权重空间分析，对 Transformer 预训练研究员仅作机制类文献备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: A weight-space analysis of small RNNs; serves only as mechanism literature backup for Transformer pretrain researchers, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures
paper.abstract: Understanding gradient descent dynamics is key to explaining the success of over-parameterized models, where implicit bias manifests through conservation laws in gradient flow. While such laws are well understood for linear and ReLU networks, they remain largely unexplored for modern architectures. This work develops a unified framework to characterize conservation laws for contemporary models, including feedforward networks with GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU activations, multihead attention with sinus

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究现代神经网络在梯度流训练中的守恒量：哪些参数函数会沿优化轨迹保持不变，以及这些守恒量是否已经被完整刻画。重点对象不是早期线性网络或 ReLU MLP，而是当前大模型常用组件，包括 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 前馈层，多头注意力、正弦位置编码、RoPE，以及不同门控形式的 MoE。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在训练动态和隐式偏置，而不是直接给出新的训练 recipe。守恒律描述了优化器和架构共同施加的几何约束。它能解释为什么某些参数组合从初始化到收敛始终受限，也为分析 loss spike、参数尺度漂移、专家路由稳定性提供一套较干净的理论语言。贡献量级偏基础理论：它把 Marcotte 等人关于线性、ReLU、ResNet、单头 Transformer 的框架推进到更贴近 LLM 的模块，尤其补上了多头注意力和 MoE。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文把守恒律刻画为一组偏微分方程的求解问题。给定模型参数 θ 和梯度流动力学，如果某个光滑函数 C(θ) 在所有训练轨迹上保持不变，就要求 C 的梯度与训练损失诱导的向量场正交。作者沿用并扩展 Marcotte 系列工作的框架，在一定损失和数据假设下给出完整性结果，即证明列出的守恒量不只是一些例子，而是穷尽了所有满足条件的光滑守恒律。具体覆盖三类模块：第一，带 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 的前馈网络，处理平滑激活和门控激活相对于 ReLU 同质性的变化；第二，多头注意力，并进一步考虑正弦位置编码和 RoPE，回应此前单头分析之外的开放问题；第三，MoE，包括 dense MoE、sparse top-k 路由、softmax gating、sigmoid gating 和 normalized sigmoid gating。区别于只列举不变量的经验观察，这篇工作的重点是完整刻画和证明边界条件。
summary.experiments: 实验用于验证理论预言的守恒量，而不是追求下游性能。论文在所考虑的前馈、注意力和 MoE 架构上跟踪对应不变量，比较 full-batch gradient descent 和 SGD 情况。全文说明实验覆盖小规模和较大规模的多模态数据设置。可核验的主结论是：理论给出的不变量在全批量训练中按预期保持，在 SGD 下也表现出可观的近似保持；这支持了守恒律作为训练动态诊断工具的可用性。提供内容中没有可核验的参数量、数据 token 数或具体数值幅度，因此不应把它解读为有直接工程收益的实验论文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30 到 45 分钟。先看 Section 3，理解作者如何把守恒律问题转成 PDE；这里决定了后面所有定理的形式。再看 Section 4 的三个子部分：4.1 对 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 的处理，4.2 对多头注意力和位置编码的完整刻画，4.3 对 MoE 门控的分类。对 LLM 预训练研究员，4.2 和 4.3 最值得停留，因为它们贴近 Transformer 和 MoE 的实际结构。Section 5 适合看证明思路和限制条件，避免把梯度流下的严格结果直接外推到 AdamW、大 batch、混合精度和复杂并行训练。Section 6 可快速查看不变量是否在 SGD 中仍有经验意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which quantities remain invariant along gradient-flow training trajectories in modern neural architectures, and whether these invariants can be characterized completely. The target is not the classical linear or ReLU setting, but modules used in current large models: GELU, SiLU and SwiGLU feed-forward blocks, multi-head attention, sinusoidal positional encodings, RoPE, and MoE layers with different gating mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining research is in training dynamics and implicit bias, not in an immediate recipe change. Conservation laws describe geometric constraints imposed jointly by the architecture and the optimizer. They can help reason about parameter-scale constraints, stability, and routing dynamics. The contribution is mainly theoretical: it extends the Marcotte-style characterization framework from simpler networks and single-head attention to components that are much closer to LLM practice, especially multi-head attention and MoE.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates conservation-law discovery as a system of partial differential equations. For a smooth function C(θ) to be conserved under gradient flow, its gradient must be orthogonal to the vector field induced by the training loss. Under assumptions inherited from prior characterization work, the authors prove completeness: the listed invariants exhaust the admissible smooth conservation laws, rather than being isolated examples. The analysis covers three families. First, feed-forward networks with smooth and gated activations, including GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU. Second, multi-head attention, with extensions to sinusoidal positional encodings and rotary embeddings. Third, MoE architectures under dense and sparse regimes, including softmax, sigmoid, and normalized-sigmoid gating. The main distinction from earlier work is the move from illustrative invariants to complete characterizations for architectures used in modern large-scale models.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments validate the predicted invariants rather than optimize task performance. The paper tracks the relevant conserved quantities for the considered feed-forward, attention, and MoE architectures under both full-batch training and SGD. The described experimental suite includes small and larger multimodal datasets. The verifiable takeaway is that the invariants behave as predicted under full-batch gradient descent and remain approximately meaningful under SGD. The provided content does not contain reliable numeric details on model size, data scale, or measured drift, so the result should be read as theoretical validation with empirical checks rather than as an engineering benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with Section 3 to understand the reduction from conservation laws to PDE constraints. Then read the three parts of Section 4: feed-forward blocks with modern activations, multi-head attention with positional encodings, and MoE gating. For LLM pretraining, Sections 4.2 and 4.3 are the most relevant. Section 5 is worth reading for proof ideas and limitations, especially before extrapolating gradient-flow results to AdamW, large batches, mixed precision, and distributed training. Section 6 can be read quickly to check whether the invariants remain empirically visible under SGD.

recommendation.zh: 训练动态机制的扎实理论工作，重点关注MoE和RoPE部分的守恒律推导，可用于解释预训练中的隐式正则化现象，读§3-§4即可。
recommendation.en: Solid theoretical work on training dynamics; focus on MoE and RoPE conservation law derivations to explain implicit regularization in pretraining, read §3-§4 only.

paper.title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces analogous to biological memory units remains an open question. This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such "AI engrams" by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem. We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters,

summary.core_problem: 深度神经网络（包括LLM）中是否存在类似生物记忆单元的可识别记忆痕迹（Engram），以及如何在不进行迭代优化的情况下对特定记忆进行精准操作，是尚未解决的核心问题。
summary.importance: 原理分析+方法创新，首次将神经科学的记忆痕迹标准形式化为约束逆问题，推导闭式记忆痕迹估计器，实现无迭代优化的记忆精准操作，架起生物记忆理论与人工表示学习的桥梁。
summary.technical_approach: 将神经科学的记忆四标准（特异性、再激活、充分性、必要性）形式化为参数流形上的约束逆问题，推导闭式AI Engram估计器（对应自然梯度更新），通过线性算术操作实现记忆的组合与擦除，无需迭代微调。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖简单MLP到LLM，验证AI Engram的因果有效性和可扩展性，可精准擦除或组合特定记忆子集，无明显性能下降。

summary_en.core_problem: It remains an open question whether deep neural networks (including LLMs) contain identifiable memory traces (engrams) analogous to biological memory units, and how to precisely manipulate specific memories (compose, erase) without iterative optimization.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis + methodological innovation; first formalizes neuroscientific engram criteria as a constrained inverse problem, derives a closed-form engram estimator, and enables iteration-free memory manipulation, bridging biological memory theory and artificial representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes four neuroscientific engram criteria (specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, necessity) as a constrained inverse problem on the parameter manifold, derives a closed-form AI engram estimator corresponding to natural gradient updates, and enables memory composition/erasure via linear arithmetic without iterative fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Validates on models ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs, demonstrating causal validity and scalability of AI engrams; specific memory subsets can be erased or composed precisely with no significant performance degradation.

recommendation.zh: 记忆机制的重要工作，闭式Engram估计和线性擦除记忆的结论非常有价值，重点看§3的推导和§5的LLM实验部分。
recommendation.en: Important work on memory mechanisms; closed-form engram estimation and linear memory erasure results are highly valuable, focus on §3 derivation and §5 LLM experiments.

paper.title: Contrastive-Difference CKA Reveals Concept-Specific Structural Alignment Across Language Model Architectures
paper.abstract: Do different LLM architectures encode high-level concepts in structurally compatible ways? We systematically characterize a geometric-functional universality dissociation: across multiple concept domains and architectural families, moderate geometric convergence coexists with near-perfect functional transfer. Using contrastive-difference CKA (CKA_Delta), a training-free diagnostic that computes kernel alignment on per-sample contrastive differences, we isolate concept-specific convergence from g

summary.core_problem: 不同 LLM 架构是否以结构上兼容的方式编码高层概念，以及这种结构相似性与功能可迁移性是否一致。
summary.importance: 贡献是提出一个训练无关的表征诊断工具 CKA_Delta，并给出一个有意思的结论：几何结构收敛并不强，但功能迁移几乎可以对齐。这对表征比较、蒸馏、跨架构迁移和机制解释都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 contrastive-difference CKA（CKA_Delta），不是直接比较原始激活，而是比较按样本构造的对比差分表示，从而把概念相关的结构对齐从通用相似性中分离出来。随后在多个概念域和多种架构家族上测量几何对齐与功能转移之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 覆盖六个概念域，包括 code-vs-NL、reasoning-vs-recall 和 safety 等；结果显示标准 CKA 难以区分概念特异对齐，而 CKA_Delta 能显著分辨。作者报告在多个概念上几何收敛中等，但功能转移接近完美；另有一个 70B-70B 配对提示规模增大时 universality 可能增强，但证据仍偏观察性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether different LLM architectures encode high-level concepts in structurally compatible ways, and whether structural similarity tracks functional transfer.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is CKA_Delta, a training-free representation diagnostic, plus an interesting empirical claim: geometric convergence is only moderate while functional transfer is nearly perfect. This is relevant to representation comparison, distillation, cross-architecture transfer, and interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces contrastive-difference CKA, which compares per-sample contrastive differences rather than raw activations, aiming to isolate concept-specific structural alignment from generic similarity. The authors then measure geometric alignment and functional transfer across multiple concept domains and architecture families.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers six concept domains, including code-vs-natural-language, reasoning-vs-recall, and safety. Standard CKA shows weak discrimination, while CKA_Delta provides significant concept-specific separation. The main empirical pattern is moderate geometric convergence alongside near-perfect functional transfer. A single 70B-70B comparison suggests universality may strengthen with scale, but that part remains observational.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会改你看表征对齐的 prior：先看 CKA_Delta 定义和六个概念实验，别被“高功能迁移=高几何相似”这个旧直觉带偏。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training recipe, but it should update your prior on representation alignment: read the CKA_Delta definition and the six concept-domain results.

paper.title: Cascaded Sparse Autoencoders Learn Multi-Level Visual Concepts in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on vision-language tasks, yet their internal visual representations remain difficult to interpret. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) provide a scalable way to decompose dense model activations into sparse, interpretable features. However, existing SAE architectures primarily recover flat feature dictionaries and are less suited for explicit multi-level concept organization. In this paper, we introduce cascaded sparse autoenco

summary.core_problem: 研究如何用稀疏自编码器解释多模态 LLM 内部的视觉表征，并显式恢复多层级视觉概念结构。
summary.importance: 这是 MLLM 机制解释工作，贡献在于把 SAE 从扁平特征字典推进到层级概念组织。它不直接改进预训练 recipe，但有助于理解视觉 token / cross-modal 表征在大模型内部如何形成抽象。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cascaded Sparse Autoencoders。第一层 SAE 从 MLLM 激活中学习低层视觉特征方向；第二层 SAE 不直接接第一层稀疏 activation code，而是训练在第一层 SAE 的 decoder weights 上，把已学到的低层 feature directions 当作输入，从而学习“概念的概念”。作者强调这不同于 nested SAE、Matryoshka 式层级或朴素 stacked SAE，可避免共享前缀耦合和中间瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM、参数规模、视觉任务、数据集和量化结果。实验应主要围绕层级概念可解释性、特征可视化、与 flat SAE / nested / stacked SAE 的对比展开，但具体效果需要读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how sparse autoencoders can make visual representations inside multimodal LLMs interpretable while recovering an explicit hierarchy of visual concepts.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability contribution for MLLMs. It extends SAEs from flat feature dictionaries toward hierarchical concept organization, which is relevant for understanding how visual tokens and cross-modal abstractions are represented in large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Cascaded Sparse Autoencoder first learns low-level visual feature directions from MLLM activations. A second-level SAE is then trained directly on the decoder weights of the first-level SAE, treating learned feature directions as inputs for higher-level abstraction. This differs from nested, Matryoshka-style, or naively stacked SAEs and is intended to avoid shared-prefix coupling and activation bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the MLLM backbone, parameter scale, datasets, or quantitative gains. The evaluation likely focuses on hierarchical concept interpretability and comparisons with flat, nested, and stacked SAE variants, but the exact evidence needs the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和层级特征案例即可；若结论站得住，它会影响 MLLM 表征诊断时 SAE 该接哪里。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and hierarchy visualizations; if the evidence is clean, it changes where SAEs should be attached for MLLM representation diagnostics.

paper.title: The Importance of Phase in Neural Representations: An Internal Oppenheim-Lim Test of Image Classifiers
paper.abstract: Oppenheim and Lim (1981) showed that natural images stay recognizable when reconstructed from their Fourier phase alone, while the magnitude carries little of their identity. We ask whether trained image classifiers reproduce this asymmetry inside their hidden layers, and we test it causally: given two images, we transplant the phase of one onto the magnitude of the other at a chosen layer and record which image the prediction follows. In PRISM2D, GFNet, and ViT-B/16 the prediction follows the p

summary.core_problem: 探究训练好的图像分类器在其隐藏层中是否重现了自然图像在傅里叶相位和幅度上的不对称性（即相位携带更多身份信息）。
summary.importance: 通过因果干预实验（内部 Oppenheim-Lim 测试），揭示了不同架构（如 ViT、ResNet）在处理图像特征时的内部机制，特别是相位信息在模型预测中的主导作用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种内部 Oppenheim-Lim 测试：在模型的特定层，将一张图像的相位移植到另一张图像的幅度上，观察模型的预测结果跟随哪张图像。对 PRISM2D、GFNet、ViT-B/16 和 ResNet-50 进行了测试。
summary.experiments: 在 PRISM2D、GFNet 和 ViT-B/16 中，预测结果跟随相位提供者；在 ResNet-50 中，在 ReLU 之前的干预揭示了晚期块中强烈的潜在符号编码，表明身份信息主要依赖于相位/符号。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating whether trained image classifiers reproduce the asymmetry of natural images in Fourier phase and magnitude (i.e., phase carries more identity information) within their hidden layers.
summary_en.importance: Through causal intervention experiments (internal Oppenheim-Lim test), it reveals the internal mechanisms of different architectures (e.g., ViT, ResNet) in processing image features, especially the dominant role of phase information in model predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an internal Oppenheim-Lim test: at a chosen layer of the model, transplanting the phase of one image onto the magnitude of another, and observing which image the prediction follows. Tested on PRISM2D, GFNet, ViT-B/16, and ResNet-50.
summary_en.experiments: In PRISM2D, GFNet, and ViT-B/16, the prediction follows the phase donor; in ResNet-50, intervention before ReLU reveals a strong latent sign code in late blocks, indicating identity mainly relies on phase/sign.

recommendation.zh: 关于视觉模型内部特征表示的机制分析，揭示了相位信息的主导作用，对理解多模态模型中的视觉编码器有一定参考价值，可快速浏览实验结论。
recommendation.en: Mechanism analysis on internal feature representations of vision models, revealing the dominant role of phase information. Offers some reference value for understanding vision encoders in multimodal models. Skim the experimental conclusions.

paper.title: Neither Parallel Nor Sequential: How DiffusionGemma Actually Commits Tokens
paper.abstract: Open diffusion language models are marketed as parallel, non-autoregressive decoders, yet the order in which a shipped checkpoint actually commits its tokens is almost never measured. We instrument DiffusionGemma 26B, a masked discrete-diffusion mixture-of-experts model built on Gemma 4, hooking its sampler's accept step to record which canvas positions commit, when, and at what confidence. Across a 686-prompt, six-regime probe suite we find that its decoding is neither parallel nor block-autore

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答一个很具体但常被默认跳过的问题：开放的 diffusion language model 在真实推理时，到底按什么顺序“提交”token。论文研究的不是训练算法，而是一个已发布 checkpoint 的解码行为：google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it，一个基于 Gemma 4 的 masked discrete diffusion MoE 模型，25.2B 总参数、3.8B 激活参数、8-of-128 expert routing。作者指出，DLM 常被描述成并行、非自回归解码器，但“架构允许并行”和“模型实际并行提交”不是一回事。真实提交顺序由模型、sampler、停止准则共同决定，需要直接测量。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模研究的价值在于，它把 diffusion LM 的一个核心承诺拆成了可观测量。DLM 的低延迟潜力通常来自多位置并行提交；如果实际 checkpoint 在许多任务上呈现较强的左到右偏置，吞吐和延迟分析就不能只看理论 denoising 步数。论文的结论也约束了后续建模判断：DiffusionGemma 既不是严格 AR，也不是完全 order-independent，而是有粒度依赖的部分左到右提交偏置。这个结果对 DLM 训练目标、sampler 设计、评测协议都有启发。尤其是它提醒研究者，不要用粗 bin 或肉眼样例把模型误读成 block-autoregressive；同一个生成过程在 token 级、bin 级、accept-call 级会呈现不同结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是纯 inference instrumentation，不训练、不微调。作者 hook 了 transformers denoising loop 中的 EntropyBoundSampler.accept_canvas，在每次 accept-call 记录哪些 canvas 位置被提交，以及这些位置的 per-position entropy。这里的“提交”指 sampler 接受某些位置的当前预测并写入生成 canvas。基于这些 trace，论文计算提交顺序与左到右位置顺序之间的 tie-aware Kendall tau_b。tie-aware 很关键，因为一次 accept-call 往往会同时提交十几个到二十几个 token，同一 call 内没有可解析的先后顺序。作者还做了不同 bin size 下的顺序相关性分析，用来区分 token 级无序、粗粒度左到右、以及真正的 block-sequential。为避免伪结论，论文显式处理了 EOS padding artifact、跨 regime pooling 导致的 Simpson's paradox、commit non-monotonicity、block-size sensitivity 和 same-call ties。与常见只看输出文本的分析不同，这篇论文测的是 sampler 内部实际接受 token 的时刻，因此更接近推理系统真正执行的生成路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 686 个 prompt、6 类 regime。强化实验设置为 5 个 seed，每个 regime 20 个 prompt，共 100 条 trace/regime，并用 prompt-clustered bootstrap 给出置信区间。主要结果是：除 JSON 外，多数 regime 在 token 级呈中等左到右偏置，prose、code、math、factual 等 regime 的 tie-aware Kendall tau_b 约为 0.43 到 0.60。随着分析 bin 变粗，左到右相关性平滑上升，例如 R1 从 bin=4 的 0.59 升到 bin=64 的 0.91，但在 16-token 附近没有跳变。这说明 16 更像分析者选择的 bin，不是模型内部固定 block。真实 token order 明显低于纯 block-sequential control，后者约 0.94 到 0.96，说明子 block 内有实际无序。每次 accept-call 平均提交约 13 到 26 个 content token，同 call tie 比例较大，因此 token 级顺序只能在 accept-call 分辨率上测量。JSON regime 很不同，token tau_b=-0.044，95% CI 为 [-0.086, -0.00]，更接近 order-independent，而不是强非顺序。置信度与正确性的关系也依赖任务：在 GSM8K 上，commit confidence 即负熵对正确性有区分度，AUROC=0.749，95% CI [0.602, 0.879]，按 entropy tertile 看 reliability 单调；在 factual recall 上 AUROC=0.471，95% CI [0.383, 0.544]，基本没有可用信号。生成通常在很少的 accept-call 内完成，远低于 48-step budget，且接受时 entropy 远低于 0.1 bound。可评分 regime 上，DiffusionGemma 的任务准确率与 AR sibling Gemma-4 26B-A4B 接近，但作者明确说明实验没有为 equivalence test 做功效设计。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 §5.1 和 §6.1。§5.1 是核心，重点看 token-level tau_b、bin-size 曲线、block-sequential control、commit batch size 和 JSON regime 的对照。这里能看清为什么“部分左到右偏置”比“block-autoregressive”更准确。§5.2 建议看 confidence-correctness 分析，尤其是 GSM8K 与 factual recall 的差异；它说明 entropy 不是通用 correctness proxy，跨任务合并会掩盖机制。§6.1 值得细看，里面列出的 EOS padding、same-call ties、block-size sensitivity、Simpson's paradox 都是后续 DLM commit-order 研究容易踩的坑。若时间有限，先读 Introduction 的 falsifiable claims，再读 §5.1 的图表和 §6.1 的 methodology caveats。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important empirical question: when an open diffusion language model is actually run, in what order does it commit tokens? The target is google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it, a masked discrete-diffusion MoE model built on Gemma 4, with 25.2B total parameters and 3.8B active parameters through 8-of-128 expert routing. The study separates architectural possibility from runtime behavior. A DLM can denoise many positions in parallel, but the checkpoint and sampler may still produce a partially ordered commitment process.
summary_en.importance: The result is useful for researchers working on non-AR language modeling because it turns a common claim about diffusion LMs into a measurable property. Parallel denoising is often used to motivate lower latency, but latency depends on how many positions are accepted per step and whether commitment is truly out of order. The main finding is not that DiffusionGemma behaves like an AR model, nor that it is fully order-independent. It shows a partial, granularity-dependent left-to-right bias. This matters for sampler design, training objective analysis, and evaluation protocols for DLMs. It also cautions against reading coarse-bin traces as evidence of clean block-autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work is inference-only. The authors do not train or fine-tune the model. They instrument the denoising loop by hooking EntropyBoundSampler.accept_canvas and record, for each accept-call, the canvas positions that become committed and the entropy at those positions. Commitment order is then measured with tie-aware Kendall tau_b between position order and accept order. The tie-aware treatment is necessary because a single accept-call often commits many positions, and positions committed in the same call have no observable internal order. The paper also studies bin-size dependence, compares the observed order against a pure block-sequential control, and analyzes whether negative entropy at commit time predicts correctness. A notable part of the methodology is its handling of artifacts: EOS padding, cross-regime pooling, commit non-monotonicity, block-size sensitivity, and same-call ties.
summary_en.experiments: The probe suite contains 686 prompts across six regimes. The strengthened run uses 5 seeds and 20 prompts per regime, giving 100 traces per regime, with prompt-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals. For prose, code, math, and factual regimes, token-level tie-aware Kendall tau_b is moderate, roughly 0.43 to 0.60. The ordering becomes more left-to-right as the analysis bin gets coarser; for example, in R1, tau_b rises from 0.59 at bin size 4 to 0.91 at bin size 64. There is no discontinuity at 16 tokens, so 16 is not supported as a privileged architectural block. The observed order remains below a pure block-sequential control, which is around 0.94 to 0.96, indicating real sub-block disorder. Accept batches are large, around 13 to 26 content tokens per call, so many token pairs are tied. The JSON regime is different: token tau_b is -0.044 with a 95% CI of [-0.086, -0.00], which is closer to order-independent behavior. Commit confidence is predictive on GSM8K, with AUROC 0.749 and a 95% CI of [0.602, 0.879], but not on factual recall, where AUROC is 0.471 with a 95% CI of [0.383, 0.544]. Generations typically finish in a small number of accept-calls, far below the 48-step budget, and at entropy well below the 0.1 bound. On scorable regimes, accuracy is comparable to the matched AR sibling Gemma-4 26B-A4B, although the comparison is not powered as an equivalence test.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 5.1 closely. The key evidence is in the token-level tau_b values, the bin-size curves, the block-sequential control, and the commit-batch statistics. These pieces explain why the right description is partial left-to-right bias rather than clean block autoregression. Section 5.2 is useful for understanding when entropy can be used as a correctness signal; the contrast between GSM8K and factual recall is the main point. Section 6.1 is worth reading for methodology. Its discussion of EOS padding, same-call ties, Simpson's paradox under regime pooling, and block-size sensitivity is directly relevant to future studies of diffusion LM decoding behavior.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻扩散 LM 并行/块 AR 的二元 prior，所有做非 AR 文本建模范式的人都应立刻复现其 instrumentation 方法。
recommendation.en: Directly falsifies the parallel vs block-AR prior for diffusion LMs; anyone working on non-autoregressive text modeling should immediately reproduce its sampler instrumentation.

paper.title: S$^2$COPE: Self-Supervised Concept Discovery via Preference Learning
paper.abstract: Current representation learning paradigms force a fundamental compromise: self-supervised methods scale to massive datasets but yield opaque features, whereas interpretable models remain bottlenecked by the need for dense human annotation. We introduce Self-Supervised Concept discOvery via Preference lEarning (\model), a label-free framework that resolves this dilemma. Instead of treating Vision-Large-Language Models (VLLMs) as static feature extractors, \model leverages them as active participa

summary.core_problem: 在没有人工概念标注的情况下，从原始图像中发现可解释、结构化、领域相关的视觉概念。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLLM 辅助的自监督概念发现方法。它和 LLM 基座预训练没有直接关系，但对多模态模型的表示可解释性、偏好信号如何进入视觉-语言模型有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S2COPE，即 Self-Supervised Concept Discovery via Preference Learning。方法不把 VLLM 仅作为冻结特征抽取器，而是让模型参与一个自监督偏好优化循环：自动提出候选视觉属性，验证这些属性是否能解释图像差异，再强化更稳定、更有区分度的概念。摘要还提到会把概念发现过程摊入 VLLM backbone 中，但未给出完整实现细节。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖自然图像、医学图像和物理领域。摘要称该方法能发现标准 VLLM 往往难以生成的领域特定概念，但未提供模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 列表、指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets label-free discovery of interpretable, structured, domain-relevant visual concepts from raw images.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLLM-assisted self-supervised concept discovery method. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal representation interpretability and the use of preference signals inside vision-language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: S2COPE treats VLLMs as active participants rather than static feature extractors. It runs a self-supervised preference optimization loop that proposes candidate visual attributes, validates whether they explain image variation, and reinforces concepts that are stable and discriminative. The abstract also suggests amortizing concept discovery into the VLLM backbone, but implementation details are not visible in the provided text.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span natural, medical, and physics domains. The abstract claims that S2COPE discovers domain-specific concepts that standard VLLMs often fail to generate, but it does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baseline details, metrics, or improvement numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看偏好循环设计和失败案例即可；它给 VLM 表示学习一点旁证，但离基座预训练 recipe 还远。
recommendation.en: Read only the preference-loop design and failure cases; it offers a small signal for VLM representation learning, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Adversarial Concept Search: Predicting Compositional Errors From Feature Geometry
paper.abstract: Humans cannot always intuit what scenarios are most challenging to LLMs. Hoping to capture challenging edge cases, developers either design problems to be difficult for humans or curate extensive benchmarks. What if we could instead anticipate which scenarios a model will fail on? In this paper, we use an LLM's representational geometry to predict which concept combinations it will fail on. We attribute this compositional failure to interference between salient features. In tasks that require sy

summary.core_problem: 在不枚举具体输入、不运行“组合任务”评测的前提下，仅根据模型内部对“原子概念”的表示，预测模型在“概念组合”场景下会不会失败，并据此做定向的压力测试/数据采集优先级排序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练目标，而在于提供一种“从表示几何预测泛化失败”的可操作信号：它把组合泛化失败与特征超位置（superposition）下的干扰联系起来，并给出可测量的几何指标（角度/相似度）来定位薄弱概念对。对数据侧的启发更明确：可以把几何干扰当作主动学习/数据补齐的排序器，用更少的生成与标注成本去覆盖模型最可能出错的组合区域。局限也清楚：它更像诊断与选样工具，而不是直接改善预训练的算法；并且依赖“可抽取的原子概念表示”这一前提，概念定义与抽取方式会显著影响结论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Adversarial Concept Search (ACS)：给定一组概念（如实体、关系、语言、推理子任务等），先为每个“原子概念”构造其在模型中的线性表示方向，然后用这些方向之间的几何关系预测“组合后是否会失败”。论文的机制假设是“有损超位置导致的组合干扰”：理论上在k-稀疏激活下，非正交特征也可被无损解码；但真实LLM的解码是有损的，当多个任务相关特征同时激活且其线性方向接近时，会发生干扰，导致组合失败。落地上，作者在不同任务里定义了不同的‘原子表示’抽取方式：
- 在受控的组合基准（SCAN）里，概念更接近离散指令/原语，便于测量概念对的交互与角度，并把角度与组合错误率做相关分析。
- 在多跳QA里，把两跳问题拆成两个单跳子问题，分别得到“单跳表示”，再用两者的夹角/相似度预测两跳组合是否成功。
- 在多语事实回忆里，把“事实表示”与“语言子空间/语言方向”的几何关系作为检索/回忆成功率的预测因子。
整体区别于常见的 error prediction / active learning：后者通常需要具体输入、需要跑模型得到不确定性或损失；ACS试图在‘输入生成之前’只用概念描述与原子表示做排序，从而把成本从‘枚举输入并推理’前移到‘少量探测/抽取表示’。
summary.experiments:
全文主线实验是“角度越大（越接近正交）→组合越可靠；角度越小（方向接近）→更易失败”。作者在三个层级验证：
1) SCAN 受控实验：在不同数据条件与模型规模下，测得概念对角度与组合泛化错误显著相关，并用来预测哪些组合指令会失败。
2) 多跳QA：用两个单跳组件的表示几何预测两跳是否答对，展示无需直接评测两跳输入也能提前筛出高风险组合。
3) 多语事实回忆：用事实表示与语言子空间的几何关系预测在特定语言下的回忆准确率，用于指出“哪些事实×语言”组合更脆弱。
给定你提供的全文片段未包含表格与具体数值页，无法可靠复述参数量、数据规模、提升幅度等精确数字；若需要精确数字，需要补充论文PDF中的实验表/附录页。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 ACS 的定义与“无需具体输入”的动机，确认它解决的是‘选样/诊断’而非‘训练改进’。
- 精看“Compositionality and Lossy Superposition”一节：这里给出机制假设（k-稀疏下理论可无损，但现实有损→干扰由角度主导），决定了方法适用边界。
- 然后按任务看实验：先看 SCAN（最干净，最能判断假设是否成立），再看多跳QA与多语事实回忆（看作者如何定义‘原子概念表示’以及这种定义是否稳健）。
- 阅读时重点追问两点：原子概念表示是如何抽取/线性化的（prompt、层选择、聚合方式、去除共变因素等），以及角度指标是否只是相关而非因果（作者是否做了控制变量或干预实验）。

summary_en.core_problem: Predict compositional failure cases of an LLM without enumerating concrete inputs or evaluating the composed tasks, by using only the model’s internal representations of the constituent atomic concepts.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a diagnosis-and-selection tool than a new pretraining algorithm. Its practical contribution to pretraining workflows is a measurable signal (representation geometry, e.g., angles/similarity) that can rank “high-risk concept combinations” for targeted stress testing and data acquisition. The main value is on the data side: it suggests an active-learning-like prioritization scheme that operates before generating/collecting expensive inputs. The main caveat is that everything hinges on how “atomic concepts” are defined and how their directions are extracted; that design choice can dominate the results and limits portability across domains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper frames Adversarial Concept Search (ACS): given a set of concepts, extract a linear direction/encoding for each atomic concept from the model, then use pairwise geometry (primarily angular separation) to predict whether composing those concepts will succeed. The mechanism hypothesis is “lossy superposition causes interference”: while sparse feature activations can in principle allow lossless decoding even with non-orthogonal features, real models decode imperfectly; when multiple task-relevant features are simultaneously active and their directions are too aligned, they interfere and compositional generalization fails.
Operationally, the paper instantiates ‘atomic representations’ differently per task:
- In SCAN, atomic primitives are cleanly defined, enabling direct measurement of concept-pair interactions and angles.
- In multi-hop QA, a two-hop question is decomposed into two single-hop components; the angle between the two single-hop representations predicts whether the composed two-hop query will be answered correctly.
- In multilingual factual recall, geometry between fact representations and language subspaces/directions is used to predict recall accuracy for fact×language combinations.
The key distinction from standard error prediction/active learning is that ACS aims to work without running the model on candidate composed inputs; it tries to rank failure-prone scenarios “upstream” using concept-level probes.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical claim is consistent across settings: larger angular separation (more orthogonal) correlates with more reliable composition; smaller angles correlate with failures.
- Controlled SCAN experiments validate the correlation across data regimes and model sizes, and show predictability of which compositions fail.
- Multi-hop QA shows that geometry between single-hop components predicts success on the composed query, without directly evaluating the composed task during the search step.
- Multilingual factual recall uses fact–language geometry to anticipate which facts will be poorly recalled in which languages.
The provided full-content excerpt does not include the quantitative tables/figures, so exact parameter counts, dataset sizes, and numeric deltas cannot be stated reliably from the current material.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction to pin down the goal: pre-input scenario ranking, not training-time improvement.
- Focus on the section explaining “Compositionality and Lossy Superposition”; it defines the causal story and the method’s applicability limits.
- Then read experiments in order: SCAN first (cleanest test of the hypothesis), then multi-hop QA and multilingual recall (to see how they operationalize ‘atomic concept directions’ in realistic settings).
While reading, scrutinize (i) how atomic directions are extracted (prompts, layer choice, aggregation, controls), and (ii) whether the evidence goes beyond correlation (any controlled interventions or confound checks).

recommendation.zh: 将组合泛化失败与内部特征的正交性联系起来，为理解 LLM 的幻觉和推理错误提供了一个很干净的机制解释，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Links compositional generalization failure to the orthogonality of internal features, providing a clean mechanistic explanation for LLM hallucinations and reasoning errors; worth reading.

paper.title: Can Editing 1 Neuron Fix Repetition Loops in LLMs?
paper.abstract: Yes. Can it cure doom loops? Probably not.   The Gemma 4 instruction-tuned models share a reproducible failure: on long factual enumeration prompts, such as listing every episode of a TV series, the 88 IAU constellations, or the 151 original Pokemon, they collapse into repetition, either a tight verbatim loop or a list whose entries decay onto a single answer. These loops occur at rates as high as 95% and survive prompt rewording, inference-engine changes, and most sampling adjustments. In this

summary.core_problem: Gemma 4 instruction 模型在长事实枚举任务上会高概率进入重复失败：一类是短语级 verbatim 死循环，另一类是列表表面结构保持但内容坍缩到少数条目。论文追问这种失败是否足够局部，能否通过小规模权重编辑直接修复。
summary.importance: 这不是一篇预训练方法论文，但和训练后模型失效模式、机制可定位性、以及 post-training 缺陷如何在权重空间中结晶有关。对基座研究者的价值主要在两点：一是看到某些高层生成故障确实集中在非常小的 MLP/MoE 子集中，二是看到这种局部性随模型尺度和架构而变，并不总能用“万能单神经元开关”解释。对思考 repetition、doom loop、长序列 factual recall 与 attention/MLP 分工有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把失败分成 tight loop 和 soft loop 两类，并构造 prompt-agnostic 的检测器。然后用逐层消融和逐神经元归因定位候选位点，再通过完整生成 sweep 验证，而不是只看中间激活相关性。尝试的手术包括 MLP 神经元置零、符号翻转、放大，以及 MoE expert slot mask。关键设计是先定位再做生成级确认，避免只根据激活相关性误判。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 Gemma 4 的四个 instruction 模型：E2B-it、E4B-it、31B-it、26B-A4B-it。默认采样下，最严重的 31B 在列举《火线》全集时失败率可达 95%。权重手术的规模很小且因模型而异：E2B 改 1 个 MLP 神经元即可基本消除观测到的 loop；E4B 需要 3 个神经元；31B 需要约 1100 个神经元；26B MoE 需要在 3840 个 layer-expert slot 中 mask 掉 3 个 routed expert 位置。编辑后常规 benchmark 性能只有很小百分点变化。论文还区分了可手术修复的 loop 和更大模型在长生成预算下残留的 doom/self-correction 状态，认为后者更像事实知识本身不足，不是局部回路问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 failure phenotype 的定义、定位方法、以及四个模型所需编辑规模为什么不同。最值得注意的不是“1 neuron fix”这个标题式结论，而是图/表里体现的异质性：dense 与 MoE、小模型与大模型，重复机制的分布并不统一。doom loop 与 factual limitation 的区分也值得看。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Edgerunner AI；并提供了四个 noloop 编辑模型的 Hugging Face 权重。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemma 4 instruction-tuned models exhibit reproducible repetition failures on long factual enumeration prompts: either tight verbatim loops or softer list collapse where entries decay onto repeated answers. The paper asks whether this failure is localized enough to be removed by small targeted weight edits.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it bears on how post-training failures crystallize in model weights and how interpretable/localized those mechanisms are. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful questions are whether high-level generation pathologies can sit in very small MLP or MoE subsets, how that locality changes with scale and architecture, and where a surgically fixable loop ends versus broader factual-recall limitation begins.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first defines two failure phenotypes, tight loops and soft loops, and builds a prompt-agnostic detector. It then uses per-layer ablations and per-neuron attribution to surface candidate sites, followed by full-generation sweeps to confirm that editing those sites actually changes generation behavior. The tested surgeries include MLP neuron zeroing, sign inversion, amplification, and MoE expert-slot masking. The important methodological choice is to validate candidates through end-to-end generation rather than relying only on activation correlations.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four Gemma 4 instruction models: E2B-it, E4B-it, 31B-it, and 26B-A4B-it. Under default sampling, failure rates can be as high as 95% on hard enumeration prompts such as listing every episode of The Wire for the 31B model. The required edits are small but heterogeneous: one MLP neuron suffices in E2B, three neurons in E4B, around 1100 neurons in 31B, and three routed expert positions out of 3840 layer-expert slots in the 26B MoE. Benchmark performance remains within small percentage-point deltas after editing. The paper further separates fixable loops from residual doom/self-correction regimes in the larger models, arguing that the latter reflect factual-knowledge limits rather than a compact removable circuit.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the phenotype definitions, the localization pipeline, and why the required edit size differs across the four models. The headline “1 neuron fix” is less important than the heterogeneity across dense and MoE variants and across scales. Also pay attention to the distinction between surgically removable loops and longer-horizon doom behavior caused by knowledge limits. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Edgerunner AI; edited model variants are released on Hugging Face.

recommendation.zh: 单神经元就能控制系统性重复故障——这个发现很有分量。建议读定位方法和MoE专家分析部分，对理解预训练中知识定位有参考，但权重编辑方案是否通用存疑
recommendation.en: A single neuron controlling a systematic failure mode is a significant finding. Read the localization method and MoE expert analysis; informs knowledge localization in pretraining, though generality of weight-editing cure remains uncertain

paper.title: A theoretical model for task routing in mixture-of-expert transformers
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers enable the scaling of transformer models while keeping the inference compute fixed. While task-expert specialization has been observed in empirical studies of frontier MoE transformer models, existing theoretical work analyzes this using continuous mixture models that cannot be used to model natural language effectively. An important open question is to \textit{theoretically explain task-expert specialization in transformer MoE models using discrete models of lang

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图用离散、语言式的数据模型解释 MoE Transformer 中的 task-expert specialization：为什么不同任务会被路由到不同专家，以及专家容量如何与任务复杂度相关。
summary.importance: 对 MoE 预训练研究的价值主要在理论直觉。现有许多 MoE 专家分化分析基于连续分布或前馈模型，难以对应自然语言中的模板、实体和事实检索。该工作把问题改写成模板加 key-value dictionary 的离散知识模型，给出 attention、router、expert 三者如何分工的构造性解释。它不能直接指导大规模 MoE 训练 recipe，但有助于理解为什么显式路由信号可能比只靠标准语言建模损失更容易形成清晰专家分工。
summary.technical_approach:
作者定义了一个合成知识数据模型。每个任务包含一组 syntactic templates 和一个有限 key-value knowledge table。模板中有两个 wildcard，分别填入 subject 和 object，生成类似事实回忆的数据。任务复杂度由模板规模和知识表大小共同决定。

在该设定下，作者构造单层 Transformer / MoE Transformer。attention 的作用是把句子的结构模板和事实 subject 分开；router 根据关系结构或模板信息把输入分配给任务相关专家；专家再执行任务内部的 associative retrieval，从对应知识表中取回 object。理论部分包括两个核心结果：一个是 dense Transformer 中可形成稀疏功能 circuit，另一个是 MoE Transformer 可用 task-specific experts 表示结构化知识，并且专家规模随任务复杂度增长。
summary.experiments: 实验使用合成知识数据，主要验证路由行为是否与理论构造一致。结果显示，显式 task-aware routing objective 会产生更清晰的 task-expert alignment；只使用标准目标时，也可能出现一定分化，但专家与任务的对应关系更弱、更不稳定。实验没有覆盖真实大规模语言模型，也没有直接给出工业级 MoE 的训练收益，因此结论应限定在理论模型和小规模合成验证范围内。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的数据模型定义，尤其是 template、wildcard、knowledge table 和 task complexity；再看 Theorem 4.2，理解 MoE 中 attention、router、expert 的构造性分工。Section 6 可以快速看实验设置和 task-aware routing objective 对专家分化的影响。证明细节可按需查阅，除非关注 MoE 理论或离散语言模型的可表示性。
