It defines the 'minimal core'—the smallest subset of steps that preserves the original predictive behavior—to quantify overcompleteness in reasoning traces, and explores whether minimal cores reveal a cleaner representation geometry of reasoning (compactness, correctness-separability, intrinsic dimensionality).
summary_en.importance: Three key implications for pretraining research: (1) The finding that 46% of reasoning steps are removable on average has direct implications for process supervision data strategy—not all intermediate steps deserve equal supervision weight. (2) Minimal cores transfer across model families, suggesting a universal reasoning structure exists beneath model-specific stylistic variation. (3) Minimal-core embeddings are more compact, lower-dimensional, and more correctness-informative than full-trace embeddings, providing a new lens for evaluating and compressing reasoning capability. From a data efficiency perspective, if large portions of reasoning traces are redundant, synthetic reasoning training data can be more focused.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method frames trace analysis as a subset-sufficiency problem. Given model M, input x, and full trace z=(r1,...,rT), the method checks for each subset S⊆[T] whether the model's prediction conditioned on x+z_S matches the prediction conditioned on the full trace. A greedy deletion algorithm (iteratively removing the step whose deletion least affects prediction) extracts minimal cores. Metrics include compression ratio, redundancy mass, step necessity, and necessity concentration. The paper provides theoretical guarantees for existence, local minimality under greedy deletion, overcompleteness certificates, and sparse-necessity structure. For representation geometry, it analyzes embedding space properties of full traces, minimal cores, and removed steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across six deliberative reasoning benchmarks: GSM8K (arithmetic), MATH500, AIME24, AMC23 (competition math), GPQA-Diamond (expert scientific reasoning), and StrategyQA (commonsense multi-hop QA). Across model families, greedy minimal-core extraction removes 46% of steps on average while largely preserving the full-trace answer. Predictive support is concentrated in a small number of steps (high necessity concentration). Minimal cores transfer across model families—a core extracted from model A preserves prediction on model B. Representation geometry analysis shows minimal-core embeddings are more compact, lower-dimensional, and more correctness-informative than either full-trace or removed-step embeddings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 1 for the conceptual framework of overcomplete reasoning traces and motivation. Chapter 2 formalizes minimal cores, metrics, and theoretical guarantees—this is the methodological core. The experimental results (Chapter 3) with the 46% average removability finding and necessity concentration analysis are the key empirical contributions. The representation geometry section (Chapter 4) adds embedding-space insights. Prioritize: overcompleteness quantification per benchmark, necessity concentration visualizations, and cross-model transfer experiments. Reading time: 25-35 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not fully specified; one author notes work done while at UMD (University of Maryland)

recommendation.zh: CoT冗余度的量化结果可用于优化推理预训练的数据筛选，仅看第3节度量定义和第4节实验统计即可
recommendation.en: Quantified CoT redundancy results can inform reasoning pretraining data filtering, only read Section 3 for metrics and Section 4 for experimental stats

paper.title: Revealing Interpretable Failure Modes of VLMs
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in safety-critical applications because of their broad reasoning capabilities and ability to generalize with minimal task-specific engineering. Despite these advantages, they can exhibit catastrophic failures in specific real-world situations, constituting failure modes.   We introduce REVELIO, a framework for systematically uncovering interpretable failure modes in VLMs. We define a failure mode as a composition of interpretable, domain-releva

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“VLM 会不会出错”这个泛问题，而是更具体的一层：如何在黑盒条件下，从一个指数级组合空间里，系统找出“可解释、可复现、贴近真实场景”的失败模式。作者把 failure mode 定义为一组领域概念的合取，例如“近距离行人 + 特定障碍物 + 恶劣天气”，并要求模型在这类场景分布上持续犯错，而不是只在某张图上偶发失误。这个定义刻意避开了像素级对抗攻击那种不自然扰动，也不同于静态 benchmark 只能被动测预设样例。核心难点有三个：概念要能落到真实场景生成上；概念组合空间是离散且带物理约束的；很多目标 VLM 是闭源，只能做黑盒评估。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是新的预训练方法，但对 VLM 预训练和评测接口有直接启发。第一，它把“失败”从单点样本提升到“概念分布上的系统脆弱性”，这比平均 benchmark 分数更接近训练时真正该修补的缺口。第二，它强调场景图级语义而不是像素扰动，给数据构造、困难样本挖掘、持续预训练和安全对齐提供了更可操作的监督单位。第三，它证明即便在黑盒模型上，也能用有限预算找到远多于随机搜索的高价值失败模式，这说明现有 VLM 的错误并不只是长尾噪声，而是有结构的感知盲点。对做预训练的人，最有价值的地方在于：这种 failure mode 可以反过来定义 curriculum、数据重采样和 targeted continued pretraining 的对象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，Revelio 的关键选择是把搜索空间从连续像素空间换成离散语义空间。作者先用 scene graph 来表示图像场景，节点是实体，边是关系，属性描述实体状态；领域概念被定义成 scene graph 的子图模式，例如“行人在车前方且距离近”“存在 barrier 且天气为雨天”。这些概念不是只做标签，而是进一步映射到场景分布：通过 Scenic 这样的场景描述语言，把概念约束编译成仿真器中的可采样 scenario distribution，再由 CARLA 等渲染引擎生成图像。这样评估的对象不是单个实例，而是满足该概念组合的一簇真实可渲染场景。

在搜索层面，作者把问题表述为带兼容性约束的黑盒组合优化。给定一个概念集合，系统从对应场景分布采样若干场景，查询 VLM 在固定任务 prompt 下的行为，估计 failure rate。目标是在预算有限时找到多个高 failure rate 的概念组合，而不是只找一个最坏点。为此设计了两类搜索器。第一类是 diversity-aware beam search：它沿着概念组合逐层扩展，但不仅按当前失败率打分，还显式鼓励结果多样性，避免 beam 全部坍缩到同一类近邻模式，适合快速勾勒 failure landscape。第二类是基于 Gaussian Process 的全局搜索，用 Thompson Sampling 在离散组合空间上做 exploration/exploitation 平衡。GP 负责对未评估组合的失败率做后验建模，Thompson sampling 负责在不确定但可能高风险的区域继续试探。由于概念之间存在物理不兼容，搜索过程中还要满足约束过滤，避免生成不可实现的场景组合。

从系统设计看，这套框架有几个值得注意的点。其一，它是黑盒友好的，不依赖梯度、内部激活或 token 级 logprob，因此可以直接测闭源 VLM。其二，它把“可解释性”前置到搜索对象本身，而不是事后再做 attribution。其三，它是可迁移的：换领域时主要替换概念 taxonomy 和渲染器接口，而不是重写整套方法。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖了至少两个安全相关场景：自动驾驶和室内机器人。定性结果里，作者展示了几类很具体的脆弱性。自动驾驶场景中，VLM 在空间 grounding 上有明显问题，例如面对近距离行人时给出错误的 stop/continue 决策；同时对附近 barrier 等危险元素经常视而不见。室内机器人场景中，则出现另一种模式：模型过度保守，导致性能受损，同时对尖锐物体等风险源识别不足。这一点很重要，因为它说明 failure mode 不只是一边倒的“冒进”，也可能是“过度谨慎但仍不安全”。

定量上，论文最核心的结果是：在相同查询预算下，Revelio 平均能比无引导随机搜索多发现 3 到 5 倍的 failure modes。这个数字说明搜索器确实在利用结构，而不是单纯多试几次。文中还比较了两种搜索策略的角色分工：beam search 更适合快速找到一批高风险模式并覆盖不同区域；GP + Thompson sampling 在预算继续增加时更有利于全局探索和挖掘随机法难碰到的组合。作者还强调 failure mode 的评估是基于场景分布上的一致失败，而不是单样本命中，因此结果比常见 adversarial case study 更稳。

从消融角度，值得注意的不是某个模块带来几点提升，而是几个设计选择共同支撑了“真实且可解释”的目标：如果不用概念级搜索而退回随机场景采样，发现效率明显下降；如果不用多样性约束，搜索结果容易集中在少数相似模式；如果不通过场景分布估计 failure，而只看个别样本，得到的模式稳定性会差很多。摘要里没有给出更细的样本数、模型名和每个 benchmark 的绝对错误率，全文阅读时应重点核对这些表格和附录设置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓定义，再看搜索器，最后看案例。优先看 Introduction 和方法部分里对 failure mode 的形式化定义，尤其是“概念子图 → 场景分布 → 黑盒 failure rate 估计”这条链路，这是整篇文章真正的新意。然后看两种搜索算法的设计动机：为什么 beam search 里要加 diversity，为什么还需要 GP/Thompson sampling 这种更全局的策略。实验部分建议重点看自动驾驶案例，因为那里最能体现 spatial grounding 的系统性缺陷；再看室内机器人案例，理解作者为什么把“过度保守”也视为 failure mode。若时间有限，预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；若要判断它能否用于数据闭环，需再看附录里概念兼容性约束、采样预算和 failure 统计置信度的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific problem in VLM evaluation: how to systematically uncover realistic, interpretable, and repeatable failure modes under black-box access. Instead of asking whether a VLM fails on isolated examples, it defines a failure mode as a conjunction of domain concepts—such as pedestrian proximity, barrier type, and weather condition—under which the model fails consistently over a scenario distribution. This is a different target from static benchmarks, which only test predefined cases, and from adversarial attacks, which often leave the natural data manifold. The hard part is that the search space is exponentially large, concept combinations must remain physically compatible, and many target VLMs are closed-source.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it reframes evaluation in a way that can feed back into data and training. The main contribution is moving from sample-level errors to distribution-level semantic failure modes. That matters for VLM pretraining because these modes are much closer to actionable training units: they can define targeted data collection, hard-example mining, curriculum design, and continued pretraining objectives. The paper also shows that many VLM failures are structured rather than random long-tail noise. If a black-box search can repeatedly surface the same semantic blind spots, then those blind spots are likely tied to representation and training data gaps, not just unlucky prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Revelio shifts the search space from continuous pixels to discrete semantics. Images are abstracted as scene graphs with entities, relations, and attributes. Domain concepts are defined as subgraph patterns, for example a pedestrian in front of the ego vehicle at close range, or a barrier co-occurring with rainy weather. These concepts are not used merely as annotations. They are compiled into scenario distributions through a scene specification layer, using Scenic and a renderer such as CARLA. As a result, the unit of evaluation is not a single rendered image but a family of physically plausible scenes satisfying the same semantic constraints.

The search problem is formulated as black-box constrained combinatorial optimization. For any candidate concept set, the framework samples scenarios from the corresponding distribution, queries the VLM with a task prompt, and estimates a failure rate. The objective is to discover multiple high-risk concept combinations under a limited query budget. To do that, the paper introduces two search procedures. The first is a diversity-aware beam search. It expands concept combinations greedily, but the scoring is not based on failure rate alone; it also encourages diversity so that the beam does not collapse onto near-duplicate modes. This makes it useful for rapidly mapping the failure landscape. The second is a Gaussian-process global search with Thompson sampling. The GP models uncertainty over untested concept combinations, and Thompson sampling balances exploitation of known risky regions with exploration of uncertain but promising ones. Physical compatibility constraints are enforced throughout, so the search does not waste budget on impossible scene combinations.

A notable design choice is that interpretability is built into the search object itself. The method does not first find arbitrary failures and then try to explain them post hoc. It searches directly over human-readable semantic factors. Another important point is that the framework is black-box by construction: it does not rely on gradients, hidden states, or token-level likelihoods, which makes it usable for frontier closed-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover at least two safety-relevant domains: autonomous driving and indoor robotics. Qualitatively, the paper surfaces several concrete failure patterns. In driving scenarios, VLMs show brittle spatial grounding, including incorrect stop-versus-continue decisions around nearby pedestrians. They also miss hazardous elements such as barriers even when those elements should be central to the decision. In indoor robotics, the dominant pattern is different: the models can become excessively cautious, hurting task performance, while still failing to properly account for sharp or dangerous objects. That distinction matters because it shows the framework is not only finding reckless behavior; it also captures maladaptive over-caution.

The main quantitative result is that Revelio discovers on average 3–5 times more failure modes than unguided random search under the same budget. That is the key evidence that the search procedures exploit semantic structure rather than merely sampling more. The paper also positions the two search strategies differently: diversity-aware beam search is better for quickly surfacing a broad set of high-risk modes, while GP-based Thompson sampling is more useful for global exploration as the budget grows. Another important experimental choice is that failures are measured over scenario distributions, not single examples, which makes the discovered modes more stable than one-off adversarial cases.

The abstract does not expose all low-level numbers such as exact model names, sample counts per concept set, or absolute failure rates on each benchmark. Those details need to be checked in the full tables and appendix. Still, the central empirical message is clear: realistic semantic search is substantially more efficient than random search for uncovering systematic VLM vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the formal definition of a failure mode and the pipeline from concept subgraphs to scenario distributions. That is the conceptual core of the paper. Then read the sections on the two search algorithms and focus on why both are needed: beam search for fast local discovery with coverage, GP plus Thompson sampling for broader exploration under uncertainty. In the experiments, prioritize the autonomous-driving case studies because they make the spatial-grounding failures easy to understand. Then look at the indoor-robotics examples to see how the framework captures over-cautious behavior as a failure mode rather than a benign conservative bias. If the goal is to assess relevance for training, spend extra time on the appendix details around compatibility constraints, sampling budgets, and how failure rates are estimated. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: VLM失败模式挖掘的实用搜索方案，做多模态预训练消融或缺陷分析时可以借鉴，重点看方法部分的搜索策略即可
recommendation.en: Practical search scheme for VLM failure mode discovery; reference the search strategy for multimodal pretraining ablation or defect analysis, focus on the search strategy in the method section.

paper.title: Tracing Persona Vectors Through LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: How large language models internally represent high-level behaviors is a core interpretability question with direct relevance to AI safety: it determines what we can detect, audit, or intervene on. Recent work has shown that traits such as evil or sycophancy correspond to linear directions in the internal activations, the so-called persona vectors. Although these vectors are now routinely utilized to inspect and steer model behavior in safety-relevant settings, how these representations are form

summary.core_problem: persona vector（如 evil、sycophancy 等行为特质对应的残差流线性方向）在预训练过程中何时形成、如何演化、以及这种表示是否能跨越 post-training（SFT/DPO/RLVR）保持可用。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接价值在于把“高层行为表征”与“训练时间轴”对齐：人格/特质方向不是 post-train 才出现，而是在极早期预训练就已可提取，并且能迁移到后续指令对齐模型。这会影响三类工作：
1) 训练动态与涌现：一些看似高层的行为控制方向可能在很少 token 后就被写入表示空间，后续训练更多是在重加权/重塑 facets；
2) 数据与安全干预：如果方向很早就稳定，后期仅靠对齐可能难以“抹掉”底层可模拟的 persona 能力，干预点可能要前移到预训练数据与目标；
3) 机制分析方法论：证明“在 base checkpoint 上做的线性表征工程”能跨 SFT/DPO/RLVR 仍有效，提升了用开源中间 checkpoint 做可重复研究的可信度。
summary.technical_approach:
方法沿用并扩展 persona vector 的标准提取范式：
- 将 persona τ 操作化为自然语言描述 + 评分 rubric Rτ；在 decoder-only Transformer 的 residual stream（每层输出的残差向量空间）中寻找线性方向 v_{τ,l}。
- 通过对比提示构造“激活 persona”与“抑制 persona”的两类 prompts，让模型生成；用 judge model 对生成进行 0-100 打分（persona 强度与连贯性），筛选高质量样本。
- 用筛选后的对比样本在指定层/多层上估计 persona direction（论文后续讨论不同 elicitation 方法会恢复不同 facets）。
- 关键实验设计是“跨 checkpoint 追踪”：在 OLMo-3-7B 的多个预训练 checkpoint 上分别提取 persona vectors，然后用这些向量去 steer：a) 同一 base checkpoint；b) 由该 base 派生的 post-trained 模型（SFT、DPO、RLVR）。由此回答“何时出现”“是否保持同一方向”“post-train 是否破坏/旋转该方向”。
- 论文还强调 persona facets 会随训练推进发生漂移：同一高层 persona 名称下，不同阶段/不同提取法得到的向量可能更偏向不同子特征，因此需要把‘方向是否保留’与‘语义细节如何变’分开看。
summary.experiments: 主实验对象是 OLMo-3-7B（公开预训练中间 checkpoint），并在 Apertus 上复现（正文简述、细节在附录）。核心结果：persona vectors 在 OLMo-3 预训练进度的 0.22% 内就已形成；即便在非常早期 checkpoint 提取的向量，也能在完全 post-trained 的 instruct 模型上实现有效 steering。论文还报告：persona vectors 在整个预训练过程中持续演化，但“底层方向”在某种意义上保持可追踪；同时，elicitation 方法会影响恢复到的 persona facets。实验形态包括跨层选择、跨 checkpoint 的 steering 效果对比，以及对 SFT/DPO/RLVR 三种后训练范式的迁移测试。（你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字与所有 persona 列表；精读时应以结果章节的曲线/表格为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里两条 RQ（何时出现、如何演化）以及 OLMo-3 选择理由：公开 checkpoint 让“训练时间追踪”可复现。
- 精看 Method：persona 的操作化、对比提示与 judge 过滤、以及 persona vector 在 residual stream 的定义；这里决定了后面所有结论的可比性。
- 重点找结果里“0.22% 预训练进度”的证据：通常会是随训练步数的 steering 强度曲线或某个阈值定义，确认它不是由筛选偏差或 judge 泄漏造成。
- 看跨 post-training（SFT/DPO/RLVR）的迁移实验：它回答‘base 上的方向是否在对齐后仍存在’。
- 最后看关于 facets 漂移与 elicitation 依赖的分析：这部分决定 persona vector 是否能被当作稳定的“可审计对象”，还是更像一个随提取流程变化的探针。

summary_en.core_problem: When and how do persona vectors—linear directions in the residual stream associated with high-level behavioral traits (e.g., “Evil”)—emerge during pretraining, and do they remain usable after post-training (SFT/DPO/RLVR)?
summary_en.importance: The paper ties a safety-relevant interpretability object (persona vectors) to the pretraining timeline. The key implication for pretraining research is that some high-level controllable behavior directions appear extremely early and persist through alignment stages. This suggests: (1) post-training may mostly select/reweight existing behavioral modes rather than create them; (2) if a risky persona direction is present early, late-stage alignment might not remove the underlying representational affordance; (3) mechanistic/representation-engineering studies on base checkpoints can generalize to their instruction-tuned descendants, improving the practical value of open intermediate checkpoints for reproducible training-dynamics work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They operationalize a persona τ via a natural-language description plus a scoring rubric, and assume it corresponds to a linear direction v_{τ,l} in a chosen layer’s residual stream. Extraction follows a contrastive generation protocol: craft prompts that elicit vs suppress the persona, sample model continuations, and use a judge model to score persona strength and coherence (0–100), filtering to high-quality pairs. A direction is then estimated from the contrastive activation statistics.

The central design is checkpoint tracing: extract persona vectors at many pretraining checkpoints of OLMo-3-7B, then use those vectors to steer (a) the base checkpoints and (b) post-trained variants (SFT, DPO, RLVR). This directly tests emergence time, directional stability across training, and whether post-training rotates/erases the representation. They also analyze “facet drift”: the same persona label can correspond to different sub-traits depending on training stage and elicitation method, so they separate directional persistence from semantic drift.
summary_en.experiments: Primary model: OLMo-3-7B with public intermediate pretraining checkpoints; replication on Apertus (briefly in the main text, detailed in an appendix). Headline finding: persona vectors form within 0.22% of OLMo-3 pretraining, and vectors extracted from very early checkpoints can still steer fully post-trained instruction models. They report continued evolution of the vectors over pretraining while preserving an underlying traceable direction, and show elicitation-method dependence in which facets are recovered. (The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables; the main evidence should be in the results figures/tables tracking steering strength vs training progress and transfer to SFT/DPO/RLVR.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the two research questions in the Introduction and why OLMo-3 checkpoints enable the study.
- Study the Method carefully: prompt construction, judge filtering, and the exact definition of the residual-stream direction; these choices determine whether “early emergence” is meaningful.
- Locate the evidence supporting the “0.22% of pretraining” claim (typically a curve over steps with a threshold); sanity-check potential confounds like selection bias from filtering.
- Check the transfer experiments to SFT/DPO/RLVR; this is the strongest argument that the representation survives alignment.
- Finally, read the facet-drift and elicitation-dependence analysis to understand how stable the persona concept is as an audit/steering handle.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练配方，但会改你对“高层行为表征何时写进模型”的 prior；先看早期形成那组结果，若稳得住，安全表征研究该前移到 pretrain 而不是只盯 post-train。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your recipe directly, but it may change your prior on when high-level behavior gets written into the model; read the early-emergence result first, because if it holds, safety representation work needs to move upstream into pretraining.

paper.title: WriteSAE: Sparse Autoencoders for Recurrent State
paper.abstract: We introduce WriteSAE, the first sparse autoencoder that decomposes and edits the matrix cache write of state-space and hybrid recurrent language models, where residual SAEs cannot reach. Existing SAEs read residual streams, but Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7 write to a $d_k \times d_v$ cache through rank-1 updates $k_t v_t^\top$ that no vector atom can replace. WriteSAE factors each decoder atom into the native write shape, exposes a closed form for the per-token logit shift, and trains un

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章解决的是：对 Mamba-2、RWKV-7、Gated DeltaNet 这类矩阵状态/混合递归语言模型，传统 residual-stream SAE 无法直接解释模型真正写入 recurrent state 的内容，因为这些模型每个 token 写入的是 rank-1 外积形式的矩阵更新，而不是一个普通向量特征。作者要做的是构造一种与原生写入形状匹配的 SAE，使得“解释”和“干预”都发生在 cache write 这一层，而不是事后在 residual 上读影子信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，它更偏机制分析与可解释性工具，而不是训练方法或数据配方。但它有两个启发点。第一，随着非 Transformer 或 hybrid recurrent LM 重新进入视野，解释工具不能默认 residual stream 是唯一合适接口，必须贴着模型的原生状态更新机制来做。第二，若未来有人研究 state-space LM 的训练动态、记忆容量或 feature superposition，这种 write-level 分解可能会成为比 residual SAE 更自然的分析入口。就今日 digest 的相关性而言，它属于可泛读的机制工作，不是预训练 recipe 级别的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 WriteSAE。普通 SAE 的 decoder atom 是向量，适合重构 residual activation；但在 Gated DeltaNet 一类模型里，每个 token 对状态矩阵 S_t 的写入是 k_t v_t^T 这样的 rank-1 外积。若仍用向量 atom 去分解 vec(S_t)，虽然数学上可行，但干预时无法对应到“替换一次原生写入事件”。作者因此把 SAE decoder atom 约束成与原生写入同形的 rank-1 外积 v_i w_i^T，并在 mean-centered state 上训练 TopK SAE，损失是重构误差加 dead-feature revival 项。这样每个 atom 都可以被解释为“一个可替换的 cache-slot write primitive”。

在此基础上，论文提出三类验证。第一是 cache-slot substitution：在某个 firing 上，用学到的 atom 替换原始 native write，并与 matched-norm ablation 对照，比较继续前向传播后的输出 KL，检验 atom 是否比简单删掉写入更接近原模型行为。第二是 closed-form logit shift：作者推导了一个三因子表达式，把单次写入扰动对后续 token logit 的影响分解为 gate 衰减项、read query 项和 unembedding 项。这个公式的意义在于，它把 recurrent state 干预和最终词表 logit 变化连起来，而且每一项都能从一次 forward pass 观测。第三是直接干预实验，包括 erase、install 和 generation probe，用来验证这些 atom 不只是重构工具，而是可以定向改变模型续写。

论文还区分了两类 atom：register 和 bundle。前者的写入方向可以从 cache 中较清晰恢复，后者则更分散。作者用这一点讨论不同矩阵递归架构的“写入秩”差异，并把 GDN、RWKV-7、Mamba-2 按 register-bundle cosine 指标排序，试图说明哪些架构更接近可由低秩写入解释的状态更新。
summary.experiments:
关键实验集中在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的某一层头位点，以及 Mamba-2-370M 的迁移验证。最核心的 substitution test 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B L9 H4 上进行：在 4851 次 atom firing 中，学到的 atom 替换 native write 后，有 92.4% 的情况优于 matched-norm ablation；在 87 个 atom 的 population test 上，这个比例是 89.8%。这说明 learned atom 不是简单学到“删掉某个写入”，而是较好逼近了原始写入的功能结构。

closed-form logit shift 的拟合结果也很强。作者在 200 个 atom-by-epsilon 单元上比较解析预测与实测 logit shift，中位数 R^2 达到 0.98。若这个结果稳健，说明在 Gated DeltaNet 这类门控递归里，单次写入对后续输出的影响确实可以被一个相对低维、可解释的链式表达捕捉。

干预实验方面，擦除某个 atom（文中举 F412）在其原生 firing 上会让被促进 token 的 log-prob 平均下降 0.116 nats，n=150，p=1.07e-6。单位置 predictive install 在 2000 个 atom-token-context 三元组上有 84.6% 的符号预测正确率。持续三位置 install、放大 3 倍时，在 300 个上下文上把 target-in-continuation 从 33.3% 提升到 100%，首步支持增加 1.27 nats。迁移到 Mamba-2-370M L24 H0 时，substitution 胜过 ablation 的比例为 88.08%，说明方法并非只对一个模型实例有效。

论文也给了边界条件。作者明确列出若干 null result，包括 4B firing-level、Mamba-2 closed-form、top-1-matched rank-2、以及 Mamba-2 generation intervention 等未成功或未完全成立的设置。这一点很重要，说明当前 closed-form 更依赖 GDN 风格 gate，而不是已经成为所有矩阵递归模型上的通用理论。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，确认它解决的不是一般 SAE，而是“如何对 recurrent matrix write 做 SAE”。然后看 Method 里 decoder atom 的 rank-1 约束，以及 closed-form logit shift 的三因子分解。理解这两点，基本就抓住了论文的核心。

如果只花 20–30 分钟，建议看三处：一是 substitution test 的定义和主结果表，这决定了方法是否真的贴近 native write；二是 closed-form 推导后的验证图，看 R^2=0.98 是在哪些条件下成立；三是 intervention 结果，尤其是 erase/install 是否能稳定改变续写。附录里关于 Householder-modulated propagator 的推导可以按需看，不必一开始就啃完。

值得留意的地方有两个。第一，作者很诚实地给出了若干失败设置，这些地方比成功案例更能说明方法边界。第二，若你关心的是预训练而不是纯解释，重点不是某个 atom 对某个 token 的控制效果，而是这种 write-level 分解是否能帮助分析 state-space LM 的记忆容量、训练阶段 feature 形成、以及不同架构的状态更新秩结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of standard sparse autoencoders for recurrent and state-space language models. In architectures such as Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, each token writes a rank-1 matrix update into a recurrent cache. Residual-stream SAEs operate downstream and cannot directly decompose or edit the native write event itself. The goal here is to build an SAE whose atoms live in the same space and shape as the model’s write primitive, so that interpretation and intervention happen at the recurrent-state write rather than on a later residual shadow.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is primarily a mechanistic interpretability paper. Still, it has two useful implications. First, if recurrent or state-space LMs become more important again, interpretability tools cannot assume the residual stream is always the right interface. They need to match the model’s native state update. Second, for future work on memory capacity, feature superposition, or training dynamics in non-Transformer LMs, write-level decomposition may be a more natural probe than residual SAEs. So this is a skim paper for a pretraining researcher: not a recipe paper, but a potentially useful tool paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is WriteSAE. A standard SAE uses vector decoder atoms, which is appropriate for reconstructing residual activations. But in Gated DeltaNet-like models, the native per-token write is a rank-1 outer product k_t v_t^T into a matrix state S_t. One can still train an SAE on vec(S_t), but a generic vector atom does not correspond to a valid native write event. WriteSAE therefore constrains each decoder atom to factor as a rank-1 outer product v_i w_i^T, matching the architecture’s write shape. The model is trained as a TopK SAE on mean-centered state vectors with reconstruction loss plus a dead-feature revival term. This makes each atom interpretable as a cache-slot write primitive that can be swapped in for a native write.

The paper then builds three validation mechanisms. First is cache-slot substitution: replace one native write with a learned atom at matched Frobenius norm, continue the forward pass, and compare the resulting output KL against a matched-norm ablation baseline. If the atom beats ablation, it is doing more than simply deleting the write. Second is a closed-form logit-shift approximation. The authors derive a three-factor expression in which the downstream effect of a write perturbation factors into a gate-decay term, a read-query term, and an unembedding term. This is useful because it links a local recurrent-state intervention to final token logits using quantities observable from a single forward pass. Third are direct interventions—erase, install, and generation probes—to test whether the learned atoms can causally steer model behavior.

The paper also distinguishes between register-like and bundle-like atoms, depending on whether the write direction is recoverable from the cache or dispersed across it. This is used to compare architectures by an effective write-rank notion, with GDN, RWKV-7, and Mamba-2 exhibiting different degrees of low-rank write structure.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments are run on Qwen3.5-0.8B at a specific layer/head location, with transfer tests on Mamba-2-370M. The central substitution test is performed at Qwen3.5-0.8B L9 H4. Across 4,851 atom firings, replacing the native write with the learned atom beats matched-norm ablation in 92.4% of cases. At the population level over 87 atoms, the success rate is 89.8%. This is the strongest evidence that the learned atoms capture functional structure of the native write rather than merely approximating deletion.

The closed-form logit-shift validation is also strong in the reported regime. Across 200 atom-by-epsilon cells, the median R^2 between predicted and measured logit shifts is 0.98. If robust, this suggests that in Gated DeltaNet-style gated recurrences, the effect of a single write can be tracked with a relatively simple interpretable expression.

The intervention results are more causal. Erasing one example atom (F412) on its native firings reduces the promoted token’s log-prob by 0.116 nats on average, with n=150 and p=1.07e-6. Single-position predictive installs get the sign right in 84.6% of 2,000 atom-token-context triples. Sustained three-position installs at 3x strength raise target-in-continuation from 33.3% to 100% under greedy decoding over 300 contexts, with +1.27 nats of first-step support. Transfer to Mamba-2-370M L24 H0 yields an 88.08% substitution-over-ablation win rate.

Importantly, the paper also reports several nulls or boundary cases, including failures or weaker results for 4B firing-level tests, Mamba-2 closed-form validation, top-1-matched rank-2 settings, and Mamba-2 generation interventions. That makes the scope clearer: the strongest claims currently depend on GDN-style gating rather than constituting a universal theory for all matrix-recurrent LMs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction to understand that the paper is not proposing another generic SAE, but an SAE aligned to recurrent matrix writes. Then read the method section on rank-1 decoder atoms and the three-factor closed-form logit shift. Those two pieces contain most of the conceptual novelty.

If you only spend 20–30 minutes, focus on three things: the substitution-test definition and main table, because that is the strongest evidence that the atoms match native writes; the validation plots for the closed-form expression, to see under what conditions the reported R^2=0.98 holds; and the intervention section, especially whether erase/install operations reliably change continuations. The appendix derivation of the propagator can be deferred unless you want the exact math.

Two details are worth watching. First, the paper is unusually explicit about failure cases, and those are useful for understanding the method’s boundary. Second, if your interest is pretraining rather than interpretability per se, the real question is not token-level steering but whether write-level decomposition can help analyze memory formation, feature emergence during training, and effective write-rank structure in state-space language models.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 logit-shift 推导；若还在评估 Mamba/RWKV，这比残差 SAE 更贴近真实状态写入，但规模仍偏小。
recommendation.en: Read the method and logit-shift derivation; for Mamba/RWKV-style models it is closer to the real state write than residual SAEs, though still small-scale.

paper.title: Uncovering Symmetry Transfer in Large Language Models via Layer-Peeled Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are pretrained by minimizing the cross-entropy loss for next-token prediction. In this paper, we study whether this optimization strategy can induce geometric structure in the learned model weights and context embeddings. We approach this problem by analyzing a constrained layer-peeled optimization program, which serves as a mathematically tractable surrogate for LLMs by treating the output projection matrix and last-layer context embeddings as optimization variables

summary.core_problem: 由于损失景观的非凸性，直接分析完整LLM的训练动态目前仍不可行。下一词预测预训练过程中，训练数据的对称性结构如何传递到模型最后层权重与上下文嵌入的几何结构中这一问题尚未得到明确解释，尤其是语言建模采用软目标分布，与传统分类场景存在本质差异，现有理论框架无法直接复用。
summary.importance: 为LLM表示的几何结构研究提供了可处理的数学代理模型框架，从群论角度解释了优化的隐式偏置。该工作衔接了分类任务中的神经坍缩结论与语言建模场景，对理解预训练表示的形成机制、优化预训练目标有理论参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出层剥离（layer-peeled）优化方法，构建LLM预训练的数学可处理代理问题：仅将输出投影矩阵和最后层上下文嵌入作为优化变量，隔离最后层权重与特征的交互，在Frobenius范数约束下最小化交叉熵损失。通过群论框架分析该非凸优化问题的全局极小值，证明目标token分布的对称性会以等变的方式传递到最后层表示中。与此前针对单热标签分类的层剥离方法不同，该框架适配了LLM下一词预测的软目标分布场景，采用局部语义token子集的分析视角，而非同时分析整个词表。
summary.experiments: 目前公开的论文内容以理论推导与框架构建为主，完整实证实验结果尚未披露。核心理论结论为：层剥离模型的全局极小值会继承目标token分布的群对称结构。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读第2节的层剥离优化问题形式化定义，再看第3节的对称性传递理论证明部分，预计阅读时间15分钟（仅针对当前公开内容）。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct analysis of full LLM training dynamics remains intractable due to the non-convex loss landscape. It is not yet clearly understood how symmetry structures in training data transfer to the geometry of last-layer weights and context embeddings during next-token prediction pretraining, especially as language modeling uses soft target distributions that differ fundamentally from traditional classification settings, making existing theoretical frameworks inapplicable.
summary_en.importance: Provides a mathematically tractable surrogate framework for studying the geometric structure of LLM representations. The group-theoretic explanation of optimization implicit bias bridges neural collapse findings from classification tasks to the language modeling setting, offering theoretical reference for understanding pretrained representation formation and optimizing pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a layer-peeled optimization approach that constructs a mathematically tractable surrogate for LLM pretraining, treating only the output projection matrix and last-layer context embeddings as optimization variables. This formulation isolates the interaction between last-layer weights and features, minimizing cross-entropy loss under Frobenius norm constraints. Uses group theory to analyze global minimizers of this non-convex problem, proving that symmetries in target token distributions transfer to last-layer representations in an equivariant manner. Unlike prior layer-peeled methods for one-hot label classification, this framework adapts to soft target distributions in LLM next-token prediction, and adopts a local analysis perspective on semantically coherent token subsets instead of analyzing the entire vocabulary simultaneously.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available content focuses on theoretical derivation and framework construction, with full empirical results not yet disclosed. The core theoretical conclusion is that global minimizers of the layer-peeled model inherit the group symmetry structure of the target token distributions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 2 first for the formal definition of the layer-peeled optimization program, then review the theoretical proof of symmetry transfer in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes (for currently available content).

recommendation.zh: 用 layer-peeled 模型严格证明了数据对称性如何导致 embedding 空间的几何结构（如循环对称），对理解表征学习机制极具理论价值，建议读理论结论部分。
recommendation.en: Rigorously proves how data symmetry leads to geometric structures (e.g., cyclic symmetry) in embedding space using a layer-peeled model; highly valuable for understanding representation learning mechanisms. Skim the theoretical conclusions.

institutions: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania

paper.title: Probing Persona-Dependent Preferences in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be said to have preferences: they reliably pick certain tasks and outputs over others, and preferences shaped by post-training and system prompts appear to shape much of their behaviour. But models can also adopt different personas which have radically different preferences. How is this implemented internally? Does each persona run on its own preference machinery, or is something shared underneath? We train linear probes on residual-stream activations of Gemma-3-

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：LLM 在不同 persona 下做选择时，内部是否存在可复用的“偏好表示”，还是每个 persona 都有一套独立的选择机制。作者把偏好定义为模型在成对任务选择中的 revealed preference，而不是口头声明的价值观。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析和 post-train 接口。论文显示，偏好不是只存在于输出文本层面的行为模式，至少在 Gemma-3-27B 和 Qwen-3.5-122B 中，可以在 residual stream 中用线性方向读出，并且这个方向会随 persona 改变含义。这个结果对安全 probe、RLHF 后模型的内部表征、persona-conditioned behavior 都有直接影响。它不是预训练方法论文，但对理解后训练如何把偏好压进基座表征有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先用成对任务选择拟合一个 utility function，再用 residual-stream activation 训练线性 probe 去预测这些 utility。这样得到的线性方向被称为 preference vector。关键点在于，probe 不是预测某个固定标签，而是预测模型自己在不同任务之间的相对选择。作者随后做了三类检验：第一，泛化检验，观察该方向能否迁移到未见 topic 和分布外偏好类型，例如真假陈述、定向偏好变化；第二，因果检验，在 Gemma-3-27B 上沿该方向 steering task token，观察成对选择是否被改变；第三，persona 检验，用 Assistant persona 训练的 probe 去预测其他 persona 的偏好，尤其是 evil persona 下偏好方向是否反转。和普通 harmfulness / truthfulness probe 不同，这里的表示是从选择行为中抽取出来的，因此更接近“评估性表示”而不是描述性特征。
summary.experiments: 实验模型包括 Gemma-3-27B 和 Qwen-3.5-122B。作者报告，preference vector 能预测不同提示和情境下的 revealed pairwise choices，并能泛化到未见主题和分布外偏好类型。在 Gemma-3-27B 上，对 task token 做正负方向 steering 会显著改变模型选择哪个任务。evil persona 实验是论文的核心证据之一：同一个 preference vector 在 Assistant rollout 中会给 benign task 更高分，在 evil persona rollout 中则会出现偏好反转，harmful task 得分更高；这个反转不出现在 text-encoder baseline 中。跨 persona 实验显示，用 Assistant persona 训练的 probe 可以较好预测其他 persona 的 utility，但不能解释全部方差。附录还展示了安全相关现象：同一方向的 steering 可能削弱拒答边界，或降低长上下文中的伦理提示强度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 §2 的 preference vector 构造、§2.2 的 causal steering、§2.3 的 evil persona 反转、§3 的跨 persona 迁移。附录 A.4 和 F.3 值得补看，因为它们展示了 probe 在安全行为上的外推风险。读的时候要注意两个问题：一是 probe 的成功是否来自真实评估性表示，还是任务语义和 persona 状态的线性混合；二是 steering 的 causal effect 是否只在局部任务选择中成立，能否推广到长程策略行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs use a shared internal representation for preferences across personas, or whether each persona implements its own choice mechanism. Preferences are operationalized as revealed pairwise task choices rather than verbal self-reports.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic rather than pretraining-methodological. The results suggest that post-trained models can encode preference-like quantities in linear residual-stream directions, and that the meaning of such directions is conditioned by the active persona. This matters for white-box safety probes, RLHF-induced representations, and persona-dependent behavior. It also gives a concrete way to study how post-training signals interact with base-model representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors fit a utility function from revealed pairwise choices, then train linear probes on residual-stream activations to predict those utilities. The resulting direction is treated as a preference vector. They test it in three ways. First, they check generalization to unseen topics and out-of-distribution preference types, including truth versus falsehood and targeted preference shifts. Second, they perform causal steering on task tokens in Gemma-3-27B to see whether moving along the direction changes pairwise choices. Third, they train on the Assistant persona and evaluate transfer to other personas, including an evil persona whose preferences are anti-correlated with the Assistant. This differs from standard harmfulness or truthfulness probes because the supervision is derived from the model’s own choices.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Gemma-3-27B and Qwen-3.5-122B. The preference vector predicts revealed choices across prompts and situations, generalizes to unseen topics, and tracks targeted shifts in preference. In Gemma-3-27B, steering along the vector on task tokens has a large causal effect on which task the model completes. In the evil-persona setting, the same vector scores benign tasks higher under Assistant rollouts but reverses under evil-persona rollouts; a text-encoder baseline does not show this inversion. Cross-persona transfer works better than simply predicting Assistant preferences, but it does not explain all variance. The appendices also report safety-relevant effects, including reduced refusal behavior and weaker ethical flagging under certain steering settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Focus on §2 for the construction of the preference vector, §2.2 for causal steering, §2.3 for the evil-persona inversion, and §3 for transfer across personas. Appendix A.4 and F.3 are worth checking because they show how the same direction can affect safety behavior. The main questions to keep in mind are whether the direction is truly evaluative rather than a mixture of semantic and persona-state features, and whether the causal results extend beyond local pairwise task choices.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心对齐到底改了什么，这篇值得看；重点不是 probe 本身，而是“不同 persona 共享同一偏好底座”这个判断，先看跨 persona 泛化和 steering 结果。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care what alignment actually changes; the key is not the probe itself but the claim that very different personas share a common preference substrate—start with the cross-persona generalization and steering results.

paper.title: Where Does Reasoning Break? Step-Level Hallucination Detection via Hidden-State Transport Geometry
paper.abstract: Large language models hallucinate during multi-step reasoning, but most existing detectors operate at the trace level: they assign one confidence score to a full output, fail to localize the first error, and often require multiple sampled completions. We frame hallucination instead as a property of the hidden-state trajectory produced during a single forward pass. Correct reasoning moves through a stable manifold of locally coherent transitions; a first error appears as a localized excursion in

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多步推理中的首个错误定位问题。已有方法多给整条推理轨迹一个置信分数，或者依赖多次采样、自一致性、外部 verifier。GeoReason 试图只用一次前向中的 hidden-state 轨迹，判断哪一步开始偏离正确推理过程。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的训练目标，而在于给 reasoning failure 提供了一个表示空间诊断工具。它把错误看成 hidden-state transition 的局部异常，而不是只看 token 概率或最终答案。这对研究 CoT 训练动态、process supervision、reasoning model 的内部状态可分性有启发。尤其值得注意的是，teacher 跨模型和跨数据集更稳定，而 student 在分布迁移下不稳定，说明 hidden-state 中确实有较强诊断信号，但把这种信号蒸馏成部署模型仍受 margin preservation 限制。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把每个 reasoning step 映射成一个 hidden vector，通常对该 step 内 token 的某一层 hidden states 做 mean pooling。teacher 使用 step-level label，把正确前缀作为局部参考系，构造 trace-specific 的 contrastive PCA lens，用来突出正确 transition 和首错 transition 的几何差异。随后计算每一步的 transition instability，包含 transport cost 相关的几何特征。student 是一个 BiLSTM，从原始 hidden-state 序列直接预测 teacher 的分数，推理时不需要标签、多次采样或额外 verifier。论文还给出三个理论结果：contrastive PCA 在 transport-separation 目标下是最优投影；在 transport margin 假设下可做单次前向首错定位；teacher-student 一致性可归约为 margin preservation 条件。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ProcessBench、PRM800K、HaluEval 和 TruthfulQA。对比对象包括 entropy-based、probing-based 和 attention-based baselines。结果显示 teacher 和 student 在域内均优于这些基线；teacher 在跨模型、跨数据集迁移时较稳定，而 student 迁移能力明显下降。论文把这个差距解释为蒸馏后的 margin 在分布变化下没有保持。全文片段中没有给出完整表格数值，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看方法部分对 step hidden-state pooling、correct-prefix normalization、contrastive PCA lens 和 transport features 的定义；再看理论部分的 Theorem 3.1、Theorem 3.2 和 Proposition 3.3，理解它们分别约束了投影、定位和蒸馏。实验部分重点看 teacher 与 student 的迁移差异，这比单个 benchmark 分数更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies first-error localization in multi-step reasoning. Most existing detectors assign one confidence score to the whole trace, require multiple sampled completions, or depend on a separate verifier. GeoReason asks whether a single forward pass contains enough hidden-state signal to identify where the reasoning trajectory first breaks.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper treats reasoning failure as a local anomaly in hidden-state transitions, not merely as high token entropy or an incorrect final answer. This is useful for studying chain-of-thought dynamics, process supervision, and the internal separability of correct versus corrupted reasoning states. The transfer gap is also informative: the label-conditioned teacher transfers more reliably across models and datasets, while the distilled student is fragile under shift. That suggests the signal exists, but preserving it in a deployable detector is the hard part.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each reasoning step is represented by pooling token hidden states from a fixed transformer layer. The teacher uses step-level labels to build a trace-specific local coordinate system around the correct prefix, then applies a contrastive PCA lens that emphasizes directions separating coherent transitions from first-error transitions. It scores each step with geometric transition features related to transport instability. The student is a BiLSTM trained to reproduce the teacher’s scores from raw hidden-state sequences, so inference requires no labels, no sampling, and no external verifier. The theory argues that contrastive PCA is optimal for a transport-separation objective, that first-error localization is possible under a transport-margin condition, and that teacher-student agreement depends on preserving that margin.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use ProcessBench, PRM800K, HaluEval, and TruthfulQA, with entropy-based, probing-based, and attention-based baselines. Both teacher and student outperform these baselines in-domain. The teacher remains comparatively stable across model and dataset transfer, while the student degrades under shift, matching the paper’s margin-preservation analysis. The provided full text excerpt does not include the complete numeric tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the definitions of step pooling, correct-prefix normalization, the contrastive PCA lens, and the transport features. Then read Theorem 3.1, Theorem 3.2, and Proposition 3.3 for the assumptions behind localization and distillation. In the experiments, the most useful part is the teacher-student transfer gap, not the headline benchmark numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看几何特征和 teacher-student 设计即可；把错误定位放到 hidden trajectory 上是干净的，但缺少规模实验前不要过度外推。
recommendation.en: Read the geometric features and teacher-student setup; hidden-trajectory error localization is clean, but without large-scale evidence it should stay a weak signal.

paper.title: Correcting Influence: Unboxing LLM Outputs with Orthogonal Latent Spaces
paper.abstract: A critical step for reliable large language models (LLMs) use in healthcare is to attribute predictions to their training data, akin to a medical case study. This requires token-level precision: pinpointing not just which training examples influence a decision, but which tokens within them are responsible. While influence functions offer a principled framework for this, prior work is restricted to autoregressive settings and relies on an implicit assumption of token independence, rendering their

summary.core_problem: 现有的基于影响函数的LLM训练数据归因方法默认token相互独立，不符合LLM内部token高度相关的实际情况，导致得到的token级影响估计可靠性不足，无法满足医疗等高风险场景下模型决策可追溯至训练数据具体token的审计需求。
summary.importance: 为预训练数据质量审计、训练数据中虚假相关性的定位与清除提供了可落地的工具思路；结合稀疏自编码器解耦表示与影响函数的设计，也为预训练内部机制、训练动态的可解释性研究提供了新的分析角度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于潜变量中介的归因框架，在预训练LLM的任意中间层接入稀疏自编码器，学习近似正交、统计独立的潜特征基，在解耦后的潜空间计算影响得分；利用克莱罗定理交换导数计算顺序，将原本每个特征O(d_l)的前向计算复杂度降为O(1)，实现10-20倍的实际加速；将潜特征层面的影响通过联合激活模式回传至输入token，支持样本和特征层面的统一归因。
summary.experiments: 在1B参数的Llama-3.2和1.5B参数的Qwen2.5上跨多个QA数据集验证；必要性和充分性消融实验显示，该方法识别的影响电路效果优于激活幅值、频率等基线；对固定测试样本的token热力图可视化显示，训练时引入上下文会改变模型行为，但相关规律还需进一步验证。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的方法框架和复杂度优化部分，以及第5章的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间30分钟；医疗场景的背景介绍部分可跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing influence function-based training data attribution methods for LLMs assume token independence, which contradicts the strong correlation between tokens in LLMs. This leads to unreliable token-level influence estimates, failing to meet the audit requirement of tracing model decisions back to specific tokens in training data for high-stakes domains like healthcare.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical approach for pre-training data quality auditing and spurious correlation localization and removal in training datasets. The design combining sparse autoencoder disentangled representations and influence functions also offers a new analytical angle for interpretability research on pre-training internal mechanisms and training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a latent mediation-based attribution framework. It attaches sparse autoencoders to any intermediate layer of a pretrained LLM to learn approximately orthogonal, statistically independent latent feature bases, and computes influence scores in this disentangled latent space. It leverages Clairaut's Theorem to swap the order of derivative calculation, reducing the original O(d_l) forward-pass complexity per feature to O(1) and delivering 10-20x practical speedup. Influence at the latent feature level is back-propagated to input tokens via joint activation patterns, supporting unified attribution at both sample and feature levels.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 1B-parameter Llama-3.2 and 1.5B-parameter Qwen2.5 across multiple QA datasets. Necessity and sufficiency ablations show that the influential circuits identified by this method outperform baselines including activation magnitude and frequency. Token heatmap visualizations on fixed test samples indicate that incorporating context during training alters model behavior, though related patterns require further validation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the method framework and complexity optimization in Section 3, as well as ablation results in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes. Background sections on healthcare use cases can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 影响函数的改进工作，打破token独立假设，§3的潜在空间归因设计对预训练归因分析有参考价值
recommendation.en: An improved influence function work that breaks the token independence assumption; the latent space attribution design in §3 is referential for pretraining attribution analysis

paper.title: When Reasoning Traces Become Performative: Step-Level Evidence that Chain-of-Thought Is an Imperfect Oversight Channel
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces are increasingly used both to improve language model capability and to audit model behavior, implicitly assuming that the visible trace remains synchronized with the computation that determines the answer. We test this assumption with a step-level Detect-Classify-Compare framework built around an answer-commitment proxy that is cross-validated with Patchscopes, tuned-lens probes, and causal direction ablation. Across nine models and seven reasoning benchmarks, laten

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个对推理模型很关键的问题：可见的 CoT trace 是否真的同步反映了模型形成答案的内部计算。它不只问 CoT 是否有用，而是追问在每一个推理步骤上，模型内部是否已经承诺了答案，以及这个时间点是否被外显文本诚实呈现。
summary.importance: 这篇论文值得精读。它把 CoT 从能力增强手段重新放回监督信号的位置来检验。当前 reasoning model 的 SFT、RL、过程监督、可解释性评估和安全审计都在不同程度上依赖可见推理轨迹。如果模型已经在隐状态里确定答案，却继续生成看似还在思考的文本，那么 CoT 作为监督通道就存在系统性噪声。对预训练和 post-train 接口的影响很直接：长 CoT 数据不一定提供真实的计算过程；基于 trace 的 reward 可能奖励表演式文本；过程监督若只看文本步骤，可能把描述性后验解释误当成因果计算。论文的贡献量级不在于提出新训练算法，而在于给出一个 step-level 测量框架，并用多种 probing 和 causal check 支撑这个测量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Detect-Classify-Compare。第一步是把生成的 CoT 切成推理步骤，使用基于换行、转折标记和句界的规则解析器，解析 F1 为 0.87。第二步是在每个 step boundary 读取模型内部是否已经形成答案承诺。主要代理信号是 logit lens：把各层 hidden state 经过 unembedding 和 layer norm 投到词表空间，观察 ground-truth answer token 的概率 p_ans。若 p_ans 大于阈值 τ=0.3，就视为内部已经 committed。第三步是构造外显 CoT 标签：检查到当前步骤为止的累计文本中，是否已经出现 ground-truth answer string 或归一化变体。Belief-CoT Agreement 用来衡量内部承诺状态和外显答案到达状态是否同步。第四步是把不一致事件分成多个类型，其中最主要的是 confabulated continuation：内部答案已经稳定，但文本还在继续生成像推理一样的内容。第五步是比较 architecture-matched 的 Qwen2.5 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 模型对，观察 reasoning distillation 如何改变不一致模式。论文还用 Patchscopes、tuned lens 和 causal direction ablation 交叉验证 logit lens 读数，避免把单一 probe 的偏差误当成内部承诺。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个模型和 7 个 reasoning benchmark。核心结果是，latent commitment 与 explicit answer arrival 的 step-level 对齐平均只有 61.9%。在检测到的不一致事件中，58.0% 属于 confabulated continuation，也就是模型内部答案已稳定，但 trace 仍继续输出审慎推理的样子。logit lens 的可靠性做了多重检查：Patchscopes 在 mid-depth steps 上的一致率为 75.6%，在 final-layer steps 上为 74.7%；logit-lens-only disagreement 接近 0，mid-depth 为 0.0%，final layer 为 1.5%；tuned-lens 二分类在 4 个 held-out model-benchmark 配置上的一致率不低于 99.2%。Qwen2.5 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 的受控比较显示，reasoning pipeline 不只改变整体对齐率，也改变错误构成；在 32B 规模上，confabulated steps 下降，但 contradictory states 上升。论文还报告了一个重要行为关联：step-level alignment 越低，CoT utility 往往越大；配对截断和 donor corruption 实验显示，很多 post-commitment 文本更像描述性延续，而不是生成最终答案所必需的计算。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法和实验。先看引言中对 oversight channel 的定义，明确论文不是一般讨论 CoT faithfulness，而是在测量答案形成时间与文本呈现时间的偏差。方法部分重点看 logit lens 的 answer-commitment proxy、τ=0.3 阈值、BCA 指标、CoT 显式标签构造，以及 step segmentation 的误差来源。实验部分重点看 Figure 1、模型和 benchmark 覆盖、五类 mismatch taxonomy、Qwen2.5/R1-Distill 配对比较、截断实验和 donor corruption。附录 J.1 的 Patchscopes 与 tuned lens 验证值得看，因为整篇论文的可信度很大程度依赖内部承诺读数是否稳健。读的时候要注意一个限制：p_ans 是对 ground-truth answer token 的代理读数，它适合选择题或短答案任务，但不等价于完整的语义信念；对开放式推理和多 token 答案，需要更复杂的 commitment 定义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether visible chain-of-thought traces are temporally synchronized with the computation that determines the answer. The key question is not whether CoT improves accuracy, but whether each written step reflects when the model has internally committed to the final answer.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong read for researchers working on reasoning training, process supervision, and CoT-based oversight. Many current pipelines use reasoning traces as SFT targets, reward-model inputs, verifier evidence, or safety-audit artifacts. If the model often commits internally before the trace reaches the answer, then the trace is a noisy supervision channel. Long rationales may train models to produce plausible deliberation rather than expose causal computation. The paper’s main contribution is measurement rather than a new training recipe: it provides a step-level framework for timing internal answer formation and supports it with probing and causal validation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is called Detect-Classify-Compare. It first segments a generated CoT into reasoning steps using a rule-based parser over newlines, transition markers, and sentence boundaries; the reported parsing F1 is 0.87. At each step boundary, it estimates internal answer commitment with a logit-lens proxy. Hidden states from each layer are projected through the unembedding and layer normalization, and the probability assigned to the ground-truth answer token, p_ans, is tracked. A step is treated as internally committed when p_ans exceeds τ=0.3. The visible-trace label is constructed by checking whether the cumulative CoT text has already exposed the ground-truth answer string or a normalized variant. Belief-CoT Agreement measures whether these two binary states match over time. Mismatches are then classified into step-level patterns, with confabulated continuation being the dominant one: the answer proxy is already stable while the model keeps writing deliberative-looking text. The paper also compares architecture-matched Qwen2.5 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill model pairs to isolate the effect of reasoning distillation. To reduce dependence on a single probe, the logit-lens signal is cross-validated with Patchscopes, tuned-lens probes, and causal direction ablation.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers nine models and seven reasoning benchmarks. The main quantitative result is that latent commitment and explicit answer arrival align on only 61.9% of steps on average. Among detected mismatch events, 58.0% are confabulated continuation. The validation checks are important: Patchscopes agrees with the logit-lens readout on 75.6% of mid-depth steps and 74.7% of final-layer steps; logit-lens-only disagreement is near zero, at 0.0% for mid-depth and 1.5% for final-layer steps; tuned-lens binary classifications agree with the logit lens at at least 99.2% across four held-out model-benchmark configurations. In controlled Qwen2.5 versus DeepSeek-R1-Distill comparisons, reasoning training changes both aggregate alignment and the mix of failure modes. The 32B pair is especially informative: confabulated steps decrease while contradictory states increase. The paper also links timing faithfulness to behavior: lower step-level alignment tends to come with larger CoT utility, and paired truncation plus donor-corruption experiments suggest that much post-commitment text is descriptive rather than load-bearing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method and validation sections carefully. Start with the framing of CoT as an oversight channel, since the paper is about timing faithfulness rather than generic rationale quality. In the method section, focus on the answer-commitment proxy, the τ=0.3 threshold, the construction of Belief-CoT Agreement, and the automatic labeling of explicit answer arrival. In the experiments, focus on Figure 1, the mismatch taxonomy, the Qwen2.5/R1-Distill matched comparisons, truncation tests, and donor corruption. Appendix J.1 is worth reading because the credibility of the results depends on whether the internal-commitment probe is conservative and stable. A useful limitation to keep in mind is that p_ans is a proxy over the ground-truth answer token. It is well suited to short-answer or multiple-choice settings, but it is not a full semantic representation of belief for open-ended or multi-token answers.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻CoT作为可靠推理监督信号的默认假设，做推理微调的团队必须复现核心结论
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the default assumption that CoT is a reliable reasoning supervision signal; teams working on reasoning fine-tuning must replicate the core findings

paper.title: Instruction Lens Score: Your Instruction Contributes a Powerful Object Hallucination Detector for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet the object hallucination remains a critical challenge for reliable deployment. In this paper, we present an in-depth analysis of instruction token embeddings and reveal that they implicitly encode visual information while effectively filtering erroneous information introduced by misleading visual embeddings. Building on this insight, we propose the Instruction Lens Score (InsLen), which combines a Calibrated Local Sc

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型目标幻觉检测方法要么依赖外部辅助模型带来高额计算开销，要么基于视觉表征的分数容易受视觉编码器或跨模态交互引入的误导信息干扰，对因局部视觉特征相似产生的幻觉（如银质勺子和叉子的局部材质相似）区分能力不足。
summary.importance: 揭示了多模态大模型中指令token的隐层表征具备过滤误导视觉信息、编码全局物体相关线索的特性，为目标幻觉检测提供了新的信号来源，也为理解多模态对齐过程中指令的作用提供了新的观测视角。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Logit Lens技术分析指令token的隐层表征，发现其可以过滤视觉误导信息，在此基础上提出由两部分组成的InsLen分数：1）校准局部分数：计算目标token在所有指令token隐层表征中的最大置信度，与现有基于视觉的分数结合，校准视觉证据的误判；2）上下文一致性分数：利用指令token隐层表征编码的全局物体上下文，评估生成的目标token与全局上下文的一致性，区分局部相似导致的幻觉。该方法是即插即用的检测工具，无需额外训练或辅助模型。
summary.experiments: 在多个目标幻觉检测基准和不同架构的多模态大模型上开展了对比实验，统计分析验证了指令表征对误导视觉信息的过滤效应，两部分分数的组合在幻觉检测的准确率和鲁棒性上优于现有仅基于视觉表征的方法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第4.1节的统计分析部分，理解指令表征过滤视觉误导信息的核心观测；方法部分重点关注两个分数的具体计算逻辑；附录可参考不同基准上的细分实验结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing object hallucination detection methods for MLLMs either rely on external auxiliary models which introduce high computational overhead, or use vision-based scores that are vulnerable to misleading information introduced by visual encoders or cross-modal interactions, with limited ability to distinguish hallucinations caused by similar local visual features (e.g., similar silver material of spoons and forks).
summary_en.importance: It reveals that hidden representations of instruction tokens in MLLMs can filter misleading visual information and encode global object-related cues, providing a new signal source for object hallucination detection and a new observation perspective for understanding the role of instructions in cross-modal alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on Logit Lens analysis of instruction token hidden representations, the paper finds instruction representations can filter misleading visual signals, and proposes the InsLen score consisting of two components: 1) Calibrated Local Score: computes the maximum confidence of the target object token across all instruction token hidden representations, combined with existing vision-based scores to calibrate false visual evidence; 2) Context Consistency Score: leverages the global object context encoded in instruction token representations to evaluate the consistency between generated object tokens and the global context, distinguishing hallucinations caused by local visual similarity. The method is a plug-and-play detector requiring no additional training or auxiliary models.
summary_en.experiments: Comparative experiments are conducted on multiple object hallucination detection benchmarks and across diverse MLLM architectures. Statistical analysis validates the filtering effect of instruction representations on misleading visual information, and the combination of the two scores outperforms existing vision-only methods in detection accuracy and robustness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the statistical analysis in Section 4.1 to understand the core observation of instruction representations' filtering effect; pay attention to the specific calculation logic of the two scores in the method section; detailed sub-experiment results on different benchmarks can be found in the appendix. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 通过分析 instruction token embedding 来做幻觉检测，视角新颖，揭示了 MLLM 内部表示的一些有趣特性，值得关注其机制分析部分。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on hallucination detection by analyzing instruction token embeddings, revealing interesting properties of internal representations in MLLMs; the mechanism analysis is worth a skim.

paper.title: Pretraining Exposure Explains Popularity Judgments in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic preferences for well-known entities, a phenomenon often attributed to popularity bias. However, the extent to which these preferences reflect real-world popularity versus statistical exposure during pretraining remains unclear, largely due to the inaccessibility of most training corpora. We provide the first direct, large-scale analysis of popularity bias grounded in fully observable pretraining data. Leveraging the open OLMo models and their compl

summary.core_problem: 在可观测的预训练语料条件下，定量回答一个常被“黑箱化”的问题：LLM 对实体“知名度/重要性”的偏好，到底更像是在复现真实世界的流行度信号，还是主要由预训练语料中的统计曝光（entity exposure：实体及其别名在训练数据中的出现频率与分布）驱动？并进一步比较不同提问方式下，模型“流行度判断”更贴近哪一种信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于把“模型偏好/先验”与“数据分布”之间的因果链条做成可复现的实证范式：用完全公开的模型与语料（OLMo + Dolma）直接测量实体级曝光，并与外部流行度代理（Wikipedia pageviews）及模型行为对齐。它给数据配比/去重/长尾覆盖等决策提供了更可操作的诊断指标：当任务是让模型形成某种“世界先验”时，先验往往就是语料曝光的函数，而不一定是现实世界分布的函数。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把“曝光”从抽象概念落到可计算的实体级统计，并把它与两类目标对齐：外部流行度与模型判断。
1) 可观测预训练数据索引：使用 Infini-Gram 对 OLMo 的完整训练语料（Pretraining/Midtraining/Long Context 三部分）做全量索引。语料合计约 27TB、7.4T tokens；索引后分 128 个 shard，总索引体积约 50TB。这样可以对任意实体/别名做精确计数与检索，而不是用抽样或间接代理。
2) 实体集合构建：从 Wikidata 按类型随机采样实体（Person/Location/Organization/Art/Product），并使用别名（aliases）来提高召回；同时强调别名歧义会污染曝光估计，因此需要对别名做验证/清洗（全文在数据部分展开）。
3) 三方对齐：
- 预训练曝光：实体及其别名在 Dolma 中的出现统计（论文将其作为 popularity proxy 的候选）。
- 真实世界流行度：Wikipedia pageviews 作为外部信号。
- 模型“流行度判断”：在 OLMo-3-7B 与 OLMo-3.1-32B 上用两种 elicitation：Directly（直接让模型给出流行度/知名度判断）与 Comparison（成对比较谁更有名）。
4) 关键设计取舍：用 Comparison 作为更“相对标尺”的行为测量，减少模型把问题当作开放式生成/解释任务时引入的噪声；并在不同实体类型、不同流行度分位上分别分析相关性，避免总体相关性掩盖长尾与类型差异。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三组相关性与分层现象展开：
- 曝光 vs Wikipedia pageviews：在多实体类型上呈强相关，说明在该语料设置下，预训练曝光本身已经携带了相当多的“现实流行度”信息（也意味着 Dolma 的采样/过滤策略在宏观上与 Wikipedia 流行度并不独立）。
- 模型判断 vs 曝光 / pageviews：模型的“流行度判断”整体更贴近曝光而非 pageviews，且 Comparison 方式下这种贴近更明显；Directly 更容易受表达方式与校准影响。
- 分位与类型差异：高流行度头部实体与低流行度长尾实体的行为不同；不同类型（人/地/组织/作品/产品）也存在不一致，提示“曝光→偏好”的映射并非单一线性规律，可能受别名歧义、上下文共现结构、以及模型对不同类型的表征差异影响。
注：你给的全文片段未包含最终表格/具体相关系数数值与显著性检验细节；若需要精确数字，需要对论文结果章节的表/图逐项摘录。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（pipeline）把三方对齐关系建立起来：曝光统计→外部流行度→模型行为。
- 重点读 Dataset/Indexing 部分：7.4T tokens 的索引方式、alias 清洗策略、以及 exposure 的具体定义（这是可复现性与可信度的关键）。
- 结果部分优先看：Comparison vs Directly 的差异、按实体类型与流行度分位的分层图/表（通常信息量最大）。
- 带着问题读讨论：哪些偏差来自语料分布本身，哪些来自 elicitation；以及对“用 Wikipedia 作为真实流行度代理”的局限性如何处理。

summary_en.core_problem: With fully observable pretraining data, the paper asks a concrete question that is usually studied indirectly: when LLMs judge an entity as “more popular/important,” is that behavior better explained by real-world popularity signals or by pretraining exposure (how often the entity and its aliases appear in the training corpus)? It also tests how different elicitation protocols change what the model reveals about this latent prior.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining algorithm paper; its contribution is methodological and diagnostic. By leveraging OLMo and the fully open Dolma corpus, it turns “popularity bias” into a measurable, entity-level data statistic and shows how closely model preferences track that statistic. For pretraining researchers, the practical takeaway is that many seemingly semantic priors are functions of corpus exposure, so decisions about data mixture, long-tail coverage, and dedup/filtering can directly shape what the model treats as salient—even when an external ‘ground truth’ popularity signal exists.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach is a three-way alignment between (i) corpus exposure, (ii) an external popularity proxy, and (iii) model judgments.
1) Full-corpus exposure measurement: the authors index the complete OLMo training corpora (pretraining, midtraining, long-context) with Infini-Gram. The combined data is ~27TB / 7.4T tokens; indexing is sharded (128 shards) and yields ~50TB of indexed artifacts, enabling exact entity/alias counting at scale.
2) Entity set construction: entities are sampled from Wikidata across five types (Person, Location, Organization, Art, Product). Aliases are used to improve recall, but alias ambiguity is treated as a key confounder, motivating validation/cleaning steps.
3) External popularity signal: Wikipedia pageviews are used as a real-world popularity proxy.
4) Model elicitation: two protocols on OLMo-3-7B and OLMo-3.1-32B—Direct (ask for popularity) and Pairwise Comparison (which entity is more popular). The paper treats pairwise comparison as a more stable behavioral readout, less sensitive to calibration and free-form generation artifacts.
5) Analysis strategy: correlations are examined not only globally but also by entity type and popularity quantiles to surface head vs tail differences and type-specific effects.
summary_en.experiments:
Key empirical findings are organized around correlation structure and stratified behavior:
- Exposure vs Wikipedia pageviews: strong correlations across entity types, suggesting the corpus distribution already encodes substantial real-world popularity information.
- Model judgments vs exposure/pageviews: model “popularity” aligns more with exposure than with pageviews, especially under the pairwise comparison elicitation.
- Head/tail and type effects: behavior differs for high-popularity vs low-popularity entities, and across entity types, indicating the exposure→preference mapping is not a single uniform rule and may be mediated by alias ambiguity and contextual co-occurrence structure.
Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables/figures (exact correlation coefficients, p-values, etc.). Extracting precise numbers requires reading the results section figures/tables directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to lock in the measurement pipeline.
- Read the dataset/indexing section carefully: how exposure is defined, how aliases are validated, and what parts of Dolma are included.
- In results, prioritize the comparison between Direct vs Pairwise elicitation and the stratified analyses by entity type and popularity quantile.
- In discussion/limitations, focus on what is attributable to corpus statistics vs elicitation artifacts, and on the limitations of Wikipedia pageviews as a ‘real-world’ proxy.

recommendation.zh: 首次用全公开预训练语料验证实体曝光对模型偏好的影响，可参考§3的统计方法做内部预训练数据偏置分析。
recommendation.en: First large-scale entity exposure analysis using fully public pretraining corpus, refer to §3 for entity bias measurement methods for internal pretraining data audits.

paper.title: Why do Large Language Models Fail in Low-resource Translation? Unraveling the Token Dynamics of Large Language Models for Machine Translation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance in machine translation (MT). However, most prior work focuses on improving or benchmarking translation quality, offering limited insight into when and why LLM-based translation fails. In this work, we systematically analyze failure modes of LLMs in MT by evaluating 15 models, including four reasoning LLMs, across 22 language pairs (LPs) with varying resource levels. We find that non-English-centric LPs consistently yield

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“LLM 翻译好不好”，而是“LLM 在低资源、尤其非英语中心翻译里为什么会失败”。全文把问题拆成两个层面：一是不同语言对上的性能落差是否系统性存在；二是这种落差是否与模型内部对目标语言 token 的可用性和激活程度有关。作者关心的不是传统 MT 模型的数据稀缺问题，而是通用 LLM 在多语生成时，词表覆盖、语言表示和推理式解码之间的关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有三点。第一，它把多语能力退化和 tokenizer / vocabulary 使用效率直接联系起来，给“为什么低资源语言掉队”提供了一个可操作的诊断量 TAR，而不是只停留在训练数据少这种泛泛解释。第二，它提示多语预训练里“词表里有这个语言”和“生成时真正会用这些 token”不是一回事，这对 tokenizer 设计、语料配比、语言退火训练都有启发。第三，它观察到 reasoning model 会在低 TAR 语言对上生成更多 reasoning tokens，且这种额外生成有时能换来 COMET/BLEU 提升，这为 post-train 如何补偿 pretrain 的语言覆盖缺口提供了一个具体切口。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三步。第一步，构造覆盖 22 个语言方向的大规模评测，其中 10 个是非英语中心语言对，12 个是英语中心语言对，且覆盖高、中、低资源语言。作者刻意把不同翻译方向分开统计，而不是把同一语言对双向混在一起，因为目标语言不同会直接影响 token 激活。第二步，设计更严格的提示词控制输出格式。作者先发现常见 ICL 翻译 prompt 会让部分模型输出解释性文字，污染自动评测，于是额外设计 Prompt 1/2，并通过规则检测加人工检查选出最干净的 Prompt 2，后续分析都基于这个设置。这一点很工程，但很关键，因为如果输出里混入解释文本，所谓 token activation 和翻译质量的相关性会被噪声掩盖。第三步，引入 TAR。按文中定义，TAR 用来衡量模型在生成目标语言时，实际激活该语言专属 token 的比例或程度，用它作为语言表示覆盖的代理变量。作者进一步把 TAR 与语言类型距离、COMET、BLEU、以及 reasoning token 数量联动分析，试图区分“模型不会翻”和“模型词表/表示层面就没把目标语言调起来”这两类失败来源。与已有多语分析工作相比，这篇文章的区别不在提出新翻译方法，而在把 failure analysis 落到 token dynamics 上，并且把 reasoning LLM 单独拿出来看其补偿机制。
summary.experiments: 实验规模不小。数据上共 22 个语言方向，每个方向随机抽取 3000 条，共 6.6 万样本。模型上评测 15 个模型，覆盖 Qwen 指令模型、Qwen Thinking、DeepSeek 蒸馏与原生 reasoner/chat 变体等，也就是既有普通 instruction-tuned 模型，也有 RLVR 或蒸馏得到的 reasoning 模型。核心结果有几类：1）非英语中心语言对的 COMET 明显低于英语中心语言对，这个趋势在多模型上稳定出现；2）TAR 能较好代理语言覆盖，且 TAR 与 COMET/BLEU 显著相关，目标语言 TAR 低时翻译质量更差；3）类型距离也是重要因素，语言越远，质量通常越差，但 TAR 提供了比“语言远近”更贴近模型内部机制的解释；4）低目标语言 TAR 与生成更多 reasoning tokens 显著相关，说明 reasoning 模型在目标语言表示不足时，倾向于通过更长的中间生成做补偿；5）这种补偿不是总有效，但在部分模型上 reasoning token 数量与 COMET 或 BLEU 提升相关。全文给出的关键信息更偏相关性分析，而不是训练新模型后的绝对提升，因此阅读时应把重点放在图表中的趋势、分组和统计显著性，而不是单个分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里问题设定，再看 Experimental Setup 中数据、prompt 清洗和模型列表，最后重点看结果部分里 TAR 与 COMET/BLEU、TAR 与 reasoning tokens、以及英语中心/非英语中心分组对比的图表。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主线。真正值得看的不是“哪个模型分高”，而是作者如何把输出噪声控制、token 激活、语言距离和推理长度串起来。如果你做 tokenizer、多语预训练或 continual pretrain，建议额外留意 TAR 的定义细节和它对语言覆盖的代理是否会受分词粒度、script 差异、共享子词比例影响。这篇文章更像一个诊断框架，适合拿来启发后续实验设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about whether LLMs are good at translation, but about why they fail in low-resource and especially non-English-centric translation settings. It studies two linked questions: whether the performance gap across language pairs is systematic, and whether that gap is tied to how effectively the model activates target-language-specific tokens during generation. The focus is on multilingual generation failure in general-purpose LLMs, rather than on conventional MT data scarcity alone.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is fairly concrete. First, it connects multilingual degradation to tokenizer and vocabulary utilization, not just to the vague claim that some languages have less data. TAR gives a measurable diagnostic for language coverage in use, not merely in principle. Second, it highlights a distinction that matters for multilingual pretraining: a language being present in the vocabulary is different from the model actually activating that language’s tokens at decode time. That has implications for tokenizer design, corpus mixing, and language balancing during training. Third, the paper observes that reasoning models tend to emit more reasoning tokens when target-language TAR is low, and that this sometimes correlates with better COMET/BLEU. That is a useful clue for how post-training may partially compensate for pretraining gaps in multilingual representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study has three main components. First, it builds a broad evaluation setup over 22 translation directions: 10 non-English-centric and 12 English-centric pairs, spanning high-, medium-, and low-resource languages. Directions are treated separately rather than merged by language pair, which is the right choice because the target language directly affects token activation. Second, the authors tighten prompting to control output format. They found that a standard in-context translation prompt often caused some models to produce explanations or noisy text instead of clean translations, which would contaminate automatic evaluation. They therefore designed two additional prompts, used rule-based noise detection plus manual inspection, and selected Prompt 2 for the cleanest outputs. This is an important methodological detail because noisy outputs would distort both translation metrics and token-dynamics analysis. Third, they introduce Token Activation Rate (TAR), a metric intended to capture how effectively a model uses language-specific tokens of the target language during generation. TAR is then analyzed jointly with typological distance, COMET, BLEU, and the number of reasoning tokens. Relative to prior multilingual evaluation work, the novelty is not a new MT method but a token-dynamics-based failure analysis, with explicit attention to reasoning LLMs as a possible compensatory mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical scale is respectable: 22 translation directions, 3,000 examples per direction, for 66,000 instances in total. The model set includes 15 LLMs, covering instruction-tuned Qwen models, Qwen Thinking variants, DeepSeek distillations, and chat/reasoner variants, so both standard instruction models and reasoning-oriented post-trained models are represented. The main findings are: (1) non-English-centric pairs consistently obtain lower COMET than English-centric pairs across many models; (2) TAR serves as a useful proxy for language coverage and is strongly associated with COMET and BLEU, with lower target-language TAR linked to worse translation quality; (3) typological distance also matters, but TAR offers a more model-internal explanation than language distance alone; (4) low target-language TAR is significantly correlated with more generated reasoning tokens, suggesting that reasoning models try to compensate when target-language representation is weak; and (5) this compensation is not uniformly effective, but for some models more reasoning tokens correlate with gains in COMET or BLEU. The paper is more about robust correlations and diagnostics than about training a better system, so the key evidence lies in the grouped analyses and trend plots rather than in a single headline score.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the problem framing in the introduction, then read the experimental setup carefully, especially the dataset construction, prompt cleaning, and model selection. After that, focus on the result sections that relate TAR to COMET/BLEU, TAR to reasoning-token counts, and English-centric versus non-English-centric comparisons. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The useful part is not which model ranks highest, but how the paper links output cleanliness, token activation, language distance, and reasoning length into one diagnostic story. If you work on tokenization, multilingual pretraining, or continual pretraining, pay extra attention to how TAR is defined and where it may be sensitive to segmentation granularity, script differences, or shared subword structure. The paper is best read as a diagnostic framework that can inform follow-up experiments.

recommendation.zh: 可参考TAR指标用于预训练tokenizer低资源语言表示效果的内部评估，重点看§3的TAR定义部分
recommendation.en: Refer to the TAR metric for internal evaluation of low-resource language representation quality in your tokenizer and pretraining pipeline, focus on §3.

paper.title: Tracing Uncertainty in Language Model "Reasoning"
paper.abstract: Language model (LM) "reasoning", commonly described as Chain-of-Thought or test-time scaling, often improves benchmark performance, but the dynamics underlying this process remain poorly understood. We study these dynamics through the lens of uncertainty quantification by treating the "reasoning" traces, the intermediate token sequences generated by LMs, as evolving model states. We summarize each trace by an uncertainty trace profile: a small set of features describing the shape of the uncertai

summary.core_problem: 大模型思维链（CoT）生成的动态机制尚不明确，现有推理质量评估方法大多聚合整段轨迹的全局特征，丢弃了生成过程中的时序结构信息，无法准确预测最终答案的正确性。
summary.importance: 从不确定性时序演化的视角解释了CoT推理的动态过程，其提出的不确定性轨迹剖面特征可用于推理阶段的低质量轨迹过滤、最优轨迹选择，也为后训练阶段的推理质量优化提供了新的监督信号来源。
summary.technical_approach: 将CoT生成过程视为模型状态的时序演化过程，逐token计算三类不确定性度量（熵、KL散度等），构造不确定性轨迹剖面，提取轨迹的斜率、线性度等时序特征，用于预测最终答案的正确性。区别于现有方法聚合整段轨迹特征的做法，该方法保留了生成过程的完整时序结构信息。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K、ProntoQA两个推理数据集上对5个不同大模型测试，不确定性轨迹剖面预测答案正确性的AUROC最高可达0.807，优于现有依赖聚合特征的相关方法。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看第1章引言和图1，理解核心研究视角，再看第3章的不确定性轨迹剖面构造方法，最后看第4章的实验结果即可，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The dynamic mechanism of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation for large language models is not yet clear. Most existing reasoning quality assessment methods aggregate global features of the whole trajectory, discard the temporal structure information in the generation process, and cannot accurately predict the correctness of the final answer.
summary_en.importance: It explains the dynamic process of CoT reasoning from the perspective of temporal evolution of uncertainty. The proposed uncertainty trace profile features can be used for low-quality trace filtering and optimal trace selection in the inference stage, and also provide a new supervision signal source for reasoning quality optimization in the post-training stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treat the CoT generation process as the temporal evolution of model states, calculate three types of uncertainty metrics (entropy, KL divergence, etc.) per token, construct uncertainty trace profiles, and extract temporal features such as slope and linearity of the trace to predict the correctness of the final answer. Different from existing methods that aggregate features of the whole trajectory, this method retains the complete temporal structure information of the generation process.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 different large models across two reasoning datasets GSM8K and ProntoQA, the uncertainty trace profile achieves a maximum AUROC of 0.807 for predicting answer correctness, outperforming existing related methods relying on aggregated features.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read Chapter 1 Introduction and Figure 1 to understand the core research perspective, then read the uncertainty trace profile construction method in Chapter 3, and finally read the experimental results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time is 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 早期错误检测发现很有意思——前数百token就能预测最终正确率，这对推理时的early termination或reranking策略有实用价值。只看§3-4和Fig 2即可
recommendation.en: The early error detection finding is noteworthy—first few hundred tokens predict final correctness, useful for early termination or reranking. Read §3-4 and Fig 2 only.

institutions: Data Science Section, IT University of Copenhagen
MaiNLP, Center for Information and Language Processing, LMU Munich

paper.title: Task Relevance Is Not Local Replaceability: A Two-Axis View of Channel Information
paper.abstract: Channel importance in vision networks is usually summarized by a single score. That summary hides two different questions: how much a channel is related to the task, and whether its function can be supplied by same-layer peers when the channel is removed.
