1. Distance alignment: geodesic distances on the activation manifold and the behavior manifold are close to isometric up to a scale factor, whereas Euclidean distances fail to capture the same structure.
2. Naturalness of trajectories: linear steering often passes through low-density regions of behavior space and produces unnatural intermediate distributions, degraded fluency, or diversity collapse; manifold steering yields trajectories that more closely match the model’s natural output transitions.
3. Reverse recovery: when the optimization is performed in behavior space to stay on My, the resulting activation trajectory bends to follow the curvature of Mh rather than remaining a straight line.
4. Cross-modal consistency: similar geometry-behavior coupling appears in the video world model for physical position, suggesting the effect is not limited to toy text tasks.

The excerpt provided does not include the full quantitative tables, so it is better to focus on the structure of the evidence than to invent exact numbers. The paper is driven by geometric alignment, trajectory visualizations, and intervention quality rather than by a single benchmark score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you work on interpretability or activation control. Start with the introduction and the main setup. The key idea to retain is simple: the paper is not searching for a better steering vector, but for the right geometry of activation space. Then look at the weekday or month examples first, because cyclic concepts make the difference between straight-line and manifold-following interventions visually obvious. After that, read the sections showing geodesic-distance alignment between Mh and My; that is the central empirical support for the paper’s claim.

If you only spend 20–30 minutes, focus on three parts: task setup, the manifold-steering procedure, and the comparison figures between linear and manifold interventions. If you want the stronger causal argument, read the reverse optimization experiment where behavior-space constraints recover curved activation trajectories. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is not immediate adoption, but a caution: many representation analyses that look linear may only be locally linear.

recommendation.zh: 看干预 setup 和线性 steering 对照即可；结论若能在 LLM residual stream 上复现，会影响 activation editing 的默认几何假设。
recommendation.en: Read the intervention setup and the linear-steering control; if it transfers to LLM residual streams, it changes the default geometry assumption behind activation editing.

paper.title: Conceptors for Semantic Steering
paper.abstract: Activation-based steering provides control of LLM behavior at inference time, but the dominant paradigm reduces each concept to a single direction whose geometry is left largely unexamined. Rather than selecting a single steering direction, we use conceptors: soft projection matrices estimated from activations pooled across both poles of a bipolar concept, which preserve the concept's full multidimensional subspace. A geometric analysis shows the bipolar subspace strictly subsumes the single-vec

summary.core_problem: 改进基于激活的 LLM 语义 steering：单一方向向量过于粗糙，难以完整表示一个概念的多维几何结构。
summary.importance: 这是推理时控制与表示分析方向的工作，贡献在于把 concept steering 从“单向量”扩展到“子空间投影”，并给出层选择诊断与布尔组合规则。对做 activation engineering、可控生成、概念可分性分析的人有参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 conceptor 表示概念：从双极概念两端的激活中估计软投影矩阵，而不是只取一个 steering direction。这样可保留概念对应的多维子空间。文中还提出用 conceptor quota 作为无需额外参数的层选择指标，预测某层概念可分性；并利用 conceptor 的闭式 AND/OR/NOT 运算测试概念组合能力。整体属于对已有 activation steering 的几何化扩展，而非训练新模型。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个 instruction-tuned 模型、3 个语义维度上评估，报告 conceptor quota 与概念可分性的 Pearson 相关最高到 r=0.96。作者还做了五个设计轴的系统比较，结论是 conceptors 在多种设置下与加性 steering 基线持平或更好。摘要未给出模型规模、具体任务集和提升幅度，因此更像方法性 probe，而不是大规模稳健结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 New York University 等机构。未见该摘要对应到基座预训练一线团队，工作更接近 activation engineering 与表示控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets activation-based semantic steering in LLMs, arguing that a single steering vector is too crude to capture the full geometry of a concept.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time control and representation-analysis paper. Its contribution is to replace one-direction steering with subspace-based steering, plus a layer-selection diagnostic and Boolean composition rules. Useful if you care about activation engineering, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of representing a concept by one direction, the authors estimate a conceptor: a soft projection matrix derived from activations pooled from both poles of a bipolar concept. This preserves a multidimensional concept subspace. They also introduce conceptor quota as a parameter-free diagnostic for layer selection, and exploit the closed-form Boolean algebra of conceptors (AND/OR/NOT) to test compositional steering. Overall, this is a geometric extension of existing activation steering rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate on three instruction-tuned models and three semantic dimensions, reporting Pearson correlations up to r=0.96 between conceptor quota and concept separability. A five-axis design-space study suggests conceptors match or outperform additive steering baselines in multiple settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark details, or robust effect sizes, so the evidence looks more methodological than large-scale or definitive.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with New York University and other institutions. The work appears closer to activation engineering and representation control than to core pretraining research.

recommendation.zh: 偏 activation engineering，不是 pretrain 主线；只看 conceptor quota 那部分，若你在做表示探针或 steering 诊断，可拿来替代拍脑袋选层。
recommendation.en: This is activation engineering, not core pretraining; read the conceptor-quota section only if you need a less ad hoc way to choose steering layers.

paper.title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
paper.abstract: Large language models can be steered at inference time through prompting or activation interventions, but activation steering methods often underperform compared to prompt-based approaches. We propose a framework that formulates prompt steering as a form of activation steering and investigates whether distilling successful prompt steering behavior into simpler, interpretable models can close this gap. Our analysis reveals that popular activation steering methods are not faithful to the mechanics

summary.core_problem: 现有 activation steering（如对某层激活加一个固定 steering vector、全 token 同一系数）在很多任务上不如 prompt steering。论文要回答的是：prompt steering 到底在激活层面“做了什么”，以及能否把这种机制蒸馏成一个更简单、可解释、但效果接近 prompting 的 activation steering 模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身（数据/目标/优化/scale）影响不大，但对“推理时控制”与“机制可解释性”有直接启发：1）把 prompting 形式化为一种 activation intervention，有助于把 ICL/提示词的作用落到可测量的内部量上；2）指出常用 constant-coefficient 的 steering 结构性不匹配 prompting 的干预形态（token 位置差异很大），这对后续做更强的 steering、以及把 steering 当作可插拔对齐层（不改权重）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把“加了 steering prompt 的前向传播”重写为“在原 prompt 的前向传播中，对共享后缀 token 的激活施加一个等价干预”。论文区分两种视角：
- 累积干预（accumulated）：把 prompt 的影响看成从底层到第 l 层累积起来的总差值 Δ_PS_acc。
- 局部干预（local）：在逐层传播时，把 steering prompt token 的激活替换回 unsteered 版本，从而把每一层的净影响抽出来，得到 Δ_PS_loc。
在这个框架下，作者实证分析 prompt steering 的 Δ_PS 在 token 维度上呈现强烈的“非均匀性”：少数 token 位置被强干预，大多数位置几乎不动；而文献中常见的 Const family（ActAdd/CAA/ITI 等）假设对所有位置用同一个 α，天然不匹配。
据此提出 Prompt Steering Replacement（PSR）：仍然使用 rank-1 方向（一个 steering vector z_attr），但把系数从常数 α 变成 token-specific 的 α_i，并且 α_i 由当前 token 的激活（或其可计算特征）预测出来。训练目标是“模仿 prompt steering 造成的激活变化/或输出行为”，相当于把 prompt 的复杂、不可解释的内部干预蒸馏到一个小而可解释的 gating/回归模块上。
论文还讨论了 PSR 何时能表示 prompt steering：需要 prompt 的主要作用在某层附近可被近似为 rank-1 方向 + 位置相关强度（而不是多方向、多机制叠加）。作者承认该假设对所有指令不成立，但认为 token-wise 系数是更一般理论的必要成分。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述“提升多少、在哪些模型/基准上”的精确数字。就方法设计与实验设置层面，论文强调：
- 任务是 long-form generation 的 steering，在 3 个 benchmark、多个 LLM 上评估。
- 评价不仅看属性命中，也强调控制“高连贯（high-coherence）完成”的对比，避免 steering 通过破坏流畅性来刷指标。
- 结论是最佳 PSR 配置能与强 steering baseline 相比不落下风，且在连贯性受控时更占优。
若需要精确数字，需要对照论文的实验章节/附录表格（当前输入未提供）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看把 prompt steering 写成 activation intervention 的那一节（含 Figure 1 的三段对照：unsteered / prompted / intervention view），理解 Δ_PS_acc 与 Δ_PS_loc 的定义差异。
2）重点看“prompt 干预在 token 位置上不均匀”的实证图（通常是 token index vs intervention magnitude/α_i 的可视化），这是提出 PSR 的直接证据。
3）再看 PSR 的形式：α_i 如何从激活估计、训练信号如何构造、以及 rank-1 假设的适用边界。
4）最后扫实验：尤其是连贯性控制下的对比，判断它是否真的在“更像 prompting”而不是换一种退化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering methods that add a fixed vector with a constant coefficient across tokens often lag behind prompt-based steering. The paper asks what prompt steering is doing in activation space, and whether that behavior can be distilled into a lightweight, interpretable activation-level module that closes the gap to prompting.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes (data/objectives/optimization), but meaningful for inference-time controllability and mechanistic understanding of prompting/ICL. The key contribution is a structural critique: many steering baselines assume uniform intervention strength across token positions, while prompt steering induces highly token-dependent interventions. This reframes how to design steering modules that better approximate prompting without weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes prompt steering as an activation intervention on the same generated suffix tokens. It introduces two notions of the prompt-induced intervention: (i) an accumulated effect up to layer l (Δ_PS_acc), and (ii) a layer-local effect (Δ_PS_loc) obtained by “neutralizing” the steering-prompt token activations while propagating the steered suffix, isolating per-layer net changes.
Empirically, the prompt-induced intervention is strongly non-uniform across token positions: a few positions receive large shifts while many are barely affected. This contradicts the common Const family (ActAdd/CAA/ITI/ReFT-R1-style) that applies the same scalar coefficient α everywhere.
Based on this, the paper proposes Prompt Steering Replacement (PSR): keep a rank-1 direction z_attr but replace the constant α with token-specific coefficients α_i predicted from the current activations (a small, interpretable gating/regression module). PSR is trained to imitate the activation changes and/or behavioral effects produced by successful prompt steering, effectively distilling an implicit prompt mechanism into an explicit intervention.
The authors also spell out when PSR can approximate prompting: when the prompt’s dominant effect at the chosen layer can be approximated by a single direction with position-dependent magnitude, rather than multi-directional or more complex dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main result tables or exact numbers, so precise gains, model sizes, and benchmark scores cannot be stated reliably here. From the described setup: PSR is evaluated on long-form generation steering across three benchmarks and multiple LLMs, with an emphasis on comparing methods under matched coherence (to avoid attributing “success” to degraded fluency). The reported qualitative conclusion is that the best PSR configurations are competitive with strong steering baselines, especially when controlling for high-coherence outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the section that rewrites prompt steering as activation interventions (and the figure contrasting unsteered vs prompted vs intervention views). Focus on the definitions of Δ_PS_acc vs Δ_PS_loc.
2) Inspect the evidence showing token-position non-uniformity of prompt-induced interventions; this is the main diagnostic that motivates PSR.
3) Read the PSR formulation: how α_i is predicted from activations, what supervision signal is used for distillation, and what assumptions are required for rank-1 approximations.
4) Skim the evaluation with coherence-controlled comparisons to judge whether PSR truly matches prompting rather than trading off fluency.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制部分：若结论站得住，很多线性 steering baseline 的 token-uniform 假设都要重做。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanistic analysis: if the result holds, many token-uniform linear steering baselines need to be rethought.

paper.title: Tracing the Dynamics of Refusal: Exploiting Latent Refusal Trajectories for Robust Jailbreak Detection
paper.abstract: Representation Engineering typically relies on static refusal vectors derived from terminal representations. We move beyond this paradigm, demonstrating that refusal is a dynamic and sparse process rather than a localized outcome. Using Causal Tracing, we uncover the Refusal Trajectory-a persistent upstream signature that remains intact even when adversarial attacks (e.g., GCG) suppress terminal signals. Leveraging this, we propose SALO (Sparse Activation Localization Operator), an inference-tim

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 jailbreak 检测过度依赖末层 refusal 表征、在强攻击下终态信号被抹掉后几乎失效的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇安全机制分析工作，贡献不在新的对齐训练，而在于把 refusal 从“静态向量”改写为“沿层传播的稀疏动态轨迹”，对理解安全表征在网络中的形成与脆弱点有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先用 causal tracing 分析拒答信号在模型内部的传播，提出 Refusal Trajectory，认为 refusal 是上游持续存在的动态过程，而不是只在末层局部出现。基于这一观察，设计了推理时检测器 SALO（Sparse Activation Localization Operator），不看终态单点表征，而是抓取潜在的稀疏激活模式，用于识别被强制解码攻击压制后的隐性 refusal 信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：在 GCG 等对抗攻击下，依赖 terminal states 的方法检测率可从接近 0% 崩到失效，而 SALO 能把检测率恢复到 90% 以上。摘要未提供模型规模、训练数据或更细 baseline 设定，因此目前更像一篇值得看方法与分析部分、但需要核查实验 setup 是否干净的论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the failure of jailbreak detectors that rely on terminal-layer refusal representations, which collapse once adversarial attacks suppress the final refusal signal.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a safety-mechanism paper rather than a new alignment method. Its value is in reframing refusal as a sparse, dynamic trajectory across layers instead of a static terminal vector, which is mildly useful for understanding internal safety representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses causal tracing to study how refusal signals propagate inside the model and introduces the notion of a Refusal Trajectory: an upstream signature that persists even when the terminal signal is suppressed. Based on this, it proposes SALO, a Sparse Activation Localization Operator for inference-time detection that captures latent sparse activation patterns rather than relying on a single terminal representation.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the headline result is that under attacks such as GCG, methods based on terminal states can drop to near-zero detection, while SALO recovers detection rates to above 90%. The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or detailed baselines, so the main value is likely in the analysis and setup, which should be checked carefully.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但如果你关心安全表征在层间如何形成，只看 causal tracing 和那条 refusal trajectory；检测结果很猛，先别全信，重点查攻击设定是否偏窄。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about how safety features form across layers, read the causal-tracing part and the refusal trajectory claim; the gains are large, so verify how narrow the attack setup is.

paper.title: Analysis and Explainability of LLMs Via Evolutionary Methods
paper.abstract: Evolutionary methods have long been useful for analysis and explanation in genetics, biology, ecology, and related fields. In this work, we extend these methods to neural networks, specifically large language models (LLMs), to better analyze and explain relationships among models. We show how relating weights to genotypes and output text to phenotypes can improve our understanding of model lineage, important datasets, the roles of different model layers, and visualization of model relationships.

summary.core_problem: 把进化分析方法迁移到 LLM，研究模型权重、输出行为、训练数据和模型谱系之间的关系。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析工具。它不是改进预训练算法，但对模型 lineage、数据来源影响、层级差异和黑盒模型关系可视化有一定启发，尤其适合做模型溯源和训练家族分析。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把权重类比为 genotype，把输出文本类比为 phenotype，用进化树和距离分析刻画模型之间的关系。在受控实验中，作者构造有真实训练树的模型族，并检验估计出的树是否能恢复真实拓扑；还分析哪些层的权重差异最能区分模型。
summary.experiments: 实验包括一个受控训练树恢复任务、层重要性分析、phenotypic 输出实验，以及对黑盒 foundation models 的无监督进化树构建。摘要称估计树能可靠恢复真实训练拓扑，并发现某个训练数据集贡献了更多有用信息，但未给出模型规模、数据规模和完整指标细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University Department of Statistics & Data Science 和 Carnegie Mellon University Software Engineering Institute AI Division。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper adapts evolutionary analysis to LLMs to study relationships among weights, outputs, training data, and model lineage.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis tool rather than a pretraining method. It is relevant for model lineage, data-attribution signals, layer-level differences, and visualization of relationships among black-box or related foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat model weights as genotypes and generated text as phenotypes, then use evolutionary trees and distance-based analyses to represent model relationships. In a controlled setting with a known training tree, they test whether the inferred tree recovers the true topology and examine which layers carry the strongest lineage signal.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include controlled training-tree recovery, layer-importance analysis, phenotypic output tests, and an unsupervised evolutionary tree over black-box foundation models. The abstract reports reliable recovery of the ground-truth topology and suggests one training dataset contributes more useful information, but does not provide full model sizes, dataset scales, or metric details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Carnegie Mellon University's Department of Statistics & Data Science and the AI Division of the Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute.

recommendation.zh: 有点意思但还偏工具雏形；只看受控 lineage 实验和层差异分析，判断能否用于内部模型族溯源。
recommendation.en: Interesting as an early tool; read only the controlled lineage experiment and layer-difference analysis for possible internal model-family tracing.

institutions: Carnegie Mellon University Software Engineering Institute

paper.title: Agentic-imodels: Evolving agentic interpretability tools via autoresearch
paper.abstract: Agentic data science (ADS) systems are rapidly improving their capability to autonomously analyze, fit, and interpret data, potentially moving towards a future where agents conduct the vast majority of data-science work. However, current ADS systems use statistical tools designed to be interpretable by humans, rather than interpretable by agents. To address this, we introduce Agentic-imodels, an agentic autoresearch loop that evolves data-science tools designed to be interpretable by agents. Spe

summary.core_problem: 研究面向 Agentic Data Science 的可解释工具：传统可解释模型主要给人读，但不一定适合让 LLM agent 读取、模拟和复用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 工具自动发现与评测方法。它把“可解释性”从人类可读转向 agent 可消费，对自动研究、自动建模系统有方法论意义，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic-imodels，一个 agentic autoresearch loop，自动演化 scikit-learn 兼容的表格回归器。优化目标同时包含预测性能和一个 LLM-based interpretability metric；该指标通过一组 LLM 评分测试，检查模型的字符串表示是否足以让 LLM 回答模型行为相关问题，即是否“simulatable”。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是表格数据回归模型库，比较 evolved models 在预测性能与 LLM 可模拟性上的联合表现。摘要称演化出的模型能同时改进预测性能和可解释性，但未给出数据集规模、LLM evaluator、baseline 数量和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Microsoft Research 与 National University of Singapore 相关作者；Jianfeng Gao 和 Michel Galley 长期从事对话系统、检索增强、LLM 与 agent 方向研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies interpretability tools for agentic data science: existing interpretable models are designed for humans, not necessarily for LLM agents that must read, simulate, and reuse model artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an automated tool-discovery and evaluation framework for agents. It reframes interpretability as agent-consumability, which is useful for autoresearch systems, though only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentic-imodels is an agentic autoresearch loop that evolves scikit-learn-compatible tabular regressors. The search objective combines predictive accuracy with an LLM-based interpretability metric, where LLM-graded tests measure whether the model's string representation is sufficient for an LLM to answer questions about model behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on tabular regression models and compare evolved models on both predictive quality and LLM simulability. The abstract reports joint improvement, but does not provide dataset scale, evaluator details, baseline count, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work involves Microsoft Research and National University of Singapore-affiliated authors; Jianfeng Gao and Michel Galley are well-known for work on dialogue systems, retrieval-augmented modeling, LLMs, and agents.

recommendation.zh: 看 metric 设计即可；把可解释性改成“agent 能否消费”的角度有意思，但不改变基座训练判断。
recommendation.en: Read the metric design only; agent-consumable interpretability is a useful framing, but it does not move any foundation-model training prior.

paper.title: Concepts Whisper While Syntax Shouts: Spectral Anti-Concentration and the Dual Geometry of Transformer Representations
paper.abstract: We test whether the causal inner product of \citet{park2024linear} -- defined by the unembedding covariance $Σ$ -- enables cross-lingual concept transport. Across 17 models and 4 language pairs, a matched-spectrum randomization test finds that Whitened Causal Alignment is indistinguishable from spectral regularization alone ($p = 0.95$). However, this failure reveals a broader phenomenon: anti-concentration is observed in residual-stream difference-of-means vectors across five architecture famil

summary.core_problem: 论文检验 Park et al. 提出的 causal inner product 是否能带来跨语言概念迁移收益，并进一步追问：LLM residual stream 中的概念方向到底落在 unembedding covariance 频谱的哪些子空间里。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析层面。负结果很明确：用 unembedding covariance 定义的白化因果几何，并没有在跨语言概念 transport 中给出可测收益。更有信息量的是后续发现：激活空间里的概念方向系统性偏向低方差谱尾，而词表侧的 unembedding row contrast 反而集中在高方差方向。这提示 residual stream 的“可干预概念空间”和 logits 侧的“词表/语法空间”可能有不同几何分工。对研究表示学习、tokenizer/词表几何、概念 steering 和 cross-lingual alignment 都有参考价值，但它不是预训练方法论文，也没有直接给出训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是 Whitened Causal Alignment。作者对每种语言的 token 子集计算 unembedding covariance Σ，加正则后用 Σ^{-1/2} 对 residual 表示白化，再做 Procrustes alignment，希望去除语言特定的各向异性。如果 causal geometry 假设有效，白化后的跨语言概念方向应比普通 Procrustes 更容易对齐。第二步是 matched-spectrum randomization test。作者构造保持特征值谱但随机化特征向量的对照，用来区分“收益来自谱形状”还是“来自具体 causal eigendirections”。结果显示 WCA 与只保留谱信息的随机化对照不可区分。随后作者转向频谱分析：把 difference-of-means concept vectors、SAE features、linear probes 投影到 Σ 的特征子空间，统计这些方向是否集中在高方差或低方差部分。核心发现是 activation-space concept directions anti-concentrate in the spectral tail，而静态 unembedding-row contrasts 呈相反趋势。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 17 个模型、5 类架构族、4 组跨语言 pair。WCA 的 matched-spectrum 检验给出 p=0.95，说明 causal eigendirections 对跨语言 transport 没有显著额外贡献。激活空间概念方向的 anti-concentration 在 residual-stream difference-of-means vectors 上非常稳定，报告 p<1e-33；SAE features 也支持该现象，例如 p=4.5e-19；Gemma 和 Llama 上的 linear probes 给出相近证据。词表侧实验显示，concept-specific unembedding-row differences 更偏向高方差方向，并通过 random-pair null model 排除普通 token pair 差异造成的假象。功能性实验包括 split-injection steering：在 Gemma 和 Llama 上，把概念向量注入高方差 eigendirections 会比注入低方差方向带来更明显的 perplexity degradation。POS-tag probing 进一步显示，多数测试架构中句法信息更偏向高方差子空间。这个结果和标题里的说法一致：语法在高方差空间里更“显眼”，概念在低方差谱尾里更“安静”。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看三处：Section 4 的 matched-spectrum randomization test，用来判断负结果是否扎实；Sections 5–7 的频谱投影统计，这是主要发现；Section 8 的 steering 和 POS probing，用来理解为什么高方差方向可能承载更多语法/格式压力，而概念方向被推到低方差空间。对预训练研究者来说，不必细抠每个跨语言 pair 的指标，更值得关注的是实验设计：保谱随机化是一个干净的因果几何检验；activation/unembedding 双侧对照也适合迁移到 tokenizer 几何、logit lens、representation anisotropy 等问题上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the causal inner product induced by the unembedding covariance can improve cross-lingual concept transport, and then studies where concept directions live in the spectrum of that covariance.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. The negative result is useful: whitening by the proposed causal geometry does not measurably improve cross-lingual concept alignment beyond spectral regularization. The more interesting finding is a geometric split. Concept directions in activation space tend to occupy the low-variance spectral tail, while concept contrasts in static unembedding rows concentrate in high-variance directions. This matters for work on representation geometry, steering, vocabulary geometry, and cross-lingual alignment. It does not directly propose a pretraining recipe, but it gives a concrete diagnostic for how residual-stream features and vocabulary-side geometry can diverge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The first component is Whitened Causal Alignment. For a language-specific token subset, the authors estimate an unembedding covariance matrix Σ, regularize it, whiten residual representations with Σ^{-1/2}, and then run Procrustes alignment. The intended test is simple: if the causal geometry is the right geometry for concepts, whitening should improve cross-lingual transport over a naive alignment. The second component is a matched-spectrum randomization test. It preserves the eigenvalue spectrum while randomizing eigenvectors, separating the effect of spectral shape from the effect of the actual causal eigendirections. After the transport result comes out negative, the paper analyzes projections of difference-of-means concept vectors, SAE features, and linear probes onto the eigenspaces of Σ. This reveals anti-concentration of activation-space concept directions in the spectral tail, together with an opposite concentration pattern for unembedding-row contrasts.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 17 models, five architecture families, and four language pairs. In the cross-lingual transport experiment, Whitened Causal Alignment is statistically indistinguishable from the matched-spectrum control, with p=0.95. The anti-concentration result is much stronger: residual-stream difference-of-means vectors show p<1e-33, and SAE features support the same pattern, with an example p-value of 4.5e-19. Linear probes on Gemma and Llama provide additional evidence. On the vocabulary side, concept-specific unembedding-row differences concentrate in high-variance directions, and a random-pair null model is used to show that this is not just a generic token-pair effect. Functional checks include split-injection steering, where injecting along high-variance eigendirections damages perplexity more than low-variance injection on Gemma and Llama, and POS-tag probing across eight models, where syntactic information is often more available in the high-variance subspace.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read Section 4 for the matched-spectrum test, because it is the cleanest part of the negative result. Then read Sections 5–7 for the spectral anti-concentration and the activation-vocabulary contrast. Section 8 is worth checking for the functional interpretation: high-variance directions appear more tied to syntax and distributional stability, while low-variance directions can carry steerable concept information with less perplexity damage. The reusable idea is the diagnostic setup, especially the spectrum-preserving randomization and the paired analysis of residual-stream and unembedding-side geometry.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了概念在低方差方向编码的反常识现象，对设计 SAE 和理解表示几何有启发，重点看双重几何的分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the counter-intuitive phenomenon that concepts are encoded in low-variance directions, inspiring SAE design and understanding of representation geometry; focus on the dual geometry analysis.

paper.title: H-Probes: Extracting Hierarchical Structures From Latent Representations of Language Models
paper.abstract: Representing and navigating hierarchy is a fundamental primitive of reasoning. Large language models have demonstrated proficiency in a wide variety of tasks requiring hierarchical reasoning, but there exists limited analysis on how the models geometrically represent the necessary latent constructions for such thinking. To this end, we develop \textit{H-probes}, a collection of linear probes that extract hierarchical structure, specifically depth and pairwise distance, from latent representation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答一个机制分析问题：LLM 在执行需要层级推理的任务时，隐状态里是否存在可读出的树状结构，以及这些结构是否只是相关特征，还是对任务执行有因果作用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在表示分析。它把“层级推理”从行为层面的准确率，推进到 latent geometry 层面的可测对象：深度、节点间树距离、低维结构子空间。这个视角对理解 CoT、树搜索式推理、分解式任务表示有启发。尤其值得注意的是，作者不仅做 probe，还做子空间消融，试图区分“可解码”与“被使用”。这比只报告 probe accuracy 的分析更有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 H-probes，是一组线性 probe，用来从模型中间层表示中恢复层级结构。任务首先构造成显式树遍历：随机标号的满二叉树，模型需要输出从起点到终点的最短路径。作者在模型生成最终答案时，抽取答案路径中节点 token 对应的各层激活。为了降低过拟合，先把隐状态用 PCA 压到 10 个主要方向；多数层中这些方向覆盖约 90% 方差。随后训练 probe 去预测两类结构量：单个节点的深度，以及节点对之间的树距离。这样做的好处是，层级结构被拆成局部位置量和成对关系量，而不是只用一个分类标签间接判断。作者还把 probe 找到的子空间用于干预：移除或扰动对应方向，观察树遍历性能是否下降。区别于传统 syntactic probe，这里关注的不是依存句法树，而是推理过程中的任务层级；区别于纯相关性可视化，它加入了跨数据、跨深度、跨模型和因果消融。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 Qwen 系列 reasoning 与 non-reasoning 模型：R1-distilled Qwen 1.5B、7B、14B，以及 Qwen 1.5 Chat 1.8B、7B、14B。生成采用 greedy decoding，最大 2000 token，reasoning 模型包含 CoT。基础树数据包含深度 1–2 的二叉树，1000 个遍历样本，一步和两步路径各占一半。迁移实验使用深度 3–4 的树，同样 1000 个样本，并加入 0.5 到 1.0 的稀疏度变化，保留 ancestor-closed 子树以保证层级仍成立。作者报告的主要现象是：H-probes 能在 held-out 数据上恢复深度和距离；不同训练集得到的结构子空间相近；不同尺度模型中都能找到类似信号；从浅树训练得到的 probe 可以迁移到更深、更稀疏的树，并进一步迁移到 GSM8K 和 HiBench 这类隐式层级任务。GSM8K 中的推理步骤层级由 LLM-as-a-judge 构造，HiBench 使用已有层级标注。消融实验显示，移除这些低维层级子空间会显著破坏树遍历表现，说明它们不只是可读出的旁路信息。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看方法部分的 H-probe 定义、PCA 降维设置、深度与树距离两个目标的建模方式，以及子空间消融实验。图表中优先找三类结果：probe 在不同层的表现、跨树深度迁移、ablation 后任务成功率变化。附录 A.1/A.2 值得扫一遍，因为树数据构造和 prompt 细节会影响这类机制分析的可信度。需要谨慎看的点是 GSM8K 层级标注来自 LLM judge，这会引入额外噪声；如果用它支撑强结论，应检查一致性和人工验证比例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs represent hierarchical reasoning in a geometrically recoverable form, and whether such representations are causally used rather than merely decodable from activations.
summary_en.importance: The value is mainly mechanistic, not a new pretraining recipe. It turns hierarchical reasoning into measurable latent variables: node depth, pairwise tree distance, and low-dimensional subspaces carrying these quantities. This is relevant for understanding how chain-of-thought, task decomposition, and tree-like reasoning may be implemented inside transformer states. The causal ablation component is the useful part: it moves beyond standard probing, where high probe accuracy can reflect information that the model does not actually use.
summary_en.technical_approach: H-probes are a family of linear probes designed to recover hierarchical structure from hidden states. The controlled task is binary-tree traversal: nodes are randomly labeled, and the model must output the shortest path between two nodes. During generation, the authors collect activations at the tokens corresponding to nodes in the model’s final path answer. To reduce overfitting, they first project hidden states onto the top 10 PCA directions, which usually preserve about 90% of variance in the analyzed layers. The probes then predict two structural quantities: the depth of individual nodes and pairwise tree distance between nodes. This separates absolute position in the hierarchy from relational structure. The same identified subspaces are then used for interventions: removing or perturbing these directions tests whether task performance depends on them. Compared with classical syntactic structural probes, the target is not dependency syntax but hierarchy in the reasoning process. Compared with pure representation visualization, the paper adds transfer tests and causal ablations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use both reasoning and non-reasoning Qwen-family models: R1-distilled Qwen at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B parameters, and Qwen 1.5 Chat at 1.8B, 7B, and 14B. Generation is greedy with a 2000-token limit, including CoT for reasoning models. The main synthetic dataset contains 1000 traversal examples from depth-1 and depth-2 binary trees, balanced between one-step and two-step paths. Transfer uses 1000 examples from depth-3 and depth-4 trees, with sparsity sampled between 0.5 and 1.0 while preserving ancestor-closed structure and target maximum depth. The reported findings are that H-probes generalize to held-out samples, converge to similar subspaces across training splits, appear across model sizes, and transfer from shallow synthetic trees to deeper and sparser trees. The authors also test less explicit hierarchy using GSM8K, where step hierarchy is constructed with an LLM judge, and HiBench, where hierarchy labels are provided. Ablating the low-dimensional hierarchical subspace substantially harms tree traversal, supporting a causal role for the probed directions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the H-probe construction, the PCA preprocessing, the definitions of depth and tree-distance targets, and the causal subspace intervention. The most informative figures are likely the layerwise probe performance, transfer to deeper trees, and performance after ablation. The dataset and prompt details in Appendix A.1/A.2 are worth checking because synthetic hierarchy tasks can be sensitive to formatting. Treat the GSM8K results with some caution, since the hierarchy labels are produced by an LLM judge; the strength of those conclusions depends on label reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看 probe 设计和消融部分；若因果干预 setup 干净，可作为层级推理表征分析的可复用模板。
recommendation.en: Read the probe design and ablations; if the causal intervention setup is clean, it is a reusable template for studying hierarchical reasoning representations.

paper.title: The Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis for Language Model Steering
paper.abstract: Steering is a widely used technique for controlling large language models, yet its effects are often unstable and hard to predict. Existing theoretical accounts are largely based on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH). While LRH assumes that concepts can be orthogonalized for lossless control, this idealized mapping fails in real representations and cannot account for the observed unpredictability of steering. By relaxing LRH's orthogonality assumption while preserving linear representati

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是：为什么同样是 activation steering，很多时候平均上有效，但落到单个样本时却很不稳定，而且现有基于 Linear Representation Hypothesis（LRH）的解释经常失灵。作者认为问题不在于“向量提取不够干净”这么简单，而在于 LRH 默认概念之间可以被正交化、从而实现近乎无损控制，这个前提在有限维表示空间里通常不成立。只要概念数超过可容纳的独立方向数，或者多个语义因素在同一表示子空间里重叠，steering 就天然会带有样本依赖的干扰。论文要解决的核心，是给这种不规则、样本特异的 steering 行为提供一个更贴近真实表示几何的解释框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不算一线方法创新，更像是机制解释层面的补充，所以放在 skim 是合适的。但它有两个启发。第一，它提醒人不要把“线性可分”“方向可提取”直接等同于“可稳定控制”，这对理解中间层表示、做 concept editing、做 post-hoc controllability 评估都有用。第二，它把 steering 失败解释为表示几何的必然结果，而不是单纯的数据噪声或实现细节问题，这会影响后续如何设计 steerability 指标：只看全局 separability 可能不够，还要看局部、样本条件下的几何结构。对基座预训练本身，它不是直接改训练目标，但对表示学习是否应该鼓励更可控、更解耦的内部结构，提供了一个值得继续追问的方向。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis（CRH）来替代 LRH 的理想化设定。核心想法是：概念仍然可以在线性框架下表示，但不同概念的贡献允许重叠、非正交。这样一来，某个目标概念在具体样本上的表示差异，不再由单一全局方向完全决定，而会分解成三个部分：一个主轴（axis），表示“概念缺失”到“概念出现”的主要变化；一个与主轴正交的法平面（normal plane），承载样本特异的剩余变化；以及法平面中的敏感扇区（sensitive sectors），决定某个 steering 向量投影进去后，是促进、抑制，还是延迟目标概念的激活。这个结构解释了一个经验现象：两个 steering 向量即便和目标方向夹角接近，实际效果也可能差很多，因为它们在样本对应的法平面里可能落在不同扇区。方法上，这篇论文不是提出新的 steering 算法，而是提出新的几何解释与验证程序。它先从“有限维空间中不可能让过多独立概念都正交”这个反例出发，论证 LRH 的 lossless control 前提过强；再把表示差异写成多个非正交概念的线性叠加，推导出样本条件下的圆柱式几何；最后在多模型、多概念、多种 steering 实现上做经验验证，检查 axis-normal-plane 结构是否稳定出现。论文的关键区别在于：它保留了线性表示假设，但放弃了全局正交和全局可预测性，因此解释重点从“找一条纯净方向”转向“局部几何如何决定控制结果”。
summary.experiments: 实验部分的主结论是，作者在 100 个概念上都观察到了相对一致的 cylindrical structure，而且这种现象跨模型架构、跨 steering 实现都存在。摘要和引言里没有给出很多具体数值，但从全文描述看，验证重点不是追求任务分数提升，而是检验 CRH 的几个可观测预言是否成立：一是表示差异能否稳定分解出主轴与法平面成分；二是法平面成分的大小是否与 steering 强度趋势相关；三是单样本结果是否会因为平面内“相位/扇区”不同而显著变化。作者还强调，基于 axis 的分解可以粗略估计整体 steerability trend，但无法预测单个样本是否会命中 sensitive sector，因此只能解释“平均上可控、个体上难预测”的现象，而不能把单样本结果做成确定性预报器。若从实验可信度看，这篇工作的价值主要在验证范围较广：100 concepts、多个模型、多个 steering setting，而不是某一个 benchmark 上的性能数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 “Limitations of the Linear Representation Hypothesis”。这里把问题立住了：为什么 separability 不等于 controllability，为什么正交化前提过强。然后重点看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2。Figure 1 是整篇论文最重要的直觉图，讲清 axis、normal plane、sensitive sector 三件事；Figure 2 则说明有限维空间里概念重叠不是偶然噪声，而是几何约束。之后再看 CRH 的形式化定义和验证实验，重点关注作者如何把“圆柱结构”变成可测量对象，以及不同模型/概念下这个结构是否稳定。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果想深一点，可以追问两个问题：第一，sensitive sector 是否能被更强的条件变量预测；第二，这种几何是否能反过来指导训练时的表示解耦，而不只是事后解释 steering。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why activation steering is often effective on average yet highly unstable at the per-sample level, and why explanations based on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH) fail to predict that behavior. The authors argue that the issue is not merely imperfect vector extraction. The deeper problem is that LRH assumes concepts can be orthogonalized for near-lossless control, which is generally unrealistic in finite-dimensional representation spaces. Once multiple semantic factors overlap in the same subspace, steering becomes inherently sample-dependent. The paper’s central goal is to provide a geometric account of this irregularity.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, and it is not introducing a stronger steering algorithm. Its value is conceptual. It sharpens an important distinction between linear separability and reliable controllability, which matters for representation analysis, concept editing, and post-hoc steering diagnostics. It also reframes steering failures as a structural consequence of representation geometry rather than incidental noise. For foundation-model research, the main implication is that global steerability metrics based only on separability are likely incomplete; local, sample-conditioned geometry may matter more than current practice assumes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis (CRH) as a relaxation of LRH. Concepts are still treated as linearly represented, but their contributions are allowed to overlap and need not be orthogonal. Under this view, the representation difference associated with a target concept decomposes into three parts: an axis capturing the main transition between concept absence and presence, a normal plane orthogonal to that axis that carries sample-specific residual variation, and sensitive sectors within that plane that determine whether a steering vector projection facilitates, suppresses, or delays concept activation. This explains an empirical puzzle: two steering vectors can have similar global angular alignment with the target concept yet produce very different outcomes because they land in different sectors of the sample-specific normal plane. Methodologically, the work is not a new steering procedure but a new geometric model plus an empirical validation protocol. It first argues, via finite-dimensional counterexamples, that lossless orthogonal disentanglement is too strong an assumption. It then derives the cylindrical geometry from linear combinations of non-orthogonal concept contributions, and finally tests whether the predicted axis-plane structure appears consistently across models, concepts, and steering implementations.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical claim is that a consistent cylindrical structure appears across 100 concepts, multiple model architectures, and multiple steering implementations. The paper is not centered on benchmark score gains. Instead, it validates several observable predictions of CRH: whether representation differences admit a stable axis-plus-normal-plane decomposition, whether the magnitude of the normal-plane component tracks broad steering intensity trends, and whether per-sample outcomes vary sharply depending on the sector in which the steering projection falls. The authors also emphasize a useful asymmetry: axis-based decomposition may provide a rough estimate of average steerability, but it cannot infer the sensitive sector, so single-sample outcomes remain difficult to predict. The strength of the experimental section is breadth of validation rather than one headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction and the section on the limitations of LRH. Those parts establish why separability is not the same as controllability and why the orthogonality assumption is too idealized. Then focus on Figure 1 and Figure 2. Figure 1 is the key intuition for the whole paper: axis, normal plane, and sensitive sectors. Figure 2 is important because it shows that concept overlap is not just noise but a geometric necessity in limited dimensions. After that, read the formal CRH definition and the validation experiments, paying attention to how the cylindrical structure is operationalized and how stable it is across models and concepts. A first pass should take about 25–35 minutes. The deeper follow-up questions are whether sensitive sectors can be predicted from richer conditioning variables, and whether this geometry can inform training-time disentanglement rather than only post-hoc explanation.

recommendation.zh: 修正了线性表示假说的正交假设，看§3的圆柱形表示形式化和§5的验证实验即可
recommendation.en: Revises the orthogonality assumption of the Linear Representation Hypothesis, only read §3 formalization of cylindrical representation and §5 validation experiments

paper.title: Measuring AI Reasoning: A Guide for Researchers
paper.abstract: In this paper, we offer a guide for researchers on evaluating reasoning in language models, building the case that reasoning should be assessed through evidence of adaptive, multi-step search rather than final-answer accuracy alone. Under an evaluation-oriented definition, reasoning requires selecting intermediate steps and halting according to input-dependent conditions, which we formalize as a search-like procedure. We show that single forward passes in scalable architectures are structurally

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是：如何评价语言模型是否真的在“推理”，而不是只用最终答案准确率来混合衡量记忆、模式匹配和多步搜索。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测信号上。当前很多 reasoning benchmark 的 pass@1 或 exact match 会把三类能力混在一起：训练语料中见过的事实回忆、基于局部统计规律的理解、以及需要中间状态选择和停止条件控制的多步推理。对于预训练和后训练，这会直接影响数据选择、RL reward 设计和 reasoning trace 的质量判断。如果只奖励最终答案，模型可能学到 benchmark shortcut 或污染样本的再现，而不是学到可迁移的搜索过程。论文的贡献不是提出新模型，而是给出一套较清楚的评测语言，适合用来校准 reasoning 数据和过程监督实验。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 reasoning 定义为一种面向评测的 adaptive multi-step computation：模型需要根据输入选择中间步骤，并在输入相关的条件下决定何时停止。这个定义刻意避开“看起来像推理”的自然语言表述，而强调可诊断的计算过程。作者进一步区分 memorization、comprehension 和 reasoning。memorization 指近似复现已见输入或答案；comprehension 指利用已学到的局部关联和模式完成回答，但不需要显式多步搜索；reasoning 则要求存在可变深度的中间计算。论文还指出，单次前向传播在结构上不适合作为 variable-depth computation 的主要接口，因为计算深度固定，难以表达输入依赖的搜索和停止。因此，作者主张通过 intermediate decoding 和 externalized reasoning traces 来评估过程。这里的 trace 不限于自然语言 chain-of-thought，也可以是其他外显中间状态。评估目标被概括为 faithfulness 和 validity：前者关注 trace 是否反映模型实际使用的信息和步骤，后者关注这些步骤是否构成有效的问题求解过程。
summary.experiments: 这不是一篇实验型论文，主要由概念分析、基准案例和评测建议构成。文中用 MMLU、TriviaQA、Natural Questions、CommonsenseQA、GSM8K、MATH、AIME、ARC-AGI、GPQA 等作为讨论对象，说明最终准确率为什么不足以区分记忆、理解和推理。一个典型例子是 MMLU 中对 argumentum ad ignorantiam 这类术语定义的考察：正确答案可能来自定义回忆，而不是从题面推导。论文也讨论了 benchmark lottery、数据污染、题目歧义、答案键错误等问题如何改变 headline accuracy 和模型排名。关键实验数字并不是重点，核心信息是：如果评测界面只保留 final answer，就很难定位模型成功或失败的原因。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30 到 45 分钟。优先看 Introduction，理解作者为什么反对只用 answer accuracy 评价推理。然后看 Before Reasoning 中对 memorization、comprehension、reasoning 的区分，这部分最适合作为设计评测集和清洗 reasoning 数据的检查表。再看关于 externalized reasoning traces、faithfulness 和 validity 的章节。对预训练研究员来说，值得深挖的是两个问题：第一，哪些预训练或后训练数据会诱导模型学会稳定的中间状态搜索；第二，过程监督或 RL 是否真的提高了 faithful reasoning，还是只提高了生成可接受解释的能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how reasoning in language models should be measured when final-answer accuracy conflates memorization, pattern-based comprehension, and adaptive multi-step computation.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly about evaluation signals. Many reasoning benchmarks report pass@1 or exact-match accuracy, but these numbers do not tell whether the model recalled a seen fact, exploited local regularities, or performed input-dependent search. This matters for pretraining data curation, reasoning-oriented mid-training, process supervision, and RL reward design. If the reward only observes the final answer, the model can be pushed toward benchmark shortcuts or contaminated recall instead of transferable reasoning procedures. The contribution is not a new model or training objective; it is a useful evaluation vocabulary for diagnosing reasoning data and reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines reasoning, for evaluation purposes, as adaptive multi-step computation. A system must choose intermediate steps and decide when to stop based on the specific input. This separates reasoning from memorization, where an answer is reproduced from prior exposure, and from comprehension, where learned associations and local regularities are enough to answer without an explicit search process. The authors argue that a single forward pass in a scalable architecture has limited ability to expose variable-depth computation, because the computation budget is fixed and the stopping decision is not observable. They therefore argue for intermediate decoding and externalized reasoning traces as the right evaluation interface. These traces need not be natural-language chain-of-thought; the key requirement is that they expose intermediate states that can be checked. The proposed evaluation targets are faithfulness, meaning the trace reflects the computation actually used by the model, and validity, meaning the steps constitute a sound solution process.
summary_en.experiments: This is primarily a conceptual and methodological paper rather than an empirical benchmark paper. It uses examples from MMLU, TriviaQA, Natural Questions, CommonsenseQA, GSM8K, MATH, AIME, ARC-AGI, and GPQA to illustrate why answer accuracy is underdetermined. For example, some MMLU items about named definitions can be answered through recall rather than problem-specific computation. The discussion also covers benchmark-choice sensitivity, data contamination, ambiguity, and answer-key errors, all of which can change headline accuracy and rankings. The main empirical message is indirect: a final-answer-only interface does not provide enough evidence to identify the mechanism behind success or failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand the critique of answer-only reasoning evaluation. Then read the section that separates memorization, comprehension, and reasoning; it is the most useful part for designing or auditing reasoning datasets. The sections on externalized reasoning traces, faithfulness, and validity are the main parts to connect with process supervision and RL. The deeper question for pretraining work is whether a training setup improves faithful intermediate computation or merely improves the production of plausible explanations.

recommendation.zh: 仅看第3章关于单前向传递推理能力上限的论证即可，可用于指导预训练阶段推理范式的选型
recommendation.en: Only read §3 for the argument on the upper bound of single-forward-pass reasoning, which is useful for reasoning paradigm selection during pretraining.

paper.title: Minimizing Collateral Damage in Activation Steering
paper.abstract: Activation steering is a method for controlling Large Language Model (LLM) behavior by intervening in its internal representations to increase the alignment with a specific target feature direction. However, standard interventions, such as vector addition, often cause ``collateral damage", defined as unintended changes in the alignment of activations along other non-target feature directions. This damage occurs because standard methods implicitly assume the isotropy of non-target features. In th

summary.core_problem: 现有激活导向方法在控制LLM行为时，隐含假设非目标特征空间各向同性，容易对非目标特征的激活对齐造成非预期改动（附带损伤），导致导向效果和下游性能存在明确trade-off。
summary.importance: 明确了激活导向附带损伤的几何根源，为不损失模型原有性能的推理侧对齐方法提供了设计思路，也可用于预训练后轻量化对齐方案的效果验证。
summary.technical_approach: 将激活导向建模为带约束的优化问题，以固定目标方向余弦相似度为约束，最小化非目标方向的加权预期激活偏移（权重为激活的经验二阶矩矩阵，适配特征空间各向异性）。提出COAST方法，基于微分几何求解最优激活偏移，泛化了SLERP等现有保范数导向方法，各向同性条件下可退化为SLERP。
summary.experiments: 在Gemma-2-9B-IT上测试，相同导向成功率下，COAST相比ActAdd准确率最高提升20%；相同下游性能下，相比Angular Steering导向成功率最高提升30%，推理开销仅增加0.9%~4%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节优化目标的形式化推导、第4节的对比实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。对激活几何、推理侧对齐感兴趣的研究者可进一步查看附录的收敛性证明。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation steering methods for LLM behavior control implicitly assume isotropy of non-target feature spaces, leading to unintended alignment shifts of non-target activations (collateral damage), which creates a clear trade-off between steering effectiveness and downstream task performance.
summary_en.importance: It identifies the geometric root cause of collateral damage in activation steering, provides design principles for inference-time alignment methods that preserve original model performance, and can be used to verify the effect of lightweight post-pretrain alignment solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Activation steering is formalized as a constrained optimization problem. With a fixed cosine similarity constraint to the target direction, the method minimizes weighted expected activation shift across non-target directions, where weights are the empirical second-moment matrix of activations to adapt to the anisotropic feature space. The proposed COAST framework solves the optimal activation shift via differential geometry methods, generalizing existing norm-preserving steering methods like SLERP, and reduces to SLERP under isotropic conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Gemma-2-9B-IT, COAST achieves up to 20% higher accuracy than ActAdd under the same steering success rate, and up to 30% higher steering success rate than Angular Steering under the same downstream performance, with only 0.9%~4% additional inference overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for formal derivation of the optimization objective and Section 4 for comparative experimental results. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. Researchers interested in activation geometry and inference-time alignment can further read the convergence proof in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 读数学设定和消融即可；它把 steering 的“副作用”从经验现象变成可优化量，值得复现一层。
recommendation.en: Read the formulation and ablations; it turns steering side effects into an optimizable quantity, worth a small internal replication.

paper.title: Beyond Decodability: Reconstructing Language Model Representations with an Encoding Probe
paper.abstract: Probing is widely used to study which features can be decoded from language model representations. However, the common decoding probe approach has two limitations that we aim to solve with our new encoding probe approach: contributions of different features to model representations cannot be directly compared, and feature correlations can affect probing results. We present an Encoding Probe that reverses this direction and reconstructs internal representations of models using interpretable featu

summary.core_problem: 常见 decoding probe 只能判断某些特征能否从模型表示中被解码，难以比较不同特征对表示的实际贡献，也容易被特征相关性误导。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析方法改进：把 probing 的方向从“由表示预测特征”反过来，改成“由可解释特征重建表示”，为比较语音、文本 Transformer 内部表征中的声学、音素、句法、词汇、说话人因素提供更干净的测量视角。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Encoding Probe，用一组可解释特征作为输入去重建模型内部 representation，而不是训练分类器或回归器从 representation 解码标签。这样可以直接比较不同 feature set 对重建误差的贡献，并在一定程度上缓解相关特征导致的虚假可解码性问题。方法覆盖声学、音素、句法、词汇和说话人身份等特征。
summary.experiments: 实验对象包括文本 Transformer 和语音 Transformer。论文比较不同特征集合对内部表示重建的贡献，发现说话人相关因素随训练目标和数据集变化很大，而句法与词汇特征对重建有相对独立的贡献。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tilburg University 和 Radboud University，团队长期关注语言与语音模型表征分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard decoding probes show whether a feature can be read out from a representation, but they do not cleanly compare feature contributions and can be confounded by correlated features.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is methodological: the paper reverses the probing direction and reconstructs internal representations from interpretable features, giving a cleaner lens on acoustic, phonetic, syntactic, lexical, and speaker factors in text and speech Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Encoding Probe uses interpretable feature sets to predict or reconstruct hidden representations, rather than decoding labels from those representations. This setup makes feature-set contributions more directly comparable and reduces misleading conclusions caused by feature correlations. The evaluated features span acoustics, phonetics, syntax, lexicon, and speaker identity.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on both text and speech Transformer models. The main findings are that speaker-related effects vary substantially with training objective and dataset, while syntactic and lexical features contribute independently to reconstruction. The abstract does not report model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tilburg University and Radboud University, with work centered on representation analysis for language and speech models.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读，核心价值是提醒 decoding probe 的可解码性不等于表示贡献；看方法和说话人因素结果即可。
recommendation.en: Not a full read; its useful point is that decodability is not contribution—skim the probe setup and the speaker-factor findings.

paper.title: Perturbation Probing: A Two-Pass-per-Prompt Diagnostic for FFN Behavioral Circuits in Aligned LLMs
paper.abstract: Perturbation probing generates task-specific causal hypotheses for FFN neurons in large language models using two forward passes per prompt and no backpropagation, followed by a one-time intervention sweep of about 150 passes amortized across all identified neurons. Across eight behavioral circuits, 13 models, and four architecture families, we identify two circuit structures that organize LLM behavior. Opposition circuits appear when RLHF suppresses a pre-training tendency. In safety refusal, a

summary.core_problem: 在不做反向传播、且只用极少前向计算的条件下，如何为“某个具体对齐行为”（如安全拒答模板、迎合/二次猜测、语言切换等）生成可检验的因果假设：哪些 FFN 神经元在促进该行为、哪些在抑制该行为，并且在动手干预前就能预判“该用 ablation 还是 direction injection/残差注入”才有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练/对齐闭环的价值主要在两点：第一，把 RLHF/DPO 这类后训练信号如何在参数内部“重分配控制权”变成可量化的结构指标（FFN/Skip ratio）与可复现实证（少量神经元控制模板化行为），有助于理解对齐对基座表征的改写方式与脆弱面。第二，给出一个工程上可用的、近似 O(1) 成本的神经元级诊断流程，用于版本迭代时定位行为漂移来源（是 FFN 集中式控制，还是注意力/残差的路由式控制），从而指导更稳的持续训练/对齐策略与回归测试。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是“两阶段 + 三种干预模式”。阶段一是 ranking：对每个 FFN neuron 计算一个带符号的重要性分数，核心是把(1)结构耦合项 c_n（由权重结构给出，衡量该 neuron 对残差/输出的线性影响通道）与(2)对任务相关扰动的激活响应 Δa_n 相乘，得到 signed score，用两次前向就能为全体神经元生成“促进/抑制该行为”的假设。阶段二是一次性 validation sweep：对排名靠前的神经元做干预验证（论文强调该 sweep 可在所有已识别神经元上摊销，约 150 次量级的前向）。
干预上区分三种模式，并提出 FFN/Skip 诊断：当行为控制集中在 FFN（FFN/Skip 高）时，ablation/放大少量 neuron 就能显著改变行为；当行为主要经由注意力与残差路由（FFN/Skip 低）时，单点 ablation 往往无效，需要在特定层做 direction injection（把线性方向注入残差流）来切换行为。论文把“opposition circuits”定义为 RLHF 与预训练倾向相对抗时出现的集中式控制结构（例如安全拒答模板、sycophancy），把“routing circuits”定义为更分布式、注意力主导的行为通路（例如部分语言切换/路由现象）。此外，作者用不同模型家族的对齐拓扑差异（Qwen/Llama/Gemma）来说明 FFN/Skip 不是抽象概念，而是可观测的架构-训练耦合结果（如 post-norm 对可干预性的屏蔽）。
summary.experiments:
覆盖 13 个模型、4 个架构家族、8 类行为电路。安全拒答上，作者报告约 50 个神经元（约占总 neuron 的 0.014%）控制“拒答模板格式”，对 520 个 AdvBench 提示做 ablation 后，约 80% 的回复格式发生变化；同时“有害服从”几乎为零（3/520，且都带免责声明）。在 200 个 HarmBench 提示上复现，并给出极小 p 值（p < 1e-74）。
语言切换/路由类任务上，direction injection 在满足三条件时有效：存在双语训练、FFN/Skip 落在约 [0.3, 1.1]、且目标方向线性可表征；在 19 个模型里仅 3 个满足并成功，报告在 580 个提示上实现 99.1% 的 EN→ZH 切换。
sycophancy/second-guessing 电路上，在 Qwen3.5-2B 里 ablation 20 个神经元把多轮“迎合式屈从”从 36.7% 降到 0%（30 个多轮问题），但会抑制单轮纠错；对其中 10 个神经元做 2× 放大可把 TruthfulQA 上的纠错从 52% 提到 88%（200 题）。此外给出家族差异：Qwen 更像 FFN bottleneck，Llama 更分布在 skip，Gemma 受 post-normalization 影响更难直接干预。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“方法定义→诊断指标→两类电路→家族对比→案例复现”的顺序读。优先抓三处：1）ranking 分数的推导与为何只需两次前向（重点看 c_n 与 Δa_n 的构造、符号如何对应促进/抑制）；2）FFN/Skip 诊断与三种干预模式的适用边界（论文在 Section 6 给出对线性可表征性、局部性、稀疏性等假设的 regime-of-validity 讨论，值得细读）；3）安全拒答“改模板不改拒答”的实验设置与度量，避免把结果误读为‘解除安全’。如果只泛读，至少把不同模型家族的 safety topology 对比图表看完，因为它直接指向“对齐信号在不同架构里落点不同”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to cheaply generate and validate behavior-specific causal hypotheses at the FFN-neuron level in aligned LLMs—identifying which neurons promote vs oppose a target aligned behavior—using only a couple of forward passes per prompt (no backprop), while also predicting in advance which intervention type (ablation vs residual direction injection) is likely to work.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for the pretrain↔post-train loop because it turns “where alignment lives” into measurable structure rather than anecdotes. The FFN/Skip diagnostic and the opposition-vs-routing circuit distinction help explain when RLHF concentrates control into small FFN bottlenecks (making behavior template edits easy) versus when behavior is routed through attention/residual pathways (making neuron ablation ineffective). This is directly relevant to debugging alignment regressions across model versions and to designing safer continual training where you want predictable, testable behavioral changes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Perturbation Probing is a two-stage pipeline. Stage 1 (ranking) computes a signed importance score for every FFN neuron from two ingredients: a structural coupling term c_n derived from weights (capturing how the neuron couples into the residual/output stream) and a perturbation response Δa_n (how the neuron’s activation changes under a behavior-targeted input perturbation). Their product yields a task-specific, signed hypothesis: neurons that causally push toward the behavior vs away from it. This stage costs two forward passes per prompt.
Stage 2 is a one-time intervention sweep over the top-ranked neurons to causally validate the hypotheses; the sweep cost is amortized across all discovered neurons (reported on the order of ~150 forward passes).
The method also outputs an FFN/Skip diagnostic that predicts whether the behavior is controlled by an FFN-centric “opposition circuit” (amenable to ablation/amplification) or by an attention/residual “routing circuit” (better addressed via layer-targeted direction injection). The paper further argues that architectural choices (e.g., post-norm) change the accessibility of these circuits, yielding different “safety topologies” across model families.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 13 models across four architecture families and eight behavioral circuits. For safety refusal, ~50 neurons (~0.014% of all neurons) are reported to control the refusal template format. Ablating them changes ~80% of response formats on 520 AdvBench prompts while keeping harmful compliance near zero (3/520, all with disclaimers). Replicated on 200 HarmBench prompts with extremely small p-values (p < 1e-74).
For routing-style behaviors, direction injection works only when three empirical conditions hold: bilingual training, FFN/Skip in roughly [0.3, 1.1], and linear representability of the target direction. Only 3/19 tested models satisfy these, achieving 99.1% EN→ZH switching over 580 prompts.
For sycophancy/second-guessing in Qwen3.5-2B, ablating 20 neurons reduces multi-turn capitulation from 36.7% to 0% (30 multi-turn questions) but harms single-turn correction; amplifying 10 neurons by 2× improves correction on TruthfulQA from 52% to 88% (200 prompts). The paper also reports family-level differences: Qwen shows an FFN bottleneck, Llama distributes control via skip connections, and Gemma’s post-norm makes safety harder to access via simple interventions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on (1) the exact definition/derivation of the signed neuron score (how c_n and Δa_n are computed and why two forward passes suffice), (2) the FFN/Skip diagnostic and the mapping to intervention modes (ablation vs direction injection), and (3) the safety refusal experiments to understand the key nuance: the intervention changes refusal templating rather than flipping refusal into compliance. If time is limited, read the sections comparing safety topologies across Qwen/Llama/Gemma, since that’s where the method connects to architecture and alignment training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 refusal ablation 表；“50 个神经元控制拒答模板”若成立，会改变对 RLHF 行为局部性的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and refusal-ablation tables; if the 50-neuron refusal-template claim holds, it changes the prior on RLHF locality.

paper.title: DPN-LE: Dual Personality Neuron Localization and Editing for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: With the widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs), understanding their personality representation mechanisms has become critical. As a novel paradigm in Personality Editing, most existing methods employ neuron-editing to locate and modify LLM neurons, requiring changes to numerous neurons and leading to significant performance degradation. This raises a fundamental question: Are all modified neurons directly related to personality representation? In this work, we investigate and quant

summary.core_problem: 定位并编辑 LLM 中与人格特质相关的神经元，同时尽量减少对通用能力的破坏。
summary.importance: 贡献属于表示机制分析加定向编辑。对预训练研究员的价值不在“人格编辑”本身，而在它提供了一个关于神经元多功能性与可分离表示的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析现有 neuron editing 方法为何会在改人格时伤害通用能力，提出神经元具有多功能性，且相反人格特质呈互斥表示模式；据此设计 DPN-LE，用 dual personality neuron localization 的方式筛出更特异的人格相关神经元，再做编辑以减少副作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验比较了现有人格编辑方法与 DPN-LE 在人格改变效果、通用能力退化和表示层模式上的差异，但未给出模型规模、数据量和具体提升幅度。更像机制验证而非大规模基座结论。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Southeast University、Zhejiang University of Technology、Kuaishou、Northeastern University、Tsinghua University、Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics。未见可明确识别的顶级基座模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to localize and edit personality-related neurons in LLMs while minimizing damage to general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-analysis plus targeted-editing paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is not personality editing per se, but the evidence it offers on neuron multifunctionality and separable internal representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze why existing neuron-editing methods can change personality but hurt general performance. They argue that neurons are multifunctional and that opposing personality traits show mutually exclusive representation patterns. Based on this, DPN-LE performs dual-personality neuron localization to identify more specific neurons before editing.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments compare prior personality-editing methods and DPN-LE on personality shift, general capability degradation, and representation patterns. No model scale, data size, or exact gains are given in the metadata, so this reads more like a mechanism study than a foundation-scale result.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Southeast University, Zhejiang University of Technology, Kuaishou, Northeastern University, Tsinghua University, and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. No clearly identifiable top-tier foundation-model lead author is evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但“神经元多功能、特质表示互斥”这个观察值得记；只看表示分析部分，编辑结果当附带。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the neuron multifunctionality and mutually exclusive trait-representation findings are worth noting; read the analysis, not the editing pitch.

institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

paper.title: reward-lens: A Mechanistic Interpretability Library for Reward Models
paper.abstract: Every RLHF-trained language model is shaped by a reward model, yet the mechanistic interpretability toolkit -- logit lens, direct logit attribution, activation patching, sparse autoencoders -- was built for generative LLMs whose primitives all project onto a vocabulary unembedding. Reward models replace that with a scalar regression head, breaking each tool. We present reward-lens, an open-source library that ports this toolkit to reward models, organised around one observation: the reward head'

summary.core_problem: 把 logit lens、activation patching、SAE attribution 等机制解释工具迁移到 reward model，因为 reward model 输出标量而不是词表 logits。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工具库和分析框架。它面向 RLHF/RLVR 中经常被忽略的 reward model 可解释性，尤其适合排查 reward hacking、偏置特征和多 reward term 冲突。对基座预训练的直接作用有限，但对 post-train 信号质量分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 reward-lens，将 reward head 的权重向量 w_r 作为解释轴，替代生成式 LLM 中的 vocabulary unembedding。库中包含 Reward Lens、component attribution、三种 activation patching、reward-hacking probe suite、TopK SAE feature attribution、cross-model comparison，以及 distortion index、divergence-aware patching、misalignment cascade detection、reward-term conflict analysis、concept-vector analysis 等扩展。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明其 adapter protocol 覆盖 Llama、Mistral、Gemma-2 和 ArmoRM 等模型族，但未给出具体 reward model 规模、数据集、benchmark 或定量发现。更像工具发布与方法整理，实验可信度需要依赖正文案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper adapts mechanistic interpretability tools such as logit lens, activation patching, and SAE attribution to reward models, whose outputs are scalar rewards rather than vocabulary logits.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a library and analysis framework. It is relevant to RLHF/RLVR because reward models define the training signal, and failures such as reward hacking or reward-term conflicts often arise inside that signal rather than inside the policy model.
summary_en.technical_approach: reward-lens treats the reward-head weight vector w_r as the central interpretability axis, replacing the vocabulary unembedding used in generative LLM tools. It includes Reward Lens, component attribution, three activation-patching modes, reward-hacking probes, TopK SAE feature attribution, cross-model comparison, and several extensions such as distortion index and reward-term conflict analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the adapter protocol covers Llama, Mistral, Gemma-2, and ArmoRM families, but it does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, quantitative benchmarks, or empirical findings. The paper should be read as a tooling release unless the full text contains strong case studies.

recommendation.zh: 作为 reward model 排障工具备查即可；核心假设是 w_r 轴足够解释 reward，结论强度要看案例是否干净。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a debugging reference for reward models; the main bet is that the w_r axis is explanatory enough, and the strength depends on clean case studies.

paper.title: Architecture Determines Observability in Transformers
paper.abstract: Autoregressive transformers make confident errors, but activation monitoring can catch them only if the model preserves an internal signal that output confidence does not expose. This preservation is determined by architecture and training recipe. We define observability as the linear readability of per-token decision quality from frozen mid-layer activations after controlling for max-softmax confidence and activation norm. The correction is essential. Confidence controls absorb 57.7% of raw pro

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个很具体但常被混淆的问题：Transformer 内部是否保留了“输出置信度之外”的错误信号，使得外部监控器可以从中间层激活读出 token 级决策质量。作者把这个性质定义为 observability，并指出很多以往 probe 结果其实主要在读 softmax confidence 的影子，而不是独立的内部可监控信号。论文真正要回答的是：这种可观测性是不是 Transformer 的普遍属性，还是由架构配置和训练过程决定的。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在训练动力学与架构选择，而不是直接提升 loss 或 benchmark。它给出一个很清楚的结论：是否能做 activation-based monitoring，不是部署阶段随便加个 probe 就行，而是上游架构和训练 recipe 已经决定了模型会不会保留这类中间信号。这个判断对可监控性、对齐安全、训练诊断都有意义。更重要的是，论文把“probe 能读到什么”从一个模糊 interpretability 话题，收缩成一个可控的、可复现实验对象：在控制 max-softmax 和 activation norm 后，中层线性可读的 residual decision-quality 信号还剩多少。这个定义很窄，但正因为窄，结论更可信。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是“先把输出侧能解释的部分扣掉，再测中间层还能读出多少”。作者对每个 token 计算 cross-entropy loss、max softmax probability，以及某层 residual stream 的 L2 norm。然后用 OLS 回归用后两者去预测 token loss，得到 residual 误差，再把这个 residual 二值化，作为 probe 的目标。接着在冻结模型上，对各中间层训练线性 probe，并用 partial Spearman correlation ρ_partial 衡量 probe 输出与真实 token loss 的相关性，同时控制 max-softmax 和 activation norm。作者还定义了更严格的 r_OC 指标，在此基础上再控制一个基于输出层表示训练的 MLP predictor，用来隔离“输出表征已经足够恢复的部分”。

这个设计的意义在于，它不再把 probe 成功简单解释为“模型内部有额外信息”，而是明确要求这部分信息不能被输出置信度和简单输出侧读出替代。论文也反复强调，observability 只是在这个协议下的线性可读性，不等于模型内部真的在用这条信号做推理，也不等于更广义的 reasoning correctness。

实验设计分三层。第一层是方法学验证：说明如果不做 confidence control，probe 分数会被严重高估。第二层是 Pythia controlled suite 上的因果更强的比较：在同一训练 recipe 下，改变层数和头数等配置，观察 observability 是否系统性塌缩。第三层是跨家族观察性比较：Qwen、Llama、Mistral、GPT-2 等不同模型家族在相近规模下 observability 差异很大，说明 scale 不是主因。

全文最有信息量的技术点是“collapse”概念。作者发现某些架构配置在训练早期其实形成过可观测信号，但随着训练推进，这个信号被抹掉；而另一些配置则能保留或恢复它。这说明 observability 不是静态结构属性，而是架构与优化轨迹共同作用的结果。也因此，论文把 architecture determines observability 说得比较克制：在同一 recipe 内，配置是决定因素；跨 recipe 时，配置与训练动态共同决定塌缩点。
summary.experiments:
方法学结果先给出一个重要校正量：在 13 个模型、6 个家族上，confidence controls 平均吸收了 57.7% 的原始 probe 信号。以 GPT-2 124M 为例，线性 probe 与 token loss 的原始 Spearman 相关是 0.549，但控制 max-softmax 和 activation norm 后只剩 0.282。这说明如果不做 residualization，很多“中层能读出错误”的结论会夸大两到三倍。

Pythia 受控实验是全文最关键的证据。作者在同一训练体系下比较多种配置，发现所有测试过的 (24 layers, 16 heads) 配置都会塌缩到 ρ_partial≈0.10，尽管参数量跨了 3.5 倍、数据还用了两个 Pile 变体；而另外六种配置则能稳定在 0.21 到 0.38 之间。与此同时，r_OC 在同样的配置点也接近 0，说明消失的不是某个 probe 指标偶然失效，而是输出独立的中间可读信号真的没被保留下来。

训练动态分析进一步支持这个结论：在最早测到的 checkpoint 上，塌缩配置和健康配置都能形成这类信号，但后续训练会把 (24L,16H) 这一类配置中的信号擦掉，而健康配置则恢复或维持。这一点很重要，因为它把问题从“某架构天生没有信号”改成“某架构在该优化路径下无法保留信号”。

跨家族结果也很有代表性。在约 3B 规模上，Qwen 2.5 与 Llama 的 observability 相差 2.9 倍，而且 probe seed 分布不重叠；Mistral 7B 与 Llama 3.1 8B 虽然外形上都属于现代 decoder-only Transformer，但 observability 仍明显不同。作者据此认为 scale 不是预测因子，配置才是。另一个实用结果是：在 WikiText 上训练的 observer，不做任务特定训练，也能捕捉一部分下游 QA 中“输出置信度看不见”的错误；而 instruction tuning 不会把 observability 完全抹掉。这说明该信号至少有一定迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Method，把 observability、ρ_partial、r_OC 三个定义吃透。若这几个量没理解清楚，后面的架构结论很容易被误读成一般性的 interpretability 论断。接着看 Section 3 的 control 实验，确认作者为什么坚持必须控制 max-softmax 和 activation norm。这里是全文最重要的测量学基础。

然后重点看 Pythia controlled suite 的结果和 checkpoint dynamics。建议盯住那几张展示不同配置随训练步数变化的图，因为论文最有价值的发现不是“某模型高某模型低”，而是“同一 recipe 下某类配置会在训练中塌缩”。如果只看最终表格，会低估这篇工作的训练动力学含义。

最后再看跨家族比较和 downstream QA 例子，把它当作外部有效性检查，而不是主证据。整篇适合 35 到 50 分钟泛读。若要深挖，值得追问三件事：第一，为什么 24L/16H 这一类配置更容易擦除 residual signal；第二，这个现象与 depth/width/head dimension、归一化位置、优化超参之间是什么关系；第三，observability 与 calibration、loss landscape、representation compression 是否存在更直接的机制联系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether transformers preserve an internal, linearly readable signal about token-level decision quality that is not already exposed by output confidence. The authors call this property observability. Their main claim is that many probe results are confounded: what probes often recover is largely max-softmax confidence in another form, not an independent hidden-state signal. The real question is therefore whether output-independent observability is a generic property of autoregressive transformers or something determined by architecture and training dynamics.
summary_en.importance: This is not a paper about improving perplexity or downstream accuracy. Its value is in architecture, training dynamics, and monitorability. The practical implication is sharp: activation-based monitoring is not merely a deployment-time add-on. Whether such monitoring can work depends on whether the upstream model architecture and recipe preserve the relevant signal during training. That matters for safety monitoring, training diagnostics, and representation analysis. The paper is also methodologically useful because it narrows a vague interpretability question into a measurable one: after controlling for max-softmax confidence and activation norm, how much token-level decision-quality signal remains linearly readable from frozen mid-layer activations?
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core methodological move is residualization. For each token, the authors compute cross-entropy loss, max softmax probability, and the L2 norm of the residual stream at a given layer. They fit an OLS model predicting token loss from max-softmax and activation norm, take the residual, and binarize it to define the probe target. Linear probes are then trained on frozen hidden states from each layer. Observability is measured by partial Spearman correlation, rho_partial, between probe predictions and token loss while controlling for max-softmax and activation norm. A stricter metric, r_OC, additionally controls for a trained output-side predictor based on the final-layer representation.

This matters because the paper is not satisfied with showing that hidden states contain information. It asks whether they contain information that is not recoverable from standard output-side confidence signals. The authors are careful about scope: observability here is linear readability under a specific protocol, not a claim about reasoning correctness, semantic truth, or what the model itself uses internally.

The experimental structure has three layers. First, a measurement layer: show that probe scores are substantially inflated if confidence controls are omitted. Second, a controlled architectural layer using the Pythia suite: under a shared training recipe, vary configuration and test whether observability systematically collapses. Third, an observational cross-family layer: compare GPT-2, Pythia, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and others to show that scale alone does not explain the effect.

The most interesting technical idea in the paper is observability collapse. Some configurations form the signal early in training but later erase it, while others preserve or recover it. That makes observability a joint product of architecture and optimization trajectory rather than a static representational property.
summary_en.experiments:
The first important quantitative result is methodological. Across 13 models from 6 families, confidence controls absorb 57.7% of the raw probe signal on average. On GPT-2 124M, the raw Spearman correlation between a linear probe and token loss is 0.549, but only 0.282 remains after controlling for max-softmax and activation norm. So without residualization, one would overstate output-independent observability by roughly a factor of two.

The strongest evidence comes from the controlled Pythia experiments. Under the same training recipe, every tested run with the (24 layers, 16 heads) configuration collapses to rho_partial around 0.10, despite a 3.5x variation in parameter count and two Pile variants. By contrast, six other configurations land between 0.21 and 0.38. The output-controlled residual r_OC also vanishes at the same collapse points, which supports the interpretation that what disappears is the output-independent hidden-state signal itself, not just a fragile probe metric.

Checkpoint dynamics are especially informative. Both the collapsing and healthy configurations show the signal at the earliest measured checkpoint, but continued training erases it in the 24L/16H class while the healthier configuration recovers or maintains it. This shifts the interpretation from “some architectures never form the signal” to “some architectures fail to preserve it under training.”

The cross-family evidence extends the pattern. At roughly 3B scale, Qwen 2.5 and Llama differ by 2.9x in observability with non-overlapping probe-seed distributions. Mistral 7B and Llama 3.1 8B also diverge despite broadly similar decoder-only shapes. The paper therefore argues that scale is not predictive; configuration is. A practical downstream result is that an observer trained on WikiText can catch a bounded subset of confidence-invisible QA errors without task-specific training, and instruction tuning does not erase observability entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the method section first and make sure the three quantities—observability, rho_partial, and r_OC—are clear. Without that, the architectural claims are easy to overgeneralize into broad interpretability statements that the paper is not making.

Then go to the control experiments showing why max-softmax and activation norm must be regressed out. That is the measurement foundation of the entire paper. After that, spend most of the time on the Pythia controlled suite and the checkpoint-dynamics figures. The most valuable result is not simply that one model family scores higher than another, but that a specific configuration class forms the signal early and then loses it during training.

Treat the cross-family comparisons and downstream QA transfer as external-validity checks rather than the main causal evidence. A skim should take 35–50 minutes. If reading more deeply, the main follow-up questions are why the 24L/16H class is especially prone to signal erasure, how this relates to depth/width/head-dimension and optimization choices, and whether observability connects mechanistically to calibration, representation compression, or loss-landscape geometry.

recommendation.zh: 读定义和 Pythia 对照实验；若结果站得住，内部 probe 评测必须加 confidence/norm 控制。
recommendation.en: Read the definition and Pythia controls; if robust, internal probing evaluations need confidence and norm residualization.

paper.title: Independent-Component-Based Encoding Models of Brain Activity During Story Comprehension
paper.abstract: Encoding models provide a powerful framework for linking continuous stimulus features to neural activity; however, traditional voxelwise approaches are limited by measurement noise, inter-subject variability, and redundancy arising from spatially correlated voxels encoding overlapping neural signals. Here, we propose an independent component (IC)-based encoding framework that dissociates stimulus-driven and noise-driven signals in fMRI data. We decompose continuous fMRI data from naturalistic st

summary.core_problem: 传统 voxelwise fMRI encoding model 容易受测量噪声、被试差异和空间相关冗余影响，难以干净地分析故事理解时语言表征与脑活动的对应关系。
summary.importance: 贡献是 LLM 表征与脑活动对齐的分析方法改进。它对语言表征可解释性有旁路参考价值，但不直接指导预训练目标、数据配比或架构选择。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于 independent component 的 encoding framework。方法先在一部分自然故事聆听 fMRI 数据上分解出 independent components，再在独立数据上训练 encoding model，用 LLM 的语言输入表示预测这些 IC time series，从而区分 stimulus-driven 和 noise-driven signals。
summary.experiments: 实验使用自然故事聆听场景下的连续 fMRI 数据。摘要称一部分 IC 在跨被试上有稳定高 predictivity，空间和时间结构一致，并覆盖听觉和语言相关认知网络；听觉 component 与 acoustic stimulus 特征强相关。摘要未报告 LLM 类型、层数、被试数量和数值指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Institute of Technology 电气与计算机工程学院、心理学院，以及 Stanford University 语言学系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses noise, subject variability, and spatial redundancy in voxelwise fMRI encoding models for story comprehension.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis method for aligning LLM-derived linguistic representations with brain activity. It is useful background for representation analysis, but it does not directly inform pretraining objectives, data mixtures, or model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an independent-component-based encoding framework. They decompose continuous fMRI recordings from naturalistic story listening into independent components on one data split, then train encoding models on independent data to predict IC time series from LLM representations of the linguistic input.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use continuous fMRI data from naturalistic story listening. The abstract reports that a subset of ICs is consistently predictable across subjects, spatially and temporally stable, and maps to auditory and language networks; auditory components correlate strongly with acoustic stimulus features. The provided abstract does not specify the LLM, number of subjects, or numerical metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Georgia Institute of Technology and Stanford University's Department of Linguistics.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 LLM 表征-脑活动对齐的分析备查；IC trick 有用，但对预训练动作的牵引很弱。
